paper.title: Spurious Advantage Hidden in GRPO
paper.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely studied for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, where its advantage estimator assigns each rollout a magnitude from within-group reward statistics. In the common case, this magnitude rewards rollouts that reach the correct answer through reasoning. Yet, an overlooked case shares the same surface: a rollout may land on it by guessing, and the formula still assigns a high magnitude, which we identify as the spurious advantage. This ar

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作指出 GRPO 的组内标准化 advantage 会把“猜中答案”的 rollout 和“推理得到答案”的 rollout 赋予相同方向、相同量级的正梯度权重，从而在有界答案或 outcome-only 搜索任务中引入 spurious advantage。
summary.importance: 这对 RLVR 和推理模型 post-train 很有实际意义。GRPO 常被当作相对稳健的二元 verifier 训练配方，但它的 advantage 幅度依赖组内正确/错误比例，而不是轨迹质量。对于选择题、短数值答案、可枚举答案、以及多路径搜索 agent，正确结果中会混入猜测或低质量路径。若这些轨迹被高权重 imitation，模型可能学到答案分布和投机策略，而不是更可靠的推理过程。这个问题也提醒预训练研究者：后训练信号的结构会反向影响对基座能力的判断，不能只看 reward 命中率。
summary.technical_approach: 作者从 GRPO 的二元奖励推导入手。对一组 G 个 rollout，奖励 r_i∈{+1,-1}，组内有 n+ 个正确、n- 个错误。GRPO 使用组内均值和方差标准化 reward。代入二元奖励后，正确样本的 advantage 幅度随组内 composition 变化；当正确样本少时，单个正确样本会得到更大的正权重。问题在于，公式无法区分这个正确样本是推理得到，还是在小候选集合中猜中。作者把这种来自猜测概率、但进入梯度权重的部分称为 spurious advantage。为此提出 SignBalance：保留 verifier 给出的正负号，但把 per-rollout magnitude 换成与组内 composition 无关的全局尺度；再用 stop-gradient 的按类别 rescaling 恢复 batch-level 的零均值力平衡。它不引入新参数，不改 PPO-style surrogate，也没有额外推理开销。
summary.experiments: 论文识别了三类 spurious advantage 容易变大的场景。第一是显式有界答案任务，例如 k 选一的多选题，随机猜测也有 1/k 的命中率。第二是表面开放、实际含有大量有界子问题的训练集；作者统计 MATH-7.5K 中 55.95% 的题目具有短数值或类别答案，因此并非完全开放答案分布。第三是 search agent；更大的搜索预算会打开更多路径，许多冗余或无效搜索仍可能通过 outcome-only reward 得到正确最终答案。实验覆盖数学推理和搜索 agent，并在不同模型尺度上比较 GRPO 与 SignBalance，报告了较一致的收益。给出的全文片段没有包含完整表格数字，因此更稳妥的读法是关注各任务中错误行为是否下降，以及收益是否来自降低猜测/绕路轨迹的权重，而不只是最终准确率变化。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 3.2–3.4 的推导和方法部分，再看 Table 1 中 MATH-7.5K 的有界答案统计，以及实验表里 SignBalance 相对 GRPO 的分任务变化。预计 20–30 分钟。重点不是记住一个新 estimator 名字，而是看清 GRPO 的 advantage 幅度怎样由组内 composition 决定，以及为什么二元 outcome reward 在有界答案和搜索场景中会把幸运轨迹放大。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper identifies a failure mode in GRPO: within-group reward normalization can assign the same positive advantage magnitude to a rollout that guessed the answer and a rollout that reached the answer through reasoning. This creates a spurious advantage signal in bounded-answer and outcome-only search settings.
summary_en.importance: The result is relevant to RLVR and reasoning post-training. GRPO is often used with binary verifiers, but its advantage magnitude depends on the correct/wrong composition inside a rollout group rather than on the causal quality of the trajectory. In multiple-choice tasks, short-answer math, enumerable subcases, and search agents with many possible paths, some correct rollouts are lucky or low-quality. If these rollouts receive high imitation weight, the policy can learn answer priors or search detours instead of robust reasoning. For foundation-model training, the broader lesson is that the structure of the post-training signal can distort conclusions about model capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis starts from binary-reward GRPO. For a group of G rollouts with rewards r_i∈{+1,-1}, let n+ and n- be the counts of correct and wrong rollouts. GRPO standardizes rewards using the within-group mean and variance. Substituting binary rewards shows that the advantage magnitude is determined by the group composition. In particular, when positives are rare, a positive rollout receives a large positive weight. The estimator cannot tell whether that positive rollout came from reasoning or from chance. The proposed estimator, SignBalance, keeps the verifier sign but replaces the composition-dependent magnitude with a global scale. It then uses stop-gradient per-class rescaling to restore batch-level zero-mean force balance. The PPO-style surrogate is left unchanged, and the method adds no parameters, external model, or inference-time cost.
summary_en.experiments: The paper highlights three regimes where the spurious component becomes large. The first is explicitly bounded-answer tasks, such as k-way multiple choice, where random guessing succeeds with probability 1/k. The second is nominally open-answer data with bounded subcases; the paper reports that 55.95% of MATH-7.5K problems admit short numeric or categorical answers. The third is search-agent training with outcome-only reward, where a larger action budget opens many redundant or invalid paths that can still end at the correct answer. Experiments span math reasoning and search-agent tasks across different model scales, and the reported pattern favors SignBalance over the standard GRPO estimator. The provided text does not include the full result tables, so the most useful reading is to check whether the gains align with reduced guessing or detour-like behavior rather than only final accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Sections 3.2–3.4 for the derivation and the SignBalance estimator, then inspect Table 1 for the bounded-answer analysis of MATH-7.5K and the experiment tables for task-wise differences from GRPO. A focused read should take 20–30 minutes. The key point is how GRPO’s advantage magnitude is tied to within-group composition, and why binary outcome rewards can amplify lucky trajectories in bounded-answer and search settings.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，因为它不是在调参，而是在拆 GRPO 奖励形状本身的病灶；做 RLVR 的应先复查自家 bounded-answer 任务有没有被“猜对”污染。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it attacks the reward geometry of GRPO itself, not just tuning; if you run RLVR, first audit whether bounded-answer tasks are being polluted by lucky guesses.

paper.title: DE-Venus: A Data-Efficient RLVR Framework for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves large language model reasoning, but its practical scaling is constrained by expensive on-policy rollouts and the cost of obtaining reliable targets at scale. Existing methods address sample selection, incomplete supervision, or noisy labels separately, often entangling supervision logic with distributed training and hindering controlled comparison and reuse. We present DE-Venus, a unified framework for data-efficient RLVR that treats

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 RLVR 里一个很实际但常被拆碎讨论的问题：在可验证奖励的推理训练中，真正稀缺的不是单一环节，而是整条 supervision lifecycle 的效率——哪些样本值得 rollout，哪些样本值得人工或外部标注，哪些无标注样本可以构造弱监督，哪些监督信号在训练中需要修正。现有方法通常只优化其中一段，而且实现上深度耦合到各自 trainer，导致很难复现、很难公平比较，也很难把一种监督策略迁移到另一套分布式 RL 基础设施上。DE-Venus 试图解决的核心问题，就是把这些分散的方法抽象成统一的监督状态流转框架。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究员而言，这篇工作的价值不在于又提出一个 RL 算法，而在于它把 post-train 阶段里“数据效率”重新定义成一个端到端监督管理问题。这个视角和 pretrain 很接近：预训练里关心数据筛选、质量、课程、噪声与重复；RLVR 里对应的是样本选择、弱监督构造、在线修正和持久化状态管理。两者共享同一类问题——训练信号不是静态真值，而是带置信度、会演化、会污染优化过程的对象。DE-Venus 的贡献更像一个方法学基础设施：它让不同 supervision 策略可以在同一执行后端上做可控比较，这对理解 RL 信号质量、数据预算分配、以及 pretrain↔post-train 接口都很有帮助。
summary.technical_approach:
文章的核心设计是把 supervision 当成“随训练演化的状态”，而不是固定标签。围绕这个抽象，框架分成三个模块，但作者强调它们是互补的 intervention points，不是必须串行执行的流水线。

第一块是 Active Data Selection。目标是在训练预算和标注预算有限时，决定哪些样本进入训练、哪些样本需要外部标注、哪些样本转入弱监督路径。实现上覆盖 verified difficulty filtering、基于模型不确定性的选择、以及 probe-calibrated selection 等。这里的关键不是某一种打分器，而是把“是否值得花 rollout/annotation 成本”前置成显式决策。

第二块是 Weak Supervision Construction。它让无标注样本也能参与 RLVR，包括伪目标构造、cross-view agreement、以及 target-free reward 等机制。文中把 TTRL、Co-Rewarding、EMRL、Intuitor 这类方法都纳入同一接口。这样做的意义在于，弱监督不再需要重写整套 rollout-optimization loop，而是作为 supervision semantics 的一种实现被注入。

第三块是 Training-Time Supervision Refinement。训练过程中，已有监督或构造监督可能因为噪声、策略漂移、奖励黑客等问题变得不可靠，因此框架支持基于 reward dynamics、表示几何、rollout evidence 的在线重估和修正，对应 TraPO、GeoMin、online label refinement 等方法。这里最重要的思想是：监督质量不是离线一次性决定的，而应在 policy 改变后被重新审视。

工程上，DE-Venus 采用“minimal-invasion”设计，保留 verl 作为 rollout、优化、验证、checkpoint 的执行底座，只在 supervision 语义发生变化的边界处插入模块。数据层用统一的 Parquet 约定记录样本身份和监督状态；训练批次则以 verl 兼容格式携带 targets、rewards、selection、advantages 等字段。再配合 voting、verification、uncertainty estimation、reward construction、evidence analysis、validation logging 等可复用服务，达到方法解耦和后端复用。这个设计选择比单个算法细节更重要，因为它决定了不同 RLVR 方法能否在同一系统里做 apples-to-apples 比较。
summary.experiments:
从全文片段可确认，作者实现并纳入了七类代表性方法以及一个 active data selection pipeline，并在公开 reasoning benchmark 和三个 business scenario 上做评测。实验目标不是证明某个新算法单点最优，而是验证统一框架在多种 supervision setting 下都能复现并承载已有方法，同时在数据效率上取得稳定收益。

摘要里明确给出的结果方向是：在标准数学和通用推理基准上，DE-Venus 能在更少标注或更少 rollout 成本下维持甚至提升 RLVR 效果；并且由于监督逻辑与分布式执行解耦，方法切换和组合更容易，复现实验成本更低。全文片段没有包含完整数值表，因此不能在这里捏造具体提升百分比、样本节省比例或 benchmark 分数。

更值得注意的是实验设计意图。作者不是只做单模块 ablation，而是把 active selection、weak supervision、training-time refinement 放在统一状态机里，考察它们在不同数据条件下的适用边界。这种实验结构对于理解 RLVR 的“信号质量瓶颈”比单纯追求某个任务分数更有信息量。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议按“抽象层级”来读，而不是按模块名逐段扫。先看 Introduction 里对 supervision lifecycle 的定义，确认作者为什么认为现有 RLVR 方法难比较、难复用。然后直接看框架总览图和数据/执行边界设计，重点理解 persistent supervision state、Parquet convention、verl-compatible batch 这几个接口对象。只有把这些接口看明白，后面各方法如何接入才不会显得像工程拼装。

接着看三类模块各自对应的代表方法，抓住它们介入训练流程的位置：训练前选样本、训练中构造信号、训练中或轮间修正信号。最后再看实验部分，重点看两类内容：一是统一后端下不同方法的可复现性和可组合性；二是在相同预算下的数据效率变化。若只想快速判断是否值得跟进，读引言、系统设计图、一个 active selection 例子、一个 weak supervision 例子、一个 refinement 例子，再扫主结果表，约 25–35 分钟足够。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical bottleneck in RL with verifiable rewards: data efficiency is not just about selecting a smaller training set, but about managing the entire supervision lifecycle. In RLVR, one must decide which questions deserve rollout compute, which require external annotation, how unlabeled examples can still provide useful learning signals, and when existing supervision should be revised because it is noisy or stale. Prior work usually tackles one of these stages in isolation and often hard-codes the logic into a custom trainer. DE-Venus tries to unify these pieces under a common abstraction so that supervision strategies can be compared, reused, and combined without rebuilding the distributed RL stack each time.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining-oriented readers is indirect but real. The paper reframes post-training data efficiency in a way that closely mirrors pretraining concerns: sample selection, signal quality, weak labels, curriculum, and dynamic trust in the data. The main contribution is not a new policy optimizer. It is a systems-and-methodology layer that treats supervision as a first-class evolving object. That is useful for studying the pretrain–post-train interface, especially if one cares about how noisy or partial training signals shape model behavior, how reward quality interacts with optimization, and how to run controlled comparisons across RLVR methods instead of comparing entangled pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The central idea is to model supervision as evolving state rather than fixed labels. On top of that abstraction, the framework organizes the lifecycle into three modules, which are presented as complementary intervention points rather than a mandatory sequential pipeline.

The first module is Active Data Selection. It decides which examples should be retained for training, which should receive external labels, and which should be routed to weak supervision. Implementations include verified-difficulty filtering, model-based uncertainty selection, and probe-calibrated selection. The important design choice is that budget allocation is made explicit before expensive rollout and annotation are spent.

The second module is Weak Supervision Construction. It allows unlabeled examples to participate in RLVR by constructing pseudo-targets, enforcing agreement across views, or assigning target-free rewards. The framework covers methods such as TTRL, Co-Rewarding, EMRL, and Intuitor under a shared interface. This matters because weak supervision no longer requires rewriting the rollout-to-update loop; it becomes a localized change in supervision semantics.

The third module is Training-Time Supervision Refinement. Since supervision can become unreliable due to noise, policy drift, or reward hacking, the framework supports online reassessment and revision using reward dynamics, representation geometry, and rollout evidence. This includes methods such as TraPO, GeoMin, and online label refinement. The deeper point is that supervision quality should be revisited as the policy changes, not fixed once offline.

At the systems level, DE-Venus follows a minimal-invasion design. It keeps verl as the execution substrate for rollout generation, optimization, validation, and checkpointing, and inserts method-specific logic only at the boundaries where supervision semantics change. Persistent sample identity and supervision state are stored through a shared Parquet convention, while verl-compatible batches carry targets, rewards, selections, and advantages during online optimization. Reusable services handle voting, verification, uncertainty estimation, reward construction, evidence analysis, and validation logging. This architecture is arguably the main contribution because it enables apples-to-apples comparisons across heterogeneous RLVR supervision methods.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, the framework includes reproducible implementations for seven representative methods plus an active data-selection pipeline, and it is evaluated on public reasoning benchmarks as well as three business scenarios. The experimental goal is not to claim that one new algorithm dominates all others. Instead, it is to show that a unified framework can host multiple supervision regimes, reproduce them on a common backend, and improve data efficiency under realistic RLVR constraints.

The abstract indicates that on standard math and general reasoning benchmarks, DE-Venus can preserve or improve RLVR effectiveness while reducing annotation or rollout cost. It also claims practical benefits from decoupling supervision logic from distributed execution, making method switching and controlled comparison easier. The excerpt does not include the full numeric tables, so exact gains, budget reductions, or benchmark scores should not be fabricated here.

What is more interesting than any single score is the experimental structure. The paper evaluates active selection, weak supervision, and training-time refinement within one supervision-state framework, which makes it easier to study where the real bottlenecks are: sample utility, missing labels, or supervision reliability during optimization.
summary_en.reading_guide:
A good way to read this paper is by abstraction level rather than by module name. Start with the introduction and the motivation for treating supervision as a lifecycle. The key question is why existing RLVR methods are hard to compare and hard to reuse. Then move directly to the system overview and the data/execution boundary design. Pay attention to persistent supervision state, the Parquet data convention, and the verl-compatible batch contract. Those interfaces are the backbone of the paper.

After that, read one representative method from each of the three intervention points: one active selection method, one weak supervision method, and one training-time refinement method. That is enough to understand how the framework localizes supervision-specific logic. Finally, skim the experiments with two questions in mind: does the common backend preserve method fidelity, and what kinds of data-efficiency gains appear under matched budgets? For a first pass, Introduction, the framework overview figure, one example per module, and the main results table should take about 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 系统化了 RLVR（如 R1-Zero 范式）中的数据效率问题，将弱监督和数据选择解耦，对正在做 reasoning RL 的团队有工程和方法论参考价值。
recommendation.en: Systematizes data efficiency in RLVR (like the R1-Zero paradigm), decoupling weak supervision and data selection; offers engineering and methodological reference for teams working on reasoning RL.

paper.title: Gradients Know What Outcomes Don't: Unlocking Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning with Gradient-Aligned Rewards
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) drives chain-of-thought reasoning in large language models, yet its binary outcome reward cannot distinguish among correct trajectories. Existing dense reward alternatives, from surface heuristics to process reward models, either ignore the expert solutions already present in training corpora or require expensive offline annotation. We propose Gradient-Aligned Reward (GAR), which operates in the policy's own gradient space: truncated backprop

summary.core_problem: RLVR 只用最终答案的二值验证奖励时，无法区分多个正确解答之间的推理质量。训练后期同一组 rollout 中正确样本比例升高后，GRPO 的组内优势信号会变平，正确轨迹之间没有可学习的偏好，容易带来信用分配不足和更新不稳定。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在 Pretrain ↔ Posttrain 接口。GAR 把已有数学语料中的专家 CoT 从“监督微调标签”转成在线 RL 的 dense reward anchor，不需要额外 PRM 标注，也不依赖长度、格式这类表面启发式。它提示了一条可复用路径：利用当前策略的梯度空间来度量轨迹是否在更新同一类推理能力，而不是只比较文本相似度或最终答案。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Gradient-Aligned Reward。对同一个问题，策略生成候选解答，训练语料提供专家 CoT anchor。GAR 分别计算候选解答和专家解答在 teacher-forcing NLL 下的梯度方向，然后用余弦相似度作为额外奖励。完整参数梯度开销太大，所以只对输出投影层做截断反传，冻结 Transformer body，得到一个紧凑的 LM head 梯度向量。这个设计和 PRM 的区别在于：奖励模型不是离线训练出来的外部模型，而是直接来自当前 policy 的梯度几何；和文本匹配不同，它比较的是“如果用这条轨迹训练模型，会推动哪些输出层方向”。论文还给出一个分解结果：梯度余弦可以拆成预测误差因子和激活模式因子，分别对应 token-level 预测差异和内部表示/激活路径差异。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B base model，在 GRPO 风格的 RLVR 训练中加入 GAR。论文报告在四个竞赛级数学 benchmark 上获得稳定 pass@k 提升，并在没有领域专门训练数据的情况下迁移到 GPQA Diamond 和 MMLU-Pro。系统开销是方法的一个重点：只反传 LM head 后，额外 wall-clock overhead 小于 9%。从实验叙述看，关键结论不是单一 benchmark 的峰值，而是 dense reward 在“多个正确答案并存”的训练阶段仍能提供组内区分信号。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 outcome-only RLVR 信号退化的分析，以及 Method 中 GAR 如何构造 expert-anchor gradient。Theorem 2 的分解值得看，它说明这个奖励为什么不只是文本相似度的替代品。实验部分重点看三类结果：数学 pass@k、GPQA/MMLU-Pro 迁移、以及开销统计。若只关心能否落地，可以直接看 LM head 截断反传的实现细节和与 GRPO reward mixing 的位置。

summary_en.core_problem: Outcome-only RLVR gives the same binary reward to all correct rollouts. Once many samples in a group are correct, GRPO loses preference information within that subset, so it cannot reinforce better reasoning traces over weaker but still correct ones.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining research is the interface between existing CoT corpora and online RL. GAR turns expert solutions that already exist in math datasets into a dense reward, without step-level PRM annotation and without relying on shallow heuristics such as length or formatting. The broader idea is to compare trajectories by the update directions they induce in the current policy, rather than by surface text overlap or final-answer correctness alone.
summary_en.technical_approach: Gradient-Aligned Reward computes a teacher-forced NLL gradient for a policy rollout and for an expert anchor solution, then uses their cosine similarity as a process-level reward. Full-parameter gradients would be too expensive, so the paper uses truncated backpropagation through only the output projection layer while freezing the Transformer body. This produces a compact gradient representation tied to the current policy. The method differs from PRMs because the reward is not an offline model trained on a fixed distribution; it is computed online in the policy’s own gradient space. The paper also derives a multiplicative decomposition of the cosine signal into a prediction-error term and an activation-pattern term, which clarifies why the score captures more than lexical similarity.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B base models trained with RLVR-style optimization. GAR gives consistent pass@k gains on four competition-level math benchmarks and transfers to GPQA Diamond and MMLU-Pro without task-specific training data. The reported compute overhead is below 9% wall-clock time because only the LM head is backpropagated for the alignment score. The main empirical message is that GAR preserves useful within-group reward variance when multiple rollouts already satisfy the final verifier.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Read the introduction for the failure mode of binary RLVR, then the method section for expert-anchor gradient construction and truncated LM-head backpropagation. Theorem 2 is worth checking because it explains what the gradient cosine is measuring. In the experiments, focus on math pass@k, transfer to GPQA/MMLU-Pro, and the overhead table or figure. For implementation, the key detail is where GAR is inserted into the GRPO reward pipeline.

recommendation.zh: 值得看奖励定义和分解推导；若开销真低于 9%，可以放进内部 RLVR ablation 验证。
recommendation.en: Read the reward definition and decomposition; if the sub-9% overhead holds, it deserves an internal RLVR ablation.

paper.title: Cliff: Learning Process Rewards from the First Mistake
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for large language model (LLM) post-training, but its reliance on coarse outcome rewards leads to limited guidance on intermediate reasoning processes. Existing approaches such as process reward modeling and on-policy distillation introduce additional constraints, such as reliance on a specialized reward model or assuming identical reasoning patterns between teacher and student. Nevertheless, we observe that

summary.core_problem: 解决 RLVR 只给 outcome reward、对中间推理步骤监督过粗的问题，尤其是在长链推理中 credit assignment 很差。
summary.importance: 这是后训练中的 reward shaping 工作。它不直接改预训练，但和推理型 post-train 如何产生更干净训练信号高度相关，对理解 process supervision、prefix correctness 和 reward hacking 都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 核心观察是：一条推理轨迹一旦第一次出错，后续 token 大多建立在错误前缀上，继续细评价值有限。基于此，Cliff 用现成 LLM teacher 找到每个 rollout 的 first mistake，把轨迹切成正确前缀和错误后缀，再转成 token-level advantage：对正确前缀给正向激励，对错误后缀施加惩罚。这样避免训练专门的 process reward model，也不要求 teacher 和 student 共享同样推理路径。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、任务集和提升幅度，但从设定看，baseline 应包括 outcome-only RLVR、process reward modeling 和 on-policy distillation。论文的关键看点应是：first-mistake 定位是否稳定、token-level shaping 是否比 outcome reward 更 sample-efficient，以及 teacher 误判会不会引入系统偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the coarse credit assignment of outcome-only RLVR, which provides weak supervision over intermediate reasoning steps.
summary_en.importance: This is a reward-shaping paper for post-training. It does not change pretraining directly, but it is relevant to how reasoning-oriented post-training can produce cleaner learning signals and what that implies for process supervision and reward hacking.
summary_en.technical_approach: The key observation is that once a reasoning trajectory makes its first mistake, the remaining tokens are conditioned on an invalid prefix and carry limited additional information. Cliff uses an off-the-shelf LLM teacher to identify that first mistake, splits each rollout into a correct prefix and incorrect suffix, and converts the signal into token-level advantages that reward the prefix and penalize the suffix. This avoids training a dedicated process reward model and does not assume teacher-student reasoning-path identity.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, or exact gains. Likely baselines include outcome-only RLVR, process reward modeling, and on-policy distillation. The main things to inspect are whether first-mistake localization is stable, whether token-level shaping improves sample efficiency, and how sensitive the method is to teacher mislabeling.

recommendation.zh: first-mistake 这个切分很像把 process supervision 压缩成更便宜的 credit assignment；先看 teacher 标注误差和 ablation，若干净，值得并入 RLVR 内部配方试一轮。
recommendation.en: The first-mistake split is a neat way to compress process supervision into cheaper credit assignment; check teacher-label noise and ablations first, then consider a quick RLVR replication.

paper.title: From Base Rollouts to RL Reasoning: A Budgeted Search Perspective
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves language-model reasoning, but how these gains relate to inference-time decoding and search remains unclear. Does RL create reasoning the base model lacks, or shift the rollout distribution toward trajectories it can already reach but rarely samples? We study this behaviorally with a Unified Decoding Framework (UDF), which expresses token-level sampling, beam-like search, tree search, and sequence-level resampling as executable polici

summary.core_problem: 解决 RLVR 提升推理能力时，一个关键但常被混淆的问题：RL 到底创造了基座模型原本没有的推理轨迹，还是主要把采样分布推向了基座已具备但低概率的正确轨迹。
summary.importance: 这是推理阶段 scaling 与 post-train 作用机理分析。价值不在新算法，而在把 RL checkpoint 与 base checkpoint 放到统一预算化搜索空间里比较，试图回答“RL 增益有多少可被更强 decoding/search 替代”。这对 pretrain↔posttrain 接口、test-time compute 分配和 RL 目标设计都有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Unified Decoding Framework，把 token 采样、beam-like search、tree search、sequence-level resampling 统一成共享预算空间中的可执行策略；在 paired Base/RL checkpoints 上，比较不同预算下的 pass@k、self-consistency、best-of-N、first-finish success，并拟合一个 Budgeted Operating-Point Transition Rule：N_Base≈αN_RL^β，用来描述 base 通过增加搜索预算逼近 RL 默认策略曲线的程度。
summary.experiments: 使用 SimpleRL-Zoo 的 Base/RL 配对 checkpoint，在 Math500、AIME、GPQA、IFEval 上做行为比较。摘要声称 pass@k 的恢复路径可由带 benchmark 条件的 BOPTR 拟合，说明 RL 增益在相当程度上可映射为预算化搜索优势；但摘要未给出 α、β 的稳定区间、模型规模和失效案例，结论仍需看正文中的 clean setup 与控制变量。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks a central question behind RLVR gains in reasoning: does RL create reasoning trajectories absent from the base model, or does it mostly shift probability mass toward trajectories the base model already has but rarely samples?
summary_en.importance: This is a scaling-and-mechanism paper for inference-time compute and post-training. Its value is not a new algorithm, but a cleaner comparison of Base and RL checkpoints inside a unified budgeted search space, directly informing the pretrain↔post-train interface, test-time compute allocation, and what RL is actually buying.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces a Unified Decoding Framework that expresses token sampling, beam-like search, tree search, and sequence-level resampling as executable policies in a shared budgeted operating space. Using paired Base/RL checkpoints, it compares pass@k, self-consistency, best-of-N, and first-finish success under matched budgets, and fits a Budgeted Operating-Point Transition Rule, N_Base ≈ αN_RL^β, to quantify how far stronger search on the base model can recover the RL policy curve.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use paired Base/RL checkpoints from SimpleRL-Zoo on Math500, AIME, GPQA, and IFEval. The abstract claims that pass@k recovery follows a benchmark-conditioned BOPTR, suggesting that a substantial part of RL gains can be interpreted as search-budget advantages. However, the abstract does not report the stability range of α and β, model sizes, or failure regimes, so the credibility depends on how clean the controls are in the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接影响你怎么看 RL reasoning：若 setup 干净，它说明不少 RL 增益其实是搜索分布重排，不是新能力生成；先看 BOPTR 拟合和失败点。
recommendation.en: This can change how you interpret RL reasoning gains: if the setup is clean, much of the gain may be distribution reshaping under search rather than new capability creation—start with the BOPTR fits and the failure cases.

paper.title: Where the Verifier Fails: A Category-Level Audit of Reward Signals in RLVR
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and standard benchmark evaluation both rely on an automatic verifier that turns a free text answer into a binary reward. Prior work reports that one evaluation harness accepts only about 94% of its own ground truth answers, blaming LaTeX parsing. That is an aggregate: it does not say which answer forms consume the error budget. We supply the decomposition. We apply metamorphic testing to the verifier rather than the model, generating certifie

summary.core_problem: 在基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）和标准基准评测中，自动验证器（Verifier）的错误被笼统地归咎于 LaTeX 解析失败，缺乏对具体错误类型和机制的细粒度分析。
summary.importance: 揭示了验证器错误并非随机噪声，而是具有高度系统性和实现依赖性。这直接影响 RLVR 的训练动态（如导致次优解或崩溃）和基准评测的公平性，为后续改进验证器和 RLVR 算法提供了关键的实证基础。
summary.technical_approach: 引入蜕变测试（Metamorphic Testing）审计验证器。通过构建保持数学语义等价的答案变体（如改变空格、标点或等价数学表达），在无需人工标注的情况下，自动检测验证器的假阴性（拒绝正确答案）和假阳性（接受错误答案）。测试覆盖了 4 种常用验证器、43 种变换和 307,420 次判定。
summary.experiments: 发现验证器对等价变体的接受率在 53.8% 到 95.2% 之间波动，同一库的不同配置差异达 26 个百分点。错误主要源于基础的字符串清理（如空格和标点占默认 LaTeX 配置错误的 93.0%），而非复杂的语法解析。此外，发现 sympy-cascade 存在与数值尺度相关的确定性假阳性缺陷。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Introduction 中对验证器系统性错误的讨论，以及 Method 中蜕变测试的构建逻辑。实验部分关于不同验证器错误分布的对比（尤其是字符串清理导致的错误比例）值得细读。

summary_en.core_problem: In Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) and standard benchmark evaluations, automatic verifier errors are vaguely attributed to LaTeX parsing failures, lacking a fine-grained analysis of specific error types and mechanisms.
summary_en.importance: Reveals that verifier errors are not random noise but highly systematic and implementation-dependent. This directly impacts RLVR training dynamics (e.g., causing suboptimal plateaus or collapse) and benchmark fairness, providing a crucial empirical foundation for improving verifiers and RLVR algorithms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces metamorphic testing to audit verifiers. By constructing mathematically equivalent answer variants (e.g., altering whitespace, punctuation, or equivalent mathematical expressions), it automatically detects false negatives and false positives without human annotation. The audit covers 4 common verifiers, 43 transformations, and 307,420 verdicts.
summary_en.experiments: Acceptance rates for equivalent variants range from 53.8% to 95.2% across verifiers, with a 26-point difference between configurations of the same library. Errors primarily stem from basic string hygiene (e.g., whitespace and punctuation account for 93.0% of errors in the default LaTeX configuration) rather than complex grammar parsing. Additionally, a scale-dependent deterministic false-positive flaw was identified in sympy-cascade.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the discussion of systematic verifier errors in the Introduction and the logic of metamorphic testing in the Method section. The experimental comparison of error distributions across verifiers, especially the high proportion of string hygiene errors, is worth a close read.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了RLVR中verifier的脆弱性，假阴性率极高且受实现细节影响大，做RLVR/数学推理的同学必看其错误分类，有助于改进reward shaping。
recommendation.en: Exposes the fragility of verifiers in RLVR, showing high false negative rates heavily influenced by implementation details; a must-read for those working on RLVR/math reasoning to improve reward shaping.

paper.title: Explore More, Drift Less: Outcome-Only Reinforcement Learning Can Suffice for Long-Horizon Interactive Agents
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning is a natural way to post-train LLM agents for long-horizon interactive tasks judged only by end-of-task verification, yet a shared belief holds that outcome-only RL soon hits a ceiling on small open models. Recent work therefore compensates around the training with denser rewards, SFT priors, skill libraries, curated memory, or multi-agent orchestration. We argue the ceiling is an artifact of two failures of common practice. Signal starvation: group-relative RL with sparse

summary.core_problem: 在小规模开源模型上，仅依赖结果反馈（outcome-only）的强化学习（RL）用于长程交互式 Agent 任务时，常被认为存在性能天花板，导致现有研究转向使用密集奖励、SFT 预热或多智能体编排等复杂补偿机制。本文旨在证明该天花板并非 outcome-only RL 的固有缺陷，而是训练轨迹分布失真导致的假象。
summary.importance: 本文挑战了长程 Agent 任务中 outcome-only RL 必须依赖复杂辅助机制的共识。它指出，被先前研究视为“有害”的困难任务，实际上是因为探索不足导致梯度信号缺失。通过纠正训练分布的失真，证明了纯粹的交互式 RL 可以在小模型上取得 SOTA 性能，为 Agent 后训练提供了一种极简且高效的新范式。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 CANOPY (Coverage-ANchored On-PolicY RL) 协议，针对两个核心失败机制进行改进：
1. 解决信号饥饿 (Signal starvation)：通过增加同任务的 rollout 组大小 (large same-task groups) 和取消单轮生成限制 (uncapped per-turn generation)，确保困难任务也能产生成功与失败混合的轨迹，从而提供有效的梯度信号。
2. 解决策略漂移 (Policy drift)：在有限任务池中反复训练会导致策略退化。CANOPY 引入轻量级 KL 散度锚定 (light KL anchor)、严格的 on-policy 更新，以及仅针对动作 token 的 token 级损失 (token-level loss over action tokens) 来维持策略稳定性。
3. 测试时扩展：在推理阶段增加交互预算 (interaction budget)，充分发挥训练好的策略能力。
summary.experiments: 在 AppWorld 基准测试中，使用 Qwen3-14B 模型，CANOPY 协议在没有任何 SFT 预热、技能库或外部编排的情况下，将基础模型性能提升了超过 50 个 TGC 点，登顶 AppWorld 排行榜（Test-Normal TGC 86.9, Test-Challenge 67.6）。同样的原则在 SWE-bench Verified 上也将 Qwen3.5-9B 提升了 16.6 个点。消融实验验证了每个组件（大 rollout 组、KL 锚定、动作 token 损失等）的必要性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Introduction 中对“信号饥饿”和“策略漂移”的机制分析，这是本文的核心洞察。其次关注 CANOPY 协议的具体配置（Explore more 和 Drift less 的具体实现），以及消融实验部分，了解各个组件对最终性能的贡献。预计阅读时间 20-30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Outcome-only reinforcement learning (RL) for long-horizon interactive agents on small open models is widely believed to hit a performance ceiling, prompting the use of complex compensations like dense rewards, SFT priors, or multi-agent orchestration. This paper aims to prove that this ceiling is an artifact of distorted training trajectory distributions, not an inherent limitation of outcome-only RL.
summary_en.importance: This paper challenges the consensus that outcome-only RL for long-horizon agent tasks requires complex auxiliary mechanisms. It reveals that hard tasks, previously deemed 'harmful', are actually starved of gradient signals due to under-exploration. By correcting the training distribution distortion, it demonstrates that pure interactive RL can achieve SOTA performance on small models, offering a minimalist and highly effective new paradigm for agent post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Introduces the CANOPY (Coverage-ANchored On-PolicY RL) protocol to address two core failure mechanisms:
1. Resolving Signal Starvation: Increases same-task rollout group sizes and removes per-turn generation caps to ensure hard tasks produce mixed success/failure trajectories, thereby providing effective gradient signals.
2. Resolving Policy Drift: Repeated training on a limited task pool degrades the policy. CANOPY uses a light KL anchor, strictly on-policy updates, and a token-level loss over action tokens only to maintain policy stability.
3. Test-time Realization: Transfers the trained policy to an enlarged interaction budget during inference.
summary_en.experiments: On the AppWorld benchmark, using a Qwen3-14B model, the CANOPY protocol improved the base model by over 50 TGC points without any SFT prior, skill library, or external orchestration, topping the AppWorld leaderboard (Test-Normal TGC 86.9, Test-Challenge 67.6). The same principles improved a Qwen3.5-9B model by 16.6 points on SWE-bench Verified. Ablation studies validated the necessity of each component (large rollout groups, KL anchor, action token loss, etc.).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Introduction for the mechanistic analysis of 'signal starvation' and 'policy drift', which is the core insight. Then, examine the specific configuration of the CANOPY protocol (implementations of 'Explore more' and 'Drift less') and the ablation studies to understand the contribution of each component. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得读训练动态部分；若结论成立，agent RL 的瓶颈更像覆盖率和漂移控制，不是 outcome reward 本身。
recommendation.en: Read the training-dynamics diagnosis; if it holds, the bottleneck is coverage and drift control rather than outcome rewards themselves.

paper.title: Locked at the Entrance, Open Inside: Where RLVR Narrows the Solution Space
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) substantially improves single-sample accuracy (pass@1) but causes the policy's solution space to contract, diminishing the returns of test-time scaling. In this work, we investigate where inside a reasoning trajectory this breadth is lost: does the policy fail to access a valid solution family, or does it fail to execute computation once initiated? To disentangle access from execution, we analyze the Countdown task, whose solution space can b

summary.core_problem: 解释 RLVR 为何提升 pass@1 的同时压缩解空间，并定位这种多样性损失究竟发生在推理轨迹的哪个阶段。
summary.importance: 这不是又一篇“RL 提升推理”论文，而是在拆解 RL 后训练如何改变策略分布形状；对 pretrain↔post-train 接口、test-time scaling 收益衰减、以及 reward 设计都有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在可穷举解空间的 Countdown 任务上，把解法按首个操作数和运算符划分为离散 entrance families，用这个结构把“进入某类解法”与“进入后执行计算”分开分析。分别在 Qwen2.5-3B 上做 PPO，以及在 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 上做 GRPO，比较训练前后解覆盖率、token likelihood shift 在首个算术操作前后的分布，并测试只提供未选中的 entrance 提示是否能恢复性能。
summary.experiments: 在两种训练设置下，solution coverage 最多下降 67%，即使对所有 checkpoint 都能解出的题目，覆盖率也会减半。关键发现是 likelihood shift 在首个算术操作前比后续推理阶段大 11x-16x，说明 RLVR 主要在入口处收窄策略支持集。摘要还指出仅补充一个未被选择的 entrance 就能显著恢复解空间与性能，支持“locked at the entrance, open inside”的解释。
summary.authors_note: 上海大学未来技术学院与伯明翰大学合作。作者不属于头部大厂，但问题设定干净，实验设计有研究味。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why RLVR improves pass@1 while shrinking the solution space, and pinpoints where along a reasoning trajectory this diversity is lost.
summary_en.importance: This is not another 'RL improves reasoning' paper; it analyzes how RL-style post-training reshapes the policy distribution itself. That matters for the pretrain–posttrain interface, diminishing returns from test-time scaling, and reward design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using the Countdown task, whose solution space can be exhaustively enumerated, the authors partition solutions into discrete entrance families defined by the first operand and operator. This lets them separate access to a solution family from execution after entering it. They study PPO on Qwen2.5-3B and GRPO on Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, measuring coverage, token-level likelihood shifts before vs. after the first arithmetic step, and the effect of supplying an unselected entrance.
summary_en.experiments: Across both training setups, solution coverage drops by up to 67%, and even halves on problems solved at all checkpoints. The key result is that token likelihood shifts are 11x-16x larger before the first arithmetic operation than during downstream reasoning, indicating that RLVR mainly narrows support at the entrance. The abstract also reports that providing only an unselected entrance can substantially recover breadth and performance.
summary_en.authors_note: A collaboration between Shanghai University and the University of Birmingham. Not a big-lab paper, but the setup is unusually clean and diagnostic.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改你对 RLVR 的 prior：问题不在“不会算”，而在早期分支被压没了；建议立刻在内部 trace 上复现入口覆盖率分析。
recommendation.en: This should update your prior on RLVR: the main damage is not failed computation but collapsed early branching; reproduce the entrance-coverage analysis on your own traces.

paper.title: Does On-Policy Distillation Really Distill? From Noisy Teacher to Self-Improvement
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) offers dense token-level supervision as an alternative to the sparse outcome-level advantages of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). However, the teacher scores student-generated trajectories that are inherently off-policy for it, so the reliability of its supervision, and hence the source of the student's improvement, remains unclear. We quantitatively analyze teacher supervision during OPD training and find substantial noise whose prevalence incr

summary.core_problem: 检验 on-policy distillation 的收益到底来自教师提供的细粒度 token advantage，还是来自一种更简单的自我改进机制。
summary.importance: 这篇工作直接碰 post-train 的一个核心 prior：OPD 被认为比 outcome-only RL 更密集、更稳定，因为教师能提供有信息量的 token 级监督。若这个前提不成立，很多蒸馏与 RLVR 设计都要重估。对 pretrain↔posttrain 接口也有价值，因为它在问训练信号的真实有效成分是什么。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先量化 OPD 训练中教师对学生轨迹打分的噪声，分析噪声如何随教师规模变化；再做干预实验，比较保留或移除 noisy supervision 后学生性能是否变化；进一步分析学习集中在哪些 token，并用固定负 advantage 替代教师 advantage，测试是否仍能达到相近效果。核心判断是：OPD 的主要作用可能只是压低低 log-prob token，而不是精确蒸馏教师偏好。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示作者系统分析了 teacher supervision noise，并发现噪声比例随 teacher scale 增大而上升；尽管如此，学生对这些噪声并不敏感，移除后性能接近不变。更关键的是，单一固定负 advantage 能匹配教师 advantage 的效果。摘要未给出具体模型规模、任务集和提升数字，但从实验设计看，重点在因果拆解而不是刷榜。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Purdue University。Ruqi Zhang 在机器学习理论、RL 与生成模型方向有较强辨识度，这篇工作延续了其对训练信号机制的拆解风格。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether on-policy distillation actually benefits from teacher-provided token-level advantages, or whether its gains come from a much simpler self-improvement mechanism.
summary_en.importance: This directly challenges a central post-training prior: OPD is often viewed as superior to outcome-only RL because it provides dense, informative token-level supervision. If that premise is weak, many distillation and RLVR designs need to be reconsidered. It also matters for the pretrain↔post-train interface because it isolates what part of the training signal is truly doing work.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first quantify noise in teacher supervision when the teacher scores student-generated trajectories, and analyze how that noise changes with teacher scale. They then intervene by removing noisy supervision and checking whether student performance changes. Finally, they inspect where learning concentrates and replace teacher-provided advantages with a single fixed negative advantage to test whether similar gains remain. The core claim is that OPD may work mostly by suppressing low-log-probability tokens rather than faithfully distilling teacher preferences.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, teacher supervision is substantially noisy, and the noise becomes more prevalent with larger teachers. Yet student performance is largely insensitive to whether that noisy supervision is kept or removed. More strikingly, a single fixed negative advantage matches teacher-provided advantages. The abstract does not list model sizes, tasks, or exact gains, suggesting the paper is more about causal diagnosis than leaderboard performance.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Purdue University. Ruqi Zhang is well known in ML theory, RL, and generative modeling, and this paper fits that style of dissecting what training signals actually matter.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改你对 OPD 的 prior：先复现“固定负 advantage≈教师 advantage”这个结论，再决定是否继续堆复杂 teacher scoring。
recommendation.en: This should update your prior on OPD: reproduce the “fixed negative advantage ≈ teacher advantage” result before investing in more elaborate teacher scoring.

paper.title: Mitigating Over-Optimization in PRM-Guided Search in Mathematical Reasoning by Optimizing the Guide
paper.abstract: Process reward models (PRMs) provide dense step-level guidance for search-based reasoning, enabling inference-time compute to be allocated toward promising partial solutions. However, recent evidence suggests that PRM-guided search can over-optimize imperfect process rewards, pruning viable trajectories while expanding spurious ones. In this work, we theoretically show that directly leveraging PRM score is vulnerable to verifier noise through an extreme-value effect: non-viable prefixes become m

summary.core_problem: PRM 引导的数学推理搜索会过度优化有噪声的过程奖励，导致可行推理路径被剪掉、虚假高分路径被扩展。
summary.importance: 贡献是对 PRM-guided search 的失效模式给出理论解释，并提出无需微调的鲁棒搜索准则；它直接关联 RLVR、过程监督、推理时计算分配中的 reward over-optimization 问题。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把直接使用 PRM 分数的问题刻画为 verifier noise 下的极值效应：推理深度越深，错误前缀越可能拿到异常高分。为此提出 maximin PRM-guided search，把搜索写成对 plausible reward perturbations 的鲁棒优化，避免把计算集中投到单个异常高分前缀上。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、具体数学 benchmark、baseline 名称和提升幅度；可确认的是方法不需要 fine-tuning 或 online adaptation，重点比较应是普通 PRM-guided search 与鲁棒 maximin search 在有噪声过程奖励下的搜索质量。

summary_en.core_problem: PRM-guided mathematical search can over-optimize noisy process rewards, pruning viable reasoning paths while expanding spurious high-scoring prefixes.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a theoretical failure analysis plus a training-free robust search rule; it is relevant to RLVR, process supervision, and inference-time compute allocation under imperfect reward models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper models direct PRM scoring as vulnerable to an extreme-value effect under verifier noise: as reasoning depth grows, non-viable prefixes have more chances to receive spuriously high scores. It proposes maximin PRM-guided search, a robust optimization formulation over plausible reward perturbations, to reduce sensitivity to PRM outliers.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, math benchmarks, baseline names, or exact gains. It states that the method is training-free, with no fine-tuning or online adaptation, and is intended to compare against standard PRM-guided search under noisy step-level rewards.

recommendation.zh: 值得看理论部分：它把 PRM 搜索失败归因到深度相关的极值噪声，内部做 RLVR search 时应复现这个 stress test。
recommendation.en: Read the theory: the depth-dependent extreme-value failure is a useful stress test for any internal RLVR search stack.

paper.title: ERR+: Sequential Entropy Resolution for Efficient and Decisive LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large reasoning models achieve strong performance on complex tasks by generating extended chain-of-thought (CoT) traces via reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). While current RLVR methods have achieved strong results with correctness-based reward signals, they provide limited guidance on the quality of the reasoning process itself, leaving the internal reasoning structure largely unoptimized. Through empirical analysis across multiple model families, we identify a consistent pa

summary.core_problem: 解决 RLVR 只用最终正确性奖励、几乎不约束中间推理过程质量的问题，试图给 reasoning trace 一个更细粒度的训练信号。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究员的价值在于它把 token-level entropy dynamics 引入 reasoning 优化，属于 post-train 侧但可能反哺对预训练内部不确定性演化的理解。贡献类型是方法创新加训练信号分析，不是范式级突破。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先做跨模型家族的经验分析，发现正确推理在 thinking phase 中更常出现且幅度更大的 token 熵下降。基于这一观察，提出两阶段 RLVR 框架 ERR+：第一阶段加入 Entropy Relief Reward，对 thinking phase 内累计熵下降给予按长度对数归一化的奖励；第二阶段再结合原有正确性信号继续训练。设计上不是简单压低熵，而是奖励不确定性被逐步消解的过程，试图保留探索同时鼓励 decisive reasoning。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整模型规模和数据细节，但说明在多个模型家族上都观察到相同现象，并据此验证 ERR+。从摘要看，实验重点是 reasoning 任务上的 RLVR 对比，而不是大规模预训练。需要重点检查 reward 定义是否会被长度、模板化 CoT 或 logit calibration 偏置污染。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a limitation of RLVR for reasoning: correctness-only rewards provide little supervision on the quality of the intermediate reasoning process itself.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining researchers comes from introducing token-level entropy dynamics as a training signal for reasoning. This is a post-training paper, but it may feed back into how we think about uncertainty resolution during pretraining and inference. The contribution is a method plus a training-signal analysis, not a paradigm shift.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first analyze multiple model families and report a consistent pattern: correct reasoning traces show more frequent and larger token-level entropy drops during the thinking phase. Based on this, they propose ERR+, a two-phase RLVR framework. Phase 1 adds an Entropy Relief Reward that bonuses cumulative entropy drops in the thinking phase, normalized by response length; Phase 2 continues training with correctness-oriented signals. The key design choice is to reward uncertainty resolution rather than simply forcing low entropy everywhere.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full model sizes or data details, but it claims the entropy-drop pattern holds across multiple model families and that ERR+ improves reasoning training under RLVR. The main thing to inspect is whether the reward is confounded by length, templated CoT structure, or logit calibration artifacts rather than genuine reasoning quality.

recommendation.zh: 想看 reasoning 训练信号就读这篇，但先别全信：核心结论可能混入长度和校准偏置，优先看熵下降统计那几张图与 reward ablation。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about reasoning rewards, but do not over-trust it yet: the main claim may be entangled with length and calibration bias, so focus on the entropy-drop plots and reward ablations.

paper.title: Consolidating RLVR Capabilities Across Domains: A Deep Dive into Fusion Paradigms
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves specific capabilities of large language models, but covering multiple capabilities often involves training separate domain experts and subsequently consolidating them. We organize three fusion paradigms by the artefacts they reuse: Merge combines expert task vectors, Mix RL pools their datasets, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) uses both. Because they have largely been studied in isolation, how they compare and how to

summary.core_problem: 在具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中，如何最有效地将多个特定领域的专家模型能力整合到一个模型中？
summary.importance: 系统性比较了三种模型融合范式（Merge、Mix RL、MOPD）在跨领域 RLVR 任务中的表现，揭示了不同方法的训练动态和性能瓶颈，为多能力模型的后训练提供了实证指导。
summary.technical_approach: 将融合范式分为三类：Merge（合并专家任务向量）、Mix RL（混合专家数据集进行联合训练）和 MOPD（多教师在线策略蒸馏）。在统一的模型规模和多领域基准测试套件下，使用共享的专家模型和数据对这三种方法进行比较，并分析其训练动态和任务向量几何特征。
summary.experiments: 在多个模型规模和多领域基准测试上进行实验。结果表明，三种方法的平均性能差异最多为 1.4 分，但在单个基准测试上差距可达 8.6 分。Mix RL 依赖于领域混合比例，MOPD 受限于教师模型，而 Merge 会压缩任务向量。

summary_en.core_problem: How to most effectively consolidate multiple domain-specific expert capabilities into a single model in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR)?
summary_en.importance: Systematically compares three model fusion paradigms (Merge, Mix RL, MOPD) in cross-domain RLVR tasks, revealing the training dynamics and performance bottlenecks of different methods, providing empirical guidance for the post-training of multi-capability models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Categorizes fusion paradigms into three types: Merge (combining expert task vectors), Mix RL (pooling expert datasets for joint training), and MOPD (multi-teacher on-policy distillation). Compares these three methods using shared experts and data across model scales and a multi-domain benchmark suite, analyzing their training dynamics and task-vector geometry.
summary_en.experiments: Conducted experiments across multiple model scales and a multi-domain benchmark suite. Results show that the average performance difference among the three methods is at most 1.4 points, but the gap reaches 8.6 points on a single benchmark. Mix RL depends on domain mixture proportions, MOPD remains bounded by its teachers, and Merge compresses task vectors.

recommendation.zh: 对 RLVR 多领域融合的系统性比较，揭示了不同融合范式的 trade-off，对做 post-training 和模型合并的研究员有直接参考价值，重点看不同方法的训练动态分析。
recommendation.en: A systematic comparison of multi-domain fusion in RLVR, revealing the trade-offs of different fusion paradigms. Highly relevant for post-training and model merging researchers; focus on the analysis of training dynamics.

paper.title: Understanding Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning: Broader Reasoning Coverage than GRPO
paper.abstract: Evolution Strategies (ES) have recently emerged as a memory-efficient post-training paradigm for LLM reasoning. However, the optimization behavior of ES remains understudied, making it hard to define its advantage scope compared to mainstream post-training paradigms (e.g., Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)). By systematically investigating ES dynamics and mechanisms, this paper first identifies a performance advantage of ES over GRPO, theoretically and empirically showing that ES can lea

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是一个近来很实际但机制上还不清楚的问题：用 Evolution Strategies 做 LLM reasoning post-training，到底相比 GRPO 好在哪里，代价又是什么。作者把问题拆成三层。第一，ES 是否真的能比 GRPO 保留更广的推理覆盖面，而不是只在 Pass@1 上做局部优化。第二，ES 常被认为参数漂移大、容易 catastrophic forgetting，这个判断是否成立。第三，哪些超参数和估计器设计决定了 ES 在大模型上的稳定性与可扩展性。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的价值不在于 ES 会替代主流 RL，而在于它把 post-train 对 pretrained capability 的利用方式讲得更细。作者给出的核心观察是：GRPO 倾向于把概率质量压到少数高回报推理模式上，因此 Pass@1 往往更强，但 reasoning coverage 会收缩；ES 通过参数空间中的群体探索保留了更多可行解模式，因此更容易提升大 K 下的 Pass@K。这对理解“post-training 是在挖掘预训练已有能力，还是在重写策略分布”很有帮助。另一个有价值的点是，论文反驳了“参数漂移大就等于遗忘严重”的简单叙事，指出 ES 的有效更新在功能上是稀疏的，遗忘更多来自训练集过拟合而非参数位移本身。对 pretrain↔post-train 接口、能力保持、训练信号设计都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，这不是提出全新 ES 变体，而是对 ES 作为 reasoning post-training 工具做系统分析，并与 GRPO 做机制层面对照。ES 的基本过程是：对当前参数加随机扰动，得到一组 perturbed policies；每个扰动模型只做前向采样和 verifier 打分；再把 reward-weighted perturbations 聚合成更新方向。它绕开反向传播，因此显存占用低、并行性强。GRPO 则是在单一策略上采样多条响应，用组内相对优势构造 token-level policy gradient 更新。

作者的理论部分聚焦于“为什么 ES 可能有更高 Pass@K”。核心概念是 verifier-projected Jensen-Shannon diversity：不是看表面文本多样性，而是看 ES 群体在 verifier 视角下覆盖了多少不同的有效推理模式。论文论证这种群体多样性有助于 repeated sampling success，并且可以转化为更新后策略更高的 Pass@K。这个角度很关键，因为它把 ES 的优势从“无梯度优化也能训”转成“参数空间探索保留了解空间覆盖”。

经验分析部分主要有三块。第一，作者比较 ES 与 GRPO 的熵动态和 reasoning coverage，指出 GRPO 会出现 entropy collapse，而 ES 没有同样程度的收缩。第二，作者分析 ES 的参数变化分布，发现真正与任务相关的效果集中在少量较大幅度更新上，而大量参数变化在 perturbation cancellation 后功能贡献很小，因此 whole-model drift 不能直接等价为 widespread functional change。第三，作者系统扫超参数和估计器设计，结论包括：z-score reward normalization 是 ES 成功训练的关键；在 reasoning 的离散 reward 场景下，zeroth-order SFT 常用的 two-point estimator 并不带来优势；随着 pretrained model 规模增大，达到有效优化所需的 population size 反而下降。

论文还提出两个顺序组合方案 ES→GRPO 和 GRPO→ES，用来结合 GRPO 在 Pass@1 上的优势与 ES 在 Pass@K 上的优势。这不是特别复杂的算法创新，但很实用，因为它把两种更新机制看成对策略分布施加不同偏置的阶段性工具。
summary.experiments:
从引言可确认，实验主要在 GSM8K 和 DeepScaleR 上进行，比较对象包括 ES 与 GRPO，并考察 Pass@1、Pass@K、熵变化、能力保持以及超参数敏感性。论文的主结论是：ES 在提升 Pass@1 的同时，能取得高于 GRPO 的 Pass@K，而且不会像 GRPO 那样出现明显 entropy collapse。也就是说，GRPO 更容易把成功模式集中化，ES 则更能保留多条可行推理路径。

在 capability preservation 上，作者报告在合适训练设置下，held-out 能力大体保持，没有出现“只要参数漂移大就必然遗忘”的普遍现象。结合参数变化分析，论文认为先前一些 ES 遗忘案例更可能是训练集过拟合，而不是 ES 机制天然导致的灾难性遗忘。

超参数实验给出几个实用结论：z-score reward normalization 对 ES 很关键；two-point estimator 在离散 verifier reward 的 reasoning 任务上没有明显收益；模型越大，所需 population size 越小，这意味着更强 pretrained model 的局部几何可能更利于 ES 估计有效更新方向。摘要里没有给出完整数值表，所以这里不硬填具体百分点，但阅读正文时应重点核对 Pass@1/Pass@K 的绝对差值、熵曲线、以及 held-out benchmark 的退化幅度。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议按问题链来读。先看 Introduction 和 RQ1-RQ3，总结作者到底在比较什么，不要把它当成单纯“ES 打赢 GRPO”的经验论文。然后看理论部分关于 verifier-projected JS diversity 的定义和推导，理解作者为何把 Pass@K 提升归因于 reasoning coverage 而非偶然采样。接着看实验里三组图表：一组是 Pass@1/Pass@K 与熵动态，一组是参数变化与能力保持，一组是超参数和 estimator ablation。

如果只想快速判断是否值得跟进，预计 25-35 分钟足够。优先看 ES vs GRPO 的主结果图、entropy collapse 证据、z-score normalization 的消融，以及 ES→GRPO / GRPO→ES 的组合结果。若要深挖，重点看作者如何定义和估计 reasoning coverage、held-out capability 用了哪些任务、以及 population size 随模型规模下降这一结论是否在多个模型族上都成立。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a practical but poorly understood question: when Evolution Strategies are used for LLM reasoning post-training, where exactly do they outperform GRPO, and what are the trade-offs. The analysis is organized around three questions: whether ES preserves broader reasoning coverage than GRPO, whether ES inherently causes catastrophic forgetting because of large parameter drift, and which hyperparameters and estimator choices make ES stable and scalable for larger pretrained models.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research is less about replacing mainstream RL and more about clarifying how post-training exploits pretrained capability. The central observation is that GRPO tends to concentrate probability mass onto a narrower set of high-reward reasoning modes, which often helps Pass@1 but can reduce coverage over valid solution paths. ES, by exploring in parameter space with a population, appears to preserve a broader set of reasoning modes and therefore improves large-K Pass@K more reliably. That is useful for thinking about whether post-training is extracting latent capability from pretraining or collapsing the policy onto a smaller behavioral manifold. The paper also pushes back on the simplistic claim that large parameter drift necessarily implies catastrophic forgetting, arguing instead that ES updates are functionally sparse and that forgetting is better explained by overfitting than by drift alone.
summary_en.technical_approach:
This is not primarily a new ES algorithm; it is a systematic mechanistic study of ES as a reasoning post-training paradigm, with GRPO as the main gradient-based comparator. In ES, the current parameters are perturbed to form a population of policies, each perturbed model is evaluated by forward-only sampling and verifier rewards, and reward-weighted perturbations are aggregated into an update estimate. This avoids backpropagation, making ES memory-efficient and easy to parallelize. GRPO, in contrast, samples multiple responses from a single policy and applies a token-level policy-gradient-style update based on relative advantages within the group.

The theoretical contribution centers on why ES may achieve higher Pass@K. The paper introduces verifier-projected Jensen-Shannon diversity, which measures diversity not at the surface-text level but in terms of distinct reasoning modes that matter under the verifier. The argument is that higher diversity across the ES population increases repeated-sampling success and can translate into higher Pass@K in the updated policy. This is an important framing shift: the advantage of ES is not just that it is zeroth-order, but that population-based parameter-space exploration preserves broader solution coverage.

Empirically, the paper analyzes three aspects. First, it compares entropy dynamics and reasoning coverage under ES and GRPO, showing that GRPO exhibits entropy collapse while ES does not collapse in the same way. Second, it studies the distribution of parameter changes under ES and finds that task-relevant effects are concentrated in a small subset of larger-magnitude updates, while much of the overall drift contributes little after perturbation cancellation. This supports the claim that whole-model drift is not the same as widespread functional change. Third, it performs a systematic sweep over hyperparameters and estimator variants, finding that z-score reward normalization is critical, that the two-point estimator commonly used in zeroth-order SFT offers no benefit under discrete reasoning rewards, and that the population size needed for effective optimization decreases as pretrained model scale increases.

The paper also proposes two sequential compositions, ES→GRPO and GRPO→ES, to combine GRPO’s strength on Pass@1 with ES’s strength on Pass@K. The idea is simple but useful: the two methods impose different biases on the policy distribution and can be staged rather than treated as mutually exclusive.
summary_en.experiments:
From the full text provided, the main experiments are conducted on GSM8K and DeepScaleR, comparing ES against GRPO on Pass@1, Pass@K, entropy dynamics, capability retention, and hyperparameter sensitivity. The main empirical result is that ES improves Pass@1 while achieving higher Pass@K than GRPO, and it does so without the same degree of entropy collapse. In effect, GRPO tends to sharpen the policy around a smaller set of successful reasoning trajectories, whereas ES preserves a broader set of viable paths.

On capability preservation, the paper reports that under appropriate training settings, held-out capabilities remain largely intact. Combined with the parameter-change analysis, this supports the claim that previously observed forgetting under ES is better explained by training-set overfitting than by parameter drift per se.

The hyperparameter study yields several practical takeaways: z-score reward normalization is a key ingredient for successful ES training; the two-point estimator does not help in reasoning tasks with discrete verifier rewards; and larger pretrained models require smaller population sizes for effective ES optimization. The excerpt does not include the full numeric tables, so the exact margins should be checked in the main results section, especially the absolute Pass@1/Pass@K gaps, entropy trajectories, and the magnitude of degradation on held-out capability benchmarks.
summary_en.reading_guide:
A good way to read it is by following the three research questions. Start with the introduction and the RQ1-RQ3 framing so the paper is read as a study of optimization behavior rather than a simple ES-versus-GRPO leaderboard comparison. Then read the theory section on verifier-projected JS diversity to understand why the authors attribute Pass@K gains to broader reasoning coverage rather than incidental sampling effects. After that, focus on three groups of experiments: Pass@1/Pass@K with entropy dynamics, parameter-drift versus capability-retention analysis, and the hyperparameter/estimator ablations.

If the goal is triage, 25-35 minutes should be enough. Prioritize the main ES-vs-GRPO plots, the evidence for entropy collapse, the ablation on z-score normalization, and the sequential composition results. For deeper reading, inspect how reasoning coverage is operationalized, which held-out capabilities are used, and whether the claim that required population size decreases with model scale holds consistently across model families.

recommendation.zh: 值得看优化动态和 Pass@K 分析；如果结果干净，应在内部 RLVR ablation 里复现 GRPO→ES 串联。
recommendation.en: Read the optimization-dynamics and Pass@K analysis; if the setup is clean, reproduce the GRPO-to-ES schedule in internal RLVR ablations.

paper.title: Boosting LLM Exploration via Weak-Model Guidance in RLVR
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) significantly improves LLM reasoning but often causes a drop in policy entropy, leading to narrowed reasoning coverage and degraded pass@$k$ for large $k$. While existing methods mitigate this entropy collapse through algorithmic regularizations, cross-model non-parametric perturbation is also neglected. In this work, we propose a simple yet effective approach to preserve the generative diversity of LLMs during RLVR. Instead of relying solely

summary.core_problem: 在 RLVR 训练中，如何缓解策略熵下降导致的探索范围缩小和 pass@k 性能退化问题？
summary.importance: 提出了一种利用弱模型引导探索的简单有效方法，从跨模型非参数扰动的角度解决了 RLVR 中的熵崩溃问题，提升了模型的生成多样性和推理能力。
summary.technical_approach: 在 RLVR 训练期间，强制目标模型基于较小、较弱的语言模型生成的部分推理轨迹（前缀）来生成答案。这些不熟悉的前缀能有效打破模型的过度自信，鼓励探索不同的推理路径。
summary.experiments: 在多个数学基准测试上进行了实验，实证研究了外部前缀的潜力，揭示了分布差异对 RLVR 训练中探索动态的影响机制。

summary_en.core_problem: How to mitigate the narrowed exploration coverage and degraded pass@k performance caused by policy entropy collapse in RLVR training?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a simple yet effective approach using weak-model guidance to solve the entropy collapse problem in RLVR from the perspective of cross-model non-parametric perturbation, improving the generative diversity and reasoning capabilities of the model.
summary_en.technical_approach: During RLVR training, forces the target model to generate answers based on partial reasoning trajectories (prefixes) generated by a smaller, weaker language model. These unfamiliar prefixes effectively disrupt over-confidence and encourage the exploration of distinct reasoning paths.
summary_en.experiments: Conducted experiments on multiple mathematical benchmarks, empirically studying the potential of outer prefixes and revealing the mechanism of the impact of distributional discrepancy on the exploration dynamics in RLVR training.

recommendation.zh: 通过引入弱模型生成的前缀来增加 RLVR 训练中的探索多样性，思路简单但直击 RL 训练中熵崩溃的痛点，值得关注其对 pass@k 的提升效果。
recommendation.en: Increases exploration diversity in RLVR training by introducing prefixes generated by weak models. A simple idea that directly addresses the pain point of entropy collapse in RL training. Worth noting its improvement on pass@k.

paper.title: CARE: Causally-Aligned Reasoning Exploration for Medical Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for medical reasoning, yet the scarcity and cost of expert-annotated data constrain their progress. While reinforcement learning offers a scalable alternative, standard outcome-based methods in medicine often suffer from autoregressive credit assignment failure and gradient variance explosion. This leads to the "Right Answer, Wrong Reason" trap, where models inadvertently reinforce spurious correlations and dataset shortcuts rather than va

summary.core_problem: 解决医学 LLM 强化学习中只按最终答案给奖励导致的 credit assignment 失败，即模型答对但推理路径依赖伪相关。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练方法改进，聚焦 RL 轨迹筛选和训练信号质量。虽然场景是医学推理，问题形式与通用 RLVR、过程监督和推理数据筛选有交集，因此有弱相关价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CARE，即 Causally-Aligned Reasoning Exploration，用两个条件筛选高质量训练轨迹：Causal Sufficiency 通过 agreement-based self-verification 近似 do-calculus 式干预，用于降低伪相关梯度；Proximal Learnability 通过动态 entropy bounds 选择模型当前可学习范围内的经验，试图减少梯度方差和过难样本带来的训练不稳定。
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整给出模型参数量、医学数据集、baseline、提升幅度或消融结果。可确认的实验主张是 CARE 面向医学大模型推理训练，用于缓解 outcome-based RL 的高方差和错误归因问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets credit assignment failure in reinforcement learning for medical LLMs, where models may reach the right answer through spurious reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training method paper about trajectory curation and reward-signal quality. The medical setting makes it domain-specific, but the problem overlaps with general RLVR, process supervision, and reasoning-data filtering.
summary_en.technical_approach: CARE introduces Causally-Aligned Reasoning Exploration with two trajectory-quality conditions. Causal Sufficiency uses agreement-based self-verification as a proxy for intervention-style debiasing, while Proximal Learnability uses dynamic entropy bounds to keep selected experiences within the model's learnable range and reduce variance.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, baselines, effect sizes, or ablations. It claims to address high-variance outcome-based RL and spurious shortcut reinforcement in medical reasoning models.

recommendation.zh: 医学外壳较重；若做 RLVR 数据筛选，只看 causal sufficiency 与 entropy bound 的定义和消融。
recommendation.en: The medical wrapper is heavy; for RLVR data filtering, only inspect the causal-sufficiency and entropy-bound definitions plus ablations.

paper.title: AutoVerifier: Residual-Guided Non-Parametric Optimization for Reference-Based Answer Verification
paper.abstract: Reference-based verifiers are important for evaluating reasoning models and providing accurate outcome rewards in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. To improve verification accuracy, prior work has explored rule-based, model-based, and tool-augmented verifiers for checking answer equivalence across diverse answer forms. However, the equivalence of answer forms such as $1+3.14$ and $1+π$ may depend on the question and scoring criterion. We frame such implicit assumptions as verifier

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是 reference-based answer verification 里的一个老问题：候选答案和参考答案是否等价，往往不只是字符串匹配或符号化简的问题，还隐含了题目语境、评分标准、数值容差、单位表达、近似形式是否可接受等“判题偏置”。现有 rule-based verifier 把逻辑写死，覆盖有限；model-based verifier 覆盖更广，但判定标准埋在模型行为里，不透明、不可编辑，也难以稳定复用。论文把这些隐含标准明确称为 verifier inductive biases，并试图从 verifier 的残差错误中自动归纳出来，再以可审计、可回放验证的形式沉淀为规则或 prompt 更新。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是核心论文，但对 post-train、RLVR、reward 建模和 benchmark 评测都很相关。原因很直接：只要训练依赖 outcome reward，verifier 的误判就会直接污染优化方向。很多 RL with verifiable rewards 工作默认 verifier 足够可靠，但实际难点常常不在算式能不能化简，而在“什么算对”这件事本身带有任务依赖的隐含标准。AutoVerifier 的价值在于，它没有再训练一个更大的 judge，而是把 verifier 改进做成一种非参数、可审计、可增量维护的过程。这对构建长期可维护的 reward pipeline 有现实意义，尤其适合数学、科学问答、结构化答案比对这类高频需要 verifier 的场景。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 residual-guided non-parametric optimization。系统从一个固定 base verifier 出发，围绕它做迭代更新。每轮先在 construction pool 上回放当前 verifier，把预测与标注不一致的样本收集为 residuals。随后对这些 recurring errors 做模式归纳，形成 rule cards。每张 card 记录一种待补充的 verifier bias，包括支持样例、反例、适用条件，以及在什么情况下应 abstain。这里的设计很像把 verifier 的错误分析流程产品化：不是直接改模型参数，而是把 recurring mismatch 变成显式知识单元。

rule card 有两条晋升路径。若某种偏置可以写成确定性的比较逻辑，例如数值容差、单位归一化、科学计数法转换、某些符号等价规则，就进入 code audit 和 replay validation，通过后成为 code module。code module 是一个三值判定单元：Correct / Incorrect / Abstain。若某类偏置无法完全规则化，仍需要模型判断，则不写成代码，而是并入 fallback verifier 的 prompt guidance。最终推理时，系统先走模块库，能直接判的就直接输出，不能判的再交给固定的 model-based fallback。这个结构的关键优点有两个：一是把高频、稳定的比较逻辑前移为显式模块，降低对大模型 judge 的依赖；二是每次更新都要经过 replay validation，避免新规则修正局部错误的同时引入直接回归。

和已有方法相比，区别不在于又加了一个工具，而在于把 verifier 改进过程做成“残差发现—规则卡片—回放验证—模块/提示晋升”的闭环。它既不同于纯规则库的手工扩展，也不同于把所有复杂性都交给 judge model 吸收。
summary.experiments:
论文在四个 reference-based verification benchmark 上评测。主结果是 AutoVerifier 达到 93.05% macro accuracy，超过文中对比的 rule-based、model-based、scientific 和 tool-augmented verifier。更有信息量的是分组件结果：相对 prompt-only 设置，加入 code modules 后 macro accuracy 再提升 1.76 个点，说明收益不只是 prompt 改写，而是显式比较逻辑确实补上了 verifier 的盲区。与此同时，能够由模块直接完成的判定还把 fallback model 调用减少了 32.13%，这意味着不仅更准，也更省推理成本。

从论文描述看，实验重点不是追求某个 benchmark 上的极限分数，而是证明两件事：第一， recurring residuals 里确实存在可抽取、可复用的 verifier bias；第二，把这些 bias 以代码模块和 prompt guidance 分流实现，比单纯依赖 prompt 或单一 judge model 更稳。值得注意的是，这类结果的可信度很依赖 construction pool 与 benchmark 的分布关系；如果两者高度同分布，规则抽取会更容易。因此读实验时要特别看 replay validation、support/counterexample 设计，以及不同 benchmark 上的泛化是否一致。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 里的几个例子，尤其是 1+3.14 与 1+π 在不同题目语境下是否等价的讨论。这个例子把论文要解决的问题讲得很清楚：不是形式化简能力不足，而是评分标准本身带条件。然后重点读 Method，抓住四个对象：residual、rule card、code module、fallback prompt。只要这四个对象之间的流转关系看明白，整篇方法就通了。

实验部分建议优先看总表和 ablation，尤其是 prompt-only vs +code modules，以及 fallback call reduction。预计 20 分钟左右可以完成泛读。若要进一步判断方法是否适合接入 RL reward pipeline，需要细看 replay validation 的通过标准、abstain 机制如何设计、以及错误模式聚类是否依赖较多人工参与。这些地方决定了它是一个可持续维护的 verifier 框架，还是一个需要较强人工运营的半自动系统。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a persistent issue in reference-based answer verification: answer equivalence is often governed not only by symbolic matching or numerical checking, but also by implicit grading assumptions tied to the question, acceptable approximation level, units, notation, and task context. Rule-based verifiers hard-code these assumptions and therefore have limited coverage. Model-based verifiers cover more cases, but the criteria remain buried inside model behavior, making them hard to audit, edit, and reuse. The paper frames these hidden criteria as verifier inductive biases and asks how to learn them from recurring verifier mistakes while keeping the resulting logic explicit and maintainable.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper, but it matters for post-training, RL with verifiable rewards, and evaluation infrastructure. Whenever outcome rewards depend on a verifier, verifier errors become optimization noise or, worse, systematic bias. Many RLVR pipelines assume the verifier is reliable enough, yet in practice the hard part is often not computation itself but deciding what should count as correct under a given scoring convention. AutoVerifier is useful because it improves the verifier without retraining a larger judge model. Instead, it turns verifier refinement into a non-parametric, auditable, incrementally maintainable process. That is practically relevant for math, science QA, and any structured-answer setting where reward quality depends on robust equivalence checking.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core method is residual-guided non-parametric optimization. The system starts from a fixed base verifier and iteratively improves it around observed mistakes. At each round, the current verifier is replayed on a construction pool, and disagreements with labels are collected as residuals. Recurring residual patterns are then abstracted into rule cards. Each card records a missing verifier bias together with support examples, counterexamples, applicability conditions, and abstention conditions. This is a key design choice: instead of directly updating model parameters, the method converts recurring failure modes into explicit knowledge units.

A rule card can follow one of two promotion paths. If the missing bias can be expressed as deterministic comparison logic—such as numerical tolerance handling, unit normalization, scientific notation conversion, or specific symbolic equivalence rules—it goes through code audit and replay validation, and if accepted becomes a code module. A code module is a deterministic verifier unit that returns Correct, Incorrect, or Abstain. If the bias cannot be fully codified and still requires model judgment, it is incorporated into the fallback verifier prompt rather than compiled into code. At inference time, the system first runs the module library; cases that can be decided explicitly are handled there, and only unresolved cases are sent to a fixed model-based fallback verifier.

What distinguishes this from prior work is not simply adding tools, but turning verifier improvement into a closed loop: residual discovery, rule-card drafting, replay validation, and promotion into either executable modules or prompt guidance. It sits between hand-maintained rule libraries and opaque judge-model behavior.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper evaluates on four reference-based verification benchmarks. The headline result is 93.05% macro accuracy, outperforming the reported rule-based, model-based, scientific, and tool-augmented baselines included in the study. The more informative result is the component ablation: compared with a prompt-only setting, adding code modules yields an additional +1.76 macro-accuracy gain. That suggests the benefit is not merely better prompting; explicit comparison logic is covering verifier blind spots that prompting alone does not fix. In addition, direct module decisions reduce fallback model calls by 32.13%, so the system improves both accuracy and inference efficiency.

The experiments are most convincing when read as evidence for two claims. First, recurring residuals do contain reusable verifier biases that can be extracted. Second, splitting those biases into deterministic modules versus prompt-level guidance works better than relying on a single prompt-only or model-only verifier. A careful reader should still pay attention to the relationship between the construction pool and the evaluation benchmarks: if they are too similar, rule extraction becomes easier. The replay-validation protocol, support/counterexample design, and cross-benchmark consistency are therefore important for judging how robust the method really is.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the motivating examples in the introduction, especially the discussion of when 1+3.14 should or should not be treated as equivalent to 1+π. That example captures the paper’s point well: the challenge is not only symbolic manipulation, but context-dependent grading assumptions. Then read the method section with four objects in mind: residuals, rule cards, code modules, and the fallback prompt. Once the transitions among these four are clear, the whole system becomes easy to follow.

In the experiments, prioritize the main comparison table and the ablations, especially prompt-only versus prompt-plus-code-modules, and the reduction in fallback calls. Around 20 minutes should be enough for a solid skim. If the goal is to assess whether this can plug into an RL reward pipeline, look more closely at replay-validation criteria, the abstain mechanism, and how much human effort is still needed to cluster or formalize recurring error patterns. Those details determine whether the method is a maintainable verifier framework or a semi-automatic workflow with significant manual overhead.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在做 RLVR 或 judge-based eval，这篇值得看；不是因为方法多新，而是它把 verifier bias 从黑盒误差变成可审计对象，先读 rule card 和 replay validation。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you use RLVR or judge-based evaluation; the key idea is not novelty for its own sake, but turning verifier bias from opaque error into an auditable object—start with the rule-card and replay-validation parts.

paper.title: Where vs What: Decomposing Structural and Content Failures in LLM-Generated Structured Outputs
paper.abstract: Structured outputs such as JSON and tables are central to modern LLM-based systems, yet generation failures are evaluated monolithically, conflating two distinct error modes: placement errors (correct values at wrong positions) and value errors (wrong values at intended positions). We introduce Structure-Content Decomposition (SCD), a framework that independently measures structural fidelity and content accuracy. Applying SCD to nested JSON and table tasks across six models (7B to frontier), we

summary.core_problem: 现有的结构化输出（如 JSON、表格）评估方法将生成失败视为单一错误，无法区分“值错误”（生成了错误的内容）和“位置错误”（正确的内容放在了错误的结构位置）。
summary.importance: 提出了一种解耦结构与内容的评估框架，揭示了随着任务复杂度增加，LLM 的“结构保真度”比“内容准确度”退化得更早、更快的现象，并基于此设计了针对性的 RL 奖励机制，为提升 LLM 结构化输出能力提供了新视角。
summary.technical_approach: 引入结构-内容分解（SCD）框架，将评估分为三个层级：格式有效性、结构合规率（SCR）和值放置准确率（VPA）。通过对比“值存在率”（VP）和 VPA，量化“正确值放错位置”的比例。进一步，提出 SA-RLVR 方法，将 SCD 指标转化为 GRPO 的可验证奖励信号，直接优化模型的结构寻址能力。
summary.experiments: 在嵌套 JSON 和表格任务上评估了 6 个模型（7B 到前沿模型）。结果显示，在最高复杂度下，即使是 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 也会将 35% 的正确值放错位置，而 Qwen2.5-7B 的错放率高达 74%。消融实验表明这与模型依赖语义捷径有关。使用 SA-RLVR 训练后，JSON 值放置准确率从 0.26 提升至 0.63，显著优于 SFT 基线（0.28）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读 SCD 框架的三个层级定义（图 2 和公式），理解如何通过 VP 和 VPA 的差值量化位置错误。关注实验部分关于“结构退化先于内容”的观察，以及 SA-RLVR 带来的显著性能提升。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing evaluations for structured outputs (e.g., JSON, tables) treat generation failures monolithically, failing to distinguish between 'value errors' (incorrect content) and 'placement errors' (correct content in the wrong structural position).
summary_en.importance: Introduces a decomposed evaluation framework that separates structure and content, revealing that structural fidelity degrades earlier and faster than content accuracy as complexity increases. It also provides a targeted RL reward mechanism based on these metrics, offering a new pathway to improve LLM structured generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the Structure-Content Decomposition (SCD) framework, evaluating outputs hierarchically: format validity, Structural Compliance Rate (SCR), and Value Placement Accuracy (VPA). By comparing Value Presence (VP) with VPA, it quantifies the rate of misplaced correct values. Furthermore, it introduces SA-RLVR, which converts SCD metrics into verifiable rewards for GRPO to directly optimize structural addressing.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated 6 models (7B to frontier) on nested JSON and table tasks. At the highest complexity, even DeepSeek-V4-Flash misplaced 35% of recalled values, while Qwen2.5-7B misplaced 74%. Ablations link this to reliance on semantic shortcuts. Training with SA-RLVR improved JSON VPA from 0.26 to 0.63, significantly outperforming a matched SFT baseline (0.28).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the definitions of the three SCD levels (Figure 2 and equations) to understand how placement errors are quantified via the gap between VP and VPA. Pay attention to the experimental observation of 'structure degrades first' and the substantial improvements achieved by SA-RLVR.

recommendation.zh: 只看 SCD 定义和复杂度曲线；它把“格式错”拆干净，可用于内部 tool-use/RLVR 数据诊断。
recommendation.en: Read the SCD definition and complexity curves; the clean split of format errors is useful for internal tool-use and RLVR diagnostics.

paper.title: TailSFT: Filtered Fine-Tuning Improves Post-Training Performance
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning post-training drives reasoning and agentic capabilities in modern AI systems, yet a growing body of work shows that it is most effective when used to fine-tune an already capable base model. We question whether existing pipelines yield models that are most suitable for reinforcement learning. Building on prior work highlighting the role of coverage and pass@K as predictors of post-RL performance, we design a simple modification to supervised fine-tuning, TailSFT, which fil

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论的是一个很具体但常被忽略的接口问题：标准 SFT 是否真的给后续 RL 提供了最好的初始化。作者指出，SFT 阶段优化的是 token-level cross-entropy，但 RL，尤其是 verifiable reward 场景下的 RLVR/GRPO，真正需要的是初始化模型在有限采样预算内能否产出“至少一个可奖励答案”。这对应的是 coverage 或 large-k pass@k，而不是单样本精度或更低的 CE loss。问题因此变成：能否修改 SFT，让它少去继续拟合那些模型已经很会的样本，把训练容量留给分布尾部、但对后续 RL 很关键的可奖励响应。
summary.importance: 这项工作的意义不在于把 SFT 再做得更强一点，而在于明确提出了 stage-aware training 的视角：一个阶段的局部最优目标，未必给下一个阶段提供最优初始化。对预训练和后训练接口研究，这个结论很重要。它把“中间模型该如何评价”从单纯看 loss/benchmark，推进到看它是否保留了足够的 response coverage。贡献量级上，这不是替代 RL 的新范式，但它给出了一个极轻量、可直接落地的 SFT 改法，并且在真实 7B 模型上证明 large-k pass@k 和最终 RL 后 pass@1 都能提升。对做 reasoning/coding post-training 的团队，这类方法很可能比继续堆 SFT 数据或延长 SFT 步数更有性价比。
summary.technical_approach:
TailSFT 的核心很简单：在 SFT 时做 sequence-level filtering，把那些相对于初始策略已经“fit 得够好”的训练序列过滤掉，只对 under-modeled tail 继续更新。作者的出发点是，标准 cross-entropy 会继续奖励所有 demonstration 的概率提升，包括模型已经很容易采样出来的响应；而概率质量守恒意味着，这种继续加压可能把质量从别的潜在有用响应上挤走，导致 coverage 下降。也就是说，CE 和 coverage 不是同一个目标，甚至可能冲突。
