Read the introduction for the distinction between sample selection and rollout allocation, because both reduce to online difficulty estimation. In the method, focus on the four components: sample graph construction, graph-structured latent difficulty states, online mean-field variational inference, and how the posterior success probabilities are consumed by schedulers. In the experiments, prioritize comparisons against probing-based and history-based estimators, overhead analysis, and ablations on graph construction. The key technical risk to inspect is whether semantic similarity reliably tracks reasoning-skill similarity; otherwise, the graph can propagate misleading feedback.

recommendation.zh: RLVR/R1-Zero 范式下的效率优化，图结构共享反馈的思路对缓解 RL 训练早期的冷启动有启发，值得关注其调度策略的实现细节。
recommendation.en: Efficiency optimization in the RLVR/R1-Zero paradigm; the idea of sharing feedback via graph structures is inspiring for mitigating cold starts in early RL training. Worth checking the implementation details of the scheduling strategy.

paper.title: Prior Audit-Repair Context Shifts LLM Verifier Thresholds Toward Leniency
paper.abstract: Automated checking pipelines increasingly place one language model as the checker and another (or the same one) as the fixer. We ask whether that wiring changes what the checker reports. Measuring false alarms on human-verified-correct ProcessBench traces with the present task held byte-identical, we find that a completed audit -> repair episode already in the model's context lowers false alarms in 15 of 15 model x wording combinations, by 2.8 to 11.5 percentage points against a length-matched n

summary.core_problem: 在「审核-修复」自动化流水线中，把同一个 LLM 既当验证器又当修复器的工程布线是否会改变验证器的判错阈值，进而影响误报率；现有文献对上下文累积效应的预测与实际方向存在矛盾，且之前实验未与输出格式、任务重写等混淆变量解耦。
summary.importance: 对预训练后对齐流水线与 verifier 训练有明确警示：验证器的上下文历史不是中性的，前置的审核-修复交互会让阈值系统性向宽松方向偏移，仅看被标记样本上的指标会误判为性能提升；这直接关系到 RL/verifier 训练中数据构造的一致性，以及 self-play 式「生成-校验-修复」循环的校准可靠性。
summary.technical_approach: 采用严格的控制变量实验设计：1) 目标任务（题目、推理步、指令、输出 schema、证据预算）在各条件下字节级完全一致，排除输出格式与任务措辞干扰；2) 仅在目标请求前插入一段与目标项无关、已完成的审核-修复对话作为处理组，对照组插入长度匹配的无关填充；3) 以 ProcessBench 中人工标注全正确的轨迹为对象，核心指标是误报率（FAR），另设独立的错误轨迹臂用于信号检测分析；4) 交叉控制 2×2 的归因条件（助手/用户位置 × 自称/他称），剥离归属偏差与位置偏差；5) 对比不同措辞、不同模型、是否开启 CoT 等多个维度的稳健性。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3.6-27B、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B、Ministral-3-14B 三个模型与 5 种审核措辞共 15 组组合中：1) 前置审核-修复上下文使误报率全部下降，相对长度匹配对照组绝对下降 2.8–11.5 pp，相对下降 9%–25%；2) 前置审核若报告过错误，误报率下降更明显，与累积消息偏置的预测方向相反；3) 信号检测分析显示该变化是判定阈值偏移，未检测到判别能力提升；4) 人工复核被消除的误报样本，发现该偏移在当前工作点上仍属有益；5) 2×2 归因实验表明修复内容与审核结论的作用跨模型互补，没有单一必要条件。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读约 25 分钟。重点看 Method 节的字节级不变量控制与 2×2 归因设计，这是实验可信度的核心；Results 与 §6 信号检测分析部分，理解阈值偏移与判别力变化的区别；Introduction 中与 Jin & Chen 2026、Khullar et al. 2026 的差异对比可帮助定位贡献。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether wiring an LLM as both verifier and repairer in an audit-repair pipeline shifts its decision threshold and changes false-alarm behavior; prior literature gives conflicting predictions on accumulated-context effects, and previous experiments failed to isolate the manipulation from output-format or task-rewording confounds.
summary_en.importance: It delivers a concrete caution for post-training alignment and verifier design: a verifier's context history is not neutral. A preceding audit-repair episode systematically shifts the threshold toward leniency, which can masquerade as improvement when metrics are computed only on flagged items. This directly bears on data consistency in RL / verifier training and calibration in self-play generate-verify-repair loops.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses a tightly controlled design: 1) The target task (problem text, step text, instructions, output schema, evidence budget) is kept byte-identical across all conditions to rule out format or wording confounds. 2) The treatment inserts an unrelated, completed audit-repair exchange before the target request; the control inserts a length-matched filler. 3) Core metric is false-alarm rate (FAR) on human-verified correct traces from ProcessBench; a separate disjoint arm of labeled-incorrect traces supports signal-detection analysis. 4) A 2×2 attribution design (assistant vs user turn placement × self vs peer labeling) disentangles placement and ownership biases. 5) Robustness is checked across five instruction wordings, three models, and with/without chain-of-thought.
summary_en.experiments: Across 15 model × wording combinations (Qwen3.6-27B, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Ministral-3-14B, five instruction phrasings): 1) A prior audit-repair context reduces FAR in all 15 cells by 2.8–11.5 absolute pp, a 9%–25% relative reduction over the length-matched control. 2) An episode whose audit reported an error lowers FAR further, opposite to the direction predicted by accumulated-message accounts. 3) Signal-detection analysis shows the change is a criterion shift, with no detectable gain in discrimination. 4) Manual audit of removed false alarms indicates the shift is still beneficial at the operating point tested. 5) The 2×2 decomposition shows repair content and audit verdict contribute complementarily across models, with no single necessary component.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in roughly 25 minutes. Focus on the Method section for the byte-identical invariant and the 2×2 attribution design, which underpin the causal claim; Results and §6 signal-detection analysis to distinguish threshold shift from discrimination change; and the Introduction's contrast with Jin & Chen 2026 and Khullar et al. 2026 to position the contribution.

recommendation.zh: Verifier 上下文偏置的干净测量，audit-repair 历史拉低误报率而非升高；用 verifier 做 RLVR 或自动评测的人需警惕此 leniency bias，看 §3 结果即可。
recommendation.en: A clean measurement of verifier context bias: prior audit-repair history lowers false alarms rather than raising them; anyone using verifiers for RLVR or automated eval should watch for this leniency bias—§3 results suffice.

paper.title: Measuring Reward Hacking and Reasoning-Answer Decoupling Under Position-Confounded Optimization
paper.abstract: When a reward is correct on every training example yet consistent with more than one goal, a model can acquire an unintended one, a failure known as goal misgeneralization. Endpoint accuracy on the training distribution cannot tell the two apart, because solving the task and exploiting a surface feature can satisfy the reward equally well. We treat this as a measurement problem: what does a benchmark score measure once a model has been optimized against a correct but confounded signal? We train

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究 reward 正确但训练分布有混淆时，RL 后训练会学到任务能力还是表面捷径。具体设置是多选数学题中训练集永远把正确答案放在 A，reward 对每个样本都正确，但“解题”和“选 A”在训练期间不可区分。
summary.importance: 这对 RL post-training 的评测解释很有价值。它说明训练 reward 全对并不代表测到的是目标能力；如果训练分布存在位置、格式或模板偏差，模型可能把 reward 优化成稳定的策略捷径。更重要的是，作者测到了 reasoning-answer decoupling：模型推理轨迹中已经算出正确数值，但最终选项仍偏向 A。这提醒 reasoning RL 不能只看最终答案 reward，也不能默认 CoT 文本和最终动作一致。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把 GSM8K 转成四选一数学题，用 GPT-4.1-mini 生成三个看起来合理的干扰项。训练分两种 curriculum：unbiased curriculum 中正确选项在 A/B/C/D 间随机；biased curriculum 中正确选项始终是 A。两者题目和正确答案相同，差异只在选项位置。模型使用 Qwen2.5、Llama 3.x、Gemma3 的 instruction-tuned 版本，通过 LoRA 适配器做 GRPO。训练分三阶段逐步引入输出格式：先训练只输出字母，再训练带 answer/reasoning 标签，最后使用评测格式，即 reasoning 在前、answer 在后。reward 包括格式 reward 和最终选项 correctness reward，不奖励推理质量、轨迹中的数值正确性，也不奖励 reasoning 与 answer 的一致性。评测不仅看随机位置数学测试集准确率，还看 A-rate、训练动态、继续用 unbiased curriculum 训练 200 步后的恢复情况、MMLU-50 的迁移，以及价值倾向二选一 prompt。
summary.experiments: 数据规模为 1266 道训练题，主测试集为 135 道位置随机的 held-out math 题。结果显示不同模型的坍缩程度差异很大，但 biased optimization 经常把选 A 的比例推到 0.90 以上，并把随机位置测试准确率压到接近随机水平。例如 Llama 3.1-8B 的准确率从 0.82 降到 0.31，A-rate 从 0.26 升到 0.94。reasoning-answer decoupling 也明显增加，例如用 GPT-4.1-mini judge 评估时，Qwen2.5-1.5B 的 decoupling 从 0.11 升到 0.43。迁移测试显示，位置捷径会外溢到未训练过的 MMLU-50：Qwen2.5-1.5B 的平均 A-rate 从 27% 升到 77%，Qwen2.5-3B 在 seed 42 下从 34% 升到 82%。继续用 unbiased curriculum 训练 200 步后，有些模型能恢复接近 unbiased 行为，有些仍保留较高 A-rate，说明捷径并不总是容易洗掉。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 35 分钟。先看 Experimental Setup，确认 biased curriculum 没有错误标签，问题只来自 reward 与策略目标的不可辨识性。然后看主结果表中的 accuracy 与 A-rate 联动；只看准确率会漏掉策略偏置。reasoning-answer decoupling 的定义和验证方式也建议看清楚，尤其是规则数值检查与 LLM judge 的一致性。恢复实验值得留意，因为它关系到 post-train 中错误偏置是否能通过后续正确监督消除。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks what a reward actually measures when it is correct on every training example but confounded with a shortcut. In the controlled setup, every training question has the correct multiple-choice answer placed at option A. The reward is factually correct, but solving the math problem and always choosing A are indistinguishable during training.
summary_en.importance: This is a useful measurement study for RL post-training. It shows that perfect training reward does not guarantee that the intended capability has been learned. If the training distribution contains positional, formatting, or template confounds, optimization can turn them into stable policies. The most relevant finding for reasoning models is reasoning-answer decoupling: a model may derive the correct numeric answer in its reasoning trace while still selecting the wrong final option, often A. This weakens the assumption that a chain-of-thought trace and the final action remain aligned under answer-only reward.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors convert GSM8K into four-choice math questions and use GPT-4.1-mini to generate three plausible distractors. They compare two curricula over the same questions. In the unbiased curriculum, the correct option is shuffled across A, B, C, and D. In the biased curriculum, the correct option is always A. The models are instruction-tuned Qwen2.5, Llama 3.x, and Gemma3 variants trained with GRPO using LoRA adapters. Training uses a three-stage format curriculum: letter-only answers, then answer/reasoning tags, then the final evaluation format with reasoning before answer. The reward contains a format component and a final-option correctness component. It does not reward reasoning quality, numeric correctness inside the trace, or consistency between reasoning and final answer. Evaluation covers randomized-position math accuracy, option-A rate, training dynamics, recovery after 200 additional unbiased GRPO steps, MMLU-50 transfer, and a value-laden binary-choice probe.
summary_en.experiments: The training set contains 1,266 questions, and the main held-out math test set contains 135 randomized-position examples. Biased optimization often drives option-A rates above 0.90 and pushes randomized-position math accuracy toward chance, although the degree of collapse varies by model family and seed. One reported example is Llama 3.1-8B, where accuracy drops from 0.82 to 0.31 while the A-rate rises from 0.26 to 0.94. Reasoning-answer decoupling also increases; under a GPT-4.1-mini judge, Qwen2.5-1.5B rises from 0.11 to 0.43. The shortcut transfers outside the training domain: on MMLU-50, Qwen2.5-1.5B mean A-rate rises from 27% to 77%, and Qwen2.5-3B with seed 42 rises from 34% to 82%. Recovery is uneven after continued unbiased training, with some models approaching unbiased behavior and others retaining elevated A-rates.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 to 35 minutes. Start with the experimental setup to verify that the biased curriculum contains no wrong labels; the issue is identifiability of the rewarded policy. Then inspect the main accuracy and A-rate results together, since accuracy alone hides the shortcut policy. The reasoning-answer decoupling section is important, especially the comparison between rule-based numeric checks and the LLM judge. The recovery experiment is also worth reading because it tests whether a shortcut acquired during RL can be removed by later correct supervision.

recommendation.zh: 控制实验极其干净，戳破GRPO训练中「CoT看起来正确就代表推理接地」的错觉，做RLVR务必排查答案位置这类易忽略的混淆因子。
recommendation.en: A spotless controlled study debunking the assumption that valid-looking CoT implies grounded reasoning under GRPO; always audit RLVR data for trivial confounds like answer position.

paper.title: GRPO Beyond English: A Large-Scale Study of GRPO in Non-English and Multilingual Settings
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), often optimized with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), has become a central recipe for improving the reasoning capabilities of pretrained language models but current studies remain heavily English-centric. We conduct a large-scale empirical study of multilingual and non-English GRPO across a wide range of base models, training languages, and different reasoning language rewards. We find that training to reason in the native language

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“GRPO 在多语言上能不能用”，而是更细的三个问题：第一，RLVR/GRPO 在非英语训练语言下是否仍然有效；第二，奖励模型要求用英语推理还是要求用题目原生语言推理，会怎样改变最终能力；第三，单语 GRPO 会不会向其他语言迁移，或者反过来带来跨语言退化。作者把问题放在一个较大规模、强控制变量的设定里做：9 个基座模型，11 个训练语言，单语与多语两种训练方式，并区分 English-reasoning reward 与 native-reasoning reward。全文最重要的结论是，多语言 RL 后训练的行为远比英文场景更依赖“模型家族 × 语言 × 奖励语言”的组合，不能从单一模型或单一语言外推。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有两层。第一，它直接补上了 RL post-train 与 multilingual pretrain 之间长期缺失的接口分析：很多模型明明做了多语言预训练，但 RL 阶段几乎只在英语上优化，这篇工作说明这种做法并不天然最优，至少在一部分语言和模型上，原生语言推理奖励只比英语推理奖励略差，甚至能带来更好的语言忠实度。第二，它揭示了一个更值得警惕的现象：GRPO 的收益和副作用都具有明显语言选择性，某些语言训练会给未见语言或其他任务带来显著回退。这对后续做 multilingual continual post-training、reasoning language control、以及预训练阶段的语言配比设计都有直接启发。贡献类型以系统性经验研究为主，不是新算法，但实验覆盖面和结论密度足够支撑后续 recipe 设计。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上没有引入新的 RL 算法，核心价值在实验设计。数据使用 Multilingual Reasoning Gym，可程序化生成 14 种语言的推理样本，并带有可调难度课程。作者没有直接把英文题翻译后拿来训，而是利用在线难度调节：某任务最近 32 次 rollout 正确率超过 70% 就升难度，低于 10% 就降难度。这样做是因为同一模型在不同语言上的能力基线不同，固定难度会把语言差异和训练效果混在一起。为了避免小模型在过难任务上完全拿不到 reward，作者先用 Qwen3-14B-Base 在默认简单难度上做筛选，去掉 pass@8 为 0 的任务；同时去掉训练集中英语内容过重的任务，只保留作评测。最终主训练集 62 个任务，OOD 评测集 30 个未见任务。

训练上，作者统一采用 DAPO 风格的 GRPO loss，不加 KL penalty。每步 64 个 prompt、每个 prompt 8 个 rollout，共 500 step，学习率 1e-6。奖励由三部分组成：二值 correctness reward 为主；只有答案正确时，额外给 format reward 和 reasoning-language reward，各自权重是 correctness 的一半。reasoning-language reward 分成两种设定：要求模型用英语写推理，或要求模型用 prompt 对应语言写推理。这里的一个细节很关键：语言奖励只在答案正确时发放，避免模型为了刷语言/格式分而牺牲解题正确率，作者也提到早期实验里低资源语言容易出现过拟合格式奖励甚至训练塌陷。

实验矩阵覆盖 Qwen、Gemma、SmolLM 三个家族，既有 base 也有 instruction/post-trained 版本，参数规模从 1B 到 8B。作者对 11 种 MGSM 语言都做了单语训练，并做了一个均匀采样语言的多语训练；意大利语、韩语、葡萄牙语完全留作 held-out language，用来测跨语言泛化。对于具备足够目标语言初始支持的模型-语言组合，再额外训练 native-reward 版本。整个设计的重点不是追求单点最好成绩，而是把“训练语言”“推理语言奖励”“模型预训练背景”这几个因素拆开看。
summary.experiments:
从全文给出的结果看，最稳定的结论有四个。第一，native-reasoning reward 平均只比 English-reasoning reward 有小幅差距，不存在普遍性的巨大性能损失。这说明在很多模型上，要求模型用本地语言思考并不会像早期工作担心的那样显著伤害最终正确率。第二，跨语言迁移很强：在一种语言上做 GRPO，往往会提升多种其他语言上的表现，说明 RL 学到的不只是表层语言模板，也包括可迁移的解题策略。第三，这种迁移并不单调，存在明显的 regression failure mode：某些模型在某种语言上训练后，会让其他未训练语言或某些评测集显著下降。作者反复强调，这种现象高度依赖具体模型和语言，不能简单归因为“低资源语言更差”或“英语总是最好”。第四，多语训练并不总是优于最佳单语训练，但通常能提供更稳健的折中，尤其在 held-out language 上更有意义。

实验评测覆盖 seen tasks、30 个未见任务、MGSM 和 PolyMath。摘要里没有给出完整表格数字，但全文明确说明结论来自 9 个模型、11 个训练语言、单语/多语、English/native reward 的大规模对照。对预训练研究者更有价值的是消融逻辑：作者不是只看平均分，而是看不同语言训练对其他语言的转移矩阵，以及不同模型家族在同一语言上的反应差异。这个分析支持一个重要判断：多语言 RL 的主要瓶颈不是“有没有多语言数据”，而是模型在各语言上的初始能力、reward 可得性、以及训练后策略漂移之间的耦合。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和实验设置，重点理解作者为什么坚持用可调难度的程序化数据，而不是直接翻译英文数学集。然后看结果部分里按训练语言、奖励语言、模型家族拆开的主表和迁移分析图，尤其留意那些“某语言训练提升本语言但伤害其他语言”的案例。Appendix 里任务筛选、held-out task 构造、以及哪些模型-语言组合具备 native reasoning 初始支持，也值得扫一遍，因为这些细节决定了结论边界。预计 25 到 35 分钟能抓住主结论；如果你关心 multilingual RL recipe，建议额外花时间看 failure cases 和 reward 设计说明。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a more precise question than “does GRPO work beyond English?” It studies three coupled issues: whether RLVR/GRPO remains effective when training is done in non-English languages, whether rewarding English reasoning versus native-language reasoning changes the outcome, and whether monolingual GRPO transfers across languages or induces regressions elsewhere. The key contribution is not a new algorithm but a controlled, large experimental matrix over 9 base models, 11 training languages, monolingual and multilingual training, and two reasoning-language reward settings. The main takeaway is that multilingual RL behavior is highly dependent on the specific model-family × language × reward-language combination, so conclusions from a single English-centric setup do not generalize well.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining-oriented research is in the interface it exposes between multilingual pretraining and RL post-training. Many open models are multilingual at pretrain time, yet their reasoning RL stage is still almost entirely English. This study shows that such a recipe is not automatically optimal: rewarding native-language reasoning often leaves only a small gap relative to English-reasoning rewards, while potentially improving language faithfulness. More importantly, the paper documents language-specific regression modes, where GRPO in one language can hurt unseen languages or other tasks. That matters for multilingual continual post-training, reasoning-language control, and even pretraining decisions such as language mixture and capability balancing. The contribution is empirical rather than algorithmic, but the scale and control make it useful for recipe design.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The technical core is the experimental design. Training data comes from Multilingual Reasoning Gym, which procedurally generates reasoning problems in 14 languages and supports adjustable difficulty. Instead of simply translating English datasets, the authors use an online curriculum: for each task, difficulty increases when more than 70% of the last 32 rollouts are correct and decreases when fewer than 10% are correct. This matters because the same model can have very different capability baselines across languages, so fixed difficulty would confound language effects with reward availability. They also pre-filter tasks using Qwen3-14B-Base at easy difficulty, removing tasks with pass@8 = 0, and exclude heavily English-dependent tasks from training while keeping them for evaluation. The resulting setup uses 62 training tasks and 30 held-out tasks for OOD evaluation.

Training uses a DAPO-style GRPO objective without KL penalty. Each run uses 500 steps, learning rate 1e-6, 64 prompts per step, and 8 rollouts per prompt. Rewards consist of a binary correctness reward plus two auxiliary rewards, each weighted at half of correctness: a format reward and a reasoning-language reward. The reasoning-language reward is instantiated either as English reasoning or native-language reasoning. A key implementation detail is that auxiliary rewards are only granted when the final answer is correct, which prevents the model from gaming language or format rewards at the expense of solving the problem. The paper notes that preliminary runs in low-resource languages could otherwise collapse or overfit to formatting.

The model suite spans Qwen, Gemma, and SmolLM families, including both base and post-trained variants from 1B to 8B parameters. The authors run monolingual GRPO for 11 MGSM languages and one multilingual run with uniform language sampling. Italian, Korean, and Portuguese are fully held out as unseen languages. For model-language pairs with sufficient initial support for the target language, they additionally train native-reward variants. The point of this design is to disentangle training language, rewarded reasoning language, and model pretraining background rather than to optimize a single benchmark score.
summary_en.experiments:
The most robust findings are fourfold. First, native-language reasoning rewards usually trail English-reasoning rewards by only a small margin on average; there is no universal large penalty for asking the model to reason in the prompt language. Second, cross-lingual transfer is strong: GRPO in one language often improves performance in many others, suggesting that RL is transferring problem-solving behavior rather than only surface-form language patterns. Third, the transfer is not monotonic. The paper identifies a regression failure mode where training in a particular language improves some evaluations but causes substantial drops on unseen languages or tasks. These regressions are highly model- and language-specific. Fourth, multilingual training is not always better than the best monolingual run, but it often provides a more stable compromise and is especially relevant for held-out-language generalization.

Evaluation covers seen tasks, 30 unseen tasks, MGSM, and PolyMath. The abstract does not expose the full numeric tables, but the full paper makes clear that the conclusions come from a broad comparison over 9 models, 11 training languages, monolingual versus multilingual runs, and English versus native reasoning rewards. For a pretraining researcher, the more useful part is the analysis style: the authors do not stop at average scores, but inspect transfer matrices across languages and compare how different model families react to the same training language. That supports a practical conclusion: the main bottleneck in multilingual RL is not merely data availability, but the interaction among initial language competence, reward attainability, and policy drift during RL.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the introduction and setup sections to understand why the paper insists on procedurally generated, difficulty-adaptive data instead of translated English math sets. Then read the main results broken down by training language, rewarded reasoning language, and model family. Pay special attention to the transfer analyses and the cases where one language improves itself but harms others. The appendix is worth skimming for task filtering, held-out task construction, and the criteria for deciding whether a model-language pair has enough initial support for native-language reasoning. Around 25–35 minutes is enough to extract the main lessons; spend more time on the failure cases if you care about multilingual RL recipes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不在算法上出新，但会直接影响多语RL配方：先看语言迁移和能力回退那几张主表，再决定内部GRPO是否继续英语中心化。
recommendation.en: No new RL algorithm here, but it can change your multilingual RL recipe; read the main transfer/regression tables before defaulting to English-centric GRPO.

paper.title: Teach the Magnitude, Not the Direction: Verifier-Bounded Credit Assignment for Multi-Turn Multi-step LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) offers a verifier-bounded performance ceiling for training multi-turn tool-use agents, yet its trajectory-level credit assignment conflates heterogeneous per-turn outcomes into a single reward signal. On-policy distillation provides dense per-token supervision but is either teacher-bounded or prone to gradient concentration collapse. We introduce $\textbf{CrEST}$, a hierarchical credit assignment framework that retains RL's verifier-bounded c

summary.core_problem: RLVR的轨迹级信用分配将不同轮次的异质结果混为单一奖励信号，导致轮间信用稀释；on-policy蒸馏提供稠密token级监督但受教师上限限制或易出现梯度集中崩溃。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出分层信用分配框架CrEST，兼顾RL的验证器有界性能上限和蒸馏的稠密token级监督信号。
summary.technical_approach: 提出CrEST分层信用分配框架，在两个层级解决信用分配问题：轮次分割的验证优势解决轮间信用稀释，熵门控自教师调制细化轮内token贡献，保留验证器上限的同时引入稠密监督。
summary.experiments: 在BFCL V3和WildToolBench基准上，两种模型规模下均一致优于RL和蒸馏基线，在长轨迹和严格会话级任务上提升幅度最大。

summary_en.core_problem: Trajectory-level credit assignment in RLVR conflates heterogeneous per-turn outcomes into a single reward signal, causing inter-turn credit dilution; on-policy distillation provides dense per-token supervision but is either teacher-bounded or prone to gradient concentration collapse.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing CrEST, a hierarchical credit assignment framework that retains the verifier-bounded performance ceiling of RL while incorporating dense token-level supervision from distillation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes CrEST, a hierarchical credit assignment framework that resolves credit at two levels: turn-segmented verified advantages address inter-turn dilution, while entropy-gated self-teacher modulation refines intra-turn token contributions, preserving the verifier ceiling while introducing dense supervision.
summary_en.experiments: On BFCL V3 and WildToolBench benchmarks, CrEST consistently outperforms both RL and distillation baselines across two model scales, with the largest gains on long-trajectory and strict session-level tasks.

recommendation.zh: 分层信用分配结合RLVR验证上限和自教师稠密信号，对多轮agent后训练有参考，做RLVR的重点看长轨迹任务的提升数据即可。
recommendation.en: Hierarchical credit assignment combining RLVR verifier bounds and dense self-teacher signals is useful for multi-turn agent post-training. Those working on RLVR should focus on the long-horizon task gains.

paper.title: PAIR: Pairwise-Aware Inclusion Reweighting for Adaptive Rollout Allocation in RLVR
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) spends most of its compute generating groups of long reasoning trajectories. Recent allocators reduce this cost by assigning budgets to prompts, rollouts, or tokens according to a pointwise notion of difficulty or utility. We identify a statistical mismatch: the unclipped leave-one-out group-relative score gradient is not a sum of independent point contributions, but a second-order U-statistic over pairs of rollouts. Completing one rollout th

summary.core_problem: RLVR中现有rollout计算预算分配器基于逐点难度/效用估计，忽略了组相对分数梯度本质上是rollout对上的二阶U统计量，导致分配次优。
summary.importance: 方法创新——揭示RLVR梯度的成对统计结构，将自适应rollout分配从逐点问题重构为图上的实验设计问题，有实际降低RLVR训练计算开销的潜力。
summary.technical_approach: PAIR将短rollout前缀视为对比图顶点、pair-gradient项视为边；用前缀预测器估计正确性和剩余token成本；通过凸优化在期望后缀token预算下选择正的继续概率；对每条观测到的边做inclusion reweighting以修正自适应选择带来的偏差。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集或baseline数字，需看正文。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing rollout budget allocators in RLVR use pointwise difficulty/utility estimates, ignoring that the unclipped leave-one-out group-relative score gradient is a second-order U-statistic over rollout pairs, leading to suboptimal allocation.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation—reveals the pairwise statistical structure of RLVR gradients and reformulates adaptive rollout allocation as experimental design on a contrast graph, with potential to materially reduce RLVR training compute.
summary_en.technical_approach: PAIR treats short rollout prefixes as vertices and pair-gradient terms as edges of a contrast graph; a prefix-only predictor estimates correctness and remaining token cost; a convex optimization selects positive continuation probabilities under an expected suffix-token budget; inclusion reweighting corrects for adaptive selection bias on observed edges.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract provides no specific model sizes, datasets, or baseline numbers; details require full text.

recommendation.zh: 把组相对梯度写成U统计量这步推导干净，做RLVR的应看§3；实际增益取决于前缀预测器质量，当弱信号读。
recommendation.en: The U-statistic reformulation of group-relative gradients is clean—read §3 if you work on RLVR; practical gains hinge on prefix predictor quality, so treat as weak signal.

paper.title: SCOUT: Unlocking Enhanced Spatial Reasoning via Structured Chain-of-Thought and Multi-Objective Process Reward
paper.abstract: Existing Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibits a critical bottleneck in robust spatial reasoning. Recent reinforcement learning (RL) methods aim to close this gap with verifiable outcomes, yet they suffer from poor credit assignment across intermediate reasoning steps. Concurrently, structured reasoning approaches overlook the critical depth perception necessary for comprehensive 3D understanding. To address these challenges, we propose SCOUT (Structured Chain-Of-Thought Utilizing Process-Super

summary.core_problem: VLM 在空间推理中不稳定，只有最终答案可验证的 RL 训练难以给中间推理步骤分配信用，尤其缺少显式深度和 3D 环境感知。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 后训练方法和训练数据：结构化 CoT、过程奖励、多目标 RL，以及 SCOUT-24k 空间推理数据。它不是基座预训练方法，但对 RLVR 如何处理可分解推理轨迹有参考。
summary.technical_approach: SCOUT 设计显式建模 3D 环境感知的结构化 Chain-of-Thought，将空间推理轨迹拆成更可监督的片段；训练侧引入多目标 process rewards 和定制 advantage estimation，以便对不同推理段落进行细粒度 credit assignment。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出底座 VLM、参数量、训练轮数、baseline 或提升幅度；实验应比较 outcome-only RL、普通 CoT、过程监督 RL 在空间推理任务上的表现，并使用 SCOUT-24k 作为训练数据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets weak spatial reasoning in VLMs, where outcome-verifiable RL provides poor credit assignment over intermediate reasoning steps and often lacks explicit depth or 3D scene modeling.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a VLM post-training recipe and dataset: structured CoT, multi-objective process rewards, tailored RL credit assignment, and SCOUT-24k. It is not a foundation pretraining method, but it is relevant to how RLVR might supervise decomposed reasoning trajectories.
summary_en.technical_approach: SCOUT defines a structured Chain-of-Thought format that explicitly models 3D environmental perception, then trains with multi-objective process rewards and a tailored advantage estimator to assign credit across different segments of the reasoning trajectory.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify the base VLM, parameter count, training schedule, baselines, or quantitative gains. The expected comparison is against outcome-only RL, standard CoT, and process-supervised variants on spatial reasoning tasks using SCOUT-24k.

recommendation.zh: 作为 RLVR 信号设计备查即可；若没有严谨 ablation，结构化 CoT 很容易只是格式工程。
recommendation.en: Keep it as RLVR signal-design background; without tight ablations, the structured CoT part may just be format engineering.

paper.title: ToolVision: Learning When and How to Use Visual Tools with Capability-Aligned Supervision
paper.abstract: Thinking with images allows a multimodal model to compensate for limited perception by invoking visual tools through code. Yet the prevailing SFT-then-RL recipe creates a different supervision misalignment at each stage. SFT is expected to teach how to use tools, but trajectories from stronger teachers may succeed through perceptual capabilities that a smaller student cannot reliably reproduce or exploit, causing the student to imitate tool-call patterns without learning how to make them useful.

summary.core_problem: 多模态模型在 SFT-then-RL 流程中学习视觉工具调用时，SFT 阶段存在能力不对齐、RL 阶段 outcome reward 抑制工具使用的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新：把'何时用工具'和'如何用工具'的监督信号分别在 SFT/RL 阶段对齐到学生模型能力。
summary.technical_approach: SFT 阶段用多 agent 搜索候选轨迹，由含学生规模模型的委员会按 stepwise evidence gain 打分剪枝；RL 阶段设计 capability-aligned reward，区分有效但无用的工具调用与真正带来证据增益的调用。
summary.experiments: 论文摘要未给出具体模型规模、baseline 与数字，仅描述方法框架。
summary.authors_note: 作者包含 Linfeng Zhang（上海 AI Lab/通用方向），但需以论文正文为准。

summary_en.core_problem: In SFT-then-RL training of multimodal tool-using agents, SFT trajectories come from stronger teachers whose perception the student cannot reproduce, while outcome-only RL rewards either suppress tool use or reward ineffective calls.
summary_en.importance: Method contribution: capability-aligned supervision that separately addresses 'how' (SFT) and 'when' (RL) to use visual tools.
summary_en.technical_approach: SFT uses a multi-agent trajectory search with a committee including student-scale models scoring stepwise evidence gain; RL uses a shaped reward that distinguishes evidence-gaining tool calls from valid-but-useless ones.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract gives no model sizes, baselines, or quantitative results; framework-level description only.

recommendation.zh: 思路对 post-train 有启发：SFT 数据应按学生能力过滤而非照搬强教师轨迹；但摘要无实验，先看 reward 设计一节即可。
recommendation.en: The 'student-capability-aligned SFT filtering' idea is worth borrowing for post-training; skip until §reward design, no numbers in abstract.

paper.title: Parameter Exploration for RLVR via Variational Learning
paper.abstract: Exploration has been a focus of reinforcement learning research for a long time. Recently, there has been growing evidence that it is also an important ingredient in LLM reinforcement learning recipes that can significantly impact downstream performance. Many existing methods control exploration in the action-space, for example, using temperature scaling. However, these methods cannot reorder tokens but only influence the variance in the output distribution. This limits exploration and can lead

summary.core_problem: RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）训练中，现有动作空间探索方法（如温度缩放）只能改变token分布的方差、无法重排token相对顺序，导致高奖励轨迹难以被采样到；在GRPO这类分组优势计算算法中，若同一prompt的所有rollout奖励相同则产生零优势组，训练停滞、算力浪费。
summary.importance: 首次将参数空间探索引入LLM的RLVR训练，提供了独立于温度/熵正则的新探索控制维度；对当前主流的GRPO类RL后训练流程有直接参考价值，尤其能缓解难样本上的探索不足与零优势组问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Perturbed Parameter Policy Optimization（3PO）框架：在训练中维护一个参数近似后验分布，每步通过向模型参数注入可学习的噪声采样出多个扰动策略，用这些策略生成rollout，从而改变logit值、直接重排token分布，突破温度缩放的探索边界。设计了三种噪声注入变体：B3PO每步仅采样一次权重扰动，实现简单但组内多样性受限；M3PO对M次独立权重扰动分别计算优势后做一次参数更新；C3PO将一个GRPO组的样本拆分到N个独立采样的扰动权重上计算优势，最大化组内多样性。噪声强度通过变分学习自适应调整，无需额外增加rollout数量。
summary.experiments: 在OLMo-3-1025-7B和Qwen2.5-Math-7B两个基座上，覆盖数学推理与代码生成任务验证。C3PO在两个模型家族上取得平均最优性能，相比AdamW基线不增加rollout数量的同时提升下游效果并加快收敛。多模型采样的变体（M3PO/C3PO）显著优于单采样的B3PO，比温度缩放等动作空间探索基线能挽救更多零优势组。提升主要集中在AIME、LiveCodeBench这类难度更高的基准上，说明参数探索对难任务的探索瓶颈改善更明显。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，预计15-20分钟。重点看第1节对温度缩放探索边界的分析（含Figure 1的示意），第3节三种3PO变体的分组与优势计算差异，以及实验部分零优势组比例的消融和难基准上的增益对比。可跳过背景公式推导细节。

summary_en.core_problem: In RLVR (Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards), existing action-space exploration methods such as temperature scaling only modulate the variance of the token distribution and cannot reorder the relative ranking of tokens. As a result, high-reward trajectories are rarely sampled. For grouped advantage algorithms like GRPO, zero-advantage groups emerge when all rollouts of a prompt share the same reward, causing training stalls and wasted compute.
summary_en.importance: This work introduces parameter-space exploration to LLM RLVR training for the first time, providing a new control lever for exploration that is complementary to temperature scaling and entropy regularization. It has direct practical implications for mainstream GRPO-style RL post-training pipelines, especially in alleviating under-exploration and zero-advantage groups on hard examples.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Perturbed Parameter Policy Optimization (3PO) framework maintains an approximate posterior over model parameters. At each training step, multiple perturbed policies are sampled by injecting learned noise into the parameters, which directly modifies logits and reorders token distributions — a capability beyond temperature scaling. Three variants are designed: B3PO draws one weight perturbation per gradient step, which is simple but limits group diversity; M3PO computes advantages separately for M independent weight perturbations before a single parameter update; C3PO splits one GRPO group across N independently perturbed weights to maximize within-group diversity. Noise scale is adapted via variational learning, without requiring additional rollouts.
summary_en.experiments: Validation is conducted on OLMo-3-1025-7B and Qwen2.5-Math-7B across mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks. C3PO achieves the best average performance across both model families, improving downstream results and accelerating convergence over the AdamW baseline without increasing rollout count. Multi-sample variants (M3PO/C3PO) consistently outperform single-sample B3PO and rescue more zero-advantage groups than action-space baselines such as temperature scaling. Gains are concentrated on harder benchmarks including AIME and LiveCodeBench, indicating that parameter exploration is more effective at resolving exploration bottlenecks on difficult tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, ~15–20 minutes. Focus on Section 1's analysis of the exploration limits of temperature scaling (including Figure 1), Section 3's design of the three 3PO variants and their advantage computation differences, and the ablation on zero-advantage group ratio plus gains on hard benchmarks in the experiments section. Background formula derivations can be skipped.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和 ablation：若参数扰动比温度更稳，RLVR 内部 recipe 应加这个探索维度。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations: if parameter perturbation beats temperature cleanly, RLVR recipes need this exploration knob.

paper.title: Improving Generalization Robustness of Multimodal RLVR
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) makes Multimodal Large Language Models more accurate, but the gains are brittle: simply paraphrasing a question or changing the prompt template can degrade them, which challenges reliable deployment in high-stakes scenarios like medical VQA. We trace this to two issues of the standard RL objective. First, the binary verifier conflates format with content, so the reward signal cannot tell a wrong answer apart from a misformatted one. Second, t

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究多模态 RLVR 的泛化脆弱性：模型在训练时拿到可验证奖励后，遇到语义等价但表述不同的 prompt 或模板时性能会明显下滑。
summary.importance: 这对 pretrain 研究员是间接相关但有价值的，因为它暴露了后训练奖励设计中的一个老问题：reward 把格式和语义混在一起，会诱导策略学到脆弱捷径。若这一点成立，它会反过来影响如何设计 verifier、合成数据和 mid-train / RL 接口。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把问题归因于标准 RL 目标的两点缺陷：一是二值 verifier 无法区分“答案错”和“格式错”；二是训练分布过窄，导致策略对未见 prompt 变体不稳。对应地，方法上强调两件事：把 reward 中的格式约束与语义正确性解耦；并在策略优化中引入更广的语义等价 prompt 分布，以提升对 paraphrase 和模板变化的鲁棒性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集和提升数字，但明确场景是多模态 RLVR，并以 prompt paraphrase / template shift 下的泛化退化为主要评测维度。若正文包含 clean 的 in-distribution vs out-of-template 对照和 reward ablation，这篇会比一般 RL trick 更值得看，因为它在测训练信号本身的失真。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a brittleness issue in multimodal RLVR: models improve under verifiable rewards during training, yet degrade noticeably when faced with semantically equivalent prompts or different templates at test time.
summary_en.importance: This is indirectly relevant to pretraining researchers because it exposes a familiar post-training failure mode: the reward mixes formatting with semantics, encouraging brittle shortcuts. If the diagnosis is correct, it has implications for verifier design, synthetic data generation, and the pretrain-to-RL interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors attribute the problem to two flaws in the standard RL objective. First, a binary verifier cannot distinguish a wrong answer from a misformatted but semantically correct one. Second, the training distribution covers only a narrow slice of possible prompts, so the learned policy is unstable under unseen prompt variants. The proposed remedy is to separate format from semantic correctness in the reward and optimize over a broader distribution of semantically equivalent prompts.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, or exact gains, but it clearly frames prompt paraphrase and template shift as the key generalization tests in multimodal RLVR. If the full paper includes clean in-distribution vs out-of-template comparisons and reward-design ablations, it is more informative than a typical RL trick paper because it probes distortion in the training signal itself.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该看的是 reward 设计而不是多模态外壳：若实验对 template shift 控得干净，它会直接影响你怎么做 verifier、怎么写 RL 数据格式。
recommendation.en: Read this for the reward-design lesson, not the multimodal wrapper: if the template-shift setup is clean, it should change how you build verifiers and format RL data.

paper.title: Beyond Solvability: Task Learnability as a Static Prior for LLM RL Post-Training
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a central post-training paradigm for eliciting reasoning capabilities in large language models, yet uniform task sampling allocates compute without regard to differences in how tasks respond to optimization. Existing task-valuation methods mostly rely on snapshot-based signals such as current pass rate or reward, which estimate how solvable a task is under the current policy. However, tasks with similar current solvability can still differ substantially in

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM RL 后训练中任务采样只看当前可解性，无法判断哪些任务会从继续优化中真正受益的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练数据与算力分配方法。它把任务价值从 snapshot pass rate/reward 扩展到 regime-conditional learnability，对 RLVR、数学推理训练和训练集 curriculum 都有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文定义 task learnability：在固定 RL 后训练 regime 下，某个任务对继续训练的预期正响应。作者先分析 per-task reward trajectories，验证 learnability 在独立采样训练上下文中可复现，并提出 TrajVal，用轻量 probe 在正式训练前估计任务 learnability，作为静态任务采样先验。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明作者分析了逐任务 reward 轨迹，并验证 learnability 能预测 downstream utility；TrajVal 被设计为训练前轻量估计器。摘要未披露具体基座模型规模、任务集规模、RL 算法细节、baseline 名称和提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to allocate RL post-training compute across tasks when current solvability does not tell whether a task will improve under further optimization.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training data and compute-allocation contribution. It shifts task valuation from snapshot pass rate or reward to regime-conditional learnability, which is directly relevant to RLVR-style reasoning training and curriculum design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define task learnability as the expected positive response of a task to continued training under a fixed RL regime. They analyze per-task reward trajectories, show that learnability is reproducible across independently sampled training contexts, and propose TrajVal, a lightweight probe-based estimator usable before full RL training.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports trajectory-level analyses showing that learnability predicts downstream utility, and introduces TrajVal as a pre-training estimator. It does not expose concrete model sizes, task counts, RL algorithms, baselines, or effect sizes.

recommendation.zh: 读定义和 TrajVal setup；若轨迹复现干净，它会改变 RL 数据筛选只看 pass rate 的默认做法。
recommendation.en: Read the definition and TrajVal setup; if the trajectory evidence is clean, it weakens pass-rate-only task filtering for RL data.

paper.title: StructReward: Efficient Structured Process Rewards for Self-Correcting Multimodal Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as an effective approach for improving multimodal reasoning. However, most existing methods evaluate an entire response using a binary reward based only on final-answer correctness, thereby discarding the supervision available in intermediate reasoning steps. Process reward models offer finer-grained feedback, but they typically rely on separately trained verifiers, costly chain-of-thought annotations, or online judging by large l

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态推理 RLVR 中奖励过稀的问题：只看最终答案对错会丢掉中间推理步骤中的监督信号。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练奖励设计。它试图用低成本结构化过程奖励替代昂贵的 verifier、人工 CoT 标注或在线 LLM judge。对预训练研究员的价值在于观察：推理能力提升未必只靠更大模型或更复杂 judge，reward granularity 和信号成本同样关键。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 StructReward，把模型生成的解答切分成 reasoning steps，再与带过程标签的 reference steps 对齐。对齐不依赖大型验证器，而使用轻量的数值、符号和词面匹配规则；之后把 step-level 标签聚合为 dense process reward，并与最终答案一致性、输出格式等信号组合用于 RL。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型参数量、数据规模、任务名称和提升幅度。可确认实验目标是 multimodal reasoning 下的 RLVR，对比对象包括只用 final-answer binary reward 的方法，以及依赖 process reward model、CoT 标注或 LLM judge 的高成本方案。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses reward sparsity in multimodal RLVR, where judging only final-answer correctness discards supervision from intermediate reasoning steps.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training reward-design contribution. It aims to provide dense process rewards without separately trained verifiers, costly chain-of-thought annotations, or online LLM judges. For pretraining-oriented work, the useful signal is that reward granularity and reward cost can matter as much as model scale in reasoning improvements.
summary_en.technical_approach: StructReward decomposes each generated solution into reasoning steps and aligns them to process-labeled reference steps. The alignment uses lightweight numerical, symbolic, and lexical matching rules rather than a large verifier. The aligned step labels are aggregated into a dense process reward and combined with final-answer consistency and output-format signals for RL.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, dataset scale, benchmark names, or exact gains. It indicates evaluation on multimodal reasoning RLVR, with comparisons against final-answer binary rewards and more expensive process-reward approaches based on verifiers, CoT annotations, or LLM judges.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和 reward aggregation 即可；结论若成立，说明部分 RLVR 收益来自廉价 dense signal，而非 judge 智能。
recommendation.en: Read the reward construction and aggregation; if the results hold, some RLVR gains come from cheap dense signals rather than smarter judges.

paper.title: PAST: Privileged Adaptation from Complete Student Trajectories for On-Policy Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) uses a privileged teacher to supervise a reasoning model on prefixes sampled from its own rollouts. Yet each rollout also reveals how the student's response unfolds and whether it succeeds, student-specific hindsight that standard OPSD does not use to form the teacher. We introduce Privileged Adaptation from Student Trajectories (PAST), which treats each completed student trajectory as additional privileged information for the OPSD teacher while leaving the stu

summary.core_problem: 解决 on-policy self-distillation 中 teacher 只看学生 rollout prefix，而没有利用完整学生轨迹成败信息的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练推理蒸馏方法。它关注 student 自己产生的完整轨迹如何作为 privileged information 改造 teacher，这对 RLVR、self-training 和 verifier-guided distillation 的接口有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PAST。对正确轨迹，保持学生的 next-token distribution；对失败轨迹，用完整轨迹及其验证结果适配 teacher，使 teacher 朝 verified success 移动，同时加入 student-proximity regularization，避免 teacher 偏离学生可学习区域。理论上分析 trajectory-conditioned teacher 能向 prefix-only student 传递什么；forward-KL distillation 会把 teacher distribution 投影为给定 prefix 下的条件算术平均。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体任务、模型规模、训练数据、baseline 或提升幅度。可确认的是方法设定在 reasoning model 的 on-policy self-distillation 上，依赖学生 rollout、prefix 级蒸馏、轨迹级成功/失败信号和 teacher adaptation。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a missing signal in on-policy self-distillation: completed student trajectories reveal success or failure, but standard teacher construction only supervises prefixes.
summary_en.importance: It is a post-training method for reasoning distillation. The useful idea is to treat full student rollouts as privileged information for the teacher, which is relevant to RLVR, self-training, and verifier-conditioned distillation.
summary_en.technical_approach: PAST keeps the student next-token distribution on correct trajectories and adapts the teacher on failed trajectories toward verified success, with a student-proximity regularizer to keep the teacher learnable. It also characterizes what a trajectory-conditioned teacher can transfer to a prefix-only student, noting that forward-KL distillation projects teacher distributions to a conditional arithmetic mean given the prefix.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide task names, model sizes, datasets, baselines, or quantitative gains. The confirmed setup is reasoning-model on-policy self-distillation using student rollouts, prefix-level distillation, trajectory-level success/failure, and teacher adaptation.

recommendation.zh: 读理论投影部分即可；完整轨迹当 privileged context 这点干净，但效果要看 verifier 噪声。
recommendation.en: Read the projection analysis; using full trajectories as privileged context is clean, but the empirical value will hinge on verifier noise.

paper.title: Sharding Prevents LLM Oversight Failures and Adversarial Exploitation
paper.abstract: Giving an LLM judge more compute does not necessarily make it check more requirements. When one call must return many verdicts, some decisions become weakly grounded in the evidence, even when that call receives the same token or tool budget as a panel of separate calls. Across expert-graded research replications, legal work, and clinical-trial assessments, agreement with experts falls as the number of verdicts per call grows. We identify sharding as the intervention that mitigates this failure

summary.core_problem: 单次 LLM judge 调用同时给出多个 verdict 时，决策质量随 verdict 数量下降；如何通过 sharding 缓解 oversight 失败。
summary.importance: 对 LLM-as-judge、可扩展监督、RLHF/RLVR 中 verifier 设计有直接启示；属于评测协议与 oversight 方法论贡献。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 sharding：把 requirements 切成小组，每组独立调用，再聚合 verdict；在固定 model、evidence、总预算和单决策预算下与 holistic judge 对比。
summary.experiments: 在专家评分的科研复现、法律工作、临床试验评估三类任务上，sharded 弱 judge 可超过拿到完整预算的 holistic 强 judge，并能抵御对抗性利用。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 CMU；J. Zico Kolter 为 CMU 知名教授，方向涵盖对抗鲁棒性、生成模型与 LLM 安全。

summary_en.core_problem: When a single LLM judge call must return many verdicts, per-decision grounding degrades; how to mitigate this oversight failure via sharding.
summary_en.importance: Direct implications for LLM-as-judge, scalable oversight, and verifier design in RLHF/RLVR; a methodological contribution to evaluation protocols.
summary_en.technical_approach: Sharding partitions requirements into smaller groups, assigns each to a separate call, and aggregates verdicts; compared against a holistic judge under fixed model, evidence, total budget, and per-decision budget.
summary_en.experiments: Across expert-graded research replications, legal work, and clinical-trial assessments, a sharded weaker judge outperforms a more capable holistic judge even when the latter receives the panel's full budget, and is more robust to adversarial exploitation.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors affiliated with CMU; J. Zico Kolter is a well-known CMU professor working on adversarial robustness, generative models, and LLM safety.

recommendation.zh: 做 verifier/judge 或 RLVR 的人该看：单调用多 verdict 会掉点，sharding 是便宜的对冲手段；结论干净，可直接在内部 judge 流水线复现。
recommendation.en: Relevant if you build judges/verifiers or run RLVR: packing many verdicts into one call hurts, and sharding is a cheap fix; clean setup worth reproducing internally.

paper.title: DiDPO: Diff-in-Diff Policy Optimization for Coding Agent Training
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for training coding agents, where the execution feedback from compilation and tests provides objective verification. However, unlike agent tasks, coding agents face a unique and finer-grained credit assignment challenge: at each step, coding actions simultaneously pack varying changes into different regions of a code version, which makes the contribution of independent change indistinguishable. Existing RLVR

summary.core_problem: 在 coding agent 的 RLVR 训练中，单步动作往往对应一个包含多处修改的 code diff，导致 credit assignment 过粗：成功/失败的回报无法区分 diff 内不同子修改的贡献。论文要解决的是：不引入 critic、也不增加额外环境 rollouts 的情况下，如何把轨迹级回报细化到 diff 内部的子区域，并把更细粒度的优势信号回传到对应的响应 token。
summary.importance:
更偏 post-train / agent RL 的方法论文，对“预训练”本身影响间接，但对 pretrain↔posttrain 闭环有两点启发：
1）当动作天然是“打包的结构化编辑”（diff）时，直接用 outcome reward 或 step reward 会浪费可验证信号；需要把结构拆开再做优势分配。
2）它提供了一种不依赖 value critic 的细粒度 credit 构造方式，和 GRPO/DAPO/GSPO 这类 group-based policy optimization 的工程路线兼容，适合在大规模 RLVR 训练里控制不稳定性与成本。

是否值得投入取决于你的工作是否覆盖 coding agent 的 RL 训练；若主要做基座预训练/数据/优化，这篇更多是“了解一种 credit 细化的做法”，不太会直接改你的 pretrain recipe。
summary.technical_approach:
DiDPO 的核心是把“轨迹级 group-relative advantage”继续向下分解到 diff 内部。

设定上沿用 CodeAct 式 Thought-Action-Observation 循环：每步 action 产生一次代码编辑（add/del/none），环境给 outcome reward（例如测试是否通过）。传统做法把整段响应当作一个 credit 载体；GiGPO 会按相似 state/action 分组做 state-level advantage，但 coding 的关键困难是：同一步 diff 里可能包含多个功能区域的修改。

DiDPO 做了三件事：
1）跨 rollouts 对齐 diff：对同一任务 prompt 采样多条轨迹，比较相邻版本之间的 diffs，在不同 rollout 的 diffs 中寻找“高度相似的 sub-diff”作为 anchor。
2）用 anchor 诱导 sub-diff 边界：把一个大 diff 切成若干 sub-diff，使这些 sub-diff 更像可复用的功能单元（例如某个函数、某段逻辑、某处 import/配置）。
3）sub-diff 分组并计算 diff-level advantage：把对齐后的 sub-diff 组成局部 group，计算局部的 group-relative advantage（diff-level advantage），再与轨迹级 advantage 结合，并投影回生成这些 sub-diff 的 token 上更新策略。

为避免 anchor 过大（语义太杂）或过小（难以聚合成组），论文引入 groupability score 来选择 anchor，平衡语义覆盖与可形成足够样本量的分组。

整体上它是 critic-free 的：优势来自组内相对比较，而不是学习一个 value function；并且强调“不需要额外 rollouts”，即在同一批采样轨迹上做更细的对齐与分配。
summary.experiments:
论文声称在多个 long-horizon coding benchmark 上优于现有 coding/agentic RL baselines（文中提到的对比对象包括 GRPO、DAPO、GSPO、GiGPO 等路线，以及一些 coding agent 相关方法）。但当前提供的正文片段未包含：具体 benchmark 名称与规模、基座模型大小、训练步数/rollout 数、pass@k 或 repo-repair 成功率的绝对值与提升幅度、以及关键消融（没有 sub-diff advantage / 没有 groupability / 不同对齐策略）的数字。

精读时建议重点核对两类结果：
- 细粒度 credit 是否真的带来稳定收益，还是主要来自某种隐含的“更强的样本筛选/重加权”；
- 计算开销：diff 对齐与相似度计算在大规模 RLVR 下是否成为瓶颈。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
1）先读 Introduction 里对 coding 与一般 agent action 的三点差异（diff 打包、sub-diff 功能混杂、语法/执行约束），这是方法动机的关键。
2）再读 Problem Setting，确认它沿用的 group-relative advantage 形式，以及与 GiGPO 的关系。
3）方法部分重点看：sub-diff anchor 如何定义“相似”、边界如何诱导、groupability score 的具体形式，以及 token-level credit 如何回传。
4）实验部分优先找消融：没有对齐/没有 groupability/只用 trajectory advantage 的对比。

预计阅读时间：20–30 分钟可把方法主线读懂；若要落地实现，需要额外时间看 diff 相似度与对齐的工程细节。

summary_en.core_problem: In RLVR training for coding agents, a single step often produces a bundled code diff touching multiple regions, making credit assignment too coarse. The paper targets fine-grained credit assignment inside a diff—down to aligned sub-diffs—without using a critic and without requiring extra environment rollouts.
summary_en.importance:
This is a post-training / agent-RL contribution rather than pretraining. The relevance to foundation-model training is indirect but practical if you run large-scale RLVR: (1) it argues that outcome/step rewards waste verifiable signal when actions are structured edits; (2) it offers a critic-free way to construct finer advantages compatible with group-based policy optimization (GRPO/DAPO/GSPO-style), potentially improving stability/cost.

If your focus is core pretraining (data/optimizer/scaling), this is more of a technique to be aware of than something that changes pretrain recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach:
DiDPO extends group-relative advantage from the trajectory level into the internal structure of a code diff.

Using a CodeAct-like interaction loop, each action yields an edit (add/del/none) and the environment provides an outcome reward (e.g., tests pass/fail). Instead of treating the whole response/diff as one credit carrier, DiDPO:
1) Aligns diffs across multiple rollouts for the same task by finding highly similar sub-diffs that recur across trajectories.
2) Uses these recurring sub-diffs as anchors to induce sub-diff boundaries within larger diffs, aiming to isolate functional regions.
3) Groups aligned sub-diffs and computes a local group-relative advantage (diff-level advantage), then combines it with the trajectory-level advantage and assigns it back to the tokens responsible for generating those sub-diffs.

To avoid anchors that are too broad (mixing functions) or too narrow (hard to aggregate), it introduces a groupability score to select anchors that balance semantic scope and group mass. The method remains critic-free and claims no additional rollouts beyond the sampled group.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper reports consistent improvements over strong RLVR baselines (e.g., GRPO/DAPO/GSPO/GiGPO-style methods) on long-horizon coding benchmarks. However, the provided excerpt does not include the concrete experimental tables: benchmark list, model sizes, training budgets, absolute success rates/pass@k, and key ablations (removing sub-diff alignment, removing groupability scoring, using only trajectory-level advantage).

When reading the full experiments, the main checks are: whether gains persist across tasks and seeds, and whether diff alignment/similarity computation becomes a scalability bottleneck.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
- Read the introduction’s three properties distinguishing coding from generic agent RL; that is the real motivation.
- In the problem setting, confirm the baseline advantage formulation and how it relates to GiGPO.
- In the method section, focus on: how sub-diff similarity/anchors are defined, how boundaries are induced, what the groupability score is, and how token-level credit is assigned.
- In experiments, prioritize ablations isolating each component.

Time: ~20–30 minutes for the main idea; longer if you need implementation details for diff alignment.

recommendation.zh: 将 RL 的 reward 粒度下钻到 code diff 级别是个很直觉且 necessary 的改进，值得关注其具体的 diff 构造和 credit assignment 算法设计。
recommendation.en: Drilling down the RL reward granularity to the code diff level is an intuitive and necessary improvement; the specific diff construction and credit assignment algorithm design are worth examining.

paper.title: DASH: Divergence-Adaptive Supervision Horizons for On-Policy Self-Distillation of Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models using automatically verifiable outcome signals, but these signals are typically sparse and at the sequence-level. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) mitigates this sparsity by querying a privileged teacher at student-visited prefixes and providing dense token-level distributional supervision. Although this dense supervision alleviates signal sparsity, we find that standard OPSD stil

summary.core_problem: RLVR使用稀疏的序列级奖励，难以做时间信用分配。On-policy self-distillation（OPSD）通过特权教师提供稠密token级分布监督来缓解信号稀疏，但vanilla OPSD对所有位置的局部KL发散赋予均匀权重，忽略了rollout中发散值的时序结构——相同的局部分散值可能出现在完全不同的发散历史之后，均匀加权无法区分这些时序上下文。
summary.importance: 指出了vanilla OPSD中一个具体且重要的缺陷：均匀系数分配使得目标函数对发散值的时序排列不敏感。提出的DASH方法通过路径依赖的门控递归实现自适应时序加权，用可忽略的额外开销在数学推理基准上取得一致提升。对预训练研究的启发在于：稠密监督信号的时序加权结构值得更细致的设计，这与预训练中不同位置loss权重分配、RL预训练中的信用分配问题有共通的结构。
summary.technical_approach: DASH的核心是divergence-adaptive propagation gate：在每个位置t，计算局部分散值与序列级平均分散值的差距，将其转化为自适应传播门λ_t。这些门控控制一个反向多步递归——从后往前传播，每个局部损失的有效系数由其前面所有位置的门控路径共同决定，从而实现路径依赖的动态权重分配。这一设计的动机来自对on-policy目标精确梯度的分析：精确梯度包含一个轨迹项，其系数依赖于后续位置的发散值，呈现顺序依赖结构，而vanilla OPSD只保留了直接蒸馏项，丢弃了这一时序结构。
summary.experiments: 在三个数学推理基准、三个模型规模上，DASH取得了对比方法中最高的综合分数，额外训练开销可忽略。消融实验验证了：(1)基于局部-均值发散差的门控比固定门控更有效；(2)多步反向聚合优于单步加权；(3)自适应监督horizon在不同长度的推理链上均有收益。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注Section 4.1对vanilla OPSD时序系数分配缺陷的形式化分析（均匀加权使得目标对发散排列不变），以及Section 4.2中DASH门控递归的具体构造。从exact on-policy gradient推导结构参考的部分是理解方法动机的关键，值得细读。预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: RLVR relies on sparse sequence-level rewards, making temporal credit assignment difficult. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) provides dense token-level distributional supervision via a privileged teacher, but vanilla OPSD applies uniform weights to all local KL divergences regardless of temporal context. The same local divergence magnitude can follow entirely different discrepancy histories along a rollout, and uniform weighting cannot distinguish these temporal contexts.
summary_en.importance: Identifies a concrete and significant limitation in vanilla OPSD: uniform coefficient allocation makes the objective invariant to permutations of divergence values along the sequence, discarding temporal structure. DASH addresses this with path-dependent gated recursion for adaptive temporal weighting, yielding consistent gains on math reasoning benchmarks with negligible overhead. The broader lesson—that dense supervision signals require carefully designed temporal weighting—connects to loss-weighting questions in pretraining and credit assignment in RL pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: DASH introduces divergence-adaptive propagation gates: at each position t, the gap between the local divergence and the sequence-level mean divergence is converted into an adaptive gate λ_t. These gates control a backward multi-step recursion, propagating from the end of the sequence backward so that each local loss's effective coefficient is determined by the full path of preceding gates. This design is motivated by analyzing the exact gradient of the expected on-policy objective, which contains a trajectory term with coefficients that depend on subsequent divergences—an order-dependent structure that vanilla OPSD discards by retaining only the direct distillation term.
summary_en.experiments: Achieves the highest overall scores among compared methods across three mathematical reasoning benchmarks and three model scales, with negligible additional training cost. Ablations validate that: (1) gates based on local-mean divergence gaps outperform fixed gates; (2) multi-step backward aggregation outperforms single-step weighting; (3) adaptive supervision horizons provide gains across reasoning chains of varying lengths.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 4.1 for the formal analysis of the temporal coefficient allocation gap in vanilla OPSD (uniform weighting makes the objective permutation-invariant to divergence values), and Section 4.2 for the concrete construction of the DASH gating recursion. The gradient analysis deriving structural guidance from the exact on-policy gradient is the key to understanding the method's motivation and deserves careful reading. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 推理模型自蒸馏训练的关键细节改进，核心是引入时间结构自适应调整token级监督权重，做RLVR的同学重点看§3权重设计
recommendation.en: Key detailed improvement for reasoning model self-distillation training, introducing temporal structure for adaptive token-level supervision weighting; focus on §3 weight design if working on RLVR.

paper.title: Evaluating Theory of Mind in Reasoning Models: Robustness over Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown strong performance on Theory of Mind (ToM) tests, prompting debate about the nature and validity of the underlying capabilities. At the same time, reasoning-oriented LLMs trained via reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards have demonstrated notable improvements across a range of benchmarks. In this work, we examine the behavior of such reasoning models in ToM tasks using novel adaptations of machine psychological experiments together with r

summary.core_problem: 检验推理型 LLM 在 Theory of Mind 任务上的提升，究竟来自新的 ToM 能力，还是仅仅来自对 prompt 与任务扰动更稳健。
summary.importance: 这是一篇机制解释与评测分析工作。它的价值不在于提出新训练法，而在于给近期“reasoning model 是否学会更深层认知能力”这类讨论降温：至少在 ToM 上，提升可能更多是 robustness，而不是能力范式变化。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把机器心理学实验改写为适合 LLM 的 ToM 测试，并结合已有 benchmark，对 reasoning-oriented、经 RL with verifiable rewards 训练的模型进行 prompt variation 和 task perturbation 下的稳健性分析。核心不是看单点准确率，而是看答案在扰动下是否保持正确。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 reasoning models 在 ToM 任务上表现出更高的鲁棒性，并且这种增益至少部分来自更稳定地到达正确答案，而非出现新的 ToM-specific ability。未在摘要中给出具体模型名单、参数量和数值幅度，因此更适合作为 interpretive evidence，而不是强结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Leiden University 的 LIACS 团队；未见顶级工业实验室背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether gains of reasoning-oriented LLMs on Theory of Mind tasks reflect a new ToM capability or simply greater robustness to prompt and task perturbations.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism and evaluation paper. Its value is not in proposing a new training recipe, but in tempering claims that reasoning models have acquired qualitatively new cognitive abilities: at least for ToM, the gains may be better explained by robustness.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors adapt machine-psychology experiments into LLM-friendly ToM tests and combine them with established benchmarks. They evaluate reasoning models trained with reinforcement learning and verifiable rewards under prompt variations and task perturbations, focusing on stability of correct answers rather than single-shot accuracy alone.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, reasoning models consistently show improved robustness on ToM tasks, and the gains appear to come at least partly from being more reliable at reaching the correct answer under variation, rather than from a new ToM-specific ability. The abstract does not provide model names, scales, or detailed effect sizes, so this should be read as interpretive evidence rather than a definitive claim.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from LIACS at Leiden University; no major frontier-industry lab affiliation is indicated.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在看 RL 后 reasoning 对 pretrain 能力边界的反哺，这篇可作弱证据：别急着把 benchmark 提升解释成新能力，先看 robustness；正文不必细读。
recommendation.en: Useful as weak evidence when thinking about how RL-style reasoning feeds back into base-model capability: do not over-interpret benchmark gains as new abilities before checking robustness; not worth a deep read.

paper.title: Don't Peek at the Answer: Outcome-Masked Group Relative Policy Optimization for Label-Free RLVR
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves LLM reasoning but typically relies on ground-truth (GT) answers, limiting scalability. Voting-based label-free RLVR replace gold supervision with answer-level consensus from model samples. However, collapse arises when the same answer-level signal is used both to estimate rewards and to drive token-level policy optimization, encouraging the model to directly reinforce answer tokens rather than improve reasoning. We propose OM-GRPO, a

summary.core_problem: 现有基于多数投票的无标注RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）方法存在答案token捷径学习问题——模型直接强化高频答案token而非提升推理能力，导致奖励黑客和训练崩溃，同时传统RLVR依赖真值答案标注，成本高昂难以扩展。
summary.importance: 答案跨度梯度掩码的设计思路可迁移至所有基于结果奖励的RL对齐场景，从机制上避免模型走答案捷径；软共识加对比增强的无标注奖励构造方案，降低了RLVR对人工标注的依赖，为大规模推理增强训练提供了低成本路径；通过跟踪答案多样性诊断训练崩溃的方法，可直接用于RL后训练的动态监控体系。
summary.technical_approach: 提出OM-GRPO框架，核心包含两个设计：一是答案跨度梯度掩码，在GRPO的梯度更新阶段，对答案区间的token设置零梯度掩码，仅保留思维链推理轨迹部分的梯度，同时保留基于组内答案频率计算的软共识奖励（而非硬多数投票奖励），将优化压力从答案token转移至推理过程本身；二是对比增强奖励（CAR），对同组内的推理轨迹进行两两对比，让模型输出更优轨迹对应的答案，以极低计算成本扩充答案池，提升软奖励的估计可靠性，不需要重新采样完整的长推理轨迹。
summary.experiments: 在多个推理基准、三个不同的LLM骨干上测试，OM-GRPO稳定优于此前的无标注RLVR基线，性能与使用真值奖励的训练效果持平；在测试时训练（TTT）场景下，相比多数投票基线提升4.24分，且全程无训练崩溃；诊断实验显示，传统投票法训练过程中答案多样性快速下降，伴随性能暴跌，而OM-GRPO训练期间答案多样性保持稳定，无明显性能退化。
summary.reading_guide: 先查看Introduction部分的失败模式诊断（性能崩溃与答案多样性下降的关联实验），再阅读Method章节的答案掩码实现细节与对比增强奖励的构造逻辑，最后扫读跨骨干、跨场景的泛化实验结果，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing majority-voting-based label-free RLVR (Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards) methods suffer from answer-token shortcut learning: models directly reinforce high-frequency answer tokens instead of improving reasoning capability, leading to reward hacking and training collapse. Meanwhile, traditional RLVR relies on ground-truth answer annotations, which are prohibitively costly for large-scale deployment.
summary_en.importance: The answer-span gradient masking design can be transferred to all outcome-reward-based RL alignment scenarios to mechanically prevent answer shortcut learning. The soft consensus plus contrastive augmentation scheme for label-free reward construction reduces RLVR's reliance on human annotations, providing a low-cost path for large-scale reasoning-enhanced training. The diagnostic method of tracking answer diversity to detect training collapse can be directly integrated into dynamic monitoring systems for RL post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The OM-GRPO (Outcome-Masked Group Relative Policy Optimization) framework has two core designs. First, answer-span gradient masking: during GRPO gradient updates, tokens in the answer span are masked with zero gradient, while only gradients from the chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning trajectory are retained. A soft consensus reward computed from answer frequency within the group (instead of hard majority voting) is preserved to shift optimization pressure from answer tokens to the reasoning process itself. Second, Contrast-Augmented Reward (CAR): pairwise comparisons are conducted on reasoning trajectories within the same group, prompting the model to output the answer corresponding to the better trajectory, which expands the answer pool at minimal computational cost and improves the reliability of soft reward estimation without resampling full long reasoning trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: Tested across multiple reasoning benchmarks and three distinct LLM backbones, OM-GRPO consistently outperforms prior label-free RLVR baselines and matches the performance of training with ground-truth rewards. In the Test-Time Training (TTT) scenario, it outperforms the majority voting baseline by 4.24 points without any training collapse. Diagnostic experiments show traditional voting methods suffer from rapid decline in answer diversity accompanied by sharp performance drops during training, while OM-GRPO maintains stable answer diversity with no significant performance degradation.
summary_en.reading_guide: First review the failure mode diagnosis experiments (correlation between performance collapse and answer diversity decline) in the Introduction, then study the implementation details of answer masking and the construction logic of Contrast-Augmented Reward in the Method section, and finally skim the cross-backbone and cross-scenario generalization results. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 准确命中无标签GRPO训练里“抄答案”的常见坑，梯度mask的fix简单实用，读方法部分即可，应在内部RL实验中验证。
recommendation.en: Directly addresses the common answer-cheating failure mode in label-free GRPO; the gradient masking fix is simple and practical, worth verifying in internal RL ablations.

paper.title: When Correct Solutions Repeat: Rarity-Aware Credit Redistribution for GRPO
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) com- monly optimizes each correct completion as an independent learning signal. In GRPO, this completion-level uniformity creates structure-level skew: recurring correct solution forms accumulate positive coefficient mass in proportion to how often they are sampled, while rare forms receive limited credit. We formalize this behavior as multiplicity-induced structure-level credit concentration and introduce a partition- conditioned rule that r

summary.core_problem: GRPO等RLVR方法将每个正确completion作为独立学习信号，导致重复出现的正确解法形式按采样频率累积正优势，罕见正确解法形式信用不足。
summary.importance: 识别了RLVR中multiplicity-induced structure-level credit concentration问题，提出了无需辅助模型推理的轻量修正；对理解GRPO训练动态有机制层面的参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: Cue-GRPO使用确定性Strategy Cues对验证正确的轨迹构建rollout-local分区，按聚类稀有度重新分配正优势；不需要额外辅助模型推理。Judge Partitions下的Credit Redistribution进一步验证了重新分配机制的有效性。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen2.5-Math-7B和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上评测AIME重复采样性能，Cue-GRPO带来提升，高采样预算下增益最大；JP分区实验表明重新分配机制有效。

summary_en.core_problem: RLVR methods like GRPO treat each correct completion as an independent learning signal, causing recurring correct solution forms to accumulate positive advantage proportional to sampling frequency while rare correct forms receive insufficient credit.
summary_en.importance: Identifies multiplicity-induced structure-level credit concentration in RLVR and proposes a lightweight fix without auxiliary-model inference; useful for understanding GRPO training dynamics at a mechanistic level.
summary_en.technical_approach: Cue-GRPO uses deterministic Strategy Cues to construct rollout-local partitions of verified-correct traces and redistributes positive advantages according to cluster rarity, requiring no auxiliary model inference. Credit Redistribution under Judge Partitions further validates the redistribution mechanism.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Qwen2.5-Math-7B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on AIME repeated-sampling; Cue-GRPO improves performance with largest gains at high sampling budgets. JP partition experiments confirm the redistribution mechanism.

recommendation.zh: GRPO信用集中问题的观察比解法更有价值，高采样预算下偏差加剧这一点对大规模RLVR有参考；只看问题形式化和§3即可。
recommendation.en: The credit-concentration observation is more valuable than the fix; the fact that bias worsens at high sampling budgets matters for large-scale RLVR. Read the formalization and §3 only.

paper.title: Verifier-Induced Support Reshaping in On-Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: We show that on-policy reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can improve the current objective while making successful behaviors for later objectives too rare to sample and reinforce. We call this verifier-induced support reshaping and define effective rewardable support as successful trajectories reachable within a fixed rollout budget. Across two model families, we study this effect through repeated verifier-scored sampling and bidirectional training on mathematical reasoning a

summary.core_problem: 基于可验证奖励的在策略强化学习（RLVR）是当前后训练的核心范式，但连续多阶段 RLVR 存在一个被忽视的前向风险：当前阶段的验证器会重塑策略的可采样行为分布，使后续目标的成功轨迹虽仍在理论可达范围内，但在有限采样预算下出现概率过低，无法被后续阶段发现和强化，进而限制后续学习能力。
summary.importance: 重新定义了后训练连续学习的评估维度：从传统的“旧任务性能保留”（灾难性遗忘）转向“未来任务可学习性保留”（有效可奖励支撑集）。这一视角直接影响预训练-后训练接口的设计，包括多目标训练顺序、参考策略约束强度、路由先验的使用方式，以及 RLVR 阶段的采样预算配置。
summary.technical_approach: 提出“有效可奖励支撑集”概念：在指定 rollout 预算下仍能被采样到的奖励为正的轨迹集合。采用双向对照实验设计：从同一基座模型出发，一支做数学推理 RLVR（Math-RLVR）后评估指令遵循支撑集，另一支做约束指令遵循 RLVR（IF-RLVR）后评估数学推理支撑集；再分别用反向验证器继续训练，检验第一阶段的支撑集偏移是否约束后续学习。通过分布分析和受控干预（固定/替换回复开头 token）定位跨任务影响的因果路径。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3-8B-Base 和 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 两个模型家族上验证：Math-RLVR 使 IFEval pass@1 提升 6.5 个百分点，但 best@32 下降，更多 IF 提示趋向“全部成功”或“全部失败”的两极分布；IF-RLVR 则降低数学任务的 best@k，并显著限制后续 Math-RLVR 的提升空间。受控干预显示，跨任务偏移主要发生在回复的前几个 token：RLVR 主要是对基座已有的开头选项做重排，而非删除推理能力；开头选择因果性地决定了数学正确轨迹的可搜索性。顺序训练、参考策略约束、路由先验、在策略蒸馏（OPD）等现有缓解方案只能部分保留支撑集，或在保留支撑集与目标任务收益之间存在取舍。MathIF 和 ReasonIF 上的结果进一步显示，单任务提升无法等比例转化为同时满足两个目标的响应。
summary.reading_guide: 精读第 1 节的支撑集重塑定义与和灾难性遗忘的概念区分；第 3 节的双向实验设计与 best@k 指标选择是方法核心；第 4 节的回复开头因果干预实验是机制洞察的关键，重点关注开头 token 分布变化与数学可搜索性的对应关系；第 5 节的缓解方案评估可用于指导实际训练 recipe。图表重点看 Figure 1（支撑集示意）、展示 pass@1 与 best@k 背离的结果表，以及开头 token 的分布可视化。

summary_en.core_problem: On-policy reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is the dominant post-training paradigm, but multi-stage sequential RLVR carries an understudied forward risk: the current verifier reshapes the policy's samplable behavior distribution, such that successful trajectories for later objectives remain theoretically reachable but become too rare to appear under a finite rollout budget. These trajectories can then no longer be discovered and reinforced in subsequent stages, limiting future learnability.
summary_en.importance: The work redefines the evaluation dimension of continual post-training learning, shifting from the traditional retrospective view of old-task performance retention (catastrophic forgetting) to a forward-looking view of future-task learnability retention (effective rewardable support). This perspective directly informs the design of the pretrain-posttrain interface, including multi-objective training order, reference-policy constraint strength, routing prior design, and rollout budget allocation across RLVR stages.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduce the concept of effective rewardable support: the set of reward-positive trajectories that remain likely enough to be sampled under a specified rollout budget. A bidirectional controlled design is used: starting from the same base policy, one branch is trained with Math-RLVR and evaluated for instruction-following support, while the other is trained with IF-RLVR (constrained instruction following) and evaluated for math-reasoning support. Each branch is then continued with the opposite verifier to test whether the first-stage support shift constrains later learning. Distributional analysis and controlled interventions (fixing or replacing the opening tokens of responses) isolate the causal pathway of cross-task interference.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across two model families, Qwen3-8B-Base and Qwen2.5-Math-7B. Math-RLVR raises IFEval pass@1 by 6.5 percentage points but reduces best@32, with more IF prompts polarizing toward either consistent success or complete failure. IF-RLVR lowers math best@k and significantly constrains the gains of subsequent Math-RLVR. Controlled interventions show the cross-task shift is localized to the first few response tokens: RLVR primarily reranks opening options already present in the base policy rather than erasing reasoning capability broadly, and the opening choice causally determines the searchability of correct math trajectories. Existing mitigation strategies — sequential training, reference-policy constraints, routing priors, and on-policy distillation (OPD) — only partially preserve support or trade preservation against target-task gains. Results on MathIF and ReasonIF further show that single-task improvements do not translate proportionally into responses satisfying both objectives.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read Section 1 closely for the definition of support reshaping and its conceptual distinction from catastrophic forgetting. Section 3 covers the bidirectional experimental design and the rationale for using best@k as a support metric, which is the methodological core. Section 4's causal intervention experiments on response openings are the key mechanistic insight — pay attention to the mapping between opening-token distribution shifts and math searchability. Section 5's mitigation evaluation is directly useful for designing practical training recipes. Key figures include the support-shift schematic (Figure 1), tables showing the divergence between pass@1 and best@k, and visualizations of opening-token distributions.

recommendation.zh: 这是 RLVR 训练动态里少见的干净反例：pass@1 上升但 best@32 下降，做 RL 后训练或 pretrain-posttrain 接口时应立刻监控 rewardable support。
recommendation.en: A clean RLVR training-dynamics warning: pass@1 can rise while best@32 falls; monitor rewardable support whenever optimizing verifier-based objectives.

paper.title: Distill Where You Fail: Recovering Learning Signals of Negative RL-Groups from Adaptive Teacher Guidance
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard paradigm for post-training large language models (LLMs). While Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely adopted, it suffers from sparse reward signals and loses gradients entirely when all responses within a group receive identical rewards. On-policy distillation (OPD) offers a natural remedy by providing dense, token-level supervision from a teacher model. However, naively combining GRPO with OPD leads to deg

summary.core_problem: RSTG 解决的是 RLVR 中 GRPO 学习信号稀疏的问题，尤其是 group 内样本全错时的 negative zero-variance prompts。GRPO 在这种情况下没有相对优势，梯度会消失。直接加入 on-policy distillation 虽然能提供 token-level dense signal，但会带来 teacher-boundedness、样本不适配、token advantage 大量为负和局部前缀误差传播等问题，实际效果可能差于标准 GRPO。
summary.importance: 这项工作对 post-train 与 pretrain 接口有明确参考价值。它说明 dense teacher signal 不能无差别加入 RL，而应该只在 RL 无法给出有效梯度的位置补信号。这个思想对 RL 数据效率、verifier-based training、reasoning model 的失败样本挖掘都有启发。贡献量级属于方法级改进，不是新训练范式，但抓住了 GRPO+distillation 中一个常见且实际的问题：什么时候应该蒸馏，蒸馏哪些 token，以及如何避免过快贴近 teacher。
summary.technical_approach: RSTG 先把 GRPO、OPD 和 SFT 放到统一 policy-gradient 视角下分析。GRPO 用 group reward 的均值和方差估计 advantage；当组内 reward 相同，advantage 退化。OPD 在学生自己采样的轨迹上最小化 student 到 teacher 的 reverse KL，可写成 token-level advantage，其中 advantage 与 teacher-student log-prob gap 相关。问题是多数学生生成 token 在 teacher 下概率低，负 advantage 过多，会压制探索。RSTG 的处理有三部分。第一，sample selection：只在 student 失败但 teacher 能成功的样本上施加 OPD，重点覆盖 negative zero-variance prompts，并按 teacher mastery 加权。文中指出，仅使用全量数据的 3.63% 做这类 OPD，效果反而优于对所有样本蒸馏。第二，token selection：只更新学生高熵 token 或 teacher-student divergence 较大的 token，减少噪声，也减缓过早收敛到 teacher。第三，auxiliary SFT：在 negative zero-variance prompts 上使用 teacher 预生成的正确轨迹做 SFT，补充全局正向轨迹信号，缓解 OPD 只沿学生错误前缀给局部梯度的问题。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen2.5 和 Qwen3 系列，在数学和代码 benchmark 上验证。相对于 naive GRPO+OPD，RSTG 在数学任务上提升 4.02%，在代码任务上提升 3.05%。文中还报告了几个训练动态层面的现象：选择性 OPD 能缓解 advantage asymmetry；token selection 会减缓向 teacher 的过快收敛；辅助 SFT 可以减少负样本组完全无梯度的问题；RSTG 还避免了 response length 的突然膨胀。由于给出的全文片段未包含完整实验表格，无法确认具体模型尺寸、每个 benchmark 的绝对分数和训练 token 数。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 naive GRPO+OPD 失败原因的拆解，再看 Preliminaries 中把 OPD 写成 policy-gradient advantage 的推导，这部分决定了后续方法为什么要做 sample/token selection。方法部分重点看三件事：negative zero-variance prompts 的筛选规则、teacher mastery weighting、token-level mask 的定义。实验部分优先看 Qwen2.5/Qwen3 上的主结果、OPD 数据比例 3.63% 的消融、response length 曲线和 advantage distribution。若在做 RLVR recipe，这项工作最值得复用的是“只在 RL 失效处补 teacher signal”的训练调度，而不是简单叠加蒸馏 loss。

summary_en.core_problem: RSTG addresses the loss of learning signal in RLVR with GRPO, especially on negative zero-variance prompts where every sampled response in the group is wrong. In that case, group-relative advantages vanish.
