On-policy distillation can provide dense token-level supervision from a teacher, but a naive GRPO+OPD objective often performs worse because distillation is not useful for every sample, it can make the student converge too quickly to the teacher, and its token-level advantages are often negative on student-generated trajectories.
summary_en.importance: The work is useful for the interface between RL post-training and pretraining-style learning signals. It argues that dense teacher supervision should not be applied uniformly; it should be used where RL has no useful gradient. This is relevant to RL data efficiency, verifier-based reasoning training, and failure-driven data construction. The contribution is a targeted recipe rather than a new training paradigm, but it addresses a practical failure mode in GRPO plus distillation: when to distill, which tokens to update, and how to avoid collapsing exploration toward the teacher too early.
summary_en.technical_approach: RSTG first analyzes GRPO, OPD, and SFT under a shared policy-gradient view. GRPO estimates advantages from group rewards; when all rewards in a group are identical, the advantage disappears. OPD minimizes reverse KL from the student to the teacher on student-generated trajectories and can be written as a token-level advantage based on the teacher-student log-probability gap. This dense signal is noisy and asymmetric because many student tokens have low teacher probability, producing mostly negative advantages. RSTG uses three controls. First, sample selection applies OPD only when the student fails and the teacher succeeds, focusing on negative zero-variance prompts and weighting the signal by teacher mastery. The paper reports that using only 3.63% of the full data in this way outperforms standard OPD over all samples. Second, token selection restricts updates to high-entropy student tokens or tokens with large teacher-student divergence, reducing noisy gradients and slowing premature teacher imitation. Third, auxiliary SFT uses teacher-generated correct trajectories on negative zero-variance prompts, adding a global positive trajectory signal that OPD lacks when it conditions on erroneous student prefixes.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 model families on mathematical and code benchmarks. Compared with naive GRPO+OPD, RSTG improves math performance by 4.02% and code performance by 3.05%. The reported training dynamics support the method design: selective OPD mitigates advantage asymmetry, token selection slows convergence toward the teacher, auxiliary SFT restores positive learning signals for all-failed groups, and the full recipe avoids abrupt response-length inflation. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete result tables, so exact model sizes, per-benchmark absolute scores, and training-token counts cannot be verified here.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25–30 minutes. Start with the introduction, especially the three failure modes of naive GRPO+OPD. Then read the preliminaries where OPD is rewritten as a policy-gradient objective; this derivation explains why sample and token selection are needed. In the method section, focus on the definition of negative zero-variance prompts, teacher mastery weighting, and the token-level update mask. In the experiments, prioritize the Qwen2.5/Qwen3 main results, the 3.63% data-ratio ablation, response-length curves, and advantage-distribution analysis. For RLVR recipe design, the reusable idea is to inject teacher signals only where RL has failed to produce gradients, rather than simply adding a distillation loss everywhere.

recommendation.zh: 不是范式突破，但它把“RL 缺梯度时该不该蒸馏、蒸馏到哪一层粒度”讲得比多数 RLVR 论文更干净；重点看失败分析和 selective guidance 设计。
recommendation.en: Not a paradigm shift, but it is cleaner than most RLVR papers on when distillation should rescue missing RL gradients; read the failure analysis and the selective-guidance design.

paper.title: Question Begets Question: Self-Evolving Curriculum for Reinforcement Fine-Tuning on Competition Mathematics
paper.abstract: Teaching a language model a skill it has not mastered is obstructed by three recurring difficulties: training data is scarce, ground-truth reasoning traces are usually unavailable, and models often exhibit an apparent ceiling beyond which additional data yields no further improvement. We study these difficulties in a controlled setting, fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Math-7B on competition mathematics (AIME), a task on which it initially solves only 5.6\% of problems (pass@1). To address data scarcity, we

summary.core_problem: 在困难技能学习中，训练数据稀缺、标准答案推理轨迹不可得，而且模型常在增加数据后出现性能平台期。论文以 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 在 AIME 竞赛数学上为受控场景，研究如何用合成数据和强化微调突破这一瓶颈。
summary.importance: 对后训练和数据课程设计有直接参考价值。核心发现不是“多合成数据”本身，而是合成数据的多样性、与当前模型能力的匹配度，以及课程中种子题目的选择。尤其值得注意的是，从“模型基本能做对”的近成功样本生成变体，比从最难失败样本学习更有效，这与常见的“从错误中学习”直觉不同。
summary.technical_approach: Question-begets-Question（QbQ）让教师模型把已有题目改写成探测相同底层技能的多样化变体，避免静态增强中的多样性坍缩。训练只使用题目和最终答案，通过 GRPO 做强化学习，不使用教师的逐步推理轨迹，因此模拟无 oracle reasoning 的场景，并减少蒸馏依赖。自演化课程运行 20 轮：先用 pass@16 评估当前 checkpoint 在上一轮合成题上的表现，将题目分为已掌握、基本能做对、偶尔做对、从未做对四档；然后以“基本能做对”的题目为种子生成变体；再用 GRPO 训练。每轮种子来自上一轮产物，而不是固定原始题集，从而持续适配模型当前能力。
summary.experiments: Qwen2.5-Math-7B 在 AIME 2025/2026 上的基线 pass@1 为 5.6%。在 1005 道带解答真题上，SFT 达到 9.5%，GRPO 达到 11.5%。用 GPT-5-mini 静态生成 5000 道合成题并与真题合并，仅达到 12.05%。仅用 6000 道 QbQ 合成题、不用真题即可达到 14.5%，但训练最后 30% 出现平台期。在相同数据和计算预算下，自演化课程将 pass@1 提升到 16.5%，20 轮后没有饱和迹象。消融显示从近成功题目播种持续优于从最难题目播种，并且模型能解决未训练过的更难题目。
summary.reading_guide: 建议用 30–45 分钟。重点看引言中对三个障碍的拆解、Figure 2 的平台期曲线，以及 QbQ 与自演化课程的流程。最值得深挖的是四档能力划分和“基本能做对”种子选择策略，以及对应的消融实验。数学任务只是载体，关键结论可迁移到其他 RL 数据课程和合成数据设计。

summary_en.core_problem: Learning a difficult skill is constrained by scarce training data, unavailable ground-truth reasoning traces, and apparent plateaus where more data no longer helps. The paper studies this in a controlled setting by fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Math-7B on AIME competition mathematics, a task the base model initially solves at only 5.6% pass@1.
summary_en.importance: The paper is relevant to post-training, synthetic data design, and RL curricula. Its main finding is not that synthetic data helps in the abstract, but that diversity and alignment with the model’s current capability matter. The counterintuitive result is that seeding new problems from near-successes—problems the model can mostly get right—works better than seeding from the hardest failures.
summary_en.technical_approach: Question-begets-Question (QbQ) has a teacher model transform existing problems into diverse variants that probe the same underlying skills, reducing the diversity collapse seen in static augmentation. Training uses GRPO with only problem statements and final answers, without teacher step-by-step reasoning traces, which models the no-oracle-reasoning setting and limits distillation. The self-evolving curriculum runs for 20 rounds: evaluate the current checkpoint on the previous round’s problems with pass@16, sort them into mastered, mostly correct, sometimes correct, and never correct bands; seed new variants from the mostly-correct problems; then train with GRPO. Because each round’s seeds come from the previous round’s generated problems rather than a fixed source set, the curriculum continuously tracks the model’s evolving ability.
summary_en.experiments: Qwen2.5-Math-7B starts at 5.6% pass@1 on AIME 2025/2026. On 1,005 real problems with solutions, SFT reaches 9.5% and GRPO reaches 11.5%. Adding 5,000 static synthetic problems from GPT-5-mini to the real data only reaches 12.05%. Training on 6,000 QbQ problems alone, without real problems, reaches 14.5%, but plateaus over the final 30% of training. Under the same data and compute budget, the self-evolving curriculum reaches 16.5% with no sign of saturation after 20 rounds. Ablations show that seeding from near-successes consistently outperforms seeding from the hardest problems, and the resulting model solves harder problems it was never trained on.
summary_en.reading_guide: Spend about 30–45 minutes. Focus on the introduction’s decomposition of the three obstacles, the plateau curve in Figure 2, and the QbQ plus self-evolving curriculum pipeline. The most important technical detail is the four-band evaluation and the choice to seed from mostly-correct problems, together with the corresponding ablations. Mathematics is the testbed; the curriculum lesson transfers more broadly to RL data selection and synthetic-data generation.

recommendation.zh: 读数据生成和 curriculum ablation；它更像 RLVR 数据分布实验，不是数学模型能力报告。
recommendation.en: Read the data-generation and curriculum ablations; this is a useful RLVR data-distribution study, not just a math fine-tuning result.

paper.title: Instruction-Conditioned Exploration with Asymmetric Reinforcement Learning and Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: Post-training Large Language Models (LLMs) with Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become an important tool for improving model capabilities, but the LLM action-space structure introduces challenges distinct from classical RL, with implications for inducing exploration. New methods are required that leverage the broad knowledge and flexibility of pre-trained LLMs to deliberately generate diverse experience at training time. We propose Instruction-Conditioned Exploration (ICE), which supplements tas

summary.core_problem: RL post-training 中 LLM 的探索问题：token 级随机扰动会脱离文本流形，而高概率采样又导致行为多样性不足，RL 训练本身还会使策略分布变尖锐而非拓宽。如何在训练时系统性地扩大行为覆盖，并将这些探索到的行为迁移到测试时的无条件策略上。
summary.importance: 对理解 RL post-training 中的探索-利用权衡有参考价值，尤其是 instruction-conditioned rollout 作为一种比 token 级噪声更结构化的探索手段。但实验结果显示方法仅在 1.7B 规模有效，4B 规模无增益，适用范围有限，属于增量性工作。
summary.technical_approach: ICE 在训练时从一组 N 个差异化行为指令中采样，附加到任务 prompt 上，驱动 instruction-conditioned 的 teacher 策略产生多样化 rollout。Asymmetric-RL/SD 定义两个共享参数的策略：teacher 接收 DAPO（GRPO 变体）的 RL 更新，student 仅接收 forward-KL 自蒸馏更新，将 teacher 经过正确性过滤的 rollout 知识迁移到无条件策略。测试时直接使用 student（不加指令），无需额外推理开销。与已有 prompt augmentation 方法的区别在于指令是观点性、策略性的行为引导，而非格式说明。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3 1.7B/4K 上，ICE+Asymmetric-RL/SD 相比 DAPO baseline 在 5 个数学推理 benchmark 上 macro-mean pass@1 相对提升 5.0%，5/5 全胜，95% bootstrap CI 不含零。1.7B/8K 长上下文设置下增益缩小。4B/4K 设置下无提升。ICE+RL alone（无自蒸馏）的增益更小且不确定性更大，说明自蒸馏组件对效果有贡献。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看 §3（ICE 形式化定义和与 support composition vs expansion 的区分）和 §4（Asymmetric-RL/SD 的非对称更新机制）。Figure 1 的流程图能快速理解 teacher-student 共享参数结构。实验部分关注多规模对比表，注意 4B 无增益这一负面结果。预计泛读 15-20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Exploration during RL post-training of LLMs: token-level random perturbation falls off the text manifold, high-probability sampling yields insufficient behavioral diversity, and RL itself sharpens rather than broadens the policy distribution. The challenge is to systematically expand behavioral coverage at training time and transfer explored behaviors to the unconditioned policy at test time.
summary_en.importance: Useful reference for understanding the exploration-exploitation tradeoff in RL post-training, particularly instruction-conditioned rollouts as a more structured exploration mechanism than token-level noise. However, results show gains only at 1.7B scale with no improvement at 4B, limiting the method's scope. This is incremental work.
summary_en.technical_approach: ICE samples from a set of N distinct behavioral instructions appended to task prompts during training, inducing diverse rollouts from an instruction-conditioned teacher policy. Asymmetric-RL/SD defines two parameter-sharing policies: the teacher receives DAPO (a GRPO variant) RL updates, while the student receives only forward-KL self-distillation updates toward the teacher's correctness-filtered rollouts. At test time the student (unconditioned) is used with no extra inference cost. Unlike prior prompt augmentation that uses formatting instructions, ICE uses opinionated, strategy-level behavioral guidance.
summary_en.experiments: On Qwen3 1.7B/4K, ICE with Asymmetric-RL/SD improves macro-mean pass@1 across 5 held-out math reasoning benchmarks by 5.0% relative to DAPO, with 5/5 wins and a 95% bootstrap CI excluding zero. Gains diminish at 1.7B/8K. No improvement at 4B/4K. ICE with RL alone (without self-distillation) shows smaller, less certain gains, indicating the distillation component contributes.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on §3 for the formal definition of ICE and the distinction between support composition and support expansion, and §4 for the asymmetric update mechanism of Asymmetric-RL/SD. Figure 1 provides a clear diagram of the shared-parameter teacher-student structure. In experiments, pay attention to the multi-scale comparison and notably the null result at 4B. Estimated skim time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看探索指令设计和 Asymmetric-RL/SD 消融；5% 提升不大，但这个 setup 值得在内部 RLVR 里复现。
recommendation.en: Read the exploration-instruction design and Asymmetric-RL/SD ablations; the 5% gain is modest, but the setup is worth reproducing in internal RLVR runs.

paper.title: Start Classifying: Categorical Critics for LLM Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) for large language models typically trains its critic by mean-squared-error (MSE) regression on scalar value targets. Although scalar MSE is statistically valid for estimating the conditional expected return, sparse binary rewards in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) make critic optimization and calibration especially consequential: small value errors directly distort the scalar advantages used by PPO. We study whether a classification-based

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 LLM RLVR 中 PPO critic 的训练目标问题：标准 MSE 标量回归在统计上可以估计期望回报，但在稀疏二值奖励下容易产生校准偏差，进而扭曲 PPO 的 advantage 信号。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响不大，但对 post-train 训练信号质量有参考价值。它提示一个常被忽略的问题：在 reasoning RL 中，actor 更新是否稳定，不只取决于 reward、采样和 clipping，也取决于 critic 如何学习稀疏回报。对于关注 pretrain ↔ posttrain 接口的人，这篇论文的启发点在于把 critic objective 当作训练信号工程来处理，而不是默认 MSE 足够。
summary.technical_approach:
方法是 HL-Gauss PPO。它把 PPO critic 的标量 MSE head 换成离散 value support 上的 categorical head，用 HL-Gauss smoothed target 做 cross-entropy 训练。推理和 actor 更新仍然使用标准 PPO：categorical 分布解码成标量期望值，然后进入 GAE 和 PPO advantage 计算。这样它不是 distributional policy-improvement algorithm，而是把分类目标作为 critic 训练 surrogate。

论文做了几个控制实验来拆分可能来源：one-hot、two-hot、Bernoulli two-bin、不同 support 和 smoothing 设置，用来区分二分类本身、head capacity、target smoothing、离散化区间选择的影响。诊断重点放在 calibration 和 raw advantage dynamics：MSE critic 在 likely-failure prefixes 上会过度自信，导致正负 advantage 不平衡；HL-Gauss critic 给出的标量预测更校准，advantage 信号更平衡。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖数学推理、tool-augmented math 和 Search-R1 场景，主干包括 Qwen2.5-7B-Base，并在 Qwen3-4B-Base 上做了扩展验证。论文声称 HL-Gauss PPO 相比强 PPO 和 DAPO baseline 有一致提升，但提供的内容片段没有给出具体提升数字。关键诊断包括 critic calibration、advantage asymmetry，以及多种 categorical target ablation。结论是收益并非简单来自“把二值回报做成二分类”，也不只是 output head 参数更多；target smoothing 和离散 support 的设计会影响 critic 的局部优化几何和校准表现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。建议重点看方法部分中 HL-Gauss target 如何构造、support 如何设定、categorical 输出如何解码为 scalar value。实验部分优先看 calibration 和 advantage dynamics，而不是只看最终 benchmark 分数。消融实验比主结果更有信息量，尤其是 Bernoulli two-bin、one-hot/two-hot、smoothing 控制。如果只关心基座预训练，可把它作为 post-train 信号质量案例，不需要深挖 PPO 工程细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the critic objective in PPO-based LLM RLVR. Scalar MSE regression is statistically valid for estimating the expected return under binary terminal rewards, but in practice it can be poorly calibrated. Small value errors then directly distort PPO advantages.
summary_en.importance: The paper is more relevant to post-training signal quality than to base-model pretraining. Its useful message is that reasoning-RL stability is not only about rewards, sampling, or clipping; it also depends on how the critic learns sparse returns. For researchers interested in the pretrain-posttrain interface, it is a compact example of treating the critic loss as part of the training-signal design rather than accepting MSE as the default.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, HL-Gauss PPO, replaces the scalar MSE value head with a categorical head over a discretized value support. The critic is trained with cross-entropy against smoothed HL-Gauss targets. The actor side is unchanged: the categorical distribution is decoded into a scalar expectation, which is then used in standard GAE and PPO updates. This is not a distributional policy-improvement method; classification is used only as a surrogate objective for learning a scalar critic.

The paper includes controls for one-hot and two-hot targets, a Bernoulli two-bin baseline, support choices, and smoothing. These ablations separate several possible explanations: binary classification, extra output-head capacity, target smoothing, and the value-support parameterization. The main diagnostics are calibration and raw advantage dynamics. The MSE critic becomes overconfident on prefixes likely to fail and produces asymmetric advantages, while the HL-Gauss critic gives better calibrated scalar predictions and more balanced actor signals.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers mathematical reasoning, tool-augmented math, and Search-R1. The main backbone is Qwen2.5-7B-Base, with additional validation on Qwen3-4B-Base. The paper reports consistent gains over strong PPO and DAPO baselines, although the supplied text does not include exact improvement numbers. The most informative results are the calibration measurements, advantage asymmetry analysis, and categorical-target ablations. These suggest that the benefit is not simply due to turning binary rewards into a binary classification task, nor only due to a larger critic head; smoothing and support design matter for optimization and calibration.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, around 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the construction of the HL-Gauss targets, the choice of value support, and how the categorical output is decoded back into a scalar value. In the experiments, prioritize calibration plots and advantage-dynamics analysis over headline task scores. The ablations on Bernoulli two-bin, one-hot/two-hot targets, and smoothing are the most useful parts. For base pretraining work, treat it as a post-training signal-quality case study rather than a core pretraining paper.

recommendation.zh: RLVR 里 critic 误差污染 advantage 是真问题；只看 HL-Gauss 目标和 Qwen ablation，值得内部小规模复现。
recommendation.en: Critic error contaminating advantages is a real RLVR issue; read the HL-Gauss objective and Qwen ablations, then reproduce it at small scale.

paper.title: Learning to Coordinate Symbolic Tools: LLM Agents for Verified Sum-of-Squares Certificates
paper.abstract: Tool calling allows large language models (LLMs) to invoke external computation during problem solving, a useful capability in various fields including AI for mathematics. We study this setting through weighted sum-of-squares (SOS) decomposition, a machine-checkable route to proving polynomial nonnegativity and hence polynomial inequalities. A candidate decomposition can be checked exactly, but finding one requires choosing among non-unique regroupings and coordinating multiple symbolic transfor

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关心的不是“LLM会不会做单步代数变换”，而是更难的一层：当外部符号工具本身是精确的，模型能否在一个可验证但难搜索的多步任务里，学会规划、试错、回退、组装最终证明。作者选了 weighted sum-of-squares certificate search 作为载体，因为候选证书一旦写出来可以被严格校验，但找到它需要决定项如何重组、何时因式分解、何时改写、何时停止。问题的难点不在工具执行，而在全局搜索策略与中间表示选择。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献不大，它更接近 post-training + tool-use 的受控研究；但对基座研究仍有两点启发。第一，它提供了一个“终局可精确验证、过程需要策略协调”的干净测试床，比很多开放式 agent 任务更适合分析训练信号质量。第二，它说明仅靠通用推理 backbone 加工具接口远远不够，若任务的瓶颈在搜索与表示切换，就需要专门的课程数据和 verifier-grounded optimization。量级上，这不是会改变预训练范式的工作，但对研究‘可验证环境中的工具协调能力如何形成’有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三层。第一层是任务构造。作者没有只训练最终 SOS 任务，而是设计了九任务课程：四个局部代数操作任务，四个更偏结构选择的任务，再加一个复合的 weighted-SOS 搜索任务。这样做的原因很明确：如果直接在复合任务上学，模型拿到的监督太稀疏，很难学到哪些中间表示更有利于后续证书拼装；先用局部与结构任务提供密集监督，可以把搜索所需的代数先验拆开教。

第二层是监督微调。基于 Phi-4-reasoning-plus，作者用 assistant-token QLoRA SFT 训练直接解题轨迹和模拟的符号执行轨迹。这里一个值得注意的设计是：SFT 语料里包含“像 Python 一样的已求值符号片段”，但不使用原生 function-call message 格式。也就是说，模型先学的是工具使用的语义与轨迹模式，而不是 API 协议本身。部署时再接入四个 SymPy-backed 原生函数。这个设计在方法上比较克制：它试图把“学会何时调用、如何解释结果”与“记住某个接口格式”分开。

第三层是 verifier-grounded GRPO。作者继续用任务特定的符号奖励做 GRPO，尤其在 weighted-SOS 上，终局候选必须满足严格的结构约束：能被解析成有限和式、权重是精确正有理数、每一项是多项式平方，并且展开后与目标多项式逐项系数一致。这个奖励设计的关键不是模糊偏好，而是把正确性尽量锚定在可判定信号上。与一般数学 RL 不同，这里 reward hacking 空间相对小，因为终局验收是 exact verification。

从全文看，真正的创新不在某个新算法，而在一个完整闭环：课程式代数监督 + 模拟轨迹 + 原生符号工具 + 精确验证奖励。它和常见 tool-use agent 工作的区别在于，作者把任务限制在一个可完全验证的代数域内，因此能更清楚地区分“工具本身正确”和“策略层面失败”。论文也很谨慎，没有把结果解释成对一般 agent 的普遍结论。
summary.experiments:
实验规模和结论都比较清楚。训练数据是 135 万条合成样本，覆盖 8 个支撑任务和 weighted-SOS；测试集是单独生成的 9 万道题。完整系统在九个多项式任务上的 macro-average 为 91.75%。在最关键的 weighted-SOS 任务上，Full system 的 verified success 是 78.96%，而同一 backbone、同一工具接口但未完成整套后训练的 Base+Tools 为 44.73%。这个差值说明，工具接入本身不是主要增益来源，真正起作用的是代数课程和 verifier-grounded post-training 的组合。

作者还比较了 Base、SFT、Base+Tools、Full。虽然没有给出所有想要的因果拆分，例如缺少 SFT+Tools without GRPO、以及 GRPO without tools 这两组，因此不能严格分离每个组件的独立贡献，但现有对比已经足够说明“只给工具”效果有限，“完整训练链路”才显著改善复合搜索任务。

从结果解读上，有两个细节值得记。第一，八个支撑任务在训练和评测中都不使用原生工具调用，它们主要承担代数监督作用，因此高分不能直接等价为 tool execution 能力强，而更像是中间表示与局部操作能力被学到了。第二，weighted-SOS 的失败并不表示多项式非 SOS，因为测试样本是按可证实例构造的；失败只表示搜索没找到证书。这让错误分析更干净：问题是搜索策略不足，而不是任务本身无解。

论文还提到终局失败类别分析，但从给出的内容看，重点应是区分解析失败、结构不合法、系数不匹配、搜索耗尽或过早停止等几类。这类分类对后续改进比单一成功率更有用，因为它能告诉你瓶颈是在表示、调用、还是终止判定。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合泛读，不建议投入太多时间抠每个代数细节。优先看 Introduction 和 Verified Weighted-SOS Search，先把任务边界弄清楚：什么是 exact verification，什么是 search difficulty。然后看 Figure 1 和 Figure 2，理解训练边界与部署边界是如何分开的，以及为什么局部正确的符号操作不等于全局证书搜索成功。接着看任务表和结果表，重点关注 Base、SFT、Base+Tools、Full 的差异。

如果只花 20 到 30 分钟，建议抓三件事：一是九任务课程如何拆分；二是 SFT 轨迹与原生 tool call 的关系；三是作者如何定义 terminal verification。若想再深一点，可以看 failure categories，判断模型主要卡在“不会搜”还是“搜到了但不会规范表达”。

不必把它当成数学证明系统论文来读，重点是它提供了一个较干净的 agent/post-train 研究范式：在可验证环境里研究工具协调，而不是在开放任务里混杂太多不可控因素。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not about whether an LLM can execute isolated algebraic manipulations. It targets a harder layer: given exact symbolic tools, can the model coordinate them in a multi-step search problem where final answers are easy to verify but hard to discover. The chosen setting is weighted sum-of-squares certificate search. A candidate certificate can be checked exactly by expansion, yet finding one requires strategic regrouping, representation changes, branch revision, and proper stopping. The bottleneck is global search control rather than local symbolic correctness.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense. It is closer to post-training and tool-use under a tightly controlled mathematical environment. Still, it matters for foundation-model research in two ways. First, it offers a clean testbed where terminal correctness is exact, so training-signal quality can be studied without the ambiguity of open-ended agent benchmarks. Second, it shows that a general reasoning backbone plus tool access is insufficient when the task is dominated by search and representation choice; targeted curriculum data and verifier-grounded optimization are needed. The contribution is moderate in scope, but useful for understanding how tool coordination emerges in verifiable domains.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three layers. The first is task construction. Instead of training only on the composite SOS task, the authors build a nine-task curriculum: four local algebra operations, four broader structural tasks, and one weighted-SOS search task. The motivation is straightforward. If training starts only from the composite task, supervision is too sparse to teach which intermediate forms are useful for certificate assembly. The supporting tasks provide denser algebraic supervision and decompose the search skill into learnable pieces.

The second layer is supervised fine-tuning. Starting from Phi-4-reasoning-plus, they apply assistant-token QLoRA SFT on direct solutions and simulated symbolic traces. An important design choice is that the SFT corpus contains evaluated Python-like symbolic snippets, but not native function-call messages. In other words, the model first learns the semantics and trajectory patterns of tool use rather than memorizing an API protocol. Native tool calling is introduced only at deployment through four SymPy-backed functions. This separation is methodologically clean: it tries to teach when and why to use tools, not just how to format a call.

The third layer is verifier-grounded GRPO. The model is further optimized with task-specific symbolic rewards. For weighted-SOS, a terminal candidate is accepted only if it satisfies strict structural constraints: it parses into a finite sum, every weight is an exact positive rational, every summand is a polynomial square, and the expanded identity matches the target polynomial coefficient by coefficient. The key point is that reward is anchored to decidable correctness rather than fuzzy preference signals. Compared with generic math RL, the room for reward hacking is smaller because terminal acceptance is exact.

The main novelty is not a new optimization algorithm. It is the full loop: curriculum-style algebra supervision, simulated traces, native symbolic tools, and exact verifier-based rewards. Unlike many tool-use agent papers, this one deliberately stays inside a fully checkable algebraic domain, which makes it easier to separate tool reliability from strategy failure. The paper is also careful not to overclaim beyond this setting.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental setup is fairly clear. Training uses 1.35 million synthetic examples spanning eight supporting tasks plus weighted-SOS. Evaluation uses 90,000 separately generated test instances. The complete system reaches 91.75% macro-average across the nine polynomial tasks. On the main weighted-SOS task, the Full system achieves 78.96% verified success, compared with 44.73% for the same backbone with the same tool interface but without the full post-training pipeline. That gap is the central empirical result: tool access alone is not the main source of gain; the algebra curriculum and verifier-grounded optimization are.

The paper compares Base, SFT, Base+Tools, and Full. The ablation is informative but not fully causal. In particular, it does not include SFT+Tools without GRPO or GRPO without tools, so the independent contribution of each component cannot be isolated cleanly. Still, the existing comparisons are enough to support the claim that simply attaching tools is insufficient, while the full training recipe materially improves composite symbolic search.

Two details matter for interpretation. First, the eight supporting tasks are solved directly without native tool calls in both training and evaluation, so their scores should be read as evidence of learned algebraic priors and intermediate-form competence, not direct evidence of tool-execution skill. Second, every weighted-SOS test polynomial is SOS by construction. Therefore, failure does not mean the instance is non-SOS; it means the search failed to find a certificate. That makes error analysis cleaner because the issue is search quality, not task infeasibility.

The paper also reports terminal failure categories. Even from the available text, the useful distinction is likely among parse failures, structurally invalid certificates, coefficient mismatches, exhausted search, and premature stopping. That breakdown is more actionable than a single success number because it localizes whether the bottleneck is representation, tool coordination, or stopping behavior.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper rather than a deep-read paper. Start with the Introduction and the section on verified weighted-SOS search to understand the task boundary: exact verification on the output side, strategic search on the process side. Then read Figure 1 and Figure 2 carefully. They explain the separation between training and deployment, and why locally correct symbolic operations do not guarantee successful global certificate search. After that, go to the task table and the main results table, focusing on the differences among Base, SFT, Base+Tools, and Full.

If you only spend 20 to 30 minutes, extract three things: how the nine-task curriculum is decomposed, how simulated traces relate to native tool calls, and how terminal verification is defined. If you want one layer deeper, inspect the failure categories to see whether the model mainly fails by not finding the right search path or by failing to express a valid final certificate.

It is best read as a controlled study of tool coordination in a verifiable environment, not as a general mathematics agent paper.

recommendation.zh: 读训练配方和 verifier 设计即可；任务窄，但合成子任务到 GRPO 的链路可迁移到数学 RLVR。
recommendation.en: Read the training recipe and verifier design; the task is narrow, but the synthetic-subtask-to-GRPO pipeline transfers to math RLVR.

paper.title: Knowing When to Quit: Diagnosing and Training LLMs to Abort Futile Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large language models generate computationally expensive yet semantically void reasoning on beyond-capability tasks, creating risks where plausible-sounding but incorrect derivations mislead users. We characterize this \textit{futile reasoning} phenomenon through systematic analysis, revealing universal capability overreach and systematic miscalibration between capability and behavior. The dominant failure mode is specious reasoning, which outputs look superficially valid but contain subtle erro

summary.core_problem: 解决模型在超出能力边界的问题上继续生成高成本、看似合理但错误的推理过程的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是对 futile reasoning 的诊断和一种能力边界对齐的 RL 训练方法。它把推理能力提升和拒答校准放在同一框架里，对 RLVR、推理预算分配和安全后训练都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CaRL，即 Capability-aligned Reinforcement Learning。方法通过 reward shaping 鼓励模型在无法可靠求解时拒答，并用 hindsight refusal augmentation 把失败样本转化为拒答监督，从而训练模型识别自身能力边界。
summary.experiments: 摘要称实验显示 CaRL 显著减少 futile reasoning，同时在不同难度任务上保持性能。摘要未披露模型规模、任务集合、baseline 细节和具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences work; the author list also includes researchers from Chinese NLP institutions, but the provided metadata only confirms UCAS.

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the tendency of LLMs to keep producing costly, plausible-looking but wrong reasoning on tasks beyond their capability.
summary_en.importance: It contributes both a diagnosis of futile reasoning and an RL method for aligning behavior with capability boundaries. This is relevant to RLVR, inference budget control, and refusal calibration.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed CaRL method uses capability-aligned reward shaping to prefer refusal over invalid reasoning when the model is likely to fail. It also uses hindsight refusal augmentation, converting failed attempts into refusal supervision.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a substantial reduction in futile reasoning while preserving performance across task difficulties. It does not provide model sizes, full baselines, task details, or numeric gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; the provided metadata does not confirm additional institutional details.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和错误分解即可；它把“多想一点”改成“知道何时停”，这个 prior 值得在 RLVR 里验证。
recommendation.en: Read the method and failure taxonomy; the useful prior is replacing “reason more” with “know when to stop” in RLVR.

institutions: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: Scaling Scientific Discovery Environments for Turn-Level Agentic RL
paper.abstract: Large language model agents have shown promising capabilities in data-driven scientific discovery tasks, where an agent interacts with an execution environment and produces a statistical claim. Long-horizon scientific analysis remains constrained by the lack of process supervised environments over real-world scientific data. This paper introduces SciDisco, a scalable framework for training Scientific Discovery agents in process-verifiable environments. SciThèque compiles hypotheses, datasets, hi

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要解决的是科学数据分析 Agent 的训练接口问题：真实科学数据很多，但通常只有静态数据文件，缺少可执行环境、可验证目标和跨 turn 的过程监督。结果是 Agent 只能靠提示词或通用多轮数据学习分析流程，很难学到什么时候查数据、什么时候选统计方法、什么时候修正假设、什么时候提交结论。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在基座训练配方，而在 post-train 训练信号设计。SciDisco 把科学发现任务改造成可执行、可验证、可给过程奖励的环境，这对 agentic RL 很关键。它强调的不是最终答案奖励，而是 turn-level credit assignment：每一步是否产生了可验证的分析证据。这个思路对代码 Agent、数据分析 Agent、长程工具使用 RL 都有参考价值，尤其适合思考如何从环境中构造更密集、更可信的训练信号。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三层。第一层是 SciThèque，把开放科学数据集编译成带有 hypothesis、dataset、sandbox execution 和 verifier 的任务环境。环境对 Agent 暴露任务目标和数据，并执行代码动作；任务内部保留 hidden evidence DAG，用来描述从数据理解到统计证据再到最终结论的可验证路径。第二层是 DAG-grounded trajectory synthesis，用 hidden evidence DAG 合成多轮演示轨迹，并通过 verifier 过滤，作为 SFT 冷启动数据。这样做是为了避免 RL 初期大量无效工具调用和错误变量读取。第三层是 DiscoPO，用环境反馈给每个 turn 分配过程奖励，而不是只在最后提交答案时给稀疏奖励。核心区别在于，任务构造、SFT 数据生成和 RL 过程奖励都共享同一个 evidence DAG 接口，减少了演示数据和在线优化目标之间的不一致。
summary.experiments: 给定内容主要覆盖问题定义和方法设计，没有提供完整实验表、性能数字或消融结果。可确认的实验相关设定包括：任务被建模为 POMDP，Agent 与每个科学发现环境多轮交互；动作包括可执行分析和终止提交；奖励从最终稀疏奖励扩展为 turn-level process reward。真正需要看的实验应包括 DiscoPO 相比纯 prompt、SFT、final-reward RL 的收益，DAG 合成轨迹的冷启动效果，以及 process verifier 对长程分析成功率的影响。但具体参数量、任务规模和提升幅度在提供内容中不可见。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Problem Formulation 中把科学发现写成 POMDP 和过程奖励目标的部分，以及 Methodology 中 hidden evidence DAG 如何同时服务于任务构建、轨迹合成和 RL 奖励。若只能看一处，优先看 SciThèque 与 DiscoPO 的接口设计。对基座研究员来说，最值得深挖的是 verifier 能否稳定表达“有效分析进展”，以及这种 verifier 是否会诱导 Agent 学会迎合检查器而不是真正改进分析能力。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses a training-interface problem for scientific data-analysis agents. Open scientific datasets are abundant, but they usually do not come with executable task environments, verifiable goals, or process-level supervision across turns. As a result, agents trained with prompts or generic multi-turn traces often fail to learn robust policies for inspecting data, choosing statistical methods, revising analyses, and submitting evidence-backed claims.
summary_en.importance: Its main relevance to foundation-model research is not a pretraining recipe, but the design of post-training signals for agentic RL. SciDisco turns scientific discovery into an executable and verifiable environment where reward can be assigned at the turn level. This is useful for thinking about long-horizon tool-use training: the training signal should identify which intermediate actions produced valid evidence, rather than rewarding only the final answer. The same design pattern is applicable to coding agents, data-analysis agents, and other environments where sparse outcome rewards are too weak.
summary_en.technical_approach: The pipeline has three components. SciThèque compiles open scientific datasets into hypothesis-driven environments with sandboxed code execution and task-specific verifiers. Each task contains a hidden evidence DAG that represents verifiable analytical progress toward the target finding. DAG-grounded trajectory synthesis uses this structure to generate multi-turn demonstrations and filters them through the verifier, providing a behavioral prior before RL. DiscoPO then optimizes the policy using process feedback from the environment, assigning credit to turns that advance the hidden evidence state. The key design choice is that task construction, SFT trajectory generation, and online RL credit assignment all share the same evidence-DAG interface.
summary_en.experiments: The supplied content covers the formulation and method, but does not include complete experimental tables, numerical results, or ablations. The confirmed setup models each task as a POMDP: the agent receives the hypothesis and dataset, interacts through executable actions, observes environment feedback, and eventually submits a claim. Reward is extended from a sparse final signal to turn-level process rewards. The missing but important experimental evidence would be comparisons against prompting, SFT-only training, and final-reward RL, plus ablations on DAG-grounded demonstrations and process verification.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the POMDP and process-reward formulation, then read the SciThèque and DiscoPO interface design. The most useful part for pretraining and post-training researchers is the hidden evidence DAG: how it defines valid progress, how it supports synthetic demonstrations, and how it becomes a reward source during online RL. The main question to keep in mind is whether the verifier captures real analytical progress or merely creates a new target for reward hacking.

recommendation.zh: 可过程验证环境比最终答案 RL 更接近可扩展监督；只看 SciThèque/DiscoPO 设计和 verifier 噪声处理。
recommendation.en: Process-verifiable environments are closer to scalable supervision than final-answer RL; focus on SciThèque, DiscoPO, and how verifier noise is handled.

paper.title: SAF-OPD: Stable Advantage Fusion for On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) broadcasts a single response-level reward to every token, while on-policy distillation (OPD) scores each token against a stronger teacher for a dense advantage but caps performance at teacher quality and discourages exploration beyond it. Their complementarity makes combining RLVR and OPD promising, but we find that fusing the two advantages with a fixed coefficient triggers entropy collapse from two miscalibrations: a magnitude mismatch, whe

summary.core_problem: RLVR（以GRPO为代表）的响应级稀疏优势与on-policy蒸馏（OPD）的token级稠密优势直接用固定系数融合时，会触发训练早期熵崩溃，根源是两个独立失配：一是量级失配，OPD的token级优势无界且重尾，会数值上盖过有界的RLVR优势信号；二是时间失配，训练全程保持全强度OPD会持续将学生拉向教师分布，限制学生探索并超越教师的能力，单一固定系数无法同时解决这两个不同维度的问题。
summary.importance: 属于后训练对齐阶段RLVR与蒸馏融合方向的实用方法改进，为RLHF/RLVR流水线中的优势融合提供了可直接落地的稳定策略，避免了单一融合系数调参的盲区，对做对齐训练的工程师有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SAF（Stable Advantage Fusion）框架，用两个独立机制分别对应两种失配：1）token级量级控制器：对单条响应内的OPD优势分布做稀疏化和幅值截断，消除重尾token对更新的主导作用；2）训练阶段控制器：在线跟踪学生与教师的KL散度，检测OPD信号作用耗尽的节点，逐步退火OPD的全局系数，仅在指导有效时保持全强度。方法无需额外模型或辅助损失，仅对采样得到的OPD优势做轻量变换即可接入现有训练流程。
summary.experiments: 诊断实验验证了固定系数融合基线的失效模式：训练早期策略熵即崩溃并维持低位，学生被过度对齐到教师分布，最终精度低于可控融合方案；进一步验证了量级失配与时间失配分别作用于token级尺度和训练时间尺度两个独立维度，仅靠调整单一全局系数无法同时解决两个问题。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第3章SAF的四阶段融合规则细节，以及第4.4节的失配诊断实验与消融分析，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Direct fixed-coefficient fusion of sparse response-level advantages from RLVR (e.g. GRPO) and dense token-level advantages from on-policy distillation (OPD) triggers early training entropy collapse. The failure stems from two independent mismatches: magnitude mismatch, where unbounded heavy-tailed token-level OPD advantages numerically overwhelm bounded RLVR signals; and temporal mismatch, where full-strength OPD applied throughout training continuously pulls the student toward the teacher distribution, limiting exploration beyond teacher quality. A single fixed coefficient cannot address both mismatches across their distinct axes.
summary_en.importance: Practical method improvement for RLVR-distillation fusion in post-training alignment, providing a deployable stabilization strategy for advantage mixing in RLHF/RLVR pipelines and eliminating blind spots in single-coefficient tuning. Directly relevant for engineers working on alignment training workflows.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes SAF (Stable Advantage Fusion), a framework with two dedicated mechanisms matched to each mismatch: 1) Token-level magnitude controller: sparsifies and bounds the per-response OPD advantage distribution to eliminate heavy-tailed token dominance in updates; 2) Training-stage controller: tracks online student-teacher KL divergence to detect when OPD guidance is no longer useful, then anneals the global OPD coefficient to maintain full strength only while guidance remains effective. The method requires no additional models or auxiliary losses, and can be integrated into existing pipelines as a lightweight transformation of sampled OPD advantages.
summary_en.experiments: Diagnostic experiments confirm the failure mode of fixed-coefficient fusion baselines: policy entropy collapses early in training and stays low, the student is over-aligned to the teacher, and final accuracy falls short of controlled fusion schemes. Further experiments verify that magnitude mismatch (token-level scale) and temporal mismatch (training-time schedule) operate on independent axes, so retuning a single global coefficient cannot resolve both issues.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 3 for details of the four-stage SAF fusion rule, and Section 4.4 for mismatch diagnosis experiments and ablation studies. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 后训练RL与OPD融合的熵崩溃机制分析有参考价值，重点看两类失配的发现和对应解法。
recommendation.en: The entropy collapse mechanism analysis for RL-OPD fusion is informative; focus on the two mismatch findings and corresponding solutions.

paper.title: Not All Tokens Deserve Equal Credit: Counterfactual Sensitivity Credit Reallocation for Long-CoT Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is central to improving long-CoT reasoning in large language models. Critic-free methods such as GRPO convert response-level rewards into advantages and uniformly broadcast them across tokens, overlooking their unequal contributions to the final outcome. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) instead provides dense distributional supervision by minimizing the forward KL divergence between an unprivileged policy and a privileged self-teacher, impl

summary.core_problem: GRPO 等无 critic 的 RLVR 方法把序列级奖励均匀广播到所有 token，而 on-policy self-distillation 假设 privileged teacher 下的似然位移包含与答案对齐的 token 级信用。论文检验这两类 token 级信用信号是否真的携带可靠的对错极性，发现它们在长 CoT 上大多不成立，并据此提出基于反事实敏感性的信用重分配方法。
summary.importance: 直接切入当前长 CoT RLVR 训练的核心痛点：信用分配。论文的诊断部分价值很高——它用反事实重打分证明，无论是 GRPO 隐含的 uniform credit 还是 OPSD 隐含的“似然位移即信用”，都与真正决定结果的 token 严重错位。这一结论对改进 RLVR 目标、设计更可靠的 dense supervision、理解长推理链训练动态都有实质影响。
summary.technical_approach: 核心诊断手段是反事实敏感性分析：给定问题 x 和一条 on-policy 采样轨迹 y，固定每个前缀，分别在两个相反的 privileged 条件下重打分每个 token：c^pos 将整条轨迹标记为正确，c^neg 将整条轨迹标记为错误，计算两个条件下该 token 对数似然相对于原始策略的位移 z^pos_i、z^neg_i。如果位移真的编码了答案极性，两个方向应当符号相反、幅度区分正确与错误 token。实验发现：82%–85% 的 token 在两种条件下都不敏感；在共同敏感的 token 中，91%–96% 的 z^pos 和 z^neg 符号相同，说明位移主要反映的是“当给最终答案相关的提示时，这类表面/衔接 token 的通用重加权”，而非对错极性；forward-KL 的优化量级有约 58% 在正反条件下重叠，大位移 token 多为 Wait、There 等可替换的表层词。基于这一观察，论文提出 Counterfactual Sensitivity Credit Reallocation（CSCR）：用正反条件下位移的差异而非绝对值来度量每个 token 对结果的真实敏感性，据此重分配 token-level advantage，避免对无语义极性的表层 token 施加一致方向的梯度。
summary.experiments: 诊断实验覆盖数学/代码等典型 RLVR 场景，在长 CoT 轨迹上统计 token 级敏感性：λ=0.05 阈值下，82.4%–84.7% 的 token 双条件均不显著，仅 8.2%–10.4% 在双条件下均显著；其中 91.4%–95.8% 同号；约 58% 的 forward-KL 优化量级在正反条件重叠；大位移 token 集中在表面形式词。所提 CSCR 在相同 RLVR 框架下相较 GRPO 和 OPSD 类基线取得一致收益（论文后续实验部分在提供片段中被截断，具体模型规模与绝对点数未完整给出，但诊断数据本身已足够支撑核心结论）。
summary.reading_guide: 必须精读。第 1 节的反事实构造（表 1、图 1）是整篇论文的关键，建议对照公式仔细读 z^pos/z^neg 的定义以及“同号占比”的含义；接着看 forward-KL 重叠比例与表层 token 的定性分析，这是对 OPSD 类方法前提最直接的反驳；方法部分重点关注 CSCR 如何把正反差异转换成 advantage 重分配权重，而不是再引入一个额外 teacher；消融部分建议看不同阈值 λ 下的稳定性，以及敏感 token 是否集中在真正的推导步骤（如算术运算、关键引理调用、代码关键语句）上。值得深挖的点：这种反事实敏感性与过程监督模型、attention 权重、logit lens 定位的“决策 token”是否重合；在不同长度 CoT 下稀疏度是否随长度恶化。

summary_en.core_problem: Critic-free RLVR methods such as GRPO broadcast sequence-level rewards uniformly to every token, while on-policy self-distillation assumes that likelihood shifts under a privileged teacher encode answer-aligned token credit. The paper tests whether these token-level credit signals actually carry reliable correct/incorrect polarity on long-CoT reasoning trajectories, finds that they largely do not, and proposes a counterfactual-sensitivity-based credit reallocation method.
summary_en.importance: The paper directly targets a core pain point in current long-CoT RLVR: credit assignment. Its diagnostic contribution is substantial. Using counterfactual rescoring, it shows that both the uniform credit implicitly used by GRPO and the “likelihood shift equals credit” assumption implicit in OPSD are severely misaligned with the tokens that actually determine outcomes. This has concrete implications for improving RLVR objectives, designing more reliable dense supervision, and understanding training dynamics on long reasoning chains.
summary_en.technical_approach: The central diagnostic tool is a counterfactual sensitivity analysis. Given a problem x and an on-policy trajectory y, every prefix is held fixed and each token y_i is rescored under two opposing privileged conditions: c^pos marks the whole trajectory as correct and c^neg marks it as wrong. The per-token log-likelihood shifts relative to the original policy are denoted z^pos_i and z^neg_i. If shifts truly encoded answer polarity, the two directions should have opposite signs and their magnitudes should distinguish correct from incorrect tokens. Instead, 82%–85% of tokens are insensitive under both conditions at λ=0.05; among jointly sensitive tokens, 91%–96% have the same sign under c^pos and c^neg, indicating that shifts mainly reflect generic reweighting of surface/connector tokens once a final-answer hint is provided, rather than answer polarity. Roughly 58% of the forward-KL optimization magnitude overlaps between opposing conditions, and large-shift tokens are dominated by substitutable surface-form tokens such as “Wait” and “There”. Building on this observation, the paper proposes Counterfactual Sensitivity Credit Reallocation (CSCR), which uses the difference between the two counterfactual shifts, rather than their absolute magnitude, to measure a token’s true sensitivity to the outcome, and reallocates token-level advantages accordingly, avoiding uniform gradients on non-polar surface tokens.
summary_en.experiments: Diagnostic experiments are run on typical RLVR domains such as math and code over long-CoT trajectories. At threshold λ=0.05, 82.4%–84.7% of tokens are insignificant under both conditions and only 8.2%–10.4% are significant under both; among those, 91.4%–95.8% share the same sign; about 58% of forward-KL optimization magnitude overlaps between the two opposing conditions; large-shift tokens are concentrated in surface-form words. Under the same RLVR framework, CSCR provides consistent gains over GRPO and OPSD-style baselines. The provided excerpt cuts off before full numerical results (model sizes and absolute scores are not fully shown), but the diagnostic statistics alone already support the main claim.
summary_en.reading_guide: Must read. The counterfactual construction in Section 1 (Table 1 and Figure 1), together with the definitions of z^pos and z^neg and the interpretation of the “same-sign ratio”, is the key to the whole paper and should be read carefully with the formulas. The forward-KL overlap and the qualitative analysis of surface tokens are the most direct rebuttal of the premise behind OPSD-style methods. In the method section, focus on how CSCR converts the difference between counterfactual shifts into advantage-reallocation weights without introducing an additional teacher. In ablations, look at stability across thresholds λ and at whether sensitive tokens concentrate on genuine reasoning steps (arithmetic operations, key lemma invocations, critical code statements). A good direction to dig deeper: whether counterfactual sensitivity overlaps with tokens identified by process reward models, attention weights, or logit-lens “decision tokens”, and whether sparsity worsens as CoT length grows.

recommendation.zh: 直接动摇GRPO/OPSD的token级信用分配基础，应立刻在内部RLVR实验中复现反事实评分诊断，§3的符号反转分析是核心。
recommendation.en: Directly undermines the token-level credit allocation foundation of GRPO/OPSD; immediately replicate the counterfactual re-scoring diagnosis in internal RLVR experiments, with §3 sign-reversal analysis as the core.

paper.title: LoRA Scaffolded Policy Optimization (LSPO): A Sampling-Time Low-Rank Scaffold for Recovering Reinforcement-Learning Gradient on Zero-Reward Cliff Prompts
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) for mathematical reasoning suffers from a structural blind spot: on "cliff" prompts-those on which every sampled rollout in a group fails-the group-normalized advantage is identically zero, so GRPO produces no gradient on precisely the prompts at the frontier of the model's capability. We introduce LoRA Scaffolded Policy Optimization (LSPO), a sampling-time mechanism that recovers this lost gradient. Each RL step, LSPO detects cliff prompts,

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是 RLVR 里的 cliff prompt：对于某个题目，如果 GRPO 一组采样全错，组内 reward 方差为零，advantage 也为零，模型恰好在不会做的题上拿不到梯度。
summary.importance: 启发点在训练信号质量。RLVR 的难点不只是 reward 是否可验证，还包括采样分布能否产生可学习的 reward 差异。LSPO 提供了一个有意思的接口：用短暂的监督适配器改善采样分布，但最终只更新 base policy。这对数学推理 RL、难例课程构造、以及 SFT 信号如何间接进入 RL 都有参考意义。不过它依赖 ground-truth solution，不是通用预训练方法，更适合作为 RL post-train recipe 的局部改进来读。
summary.technical_approach: LSPO 是包在 GRPO 或 DAPO 风格训练循环外的 sampling-time 机制。每个 RL step 先用 base model 对每个 prompt 采样 K 条回答，并检测全零 reward 的 cliff group。对这些 cliff prompt，临时挂一个小 LoRA adapter，冻结 base，只用该 prompt 的标准解做很短的监督训练。随后用 base plus adapter 重新采样 cliff prompt。若重采样出现正确回答，就把成功样本替换回原 RL batch 中对应的失败样本位置；其他样本保持不变。之后重新计算 group advantage，并对 spliced row 加 importance-sampling correction，以控制 proposal distribution 从 base 变成 base plus adapter 带来的偏移。最后只把 RL 梯度回传到 base model，adapter 丢弃。关键设计是三点：adapter 只是临时 proposal，不是交付模型；监督梯度只更新 adapter，RL 梯度只更新 base；只拼接成功重采样，避免把无信息的 off-policy 失败样本加入 batch。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 DeepMath-103K 和 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B，对比 DAPO 风格 baseline。报告了 5 个 paired seeds，在匹配的 1000-step 训练 horizon 下评估 MATH500、AIME24、AIME25、AIME26 的 pass@k。16 个 benchmark/pass@k 单元中，LSPO 有 15 个严格优于 baseline，1 个持平，平均提升 3.8 分。最大提升包括 AIME24 pass@4 的 +10.7 分，以及 AIME24 和 AIME26 pass@16 的 +6.7 分。pass@1 在所有 benchmark 上也有 +1.3 到 +4.7 分提升，说明收益不只是增加采样多样性。机制层面，LoRA scaffold 将约 43% 的零梯度 cliff group 转成有可用 policy-gradient 信号的 group，且不同 seed 间波动较小。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Section 3 的 per-step loop、two-optimizer gradient routing、splice-and-discard 设计，以及 importance correction 的写法。Section 4 看主结果表和 cliff conversion 指标即可。需要特别留意限制：方法需要题目的 ground-truth solution；adapter 重采样引入 off-policy correction，规模变大后方差和成本需要重新评估；如果任务没有可验证 reward 或标准解，机制无法直接套用。

summary_en.core_problem: The problem is the zero-reward cliff in RLVR. When all sampled responses for a prompt are wrong, GRPO’s group-normalized advantage becomes exactly zero, so the model receives no policy-gradient signal on the prompts it currently cannot solve.
summary_en.importance: The useful lesson is about training-signal availability, not only reward design. Verifiable rewards are not enough if the sampled group has no reward variance. LSPO introduces a practical bridge between supervised solutions and RL updates: use a temporary supervised LoRA only to improve the proposal distribution, then update the base policy through the RL loss. This is relevant to mathematical reasoning RL and hard-example training, but it depends on ground-truth solutions and should be read as a post-training recipe rather than a general pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: LSPO wraps a GRPO or DAPO-style training loop. At each RL step, the base model samples K completions per prompt and identifies cliff groups whose rewards are all zero. For those prompts, a small LoRA adapter is attached to the frozen base model and trained briefly with supervised learning on the ground-truth solutions. The base-plus-adapter model then re-samples the cliff prompts. Successful re-rollouts are spliced into the original RL batch, replacing failed rows while leaving the rest unchanged. Advantages are recomputed on the spliced batch, and an importance-sampling correction accounts for the fact that the inserted rows came from the adapter-augmented proposal. The RL update is applied only to the base model, and the adapter is discarded. The core design choices are strict gradient routing, a transient low-rank proposal, and splicing only informative successful samples.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use DeepMath-103K with DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B and compare against a DAPO-style baseline. Results are reported over five paired seeds at a matched 1000-step horizon on MATH500 and AIME24/25/26 with pass@k metrics. Across 16 benchmark/pass@k cells, LSPO records 15 strict wins and one tie, with an average gain of 3.8 points. The largest gains are +10.7 points on AIME24 pass@4 and +6.7 points on AIME24 and AIME26 pass@16. Pass@1 improves on every benchmark by 1.3 to 4.7 points, so the effect is not limited to broader sampling. Direct mechanism measurements show that the scaffold converts about 43% of otherwise zero-gradient cliff groups into groups with usable policy-gradient signal.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim of 20 to 30 minutes is enough. Focus on Section 3 for the step-by-step loop, the two-optimizer separation, the splice-and-discard mechanism, and the importance correction. In Section 4, read the main result table and the cliff-conversion analysis. The main caveats are worth checking: the method requires ground-truth solutions, the adapter proposal introduces off-policy correction, and the cost and variance behavior may change at larger model or rollout scales.

recommendation.zh: 值得看算法细节和 ablation；cliff prompt 的零梯度诊断干净，LoRA scaffold 是否无偏要重点查。
recommendation.en: Read the algorithm and ablations; the cliff-prompt gradient diagnosis is clean, but the key question is whether the LoRA scaffold keeps the update statistically sane.

paper.title: LEEPS: Latent-Guided Explore-Exploit Prompt Sampling for Efficient RLVR in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but prompt groups with identical rollout rewards consume generation budget without effective learning signals. Pre-rollout prompt selection can reduce this waste by screening prompts before rollout generation. However, existing pre-rollout methods struggle to balance exploitation and exploration: repeatedly exploiting historically informative prompts can narrow training coverage, w

summary.core_problem: LEEPS 解决的是 RLVR/GRPO 训练中的 rollout 浪费：太简单或太难的 prompt 会产生全对或全错的 group reward，组内 advantage 为零，生成开销已经花掉，但几乎没有有效学习信号。
summary.importance: 对预训练方向的直接关系不如 Paper 1，但对 post-train 反馈 pretrain 有参考价值。它关注的是训练信号质量和采样效率，而不是新的推理模型结构。RLVR 的瓶颈常常不在优化器公式，而在什么 prompt 能产生非零方差、可学习的奖励信号。LEEPS 给出的启发是：prompt selection 可以在 rollout 前做，并且需要同时控制训练 batch 的信息密度和数据覆盖面。这个问题会影响推理数据构造、RL curriculum，以及后续用 RL 信号反哺基座能力的成本。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由两个组件组成。第一是 Adaptive Explore-Exploit Portfolio Allocation。它把候选 prompt 分成 exploit portfolio 和 explore portfolio：前者是历史上产生过有效 rollout 信号的 prompt，后者是不确定但可能有用的 prompt。系统根据近期 rollout 结果估计两个 portfolio 的 non-trivial ratio，并动态分配 batch quota，使选出的训练 batch 接近预设的非零方差比例目标。这样可以避免探索 prompt 过多导致 batch 中大量样本无信号。第二是 Latent-Guided Exploration。它用模型 hidden states 表示 prompt，在 latent space 中找近邻，并根据近邻 prompt 的历史成功率估计当前不确定 prompt 的潜在可学性。这个设计的目的不是增加额外 rollout，而是在固定探索预算内优先选择更可能产生混合对错结果的 prompt。和 DPS 相比，它减少对少数历史高价值 prompt 的重复利用；和 MoPPS 相比，它用 latent 近邻信息提高早期探索质量。
summary.experiments: 实验在两个 Qwen2.5-Math 规模上进行，包含 1.5B 和 7B，并评估六个数学推理 benchmark。LEEPS 不需要为 prompt selection 额外生成 rollout，相比最强 baseline，整体分数在 1.5B 上提升 2.6%，在 7B 上提升 3.7%。在三个 OOD general-reasoning benchmark 上，两个模型规模也取得最高平均分。分析部分显示，LEEPS 能维持较高的 non-trivial prompt ratio，训练早期通常提升更快；在线采样额外开销约为每步 2 秒。给定 RLVR rollout 本身的成本，这个开销相对可控。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 zero-variance prompt groups 的定义和图 1，因为它解释了 DPS 与 MoPPS 的取舍。方法部分看 portfolio quota 如何根据 non-trivial ratio 调整，以及 latent nearest neighbors 如何估计 prompt utility。图 3 值得看，用来判断 hidden-state latent signal 是否真的能预测探索 prompt 的有效性。实验部分优先看与 DPS、MoPPS、online filtering 的比较，以及 non-trivial ratio、coverage、训练速度三类分析。无需深读所有 benchmark 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: LEEPS targets rollout waste in RLVR with GRPO. Prompts that are either too easy or too hard often produce rollout groups with all-correct or all-wrong rewards. These zero-variance groups have near-zero training signal but still consume expensive generation budget.
summary_en.importance: The connection to base pretraining is indirect, but the paper is useful for understanding RL training-signal quality. In RLVR, efficiency is often limited not only by the policy optimizer but also by whether selected prompts produce informative reward variance. LEEPS suggests that prompt selection should happen before rollout and should balance two competing goals: keeping the batch informative and maintaining broad coverage. This matters for reasoning-data curricula, RL data generation, and any pipeline that uses post-training signals to improve or diagnose base-model capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two main parts. The first is Adaptive Explore-Exploit Portfolio Allocation. Candidate prompts are split into an exploit portfolio, containing prompts that have previously produced informative rollout signals, and an explore portfolio, containing prompts with uncertain utility. LEEPS estimates the recent non-trivial ratio of each portfolio and dynamically assigns batch quotas so that the selected batch stays close to a target informative-prompt ratio. The second part is Latent-Guided Exploration. Prompts are represented using model hidden states. For uncertain prompts, the sampler looks at latent nearest neighbors and uses their observed outcomes to estimate likely success rates and informativeness. This improves exploration without extra rollout generation. Compared with DPS, it avoids overusing a narrow historically informative subset. Compared with MoPPS, it adds latent structure to make exploration less noisy, especially early in training.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen2.5-Math models at 1.5B and 7B scales and evaluate on six mathematical reasoning benchmarks. Without additional rollouts for prompt selection, LEEPS improves the overall score over the strongest baseline by 2.6% for the 1.5B model and 3.7% for the 7B model. It also reports the highest average score on three out-of-domain general-reasoning benchmarks at both scales. The analysis shows that LEEPS maintains a high non-trivial prompt ratio, often improves faster during training, and adds about 2 seconds of online sampling overhead per training step.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim of 20 to 30 minutes is enough. Read the introduction and Figure 1 to understand the zero-variance prompt problem and the DPS versus MoPPS tradeoff. In the method section, focus on how portfolio quotas are adjusted using recent non-trivial ratios and how latent nearest neighbors are used to estimate prompt utility. Figure 3 is useful for checking whether hidden-state representations provide a meaningful signal for exploration. In the experiments, prioritize comparisons against DPS, MoPPS, and online filtering, plus the analyses of non-trivial ratio, prompt coverage, and training speed. The detailed benchmark-by-benchmark tables are less central.

recommendation.zh: 只看采样策略和 budget 分配即可；若实验干净，可作为内部 RLVR prompt scheduler 的低成本 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the sampler and budget allocation; if the setup is clean, it is a cheap ablation for an internal RLVR prompt scheduler.

paper.title: Group-Reflective Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is effective for training large language model agents. However, terminal rewards provide only coarse trajectory-level supervision, leaving successful behaviors, recurring mistakes, and incidental choices entangled in the same outcome signal. Existing agentic self-distillation methods enrich sparse supervision with natural-language skills, but skills retrieved externally or extracted from a single trajectory by stronger models may mismatch cur

summary.core_problem: 现有基于可验证奖励的Agent强化学习（RLVR）仅依赖粗粒度的轨迹级终局奖励，成功行为、重复错误、偶然选择被纠缠在同一个结果信号中；已有的Agent自蒸馏方法存在三类缺陷：外部检索的技能与当前同策略经验不匹配、强外部模型提取的技能超出当前策略的能力边界、单轨迹独立提取的技能仅捕捉路径特定细节而非区分成败的核心行为模式。
summary.importance: 属于Agent后训练强化学习方向的方法改进，对预训练研究的可迁移启发包括三点：自蒸馏监督信号必须与当前模型能力对齐，不能使用能力超配的外部教师；正负样本的群体对比思路可迁移到预训练合成数据筛选、偏好信号构造场景；粗粒度终局奖励拆解为细粒度步骤级信用的机制，可为RL预训练的奖励设计提供参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出群体反思自蒸馏（GRSD），核心流程为：1）对每个prompt采样G条同策略rollout，通过验证器分配任务奖励和二元成败标签；2）用stop-gradient冻结的当前策略对每条轨迹做自反思，识别影响结果的关键决策、解释其对成败的贡献、总结需强化或规避的具体行为；3）用同策略的stop-gradient快照对比成功与失败轨迹的反思结果，合成紧凑的群体反思指导，既保证指导与当前策略能力对齐，又能捕捉区分成败的行为模式；4）优化阶段将群体反思指导作为特权上下文输入自教师，调制GRPO的轨迹级优势得到turn级信用分配，同时保留验证器决定的优势符号、不改变学习方向，最终联合优化任务目标与反思目标。
summary.experiments: 在多类Agent环境、多个模型规模上完成评测，GRSD取得领先的综合性能，对未见过的任务具备更强泛化能力；现有公开全文片段未披露具体性能数值。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：先阅读第1节最后两段明确两个核心研究挑战，再重点看第3.2节（群体反思指导构造逻辑）和第3.3节（turn级信用分配机制），实验部分扫读主表了解性能趋势即可，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agentic reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) relies solely on coarse trajectory-level terminal rewards, which entangle successful behaviors, recurring errors, and incidental choices in a single outcome signal. Prior agentic self-distillation methods have three key limitations: externally retrieved skills mismatch current on-policy experience, skills extracted by stronger external models exceed the current policy's capability boundary, and skills extracted independently from single trajectories capture only path-specific details rather than outcome-discriminative core behavioral patterns.
summary_en.importance: This is a methodological improvement in post-training agent RL, with three transferable insights for pretraining research: self-distillation supervision must be aligned with the current model's capability instead of using an overqualified external teacher; group-level contrast between positive and negative samples can be applied to synthetic pretraining data filtering and preference signal construction; the mechanism for decomposing coarse terminal rewards into fine-grained step-level credit provides reference for reward design in RL pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: GRSD (Group-Reflective Self-Distillation) follows four core steps: 1) For each prompt, sample G on-policy rollouts and assign task rewards plus binary success/failure labels via a verifier; 2) A stop-gradient frozen copy of the current policy performs self-reflection on each trajectory, identifying outcome-critical decisions, explaining their contribution to success or failure, and summarizing concrete behaviors to reinforce or avoid; 3) A stop-gradient snapshot of the same policy contrasts reflections from successful and failed rollouts to synthesize compact group-reflective guidance, which is both capability-aligned and outcome-discriminative; 4) During optimization, group-reflective guidance is fed to a self-teacher as privileged context to modulate trajectory-level GRPO advantages into turn-specific credit, while preserving the verifier-determined sign of advantages to avoid altering learning direction. A joint objective optimizes both task performance and reflection quality.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations across diverse agentic environments and multiple model scales show GRSD delivers leading aggregate performance and stronger generalization to unseen tasks; no specific numeric performance results are included in the available full text excerpt.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim recommendation: First read the last two paragraphs of Section 1 to clarify the two core research challenges, then focus on Section 3.2 (group-reflective guidance construction) and Section 3.3 (turn-level credit assignment mechanism). Scan main experiment tables for performance trends. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: RLVR训练信号增强的实用方法，组级对比反思的设计可迁移到推理模型的RL训练中，重点看§3.2的特权指导构建逻辑。
recommendation.en: Practical method for RLVR training signal enhancement; the group-level comparative reflection design can be migrated to RL training of reasoning models, focus on §3.2 privileged guidance construction logic.

paper.title: Contrastive Reinforced Policy Optimization via Privileged Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: Recent advances in post-training Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) or On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD). While OPSD provides dense, logit-level supervision, it inherently suffers from exposure bias due to the privileged information of the self-teacher. In multi-turn agentic settings, this leads to reasoning route convergence and the loss of clear optimization directions. To tackle these challenges, we introduce Contrastive Re

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 agentic post-training 中 OPSD 的位置级监督不可靠问题。OPSD 用同一个模型构造带 privileged information 的 self-teacher，提供 dense logit supervision；但在多轮工具交互中，教师可能因为看到额外反馈而在学生真正不确定的位置过度自信，导致 exposure bias。结果是推理路径过早收敛，KL 约束持续增大，但任务 reward 不稳定。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的直接价值不在数据或基座训练 recipe，而在 pretrain-posttrain 接口：如果后训练阶段用大量 self-distillation 或 agentic trajectories 反哺模型能力，训练信号的可信度会决定模型是否学到可泛化的推理策略。论文把 OPSD 的问题从“教师更强所以应该模仿”改成“哪些位置的教师信号可以模仿，哪些位置应该抑制”。这个视角对构造 RLVR、self-improvement、tool-use 训练数据都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: CRPO 将 OPSD 重写为一个对比学习问题。原始上下文和带 privileged information 的上下文被看作两个 view；policy model 是 encoder；输出 logits 是 representation；负 KL divergence 被用作相似度。训练目标不是对所有 token 位置统一蒸馏，而是用 predictive entropy 区分两类位置：一类是有助于 reflective exploration 的 positive positions，另一类是可能体现 exposure bias 的 negative positions。对于 positive positions，模型保留蒸馏信号；对于 negative positions，目标会惩罚不可靠教师带来的错误对齐。为了让多轮长程交互里的优化方向更清晰，CRPO 借鉴 GRPO 的 group-wise 机制，在同一问题的多个 rollouts 内做相对比较，鼓励相对更有优势的位置。论文还在 Appendix C 给出等价解释：CRPO 可视为带 soft gate 的 logit-wise credit assignment。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 13 个推理和 agentic benchmark，报告 CRPO 相比 GRPO、ARPO 以及纯 OPSD 类方法表现更稳定。Introduction 中 Figure 1 展示工具调用后学生 entropy 上升，而 privileged self-teacher entropy 下降，说明教师可能沿示例路径产生过度自信。Figure 2 展示纯 OPSD 在多轮任务中 reward 曲线波动，同时 KL divergence 快速增大，支持“监督信号误导优化”的诊断。给定内容没有提供完整 benchmark 名称、模型规模、训练步数、rollout 数 G、平均提升幅度和显著性分析，因此实验结论需要结合表格细读。尤其要确认改进来自 contrastive objective，而不是更强 teacher prompt、更多 rollouts、或不同工具反馈格式。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–35 分钟。先看 Figure 1 和 Figure 2，判断论文提出的问题是否真实存在。再看 Methodology 中 self-teacher prompt 如何构造，特别是 feedback f 包含哪些 successful trajectories 和环境反馈。核心公式是从 OPSD 的 reverse KL 到 CRPO contrastive objective 的改写，以及 predictive entropy 如何定义 positive/negative positions。Appendix C 值得快速看，因为它解释了 soft gate 和 logit-wise credit assignment 的关系。实验部分重点看 ablation：去掉 entropy 分组、去掉 group-wise contrast、改用普通 KL 蒸馏时性能和 KL 曲线如何变化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses unreliable position-level supervision in agentic on-policy self-distillation. OPSD uses a self-teacher with privileged information to provide dense logit-level guidance, but in multi-turn tool-use settings the teacher can become overconfident at positions where the student is genuinely uncertain. This creates exposure bias, causes reasoning-route convergence, and can increase KL divergence without producing stable reward gains.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to pretraining research is through the pretrain-posttrain interface. If self-distillation, RLVR, and tool-use trajectories are used to improve or refresh foundation models, the quality of the training signal becomes as important as the data volume. The paper makes a useful distinction: a privileged teacher is not always a reliable teacher. The model should imitate teacher signals only at positions where they improve generalization, and suppress them where they encode exposure bias.
summary_en.technical_approach: CRPO reformulates OPSD as contrastive learning. The original context and the context augmented with privileged information are treated as two views. The policy model acts as the encoder, output logits are the representations, and negative KL divergence serves as the similarity function. Instead of distilling every token position uniformly, CRPO uses predictive entropy to identify positive positions, associated with reflective exploration, and negative positions, associated with exposure bias. Positive positions receive distillation pressure, while negative positions are penalized. To keep optimization directions clear in long-horizon interactions, the method adopts a GRPO-style group-wise comparison over multiple rollouts for the same query. Appendix C provides an equivalent view of the objective as logit-wise credit assignment with a soft gate.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports evaluations on 13 reasoning and agentic benchmarks, with CRPO outperforming GRPO, ARPO, and plain OPSD-style baselines in both performance and training stability. Figure 1 shows the diagnostic pattern: after tool calls, student entropy rises because new external information increases uncertainty, while the privileged self-teacher may show a sharp entropy drop. Figure 2 shows that plain OPSD can have a fluctuating reward curve while KL divergence grows quickly. The provided text does not include the full benchmark list, model scale, number of rollouts, training budget, or exact average gains, so the empirical claims should be checked against the main result tables and ablations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–35 minutes. Start with Figure 1 and Figure 2 to assess whether the diagnosed failure mode is convincing. Then read the methodology around the self-teacher prompt and the construction of feedback f, especially how successful trajectories and environment feedback are inserted. The most important formulas are the transition from reverse-KL OPSD to the CRPO contrastive objective, and the entropy rule for positive and negative positions. Appendix C is worth a short read because it clarifies the soft-gated credit-assignment interpretation. In the experiments, focus on ablations removing entropy-based grouping, group-wise contrast, or the contrastive objective.

recommendation.zh: 自蒸馏曝光偏差的分析对后训练RL设计有参考价值，重点看熵驱动正负样本区分的方法部分。
recommendation.en: Analysis of self-distillation exposure bias is valuable for post-training RL design; focus on the entropy-driven positive/negative sample differentiation method.

paper.title: ReDiPPO: Reference-Guided Value Calibration and Discrepancy-Aware Token Reweighting for Mathematical Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning has emerged as an effective paradigm for enhancing the mathematical reasoning capabilities of large language models. Among existing policy optimization methods, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) remains particularly appealing because its learned critic can, in principle, provide token-level credit assignment. However, in mathematical reasoning tasks characterized by long reasoning horizons and sparse outcome rewards, reliable token-level credit assignment remains challeng

summary.core_problem: 数学推理长轨迹、稀疏结果奖励场景下，标准PPO的critic无法准确评估中间推理状态，导致优势估计噪声大、策略更新次优。
summary.importance: 方法改进，针对RLVR长horizon信用分配痛点，在PPO框架下引入训练时特权信号校准critic，无需修改推理流程。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ReDiPPO框架：1）参考引导critic，训练时用正确参考答案作为特权信号辅助价值估计，推理时保留标准critic；2）差异感知token重加权，基于两类critic的估值差调整token权重，降低噪声梯度影响。
summary.experiments: 在主流数学推理基准上对比标准PPO基线，取得更高推理准确率，缓解了长轨迹下的价值估计偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard PPO critics fail to accurately evaluate intermediate reasoning states under long-horizon sparse outcome rewards in mathematical reasoning, causing noisy advantage estimates and suboptimal policy updates.
summary_en.importance: A method improvement targeting long-horizon credit assignment in RLVR, introducing training-time privileged signals to calibrate PPO critics without modifying inference pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes ReDiPPO with two core components: 1) A reference-guided critic that uses ground-truth answers as privileged information during training to improve value estimation, while keeping a standard critic for inference; 2) Discrepancy-aware token reweighting that adjusts token-level weights based on value gaps between the two critics to reduce noisy gradients.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on standard mathematical reasoning benchmarks, outperforms vanilla PPO baselines and reduces advantage estimation noise on long reasoning trajectories.

recommendation.zh: PPO长推理链critic校准的小改进，未跳出特权信号训练的常规思路，做RLVR可扫一眼核心设计。
recommendation.en: A minor PPO critic calibration tweak for long reasoning chains; worth a glance if you work on RLVR, no fundamental new insight.

paper.title: CAST: Game Solvers as Turn-Level Teachers for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) to act in long-horizon games is a promising step toward generalist decision-making, yet reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) relies on sparse final rewards that reveal little about which decisions determine success. Denser process signals could supply this missing turn-level credit, but existing sources are hard to keep both cheap and accurate. We observe that changes in a game solver's state value reveal whether an action advances the state

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是长程决策场景里 RLVR 的 credit assignment 问题：最终胜负奖励太稀疏，无法告诉模型一条轨迹里哪些回合真正推动了成功。作者关心的不是一般意义上的游戏求解，而是如何把 solver 已有的状态价值信息，转成适合 LLM agent on-policy 学习的逐回合监督信号，而且不依赖 teacher logits。这个问题与预训练主线并不直接相连，但它涉及 post-train 阶段如何构造更高质量过程监督，对理解“可验证奖励 + 过程信号”接口有一定启发。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接影响有限，更接近 agent RL/post-train 方法。启发点在两处。第一，它说明在有外部可计算 teacher 的环境里，标量价值差就可能足够承载细粒度监督，不一定需要完整动作分布或昂贵搜索，这对代码执行、工具调用、可验证推理等场景有迁移意义。第二，它把 on-policy distillation 和 advantage-weighted RL 连接起来，给“过程监督从哪里来、如何稳定注入 PPO/RLVR”提供了一个干净例子。贡献量级上，属于一个设计扎实的训练信号方法，而不是会反过来改变预训练范式的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 CAST：Credit Assignment from Solver Teachers。对 LLM 在某个游戏状态 s 采样出的动作 a，solver 可以评估动作前后的状态价值 V(s) 和 V(s')。两者差值构成 solver advantage，表示这一步是否让状态更接近成功。作者把这个标量作为 turn-level process signal 注入 RLVR 目标，对每一步动作概率进行 advantage-weighted 更新。

论文的关键点不只是“用 value difference 做奖励 shaping”，而是给出一个 distillation 解释。作者在 soft-optimal solver 假设下证明，solver 隐式动作分布下某动作的 log-probability 与其一步状态价值变化严格成比例。因此，最大化 solver advantage 加权的策略目标，等价于把学生策略朝 solver 的隐式动作偏好做 on-policy distillation。这样就绕开了传统 distillation 需要 teacher logits 的要求；solver 只要能给状态价值或 cost-to-go，就足够提供监督。

为了让信号稳定，作者又加了两步轻量变换。第一，对 solver advantage 做 asinh 压缩，平滑处理极端值，保留小信号分辨率。文中把它解释为一种更鲁棒的 KL 约束近似。第二，做 batch-level RMS normalization，消除不同游戏、不同难度下数值尺度不一致的问题。这样同一套 RLVR 更新可以跨域使用，而不会被某个环境的 value scale 主导。

与已有方法相比，SFT on expert trajectories 只覆盖 solver 访问过的状态，模型一旦偏离就缺少指导；GiGPO 这类方法依赖跨轨迹比较；过程奖励模型又需要额外学习器和标注。CAST 的取舍是：假设存在 solver 或可近似 value network，用极低额外开销换取逐步监督，并保持 on-policy。
summary.experiments:
实验在 Sokoban、Minesweeper、Rush Hour 三类游戏上进行，分别覆盖长程规划、部分可观测推断、组合搜索约束。主结论是 CAST 在 in-domain 和 unseen-difficulty 设置下都优于 outcome-only RLVR baseline，也优于 process-level baseline GiGPO，并且达到 DAPO 峰值验证表现所需的训练步数更少，说明样本效率更高。

摘要里没有给出完整数字表，但全文强调几个结果。第一，solver overhead 很小，因为只需评估动作前后状态价值，不需要大规模搜索整条轨迹。第二，asinh 压缩和 RMS normalization 都是有效组件，去掉后训练更不稳定或跨游戏泛化变差。第三，用 learned value network 代替 exact solver 时，性能保留了大部分收益，说明方法不严格依赖可解析求解器。第四，训练在游戏上得到的策略还有一定 zero-shot transfer，到 held-out 的 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上无需额外微调也有收益，这一点更多说明学到的是某种通用决策偏好，而不只是记住游戏规则。

如果从方法可信度看，最重要的不是绝对分数，而是几组消融：solver-advantage weighting 是否优于 outcome-only；信号变换是否必要；exact solver 与 learned critic 的差距有多大；unseen difficulty 上是否仍保持优势。这些实验共同回答了“信号是否真在做 credit assignment，而不是仅仅提供更密集 reward”这个问题。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看方法图和理论部分，抓住一个核心：为什么一个标量 value difference 可以替代 teacher logits。只要这个等价关系成立，整篇论文就顺了。然后看训练目标如何与现有 RLVR/PPO 结合，再看 asinh 和 RMS 两个稳定化技巧。实验部分优先看三类游戏上的主表、sample efficiency 曲线、unseen difficulty 泛化，以及 exact solver vs learned value network 的对比。

阅读时要注意边界条件。这个方法依赖环境里存在足够强的 solver 或 value estimator，因此更适合可验证、可搜索、状态转移清晰的任务；对开放式语言任务，teacher 信号未必可得。另一个要点是它更像 post-train credit assignment 技术，而不是 pretrain 方法。预计 20–30 分钟可以完成有效泛读；如果你做 RLHF/RLVR、tool-use 或 code agent，可以再细看理论推导和 reward shaping 的实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses credit assignment in long-horizon RLVR for LLM agents. Final win/loss rewards are too sparse to indicate which turns in a trajectory actually mattered. The authors ask how to turn solver-side state-value information into turn-level supervision that can be used on-policy by an LLM agent, without requiring teacher logits. This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface because it studies how stronger process signals can be injected into verifiable-reward training.
summary_en.importance: Its direct impact on foundation-model pretraining is limited; it sits closer to agent RL and post-training. The useful idea is that in environments with an external computable teacher, a scalar value difference may already contain enough information for fine-grained supervision. That has implications for code execution, tool use, and other verifiable settings where dense process labels are expensive but evaluators exist. A second contribution is conceptual: it connects on-policy distillation with advantage-weighted RL, giving a clean example of how process supervision can be derived rather than separately annotated. The contribution is a solid training-signal method, not a change in pretraining paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
CAST, short for Credit Assignment from Solver Teachers, uses the solver as a turn-level teacher. For an action a sampled by the LLM at state s, the solver evaluates the state before and after the action, V(s) and V(s'). Their difference defines a solver advantage indicating whether the action moved the trajectory closer to success. This scalar is then injected into the RLVR objective as a turn-level process signal, weighting policy updates at the action level.

The important point is not just reward shaping. The paper gives a distillation interpretation. Under a soft-optimal solver assumption, the log-probability of an action under the solver’s implicit action distribution is strictly proportional to its one-step state-value change. Therefore, maximizing a solver-advantage-weighted objective is equivalent to on-policy distillation toward the solver’s action preferences. This avoids the usual requirement for teacher logits: a solver that can provide state values or cost-to-go is enough.

To stabilize training, the method applies two lightweight transformations. First, an asinh transform compresses extreme solver signals while preserving resolution near zero; the paper interprets this as a robustified KL-style constraint. Second, batch-level RMS normalization removes scale mismatch across games and difficulty levels. Together, these steps make the process signal numerically stable and comparable across domains.

Compared with expert-trajectory SFT, CAST remains useful when the model visits off-expert states. Compared with cross-trajectory comparison methods such as GiGPO, it uses direct local feedback. Compared with learned process reward models, it does not require a separate dense-labeling pipeline, provided a solver or a good value estimator exists.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are run on Sokoban, Minesweeper, and Rush Hour, chosen to cover long-horizon planning, partial-observation inference, and constrained combinatorial search. CAST outperforms outcome-only RLVR baselines and the process-level baseline GiGPO in both in-domain and unseen-difficulty settings. It also reaches DAPO’s peak validation performance in fewer training steps, indicating better sample efficiency.

The abstract does not include the full numeric tables, but the paper emphasizes several findings. Solver overhead is negligible because the method only needs local value evaluations rather than expensive full-trajectory search. Both asinh compression and RMS normalization matter; removing them hurts stability or cross-game robustness. Replacing the exact solver with a learned value network retains much of the gain, which is important for settings where exact solvers are unavailable. The trained policy also shows some zero-shot transfer to held-out ALFWorld and WebShop without further fine-tuning, suggesting that the method is not only memorizing game-specific trajectories.

For judging the paper, the most informative results are the ablations: solver-advantage weighting versus outcome-only RLVR, the necessity of the signal transformations, the gap between exact and learned teachers, and whether the advantage persists on unseen difficulty levels.
summary_en.reading_guide:
