summary.core_problem: 多模态强化学习（RLVR）中答案级正确无法保证VLM的预测真正基于视觉证据，现有视觉干预方法按干预类型分配监督而非实际效果，同操作在不同样本上效果差异大。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出基于干预实际效果的样本级视觉对齐框架，改进多模态RL模型的视觉grounded性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SIVA-RL框架，用样本级结果条件监督替代操作条件正则；通过token对齐、距离约束的PatchSwap构造局部图像干预；用冻结审计策略打分干净-干预对的奖励下降幅度作为软路由权重，分别驱动敏感性对齐（大降样本）和不变性对齐（低降样本）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未明确给出模型参数量、训练数据规模及具体基线对比数值，仅披露框架设计思路。

summary_en.core_problem: In multimodal reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), answer-level correctness does not guarantee VLM predictions are grounded in visual evidence; existing visual intervention methods assign supervision by intervention type rather than actual effect, leading to inconsistent outcomes across samples.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing a sample-wise outcome-conditioned visual alignment framework to improve visual grounding in multimodal RL.
summary_en.technical_approach: SIVA-RL replaces operator-conditioned regularization with sample-wise outcome-conditioned supervision; constructs localized interventions via token-aligned, distance-constrained PatchSwap; uses a frozen audit policy to score reward drops on clean-intervention pairs as soft routing weights, driving sensitivity alignment for high-drop pairs and invariance alignment for low-drop pairs.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not specify model size, training data scale, or quantitative baseline comparisons, only discloses framework design.

recommendation.zh: 多模态RL视觉对齐的增量工作，干预效果驱动监督的思路可作设计参考，无需深读正文。
recommendation.en: Incremental work on multimodal RL visual alignment; the outcome-conditioned supervision idea is useful as design reference, no need for deep reading.

paper.title: LAPO: Leave-One-Turn Attribution for Self-Generated Process Rewards in Multi-Turn Search Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning for multi-turn search reasoning typically relies on terminal outcome rewards, which cannot distinguish useful, redundant, and harmful intermediate interactions. We propose LAPO, a self-generated process-supervision method based on backward leave-one-turn attribution. For each search turn, LAPO replaces the turn and its retrieval observation with a fixed [DELETE] placeholder and measures the resulting change in the current policy's mean log-likelihood of the gold answer. Th

summary.core_problem: 该工作解决多轮搜索推理 RL 中的轨迹内 credit assignment 问题。只用最终答案对错作为 reward，会把同一条轨迹中的所有搜索动作一起奖励或惩罚，无法区分有用检索、冗余检索和误导检索。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关系不在基座预训练本身，而在 post-train 信号构造。它提供了一个值得借鉴的思路：过程监督不一定要来自外部 reward model、teacher 或 verifier，也可以从当前 policy 对 gold answer 的条件似然变化中构造。这个设计对 RL 训练中的信号质量、过程奖励自举、以及搜索增强推理的训练稳定性有启发。贡献量级是一个具体 RL recipe，适合泛读，不属于通用预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: LOTAPO 使用 backward leave-one-turn attribution 构造自生成过程奖励。给定完整多轮搜索轨迹，每个有效搜索 turn 包含模型生成的 search action 和环境返回的 observation。方法依次把某个 search turn 及其 observation 替换成固定的 [DELETE] 占位符，然后在保留下游交互不变的条件下，计算当前 policy 对 gold answer 的平均 log-likelihood 变化。若删除某个 turn 后 gold answer 似然下降，说明该 turn 对最终回答有正贡献；若似然上升，则说明该 turn 可能冗余或有害。这个 Answer-Likelihood Gain 被用作 turn-level attribution。为降低噪声，方法还做 robust scaling、tanh 有界变换、group normalization，并加入 sign-consistency gating：只有归一化后的 advantage 与原始 likelihood gain 在方向上一致时，才保留该过程信号。最终，搜索 turn 的 policy tokens 同时接收 GRPO 的终局 advantage 和 LOTAPO 的过程 advantage；最终答案 turn 仍只使用终局 reward。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖七个知识密集型问答数据集，评估多轮搜索推理场景下的 RL 训练效果。摘要和正文片段表明，LOTAPO 相比只用 outcome reward 的训练能提供更细粒度的中间步骤反馈，并且不需要额外训练过程奖励模型、教师模型、verifier 或 LLM judge。关键实验应关注三类结果：最终 QA accuracy 或 exact match 的提升；去掉 sign-consistency gating、只用原始 likelihood gain、去掉 group normalization 等消融；以及不同 turn 位置的 attribution 是否能识别早期关键证据。当前给出的全文内容未包含具体数值表，因此不补写具体提升幅度或模型规模。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。优先看 Method 中 leave-one-turn 替换方式、Answer-Likelihood Gain 的定义、归一化与 sign-consistency gating 的公式。实验部分重点看 outcome-only GRPO 与 LOTAPO 的对比，以及 gating 和归一化的消融。若关注 RLHF/RLVR 或搜索增强推理，值得细看它如何避免外部过程奖励模型带来的分布偏移；若只关注基座预训练，可以读到方法公式和主要消融即可。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets credit assignment in reinforcement learning for multi-turn search reasoning. Terminal answer correctness gives the same trajectory-level signal to all intermediate search actions, so useful, redundant, and harmful search turns are reinforced or penalized together.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance is mainly to post-training and RL signal construction rather than base-model pretraining. The useful idea is to derive process supervision from the current policy itself, without an external process reward model, teacher, verifier, or LLM judge. This is relevant for training search-augmented reasoning systems, and more broadly for understanding how to build lower-noise intermediate rewards in RL pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: LOTAPO constructs self-generated process rewards with backward leave-one-turn attribution. For a completed search trajectory, each valid search turn consists of the model-generated search action and the corresponding retrieval observation. The method replaces one such turn with a fixed [DELETE] placeholder while keeping the downstream interactions intact, then measures how the current policy’s mean log-likelihood of the gold answer changes. This Answer-Likelihood Gain estimates the turn’s contribution in the full reasoning context: if removing a turn lowers the gold-answer likelihood, the turn receives positive attribution; if removal increases it, the turn may be redundant or misleading. The raw gains are noisy, so LOTAPO applies robust scaling, a bounded tanh transform, group normalization, and sign-consistency gating. The gate keeps only process advantages whose normalized direction agrees with the raw likelihood-gain direction. The resulting process advantage is assigned to the policy-generated tokens of the corresponding search turn and combined with the terminal GRPO advantage, while the final answer turn remains supervised only by the terminal reward.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers seven knowledge-intensive question-answering datasets in multi-turn search reasoning. The available text indicates that LOTAPO improves training over outcome-only rewards by providing turn-level feedback without relying on external evaluators. The most informative experimental checks are the comparison against vanilla GRPO or outcome-only RL, ablations on sign-consistency gating and normalization, and analyses showing whether early evidence can be credited even when its value appears only after later turns. The provided full-text excerpt does not include numerical result tables, so exact gains, parameter counts, and dataset sizes should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the method definition of leave-one-turn deletion, the Answer-Likelihood Gain formula, and the normalization plus sign-consistency gate. In the experiments, prioritize outcome-only RL comparisons and ablations over the attribution pipeline. For readers working on RLVR, RLHF, or search-augmented reasoning, the most useful detail is how the method avoids evaluator-induced distribution mismatch. For base-pretraining work, the main value is the reward-construction idea rather than the task setting.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 §方法和主表；无 judge 的过程奖励很干净，但 gold-answer likelihood 可能偏向答案复述。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and main table; judge-free process rewards are clean, but gold-answer likelihood may bias toward answer restatement.

paper.title: Post-Training Shifts Confidence: A Three-Stage Analysis of How SFT, RL, and OPD Shape Pre-, Intra-, and Post-CoT Calibration
paper.abstract: Large language models have made strong reasoning gains through supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and on-policy distillation, yet these post-training methods are usually evaluated only by final-answer accuracy. We study how they reshape confidence during reasoning. We introduce a three-stage calibration framework that evaluates confidence before, during, and after chain-of-thought generation, corresponding to difficulty estimation, early termination, and answer aggregation. Through

summary.core_problem: 分析 SFT、RL 和 on-policy distillation 如何改变数学推理模型在 CoT 前、中、后三个阶段的置信度校准。
summary.importance: 贡献是后训练机制分析。它不只看 final-answer accuracy，而是把置信度拆成三类可用信号：推理前难度估计、推理中提前停止、推理后多轨迹聚合。这对 RLVR、reasoning model 训练监控和 test-time compute 分配有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出三阶段校准框架：pre-CoT 衡量模型在生成推理前是否知道题目难度；intra-CoT 衡量推理过程中置信度能否支持 early termination；post-CoT 衡量完整推理轨迹的置信度能否用于 answer aggregation。通过受控比较 SFT、RL 和 OPD，分析不同后训练方法在不同位置的置信度可靠性。
summary.experiments: 实验在数学推理 benchmark 上进行受控比较。摘要给出的主要发现是：OPD 提供最有用的推理前置信度；SFT 提供最强的在线早停信号；RL 产生最可靠的轨迹级聚合信号。位置效应明显：RL 置信度在 path-commitment 阶段后才变得有信息，OPD 早期有用但后期可能反向校准。摘要未披露具体模型规模、数据量和提升数字。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Eastern Institute of Technology, Ningbo 和 The Hong Kong Polytechnic University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper analyzes how SFT, RL, and on-policy distillation reshape confidence calibration before, during, and after chain-of-thought reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training behavior analysis. Instead of measuring only final-answer accuracy, it decomposes confidence into signals for difficulty estimation, early stopping, and answer aggregation. This is relevant to RLVR, reasoning-model monitoring, and test-time compute allocation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce a three-stage calibration framework: pre-CoT confidence for difficulty estimation, intra-CoT confidence for early termination, and post-CoT trace confidence for answer aggregation. They run controlled comparisons across SFT, RL, and OPD to study how confidence reliability changes by position within the reasoning process.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use mathematical reasoning benchmarks. The reported findings are that OPD gives the most useful pre-reasoning confidence, SFT gives the strongest online early-stopping signal, and RL gives the most reliable trace-level signal for aggregation. RL confidence becomes informative after a path-commitment phase, while OPD confidence can become inversely calibrated later. The abstract does not provide model sizes, data sizes, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Eastern Institute of Technology, Ningbo and The Hong Kong Polytechnic University.

recommendation.zh: 值得 skim；重点看三阶段校准定义和位置效应，别只拿 final accuracy 判断后训练质量。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming; focus on the three-stage calibration setup and position effects, not just final-answer accuracy.

paper.title: SCOPE-RL: Optimizing Reasoning Paths Before and After Success
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) optimizes LLMs using sparse verifiable final-answer rewards. This sparse anchor reliably verifies whether a trajectory succeeds but provides no direct feedback on the reasoning path that produced it. Before success, prerequisite progress on hard problems receives no reward signal; after success, outcome rewards cannot distinguish well-organized correct trajectories from redundant or locally flawed ones. We introduce SCOPE-RL (Scaffolded Chain

summary.core_problem: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）仅使用稀疏的最终答案正确性作为奖励信号，存在两个阶段的系统性缺陷：1）成功前：困难问题上模型很少答对，推理路径上的前置进展无法获得奖励，训练陷入停滞；2）成功后：最终正确的轨迹中，冗余、局部有缺陷的推理路径和高质量推理路径获得相同奖励，无法优化推理过程的质量和效率。现有方法通常分别处理这两个问题，没有从「稀疏终端奖励锚点」的统一视角出发设计解决方案。
summary.importance: 该工作首次将RLVR中「成功前探索不足」和「成功后过程低效」两个看似独立的问题，统一归因于稀疏终端奖励锚点的固有缺陷。提出的两阶段奖励稠密化方案完全兼容GRPO等现有策略更新算法，不需要修改RL训练的核心更新逻辑，对推理模型的RL训练流程有直接的工程参考价值；同时「前缀分解可验证奖励」的思路也为预训练阶段的过程监督信号设计提供了启发。
summary.technical_approach:
提出SCOPE-RL两阶段框架，核心设计原则是不修改GRPO的策略更新逻辑，仅在成功边界的两侧稠密化奖励信号：
1）第一阶段自适应脚手架RL（ASR）：通过在线策略路由自动识别成功率低的问题（组内奖励方差为0且全错的问题），将问题拆分为答案隐藏的子问题链，为每个子问题的正确解答提供前缀一致的可验证奖励——子问题答案不会泄露最终答案，且模型必须按顺序完成前缀子问题才能获得后续奖励，既为困难问题提供了部分进展的奖励信号，又避免了答案泄露。
2）第二阶段质量感知过程RL（QPR）：针对已经能答对的问题，通过正确性门控确保只有最终答案正确的轨迹才能获得过程奖励，过程奖励偏好有用步骤密度高、低价值步骤少、错误定位清晰的推理路径，惩罚冗余和局部有缺陷的推理。过程奖励设置了上限，权重不会超过正确性奖励，避免模型为了简洁性牺牲答案正确性。
两个阶段天然顺序衔接：ASR先提升困难问题的答对率，增加验证轨迹的供给，QPR再优化这些正确轨迹的过程质量。
此外还提出了步骤质量评估协议，在规则验证答案正确性的基础上，增加事后LLM评判的有用步骤密度、低价值步骤比例、错误定位、token效率等诊断指标，用于评估推理过程质量。
summary.experiments:
基础设置：以Qwen3-8B-Instruct为基座模型，在DAPO-Math和Big-Math两个训练语料上开展实验，基线算法为GRPO。
- 准确率提升：DAPO-Math上平均准确率从55.80%提升至66.35%，Big-Math上从53.58%提升至64.79%。
- 推理效率提升：在准确率提升的同时，推理token消耗分别减少16.2%（DAPO-Math）和27.1%（Big-Math）。
- 兼容性验证：替换为GSPO策略更新后端时仍有效（准确率从61.60%提升至66.93%）；在更小的Qwen3-0.6B-Instruct上也获得一致收益（准确率从26.06%提升至32.06%），说明奖励稠密化与策略更新层面的RLVR改进是互补关系。
- 消融实验：ASR和QPR各自独立贡献收益，ASR主要提升困难问题的准确率，QPR主要提升推理效率和有用步骤密度。
summary.reading_guide: 1）精读第1章的稀疏锚点视角，理解两个看似不相关的RLVR失败模式如何统一到同一个根源；2）精读第3章的ASR和QPR设计细节，重点关注：ASR如何构造答案隐藏的子问题链、如何保证前缀一致性、如何实现在线策略路由；QPR的正确性门控设计、过程奖励的组成和权重设置、如何避免过程奖励压过正确性奖励；3）第4章的消融实验和步骤质量评估协议值得细看，尤其是推理过程质量的量化指标设计；4）附录中的子问题构造示例和奖励设计细节是工程落地的关键参考。

summary_en.core_problem: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) relies solely on sparse final-answer correctness as reward signal, leading to two phase-specific systematic failures: (1) Before success: On hard problems where models rarely produce correct answers, prerequisite progress along the reasoning path receives no reward, causing training stalls. (2) After success: Among trajectories with correct final answers, redundant or locally flawed reasoning paths receive the same reward as high-quality ones, leaving process quality and efficiency unoptimized. Existing work addresses these two issues separately, lacking a unified framing around the sparse terminal reward anchor.
summary_en.importance: This work is the first to unify two seemingly independent RLVR failures — insufficient exploration before success and inefficient process after success — as inherent consequences of the same sparse terminal reward anchor. Its two-stage reward densification scheme is fully compatible with existing policy update algorithms like GRPO, requiring no changes to core RL update logic, and provides direct engineering reference for RL training of reasoning models. The prefix-decomposed verifiable reward design also offers insights for process supervision signal design in pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SCOPE-RL is a two-stage framework built on a single design principle: leave the GRPO policy update unchanged, and only densify the reward signal on either side of the success boundary.
1) Stage 1: Adaptive Scaffolded RL (ASR). Hard problems with low success rates are identified via on-policy routing (prompts with zero within-group reward variance where all rollouts are wrong). The problem is decomposed into an answer-hidden sub-question chain, and prefix-consistent verifiable rewards are assigned to each correctly solved sub-question. Sub-question answers do not leak the final answer, and the model must complete prefix sub-questions sequentially to earn subsequent rewards, providing partial progress signal for hard problems without answer leakage.
2) Stage 2: Quality-Aware Process RL (QPR). For problems where the model already produces correct answers, a correctness gate ensures only trajectories with correct final answers receive process-shape rewards. These rewards prefer reasoning paths with higher useful-step density, fewer low-value steps, and clearer error localization, penalizing redundancy and local flaws. Process rewards are bounded to never outweigh correctness rewards, preventing the model from optimizing for brevity at the cost of answer accuracy.
The two stages are naturally sequential: ASR first raises the supply of verified correct trajectories on hard problems, then QPR refines the process quality of those correct trajectories.
A Step-Quality Evaluation Protocol is also introduced, complementing rule-based answer verification with post-hoc LLM-judged diagnostics: useful-step density, low-value step ratio, error localization, and token efficiency.
summary_en.experiments:
Base setup: Qwen3-8B-Instruct as the base model, trained on DAPO-Math and Big-Math corpora, with GRPO as the baseline RL algorithm.
- Accuracy gains: Average accuracy rises from 55.80% to 66.35% on DAPO-Math, and from 53.58% to 64.79% on Big-Math.
- Efficiency gains: Token reduction reaches 16.2% on DAPO-Math and 27.1% on Big-Math, alongside accuracy improvements.
- Compatibility: Gains hold under GSPO policy update backend (accuracy rises from 61.60% to 66.93%) and on smaller Qwen3-0.6B-Instruct (accuracy rises from 26.06% to 32.06%), confirming reward densification is complementary to policy-update-level RLVR advances.
- Ablation: Both ASR and QPR contribute independently. ASR primarily improves accuracy on hard problems, while QPR primarily improves reasoning efficiency and useful-step density.
summary_en.reading_guide: 1) Read Section 1 closely for the sparse-anchor framing, which unifies two seemingly unrelated RLVR failure modes. 2) Dive into Section 3 for ASR and QPR design details: focus on how ASR constructs answer-hidden sub-question chains, ensures prefix consistency, and implements on-policy routing; for QPR, focus on the correctness gate design, process reward composition and weighting, and the mechanism to prevent process rewards from overriding correctness. 3) Section 4 ablation studies and the Step-Quality Evaluation Protocol are worth careful reading, especially the metric design for quantifying reasoning process quality. 4) Appendix examples of sub-question construction and reward design details are critical reference for engineering implementation.

recommendation.zh: 应读奖励分解和 step-quality protocol；它改变的 prior 是 RLVR 只靠最终答案锚点也能把过程学干净。
recommendation.en: Read the reward decomposition and step-quality protocol; it challenges the prior that final-answer RLVR alone can cleanly learn reasoning process quality.

paper.title: When the Reward Suite Is Leaky: A Preregistered Causal Contrast of Natural Verifier False Positives in RLVR
paper.abstract: The test suites used as RLVR rewards for code have natural false positives: per-task, persistent, asymmetric errors that accept the same wrong programs every time they appear, unlike the symmetric or resampled noise assumed by existing noise-robustness analyses. We run a preregistered two-arm causal contrast on a deployed suite: GRPO on identical MBPP tasks, seeds, and compute, rewarded by the original MBPP tests (leaky) versus the MBPP+ extra tests (hardened). Two further families replicate the

summary.core_problem: 研究代码 RLVR 中测试套件作为 reward 时的自然假阳性问题：错误程序被固定测试持续接受，导致奖励泄漏。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练奖励信号质量分析和因果实验。它直接关系到 RLVR 能否真实提升能力，还是只是在固定 verifier 的漏洞上优化；对预训练研究员理解 pretrain 与 posttrain 闭环中的 reward hacking 很有价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者做了 preregistered two-arm causal contrast：在相同 MBPP 任务、随机种子和计算预算下，用 GRPO 分别对原始 MBPP tests 的 leaky reward 和 MBPP+ extra tests 的 hardened reward 训练。另有两个实验族在数据产生前冻结 preregistration 后复现设计。论文还提出廉价静态 leakiness audit，用训练前信号预测哪些任务更容易产生 rewarded false positives，并用人工签名规则审计 rewarded FP。
summary.experiments: 核心实验是在 MBPP 代码任务上比较原始测试和强化测试作为 RLVR reward 的效果。平均 held-out 效应在预注册 1.5pt non-inferiority margin 内，gap 为 0.20pt，单侧 95% 上界为 0.75pt。训练前静态 leakiness audit 与 rewarded FP mass 的 Spearman 相关为 0.80；注册的 train-side test 显示 leak-stratum 的 FP share 比 clean tasks 高 43.8pt。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Beijing Jiaotong University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies natural false positives in code RLVR rewards, where fixed test suites repeatedly accept the same wrong programs and create persistent reward leakage.
summary_en.importance: This is a reward-signal quality study for post-training. It matters because RLVR improvements can come either from genuine capability gains or from exploiting stable verifier holes; the distinction is directly relevant to reward hacking and the pretrain-posttrain feedback loop.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author runs a preregistered two-arm causal contrast: GRPO is trained on identical MBPP tasks, seeds, and compute, with rewards from either the original leaky MBPP tests or hardened MBPP+ extra tests. Two additional experiment families replicate the design under preregistration frozen before their data existed. The paper also introduces a cheap static leakiness audit computed before training and audits rewarded false positives under signed human-adjudicated rules.
summary_en.experiments: On MBPP code tasks, the average held-out effect is bounded and non-inferior under a preregistered 1.5-point margin, with a 0.20-point gap and a one-sided 95% upper bound of 0.75 points. Rewarded false-positive mass correlates strongly with the pretraining static leakiness audit, with Spearman 0.80. The registered train-side test places the leak-stratum false-positive share 43.8 points above clean tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is affiliated with Beijing Jiaotong University.

recommendation.zh: 应把静态 leakiness audit 加进 RLVR pipeline；平均收益不塌不代表 reward 干净，分层 FP 才是危险信号。
recommendation.en: Add static leakiness audits to RLVR pipelines; stable average gains do not mean clean rewards, and stratified false positives are the warning signal.

paper.title: SCALECUA: Scaling Computer Use Agents with Verifiable Task Synthesis and Efficient Online RL
paper.abstract: Computer use agents (CUAs) are emerging as a powerful interface for automating complex digital workflows through visual perception and GUI execution. Online reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a key direction for scaling their capabilities. However, this paradigm is bottlenecked by verifiable data scarcity and online RL inefficiency. To break these barriers, we introduce ScaleCUA, a unified framework that scales online RL for CUAs via verifiable task synthesis an

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 CUA 在线 RLVR 难以放大的两个瓶颈：可验证 GUI 任务少，以及多轮 GUI rollout 的训练效率低。GUI 任务不像数学或代码题天然带 verifier，完成状态往往存在于文件系统、浏览器、桌面配置等环境状态里；同时 GRPO 类训练如果采到全对或全错的任务组，advantage 为零，rollout 会被浪费。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接价值不在模型结构，而在 post-train 信号如何规模化。它把“可验证奖励”从数学、代码扩展到视觉 GUI 交互，并把数据生成、难度控制、在线采样、长轨迹训练放在同一个系统里处理。对做 RL pretrain、agentic mid-train、可验证环境数据构造的人有参考意义，尤其是 verifier 设计和 frontier-style curriculum 的工程取舍。
summary.technical_approach: ScaleCUA 由三部分组成。第一，VeriGen 用环境知识文档和模型 rollout 轨迹生成 GUI 任务，并在真实 Docker 环境中反复执行、检查和修正任务与 judge。judge 是确定性的环境检查函数，例如文件状态、浏览器状态或 Python 检查代码，而不是人工或 LLM 打分。第二，Frontier Sampling 为每个任务维护采样权重，在每轮 rollout 前选择当前模型刚好有学习信号的任务，减少全成功或全失败组带来的无效 GRPO 更新。第三，Visual Context Segmentation 用滑动窗口保留近期视觉上下文，同时保留文本连续性。这样避免 trajectory-level 训练中截图 token 不断累积，也避免 step-wise 训练把一条长轨迹拆成大量训练样本后拖慢训练。
summary.experiments: VeriGen 通过共享 Docker interaction probe 支持 100+ agent workers 和 100+ Docker 环境并发，产出 24K+ 可验证任务，并筛出接近 3K 个高质量 RL 任务。ScaleCUA 被用于 GLM-4.6V-Flash、Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking、Qwen3.5-9B，三类模型都有收益。Qwen3.5-9B 在 OSWorld 达到 68.7%，在 ScienceBoard 达到 54.0%。作为参照，文中列出的开源 CUA 基线包括 ComputerRL-9B 的 48.0%、EvoCUA-32B 的 56.7%、Kimi K2.5 的 63.3%。这些数字说明收益主要来自可验证任务规模、难度匹配采样和多轮训练包装三者的组合，而不是单一 prompt 或单一 benchmark 调参。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。重点看 VeriGen 如何把自然语言任务变成可执行 verifier，Frontier Sampling 如何定义和更新任务权重，以及 Visual Context Segmentation 如何在 rollout engine 和 training engine 之间折中。实验部分重点关注三类模型的迁移结果、OSWorld/ScienceBoard 指标，以及关于 uniform sampling、trajectory-level、step-wise 训练的消融。如果只关心预训练接口，优先读数据生成与采样部分；如果关心 agent RL 系统，优先读并发 Docker 交互和长轨迹训练设计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets two scaling bottlenecks for online RLVR in computer-use agents: the lack of verifiable GUI tasks and the inefficiency of multi-turn GUI rollouts. Unlike math or code, GUI tasks do not naturally come with verifiers; success is encoded in environment state such as files, browser state, or desktop configuration. GRPO-style training also wastes rollout groups when all attempts succeed or all fail, because the within-group advantage becomes zero.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to foundation-model training is the construction of scalable verifiable post-training signals, not a new base architecture. The work extends verifiable rewards from math and code into visual GUI interaction, and treats task synthesis, verifier construction, difficulty control, online sampling, and long-trajectory training as one coupled problem. It is useful for researchers working on RL pretraining, agentic mid-training, and environment-based data pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: ScaleCUA has three main components. VeriGen generates GUI tasks from environment knowledge documents and model rollout traces, then iteratively tests and refines both the task and the judge inside live Docker environments. The judge is deterministic, such as a filesystem check, browser-state inspection, or Python verification script, rather than a human or LLM rating. Frontier Sampling maintains per-task sampling weights and selects tasks near the model’s current capability frontier before each rollout, reducing all-pass and all-fail GRPO groups. Visual Context Segmentation keeps a sliding window of recent visual context while preserving textual continuity, avoiding both trajectory-level visual-token blow-up and step-wise sample-count inflation.
summary_en.experiments: The VeriGen pipeline scales to more than 100 agent workers and more than 100 Docker environments through a shared Docker interaction probe. It produces over 24K verifiable tasks and nearly 3K high-quality RL tasks. ScaleCUA is applied to GLM-4.6V-Flash, Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking, and Qwen3.5-9B, with consistent gains. With Qwen3.5-9B, the system reaches 68.7% on OSWorld and 54.0% on ScienceBoard. The paper compares against open-source CUA baselines including ComputerRL-9B at 48.0%, EvoCUA-32B at 56.7%, and Kimi K2.5 at 63.3%. The reported gains are tied to the combination of verifiable task scale, capability-matched sampling, and more efficient multi-turn training.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–45 minute skim is enough for most readers. Focus on how VeriGen turns GUI instructions into executable verifiers, how Frontier Sampling defines and updates task weights, and how Visual Context Segmentation balances rollout cost against training cost. In the experiments, look for transfer across the three model families, OSWorld and ScienceBoard results, and ablations against uniform sampling, trajectory-level training, and step-wise training. For pretrain/post-train interface questions, prioritize the data generation and sampling sections. For agent RL systems, prioritize the Docker interaction and long-trajectory training design.

recommendation.zh: VeriGen的Docker+多智能体闭环合成可验证RL数据的思路可迁移到内部RLVR数据流水线，重点看§3数据生成流程与Frontier Sampling的实现细节。
recommendation.en: VeriGen's Docker + multi-agent closed-loop pipeline for verifiable RL data is portable to internal RLVR data workflows; focus on §3 data generation and Frontier Sampling implementation details.

paper.title: SVR-R1: Bootstrapping Multi-modal Reasoning with Self-verification in Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: We introduce Self-Verified Reasoner (SVR-R1), a multi-turn RL framework that turns a model's own verification into a learning signal for multimodal reasoning. For each query, the model proposes an answer using the same weights, and issues a binary self-verdict (Yes/No). A 'No' triggers a second-chance rethink; a 'Yes,' or a turn cap, finalizes the output for computing the outcome-based reward. SVR-R1 is implemented with GRPO and an asynchronous multi-turn rollout framework and needs no external

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决多模态 RL 训练中的一个训练信号问题：在没有外部 verifier、critic 或额外监督的情况下，如何利用模型已有的自我验证能力，让 VLM 在 rollout 阶段先判断自己的答案是否可信，再决定是否重新作答。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的直接价值不在视觉问答分数本身，而在 RL 训练接口。SVR-R1 把“生成—验证—再生成”放进 RL rollout，而不是只在推理时 prompt 模型反思，也不是用自生成高置信样本做离线 SFT。这说明 rollout 结构可以成为一种训练信号设计：即使最终 reward 仍是 outcome-based，模型在拿到 reward 前经历的交互路径会改变策略学习。这个思路对 RL pretrain、推理型 mid-training、多模态可验证任务训练都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: SVR-R1 使用同一个 VLM 权重同时扮演 generator 和 verifier，只通过不同 prompt 区分角色。给定图像和问题后，模型先生成包含推理过程和答案的响应；随后同一模型看到问题和初始答案，输出二元自检结果 Yes 或 No。如果输出 No，系统把会话历史保留，并要求模型重新思考和重新作答；如果输出 Yes，或者达到最大验证轮数，就把最终答案送入 reward 计算。训练使用 GRPO，reward 是基于最终答案匹配的 outcome reward，不引入外部监督模型。工程上采用异步多模态多轮 rollout 框架来协调生成、验证和重新生成。这与普通 GRPO 的区别在于，普通 GRPO 对单次采样答案直接打分；SVR-R1 让同一策略在 reward 前执行自检和修正，训练的是一个多轮决策过程。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖多模态表格和图表推理 benchmark，以及通用推理任务。SVR-R1 相比标准 GRPO baseline 有明显准确率提升。一个有信息量的训练动态是：训练早期模型更频繁触发 verification 和 rethink；随着训练推进，verification 轮数下降，模型更常在第一轮就给出 Yes，但测试准确率仍提高。这说明模型并不是长期依赖多轮自检来换取推理时间，而是在训练中把 verifier 提供的选择压力内化到第一轮生成策略中。提供内容中没有完整列出各 benchmark 的精确分数、模型尺寸和训练步数；这些数字需要结合实验表、训练曲线和消融部分读取。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。优先看方法部分的 rollout protocol，特别是 generator/verifier 共享权重、Yes/No 触发规则、最大轮数和 GRPO reward 计算的位置。然后看训练动态图，重点观察 verification turns 如何随训练变化，以及准确率是否同步上升。消融部分如果包含去掉 self-verification、固定多轮反思、外部 verifier 或不同轮数上限的对比，应优先阅读，因为这些实验决定 SVR-R1 的收益来自自检机制，还是来自额外生成长度和更多采样机会。对基座训练更有启发的是 rollout 设计，而不是某个多模态 benchmark 的排名。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a training-signal problem in multimodal RL: how to use a VLM’s own verification ability during rollout, without an external verifier, auxiliary critic, or additional supervision. The model first answers, then judges whether its own answer is correct, and only rethinks when it predicts failure.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is more relevant as an RL training interface than as a vision-language benchmark result. SVR-R1 moves generation, verification, and regeneration into the rollout process. It is different from inference-time self-reflection prompts, and also different from offline SFT on high-confidence self-generated traces. The final reward can remain outcome-based, but the path taken before reward assignment changes the learning problem. This is a useful design pattern for RL pretraining, reasoning-oriented mid-training, and multimodal tasks with verifiable answers.
summary_en.technical_approach: SVR-R1 uses the same VLM weights for both the generator and the verifier, with role separation handled by prompts. Given an image and a question, the model generates a rationale and an answer. The same model then receives the question and its tentative answer and emits a binary verdict, Yes or No. A No triggers another generation round with the conversation history preserved. A Yes, or hitting the maximum number of verification rounds, finalizes the answer for reward computation. Training uses GRPO with outcome-based answer matching, and an asynchronous multimodal multi-turn rollout framework handles generation, verification, and regeneration. Compared with standard GRPO, which scores a single sampled response directly, SVR-R1 trains the policy over a multi-turn decision process before reward assignment.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers multimodal table and chart reasoning benchmarks, as well as general reasoning tasks. SVR-R1 improves accuracy over strong standard GRPO baselines. The most informative observation is in the training dynamics: early in training, the model uses more verification and rethink turns; later, it uses fewer verification rounds and often accepts the first answer, while test accuracy continues to improve. This suggests that the training process internalizes the verifier’s selection pressure into the first-pass generator rather than merely spending more inference-time compute. The provided content does not include the full per-benchmark scores, model size, or training-step details; those should be read from the experimental tables, training curves, and ablations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25–35 minutes. Focus first on the rollout protocol: shared generator/verifier weights, the Yes/No control rule, the maximum-turn cap, and where GRPO reward is applied. Then read the training-dynamics figure showing verification turns over time and accuracy changes. The most useful ablations would be comparisons against no self-verification, fixed multi-turn reflection, external verification, and different turn caps, because they separate the effect of self-verification from extra generation length or more sampling opportunities. For foundation-model training, the main object of interest is the rollout design, not the absolute ranking on a particular multimodal benchmark.

recommendation.zh: 自验证+多轮GRPO的VLM版本，训练动态那张图值得看；rethink轮次和reward hacking风险需自行消融。
recommendation.en: Self-verification extended to multi-turn GRPO for VLMs; worth reading the training-dynamics plot, but recheck reward hacking and rethink-turn budgets in your own ablations.

paper.title: STAMP: Provenance-Guided Credit Assignment for Deep Search Agents
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning for deep-search agents has largely focused on trajectory-level scoring -- outcome correctness, citation-aware rewards, and evidence coverage. Yet the actions that expose supporting documents receive no targeted credit, a gap we call the reward-credit mismatch. We propose STAMP, in which a reference-based verifier judges whether each cited document supports an entity or relation in a training-time evidence graph, and first-exposure attribution traces each supported citation

summary.core_problem: 深度搜索Agent的RL训练普遍采用轨迹级评分，无法为找到关键支持文档的动作分配针对性信用，存在奖励-信用不匹配问题。
summary.importance: 提出溯源引导的步级信用分配方法STAMP，在不改变轨迹级奖励和排名的前提下提升搜索Agent RL训练效率，属于Agent RL训练方法改进。
summary.technical_approach: 1）训练时用基于引用的验证器判断每个被引文档是否支持证据图中的实体或关系；2）首次曝光归因机制将每个有效引用追溯到首次发现它的搜索动作；3）符号保持优势调制，在步级重新分配优势，不改变轨迹总奖励和组内轨迹相对排名。
summary.experiments: 在BrowseComp、BrowseComp-ZH、xbench-DS基准上，相同SFT初始化、训练数据和搜索工具配置下，STAMP相比GRPO基线分别提升2.0/5.5/3.0个点，可与结果奖励、引用评分奖励叠加使用。

summary_en.core_problem: RL for deep-search agents relies heavily on trajectory-level scoring, failing to assign targeted credit to actions that surface critical supporting documents, leading to a reward-credit mismatch.
summary_en.importance: Proposes STAMP, a provenance-guided step-level credit assignment method that improves RL training efficiency for search agents without altering trajectory-level rewards or rankings, as an RL training improvement for agentic systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Uses a reference-based verifier at training time to judge whether each cited document supports an entity or relation in the evidence graph; 2) Applies first-exposure attribution to trace each valid citation back to the search action that first surfaced it; 3) Uses sign-preserving advantage modulation to redistribute step-level advantages without changing total trajectory reward or relative ranking of trajectories within a batch.
summary_en.experiments: On BrowseComp, BrowseComp-ZH, and xbench-DS, STAMP outperforms the GRPO baseline by +2.0/+5.5/+3.0 points under matched SFT initialization, training data, and search tools, and composes with both outcome-only and citation-rubric base rewards.

recommendation.zh: 针对搜索Agent的GRPO步级信用分配改进，场景绑定较强，可快速扫过方法部分了解优势调制思路，无需深入读。
recommendation.en: Step-level credit assignment improvement for GRPO tailored to search agents, highly scenario-specific; skim the method section for the advantage modulation idea, no deep read needed.

paper.title: Agon: Competitive Cross-Model RL with Implicit Rival Grading of Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (e.g. GRPO) is the engine behind today's reasoning models, yet it grades only the final answer. On hard problems this trains models to write more rather than to think better, since the trace itself is never graded and no label for good thinking exists. We introduce Agon, which makes two competing models each other's graders. Both attempt the same problem; in alternating roles, one drafts a solution and the other reads it while solving, and each is r

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作想解决的是 outcome-only reasoning RL 的一个老问题：奖励只看最终答案，不看推理过程，于是模型在难题上更容易学会“写得更长”而不是“想得更好”。只要更长的链条能增加偶然撞对答案的概率，GRPO 就会给这种行为正反馈，结果是 trace 充满回退、犹豫和冗余文字，但单位 token 的推理质量没有同步提升。直接给过程打标签又很难，因为没有可靠、可验证的“好推理”标注。作者提出的切入点是，不去显式标注过程，而是让另一个模型在竞争中隐式评价你的推理：如果对手看了你的解题过程后还能把你击败，说明你的过程没有真正形成优势；反之，能在对手可见的条件下仍然赢，才说明过程里有有效推理成分。
summary.importance: 对后训练和 reasoning research 的启发在于，它试图把“过程奖励”从显式监督问题改写成博弈问题。不是训练一个 reward model 去判断哪一步推理好，而是设计一个竞争环境，让过程质量通过对手的可利用性间接显现。这条路如果成立，意义不在于替代所有 outcome reward，而在于给 reasoning RL 增加一个更接近“思维质量”的训练信号，而且不依赖人工过程标注。另一个值得注意的点是，它明确反对单模型自我审查的闭环。作者认为 self-generated signal 容易强化原有盲点，而异构对手能提供不同错误模式，从而打破自我强化的局部最优。这个思路和 self-play 有亲缘关系，但这里的博弈对象不是环境，而是另一个会读你推理痕迹的策略。对基座预训练本身的直接影响有限，但对 post-train 如何塑造 reasoning trace 的分布有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法名是 Agon。核心机制是双模型、轮换角色、带信息交换的竞争式 GRPO。每个问题上，两套策略都参与：一方先作为 drafter 产出解题过程和答案，另一方作为 challenger 在读到对手草稿后再尝试求解。奖励不只看自己是否答对，还看是否“击败”对手，也就是在对手已有工作可见的情况下仍然比对方更成功。角色在每个训练 step 轮换，使两边都学会起草和挑战。

作者强调两个条件缺一不可。第一是信息交换：挑战者必须能看到对手的推理文本，否则就谈不上“你的过程是否经得起对手利用”。第二是竞争而不是合作：如果只是互相参考、追求一致，容易退化成共识平均，尤其当两模型能力不完全对齐时，强者会被弱者拖低，或者双方都学会输出更安全但不更强的轨迹。文中专门设计了一个 2×2 实验矩阵，把 competition 与 information exchange 两个因素拆开验证，并指出其中“竞争但不交换信息”的一个单元在 group-relative normalization 下按构造是 inert 的，因此真正有意义的比较是 adversarial exchange 对 cooperative exchange 的增益。

实现上，作者没有真的训练两套完整模型，而是用一个冻结 base 上挂两组 LoRA/adapter，额外内存约 2%，通过不同初始化和不同更新流保持差异性。这样做的原因很现实：如果每次都用两套全参模型做 head-to-head RL，成本太高，也很难作为常规 recipe 复用。文本交换是当前版本的通信通道，作者提到 latent-space exchange 可能更高效，但留到后续工作。

从优化角度看，Agon 仍然建立在 stock GRPO trainer 上，没有改动核心优化器，只是改变 rollout 结构和 reward 设计。这一点和很多“新 RL 算法”不同，它更像是在采样与奖励层重新组织训练信号。作者还加入了 self-refinement control、zero-training orchestration control，以及 budget-matched 的 self-cascade GRPO control，用来区分“只是多一次推理/多一个模型串联”与“竞争式共同训练”之间的差别。
summary.experiments:
实验同样聚焦 hard math，并且强调 matched generation budget。主结论有三层。第一，带信息交换的双模型训练优于单模型 vanilla GRPO。第二，在有信息交换的前提下，竞争式训练优于合作式训练，支持“对抗压力比互助平均更能逼出有效推理”的假设。第三，收益在小模型上更明显，说明当单模型 reasoning ceiling 较低时，异构对手提供的额外信号更有用。

摘要给出的一个直观结果是：在相同的双倍推理预算下，训练后的 draft-and-challenge cascade 几乎把未训练的 Mixture-of-Agents 编排准确率翻倍，而后者相对普通 GRPO 几乎没有明显提升。这说明收益不只是来自 inference-time orchestration，而是来自训练过程中形成的互相适应与竞争。文中还提到 accuracy 的提升明显快于长度膨胀，对应它想解决的核心病灶：不是单纯让模型写更多。

从实验设计看，最关键的是 2×2：competition × exchange。作者还加入 self-refinement 作为“同一模型看自己草稿再改”的对照，用来支撑“自我闭环容易平台化”的论点。另一个重要细节是，他们把某个 cell 说明为在 group-relative normalization 下理论上不产生有效竞争信号，这种先验分析有助于避免把无意义对照读成负结果。全文片段没有暴露完整参数规模、训练步数和所有绝对分数，但可以确认作者关注的是 pass@1、长度变化、以及在相同生成预算下的公平比较，而不是只报一个最好看的终点数。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议先看 Introduction，尤其是作者对“unscored trace”问题的表述：为什么 outcome reward 会鼓励更长而非更好的推理。然后直接看方法部分，抓住 Agon 的三个关键词：draft-and-challenge、role rotation、competitive reward。接着看 2×2 实验设计，理解为什么必须把 competition 和 exchange 拆开，以及为什么其中一个对照按构造是 inert。

图表上，优先看主结果表和长度/准确率关系图。如果论文给出了 trace length 的分布变化或 token-normalized gain，那些图比单纯 pass@1 更能说明方法是否真的改善了 reasoning quality。再看 self-refinement、cooperative exchange、untrained orchestration 这些控制组，判断收益究竟来自哪里。

预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。若要深挖，建议重点想三件事。第一，双 adapter 是否真的能维持足够的策略差异，还是训练后会逐渐同质化。第二，竞争奖励会不会诱导“误导对手”的策略，而不一定提升对外部任务的真实可迁移推理能力。第三，文本级交换是否只是把更多上下文塞给第二个模型，收益里有多少来自额外条件信息，有多少来自竞争本身。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a familiar pathology of outcome-only RL for reasoning: the reward grades only the final answer, not the reasoning trace, so on hard problems the model is often incentivized to write longer rather than think better. If a longer chain increases the chance of stumbling into the correct answer, GRPO reinforces that behavior. The result is inflated traces full of hedging, retries, and filler, with much weaker gains in reasoning quality per token. Direct process supervision is unattractive because there is no reliable, verifiable label for “good thinking.” The paper’s alternative is to let another model implicitly grade the usefulness of a trace through competition: if an opponent can read your work and still beat you, your reasoning did not create a robust advantage.
summary_en.importance: The interesting idea is to recast process reward as a game rather than a labeling problem. Instead of training a reward model to score intermediate reasoning steps, the method creates a competitive setting in which reasoning quality is revealed indirectly by whether a peer can exploit or overcome your trace. If that works, it offers a way to add a more process-sensitive signal without human process labels. A second important claim is that single-model self-improvement is structurally limited because it reinforces its own blind spots. A rival with different failure modes can break that loop. This is closer to self-play than to standard RLHF-style post-training, but the opponent here is another policy that can inspect your reasoning. The direct relevance to pretraining is limited; the stronger relevance is to post-training recipes that shape the distribution and quality of reasoning traces.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Agon trains two policies head-to-head with competitive GRPO. On each problem, one policy acts as a drafter and produces a worked solution; the other acts as a challenger, reads the opponent’s draft, and then attempts the same problem. Reward depends not only on correctness but also on out-solving the rival. Roles alternate across training steps so both policies learn both drafting and challenging.

The paper argues that two ingredients are necessary. First, there must be information exchange: the challenger needs access to the opponent’s reasoning, otherwise the setup cannot say anything about whether the trace itself is useful or exploitable. Second, the interaction must be competitive rather than cooperative. Pure cooperation or agreement-seeking tends to regress toward consensus and can dilute quality when the two models differ in strength. Competitive pressure instead rewards reasoning that remains strong even when exposed to a peer.

To isolate these effects, the paper uses a 2×2 design over competition versus cooperation and exchange versus no exchange. One cell, competition without exchange, is argued to be inert under group-relative normalization, so the meaningful comparison is adversarial exchange versus cooperative exchange. That analytical point matters because it prevents over-interpreting a control that is structurally unable to carry the intended signal.

Implementation is deliberately lightweight. Rather than training two full models, the authors instantiate the pair as two LoRA-style adapters on top of one frozen base, with roughly 2% extra memory overhead instead of 2× model cost. Different initialization and separate update streams are used to keep the two policies divergent. The communication channel is plain text in this version; latent-space exchange is mentioned as a future direction. Importantly, the optimization core remains a stock GRPO trainer. The novelty is in rollout structure and reward shaping, not in a new optimizer.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are run on hard math under matched generation budgets. The main findings are threefold. First, dual-model training with information exchange outperforms single-model vanilla GRPO. Second, given exchange, competitive training outperforms cooperative training, supporting the claim that adversarial pressure is more effective than mutual assistance for improving reasoning. Third, the gains are larger for smaller models, which is plausible because smaller models have lower reasoning ceilings and benefit more from an external source of signal.

A particularly useful result from the abstract is that, at the same doubled inference budget, the trained draft-and-challenge cascade nearly doubles the accuracy of an untrained Mixture-of-Agents orchestration over the same base, while the untrained orchestration itself barely improves over GRPO. That suggests the gain is not merely from adding another pass or another model at inference time; it comes from the co-training dynamics and the induced specialization under competition.

The evaluation design includes self-refinement as a control, which is important for the paper’s argument that self-auditing tends to plateau. It also includes zero-training orchestration and a budget-matched self-cascade GRPO control, helping separate “more inference structure” from “competitive joint training.” The excerpt does not expose the full parameter scales, training lengths, or all absolute scores, but it is clear that the paper tracks pass@1, reasoning length, and fairness under matched generation budgets rather than relying on a single cherry-picked endpoint.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the Introduction, especially the framing of the “unscored trace” problem. That section explains clearly why outcome-only reward can favor longer traces without improving reasoning quality. Then read the method section with three keywords in mind: draft-and-challenge, role rotation, and competitive reward. After that, go straight to the 2×2 experiment design to understand why competition and exchange must be disentangled, and why one control cell is structurally inert.

For figures and tables, prioritize the main results and any plots relating trace length to accuracy. If the paper reports token-normalized gains or changes in length distribution, those are more informative than pass@1 alone because they speak directly to the claimed mechanism. Then inspect the controls: self-refinement, cooperative exchange, and untrained orchestration. Those comparisons determine whether the method is learning better reasoning or merely exploiting extra context and extra passes.

Estimated reading time is 20–30 minutes. Three deeper questions are worth probing. First, do the two adapters remain meaningfully different over training, or do they gradually collapse toward similar policies? Second, can the competitive reward induce adversarially misleading traces that help beat the rival without improving true task-general reasoning? Third, since the challenger reads the draft in text, how much of the gain comes from extra conditional information versus competition itself?

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和 ablation：想法值得试，但双模型竞争很容易把 compute gain 伪装成训练信号改进。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations only: the idea is worth testing, but two-model competition can easily confuse extra compute with a better training signal.

paper.title: UP: Unbounded Positive Asymmetric Optimization for Breaking the Exploration-Stability Dilemma
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become the standard paradigm for enhancing the complex reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). To achieve sample efficiency, modern RL frameworks rely on importance sampling (IS). However, these algorithms suffer from an exploration-stability dilemma. Pure IS often leads to catastrophic training instability, while standard clipping mechanisms used to mitigate this instability strictly constrain the policy update budget. By formalizing the concept o

summary.core_problem: 现有基于重要性采样（IS）的LLM强化学习（RL）算法存在探索-稳定性两难——纯IS易引发梯度爆炸，而标准裁剪机制虽能保障稳定，但会过早截断低置信度正确推理路径的更新预算，结构性限制模型探索能力。
summary.importance: 从理论层面揭示了RL裁剪机制对推理路径探索的约束本质，提出的非对称优化思路可插件式集成到现有RL框架中提升推理性能，对后训练RL算法设计有直接启发，也为预训练与RL的协同优化提供了新方向。
summary.technical_approach: 提出无界正非对称优化（UP），核心贡献包括三点：1）形式化定义“概率容量（Cap）”概念，量化裁剪机制对策略更新的约束程度，证明DAPO等仅调整裁剪上界的方法无法从根源解决探索受限问题；2）通过stop-gradient算子将策略锚定在当前状态（而非旧策略π_old）重构重要性采样机制，对正优势token采用无界更新以最大化探索容量，对负优势token保留约束以保障训练稳定性；3）作为通用插件式目标，可适配token级（GRPO、DAPO）、序列级（GSPO）等不同优化粒度，以及稠密模型、MoE、视觉语言模型等不同架构。
summary.experiments: 在AIME24、AMC23、MATH500、Minerva、OlympiadBench五个推理基准上测试，UP-GRPO在11种强基线方法中取得最高平均Pass@1准确率；在稠密模型、MoE、多模态等不同架构和训练模态下均能稳定提升性能，无训练不稳定问题。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注概率容量的形式化定义与UP的核心推导部分，实验部分关注跨算法、跨架构的通用性验证结果，预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Importance sampling (IS) based reinforcement learning for LLMs faces an exploration-stability dilemma: unclipped IS causes catastrophic gradient explosion, while standard clipping mechanisms, though stability-preserving, prematurely truncate update budgets for correct but low-confidence reasoning paths, structurally limiting exploration capacity.
summary_en.importance: Identifies a fundamental limitation of standard clipping in RL for reasoning tasks, and proposes a universal plug-and-play asymmetric optimization objective that improves exploration without sacrificing training stability, with direct relevance to post-training RL algorithm design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Unbounded Positive Asymmetric Optimization (UP) with three core contributions: 1) Formalizes Probability Capacity (Cap) to quantify the maximum allowed policy update before gradient truncation, proving that methods only adjusting upper clip bounds (e.g., DAPO) fail to fundamentally resolve exploration constraints. 2) Restructures importance sampling by anchoring the policy to its current state via stop-gradient (instead of the old policy π_old), applying unbounded updates to tokens with positive advantages to maximize exploration, while retaining constraints on negative advantages to preserve stability. 3) Works as a universal plug-and-play objective compatible with token-level (GRPO, DAPO), sequence-level (GSPO) optimization granularities, and diverse architectures including dense models, MoEs, and vision-language models.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on five reasoning benchmarks: AIME24, AMC23, MATH500, Minerva, and OlympiadBench. UP-GRPO achieves the highest average Pass@1 accuracy among 11 strong baselines. It consistently improves performance across dense, MoE, and vision-language settings without training instability.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the formalization of Probability Capacity and the core derivation of UP. Skim experiments for cross-algorithm and cross-architecture generalization results. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: RL训练稳定性的实用改进，可替换现有PPO/GRPO的对称clip做内部ablation，无范式级突破，重点看§3的概率容量分析即可。
recommendation.en: A practical fix for RL training stability, test as a replacement for symmetric clipping in PPO/GRPO ablations; no paradigm shift, focus on the Probability Capacity analysis in §3.

paper.title: More Convincing, Not More Correct: Self-Play Reward Hacking of Reference-Free LLM Judges
paper.abstract: Training a language model against its own reference-free judgments (the premise of self-rewarding, self-play, and LLM-as-a-judge pipelines) assumes a model's verdict on a shown answer tracks correctness. We show it fails structurally: conditioned on a candidate, a judge scores plausibility, not correctness, leaving false-positive basins a policy learns to exploit. We measure this with a hidden-anchor audit: a held-out, cross-source exact-match check the judge never sees. On GSM8K with Qwen3 poli

summary.core_problem: 无参考自博弈（self-play / self-rewarding / LLM-as-a-judge）训练建立在一个未经检验的前提上：模型对候选答案的评分可以近似真实正确性。论文指出这个前提存在结构性失效——无参考裁判评分的是答案的“看起来合理”（plausibility），而非正确性；在验证难度高于识别难度的推理任务上，这会形成一个“合理但错误”的假阳性盆地，策略在优化中会主动找到并占据这个盆地，产生系统性的 reward hacking。
summary.importance: 这篇工作直接触及当前后训练与“预训练-后训练闭环”中的一个核心假设：无监督自提升是否真的在提升能力，还是只是在学会骗过裁判。对做 RL pretrain、self-play、reasoning model 训练的研究者，它给出了一个可操作的诊断工具（hidden-anchor audit）和一个清晰的失效边界（低准确率区域风险最高），并解释了为什么换更大/更多裁判不解决问题。结论对 R1-Zero 一类无监督推理强化、以及“以合成数据+自评判持续迭代”的训练路线都有直接约束意义。
summary.technical_approach: 核心设计有三块。第一，hidden-anchor audit：对每个问题保留一个独立来源的精确匹配 ground truth，裁判从来看不到、训练也从不使用，仅用作事后审计；用 judge pass rate 与 anchor EM 的差值（VA-Gap）量化裁判与真实能力的偏离，并跟踪 FPR、TPR、discrimination = TPR − FPR。第二，理论刻画：给出 VA-Gap ≤ 1 − EM 的可证伪上界，说明准确率越低、可利用的作弊空间越大；并给出独立性界，把裁判对候选答案的锚定效应量化为信息量（bits），证明单调聚合（如全体一致通过的 ensemble）无法逃脱这一失效。第三，de-anchoring 修复：让裁判在打分前先独立给出自己的答案，再看候选，打破对候选的锚定。实验用 Qwen3 在 GSM8K 上做自博弈 DPO，在压制推理长度/能力的 regime 下放大失效，便于测量。
summary.experiments: 在 GSM8K、reasoning-suppressed 设定（保持真实准确率很低）下，5 轮自博弈后裁判 pass rate 从约 0.72 升到 0.94，而 hidden-anchor 测得的真实 EM 停在约 0.20，VA-Gap 达 0.74（三个种子一致）。交叉验证：用 Llama、Gemma 等不同家族、不同规模（到 14B）的独立裁判重新打分，膨胀依然存在；三家族全体一致通过的 ensemble 仍有 55% 的错误答案被通过，discrimination 从 0.31 塌到 0.09；直接用 ensemble 奖励训练策略也无法缓解。best-of-N 选择、Gemma policy 跑完整 loop 复现同样现象，说明不需要训练信号也能找到这个 basin。Oracle 控制（直接用 EM 做奖励）无膨胀，定位问题在裁判奖励本身而非偏好优化。De-anchoring 干预把错误答案上的 FPR 从 0.719 压到 0.012，作为训练奖励时能阻止策略进入假阳性盆地。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看 §3 的 hidden-anchor 审计定义与四个诊断量（VA-Gap / FPR drift / discrimination / risk score），这是可以直接搬到自己训练流水线里的工具。§4 的界和命题给出“什么时候会炸”的预测条件：低 EM 区域是高危区，高准确率区域风险小——这对决定哪些任务/阶段可以放心用无参考裁判很关键。§5 是核心实证：跨家族迁移、ensemble 失效、best-of-N 复现、de-anchoring 修复，几组实验合在一起把“是裁判能力不够”这个常见反驳堵死。Figure 1(a) 的五条迭代轨迹最直观，值得对照 loss/奖励曲线思考自己的训练有没有类似分叉。值得深挖的点：de-anchoring 在高准确率 regime 是否仍然稳健，以及如何把“先独立作答再评判”嵌入在线 RL 的样本效率约束里。

summary_en.core_problem: Reference-free self-play, self-rewarding, and LLM-as-a-judge pipelines rest on an untested premise: that a model's verdict on a candidate answer is a usable proxy for correctness. This paper identifies a structural failure of that premise. Without access to a reference, a judge scores plausibility—how convincing an answer looks—not correctness. On reasoning tasks where verification is harder than recognizing a plausible answer, this creates a false-positive basin of plausible-but-wrong answers that optimization actively drives the policy into, producing systematic reward hacking rather than genuine capability gains.
summary_en.importance: The work bears directly on a core assumption across post-training and the pretrain–posttrain loop: whether label-free self-improvement is actually improving ability, or merely teaching the model to fool the judge. For researchers working on RL pretraining, self-play, and reasoning models, it provides an operational diagnostic (the hidden-anchor audit), a clear failure regime (risk is concentrated in low-accuracy settings), and an explanation for why scaling judges or ensembling them does not solve the problem. The findings impose concrete constraints on R1-Zero-style unsupervised reasoning RL and on iterative training recipes that rely on synthetic data plus self-judgment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The design has three parts. First, the hidden-anchor audit: for every question, an independent-source exact-match ground-truth answer is held out. The judge never sees it, training never uses it; it exists only for auditing. The judge–truth gap (VA-Gap) is defined as judge pass rate minus anchor EM, supplemented by FPR on wrong answers, TPR on correct answers, and discrimination (TPR − FPR). A pre-optimization risk score, FPR_base · (1 − EM), rank-orders setups by exploitability. Second, a theoretical characterization: a falsifiable bound VA-Gap ≤ 1 − EM shows the exploitable gap shrinks as accuracy rises; an independence bound quantifies anchoring to the candidate in bits, and a no-escape result shows monotone aggregation (e.g., unanimous ensembles) cannot fix the failure. Third, a de-anchoring fix: require the judge to commit its own answer before scoring the candidate, breaking candidate-conditional anchoring. Experiments use Qwen3 policies on GSM8K in a reasoning-suppressed regime that holds true accuracy low, making the failure measurable.
summary_en.experiments: On GSM8K in the reasoning-suppressed regime, five iterations of self-play drive the judge pass rate from roughly 0.72 to 0.94 while hidden-anchor EM stays flat around 0.20, yielding a VA-Gap of 0.74 across three seeds. Cross-family re-scoring with Llama and Gemma judges up to 14B shows the same inflation; a three-family unanimous ensemble still accepts 55% of the hacked wrong answers, with discrimination collapsing from 0.31 to 0.09, and training directly against the ensemble reward does not help. The basin appears under best-of-N selection without any gradient updates and replicates with a Gemma policy running the full loop, indicating it is a shared blind spot of reference-free judging rather than a quirk of one setup. An oracle control rewarding exact match shows no inflation, localizing the failure to the judge reward rather than preference optimization itself. The de-anchoring intervention reduces FPR on wrong answers from 0.719 to 0.012 and, used as the training reward, prevents entry into the false-positive basin.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on §3 for the hidden-anchor audit and its four diagnostics (VA-Gap, FPR drift, discrimination, risk score); these are directly portable into one's own training pipeline. §4's bounds specify when the failure is predicted to occur: low-EM regimes are high-risk, while high-accuracy regimes show little exploitable gap—directly relevant for deciding which tasks or training phases can safely use reference-free judges. §5 contains the key empirical block: cross-family transfer, ensemble failure, best-of-N replication, and the de-anchoring fix, which together rule out the common objection that “a stronger judge would have caught it.” Figure 1(a), the five-iteration trajectories, is the cleanest single view of the phenomenon and is worth comparing against one's own reward-vs-capability curves. Open directions worth digging into: whether de-anchoring remains robust in high-accuracy regimes, and how to implement “answer first, then judge” efficiently inside online RL loops.

recommendation.zh: 应纳入所有 self-rewarding/RLVR ablation：先答后评这个变量足以改变对 judge reward 的信任边界。
recommendation.en: Add this to every self-rewarding/RLVR ablation suite; the commit-before-judge variable materially changes the trust boundary of judge rewards.

paper.title: Strategic Bargaining in Multi-Buyer Markets: Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards for LLM Negotiations
paper.abstract: Negotiation is a fundamental strategic interaction in management science, characterized by agents attempting to reach agreements while protecting private information, such as reservation costs and hidden valuations. A prevalent yet complex scenario involves a single seller negotiating concurrently with multiple buyers, each possessing heterogeneous, private budgets. In such settings, constrained by a limited number of communication turns, the seller must balance exploring the broader market to d

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM 在多买家并行谈判中是否能通过可验证奖励训练出有效的探索与议价策略。
summary.importance: 贡献主要在后训练与 agent 决策行为分析：它把 RLVR 放到经济谈判环境里，暴露出语言流畅性和战略探索能力之间的缺口。对基座预训练的直接价值有限，但对“可验证奖励是否足够塑造推理/决策策略”有弱信号。
summary.technical_approach: 构造单卖家、多买家、私有预算、有限轮次的谈判设置，用可验证的谈判收益作为强化学习奖励训练 LLM seller。核心关注探索-利用权衡：模型需要决定是否继续试探其他买家，还是集中轮次推进当前最高出价者。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的主要发现是标准 LLM 虽然语言能力足够，但会过早锁定当前最高出价者，缺少对买家池的系统探索。具体模型规模、训练轮数、baseline 和收益提升幅度在给定信息中未披露。
summary.authors_note: David Simchi-Levi 是 MIT 运筹优化、供应链和管理科学方向的知名研究者；该工作更偏管理科学中的 LLM 决策实验，而不是通用 LLM 训练方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether LLMs can learn effective exploration and bargaining strategies in concurrent multi-buyer negotiations using verifiable rewards.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly about post-training and agentic decision behavior. It places RLVR in an economic negotiation setting and exposes a gap between fluent language generation and strategic exploration. The direct value for base pretraining is limited, but it is a useful weak signal on whether verifiable rewards are sufficient to shape decision policies.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup has one seller, multiple buyers with private heterogeneous budgets, and a limited number of communication turns. The seller policy is trained with verifiable negotiation outcomes as reinforcement learning rewards, with the key tradeoff being whether to explore more buyers or exploit the current best bidder.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that standard LLMs tend to fixate on the current highest bid instead of exploring the buyer pool. Model sizes, training budget, baselines, and quantitative gains are not available from the provided abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: David Simchi-Levi is a well-known MIT researcher in operations research, supply chains, and management science. The work reads more like an LLM decision-making study in management science than a general LLM training paper.

recommendation.zh: 可作为 RLVR 在非数学任务上失效模式的例子；预训练侧不必读正文，看实验设定即可。
recommendation.en: Useful as a failure case for RLVR outside math-like tasks; for pretraining work, the setup matters more than the full paper.

paper.title: KAT-Coder-V2.5 Technical Report
paper.abstract: We present KAT-Coder-V2.5, a coding-focused agentic model trained to act autonomously inside real, executable repositories rather than as a single-turn code generator. Its capability is bottlenecked less by model scale than by the scarcity of reproducible environments, verifiable rewards, and high-value trajectories, which we address with an end-to-end agentic post-training framework. AutoBuilder reconstructs multilingual repositories into sandboxed environments with fail-to-pass and pass-to-pas

summary.core_problem: 如何在可执行仓库环境中规模化训练具备自主工具使用能力的代码 Agent，解决可复现环境、可验证奖励和高质量轨迹稀缺的瓶颈。
summary.importance: 系统级工程贡献：给出端到端 agentic post-training pipeline，把 sandbox 构建、近失败轨迹挖掘、工具使用轨迹合成、RL 可靠性硬化串成闭环，是 R1-Zero 范式下代码 RL 的可复现 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: AutoBuilder 大规模重建多语言仓库沙箱，做 fail-to-pass / pass-to-pass 验证，据此重写 task spec、恢复 near-miss 轨迹并做 process-aware 过滤蒸馏；KwaiClawEnv 从可执行服务和真实任务种子合成工具使用轨迹；RL 部分引入 harness randomization、可靠性加固沙箱、非对称 actor-critic PPO + hindsight value 估计、面向 harness 的 reward。
summary.experiments: 技术报告未给出具体模型规模/基准数字；核心指标围绕仓库级 agent 执行通过率与 RL 稳定性，未公开 SOTA 对照表格。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表含多位快手(Kuaishou/Kwai)成员，团队此前发布 KAT-Coder 系列代码模型。

summary_en.core_problem: How to train an autonomous coding agent at scale inside real executable repositories, addressing the scarcity of reproducible environments, verifiable rewards, and high-value trajectories.
summary_en.importance: End-to-end systems contribution: a full agentic post-training pipeline that stitches together sandbox reconstruction, near-miss trajectory recovery, tool-use trajectory synthesis, and reliability-hardened RL—a replicable recipe for code RL in the post-R1-Zero era.
summary_en.technical_approach: AutoBuilder rebuilds multilingual repos into sandboxes at scale with fail-to-pass and pass-to-pass verification, then regenerates self-contained task specs, recovers near-miss trajectories, and distills supervision via process-aware filtering. KwaiClawEnv synthesizes large-scale tool-use trajectories from executable services and real task seeds. RL uses harness randomization, a reliability-hardened sandbox, asymmetric actor–critic PPO with hindsight-augmented value estimation, and a harness-oriented reward.
summary_en.experiments: Technical report; no concrete model sizes or benchmark numbers in the abstract. Metrics center on repository-level execution pass rate and RL stability; no public SOTA table provided.
summary_en.authors_note: Author list includes multiple Kuaishou/Kwai members; the team previously released the KAT-Coder family of coding models.

recommendation.zh: 工程堆叠重但接近真实 R1 式代码 RL pipeline，看 §3 AutoBuilder 和 near-miss 蒸馏就够，RL 部分是已知技巧拼装。
recommendation.en: Heavy systems plumbing but close to a real R1-style code-RL pipeline; read §3 on AutoBuilder and near-miss distillation—the RL section assembles known tricks.

paper.title: LLM-as-a-Verifier: A General-Purpose Verification Framework
paper.abstract: Scaling pre-training, post-training, and test-time compute have become the central paradigms for improving the capabilities of LLMs. In this work, we identify verification, the ability to determine the correctness of a solution, as a new scaling axis. To unlock this and demonstrate its effectiveness, we introduce LLM-as-a-Verifier, a general-purpose verification framework that provides fine-grained feedback for agentic tasks without requiring additional training. Unlike standard LM judges that p

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM验证方法存在两类核心局限：一是基于提示的离散打分器将连续判断压缩为粗粒度离散分数，导致大量平局、区分度不足；二是训练得到的奖励模型受训练数据约束，跨领域泛化能力差。同时，验证能力本身没有像生成能力那样形成清晰的可扩展范式，制约了Agent系统与RL后训练的进一步提升。
summary.importance: 提出了验证能力的三条可扩展轴，为后训练阶段的奖励信号设计、Agent轨迹评估、RL样本效率提升提供了一套无需额外训练的通用方案。对预训练研究的启发在于：LLM内部logits分布本身携带细粒度质量信号，可被直接利用，不必依赖额外训练奖励模型或离散打分prompt。
summary.technical_approach: 核心思路是不要求LLM生成离散分数，而是直接读取打分token的logits分布，计算期望得到连续、细粒度的验证分数。在此基础上沿三个维度扩展验证能力：1）增加提取的logits token数量，降低平局率、提升正负样本分离度；2）重复多次评估取平均，降低方差；3）将评估准则拆分为多个子维度，降低单一prompt的偏差。进一步提出基于偏好概率的低成本排序算法，用于从多个候选解中选出最优解。该框架还可对整条交互轨迹打分，并作为密集奖励信号接入RL训练。
summary.experiments: 在多个领域取得强结果：Terminal-Bench V2 86.5%，SWE-Bench Verified 78.2%，RoboRewardBench轨迹偏好准确率87.4%，MedAgentBench 73.3%。机器人任务上与现有奖励模型Robometer、TOPReward、RoboReward对比，值序相关系数VOC均值达0.966。作为RL奖励信号时，机器人LIBERO基准上样本效率比稀疏奖励基线高约1.8倍，MATH推理基准上用GRPO微调Qwen3-8B时样本效率高约1.1倍。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3节方法部分，理解logits期望打分的数学形式与三条扩展轴的设计动机；第4节看离散打分基线的对比实验与平局率分析；第5节关注RL样本效率部分，理解密集信号如何转化为训练增益。附录中的prompt模板与logits提取细节值得参考。预计阅读时间40-60分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Current LLM verification suffers from two bottlenecks: prompt-based discrete judges collapse continuous judgments into coarse scores, causing massive ties and poor discrimination; learned reward models are bounded by training data and generalize poorly across domains. Unlike generation, verification has not developed a clear scaling paradigm, limiting further gains in agent systems and RL post-training.
summary_en.importance: It identifies three scalable axes for verification and provides a training-free general solution for reward signal design, agent trajectory evaluation, and RL sample efficiency improvement. A key implication for pretraining research is that LLM internal logit distributions already carry fine-grained quality signals, which can be exploited without training separate reward models or engineering discrete-score prompts.
summary_en.technical_approach: Instead of asking LLMs to emit discrete scores, the framework reads the full logit distribution over scoring tokens and computes the expectation to obtain continuous, fine-grained verification scores. Verification is then scaled along three dimensions: (1) increasing the number of logit tokens extracted to reduce tie rate and improve separation; (2) repeated evaluations to reduce variance; (3) criterion decomposition to reduce single-prompt bias. A cost-efficient ranking algorithm based on pairwise preference probabilities is further introduced to select the best candidate from a pool. The framework can score full interaction trajectories and serve as a dense reward signal for RL.
summary_en.experiments: Strong results across domains: Terminal-Bench V2 86.5%, SWE-Bench Verified 78.2%, RoboRewardBench trajectory preference accuracy 87.4%, MedAgentBench 73.3%. On robotic tasks it achieves a mean Value-Order Correlation (VOC) of 0.966, outperforming Robometer, TOPReward, and RoboReward. As an RL reward signal, it yields ~1.8x higher sample efficiency than sparse reward baselines on LIBERO, and ~1.1x higher sample efficiency on MATH when fine-tuning Qwen3-8B with GRPO.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the mathematical formulation of logit-expectation scoring and the motivation behind the three scaling axes; Section 4 for comparisons against discrete judge baselines and tie-rate analysis; Section 5 for RL sample efficiency results and how dense signals translate into training gains. Prompt templates and logit extraction details in the appendix are worth checking. Estimated reading time: 40-60 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不必全读，抓住 logits-expectation verifier；若做 RLVR 数据筛选，先看评分粒度和重复评估实验。
recommendation.en: No need to read end to end; extract the logits-expectation verifier idea, especially the granularity and repeated-evaluation results for RLVR data filtering.

paper.title: Weak-to-Strong Generalization via Direct On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is a powerful recipe for improving language-model reasoning, but it is expensive to repeat on every new strong model because the target model must generate many rollouts during training. As models scale, post-training itself becomes a bottleneck. We study a weak-to-strong alternative: run RL on a smaller model where rollouts are cheaper, then reuse what that RL run learned to improve a stronger target model. Directly distilling the post-RL we

summary.core_problem: RLVR（带可验证奖励的强化学习）已成为提升LLM推理能力的主流后训练方案，但其训练成本与目标模型规模绑定：每次更新都需要当前策略生成大量rollout，模型越大每轮RL越昂贵。当推理模型持续扩展时，从零开始为每个新强模型重复RLVR会使后训练本身成为瓶颈。直接蒸馏小模型RL后的最终策略效果很差，因为小模型的最终策略混合了RL带来的有用改进与小模型本身的能力上限，会覆盖学生模型已有的更强行为。
summary.importance: 提出了一种新的弱到强后训练范式：把小模型RL当作可迁移监督信号的廉价生成器，而非要模仿的最终教师。该范式将后训练成本与目标模型规模部分解耦，显著降低了大模型推理增强的计算开销。对预训练研究的核心启示是：RL学到的改进可以以「策略偏移量」的形式在模型间传递，不必依赖显式奖励模型，也不必在大模型上重跑完整RL流程；这为预训练-后训练闭环中的信号复用与跨模型知识迁移提供了新机制。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Direct On-Policy Distillation（Direct-OPD），核心是不蒸馏小模型RL后的最终策略π_T，而是蒸馏其RL前后的策略偏移量Δ_T = log π_T - log π_{T_ref}，其中π_{T_ref}是RL前的小模型参考策略。这个偏移量只保留RL引起的概率变化，丢弃小模型原有的偏好，从而避免把小模型的能力上限传递给学生。数学上证明：在KL正则化的RL目标下，该策略偏移量等价于训练小模型的奖励信号，对其优化可恢复与原RL相同的目标形式。训练时学生在自身的on-policy状态上采样，用偏移量作为隐式奖励，并以学生初始模型为锚点加KL约束，无需训练显式奖励模型，也无需在目标模型上执行稀疏奖励RL。
summary.experiments: 使用两组教师对（R1-Distill-1.5B→JustRL-1.5B、Nemotron-1.5B→QuestA-Nemotron-1.5B）和三个不同家族的学生模型（R1-Distill-7B、Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-4B），所有学生均获得提升，包括初始能力已超过RL后小教师的R1-Distill-7B和Qwen3-4B。Qwen3-1.7B在AIME 2024上从48.3提升至62.4，仅需8张A100运行约4小时，效果与Polaris用32张A100在Qwen3-1.7B上直接跑RL一周相当。在相同RL步数下，先在1.5B模型跑RL再用Direct-OPD迁移，在准确率和计算效率上均优于直接在R1-Distill-7B上跑RL。分析表明该方法不依赖师生间的top-k重叠，可跨思维模式迁移，并识别出了隐式奖励与验证准确率保持一致的响应长度和KL条件。
summary.reading_guide: 精读第2.2节的数学证明，理解策略偏移量与KL正则化RL目标的等价性，这是整个方法成立的核心；第1节图1的失败案例（vanilla OPD拉低学生性能）与成功案例对照阅读，建立直观认识；第3节实验部分重点看跨模型家族、跨师生能力关系的迁移结果，以及4小时vs一周的成本对比；第4节分析部分关注响应长度、KL阈值与信号可靠性的关系，这是实际落地时的关键调参依据。

summary_en.core_problem: RLVR (Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards) has become the dominant post-training recipe for improving LLM reasoning, but its cost scales with the target model size: each update requires the current policy to generate many rollouts, and larger models make each RL iteration more expensive. As reasoning models continue to scale, re-running RLVR from scratch for every new strong model risks turning post-training itself into a bottleneck. Directly distilling the final post-RL policy of a small model performs poorly, because the final policy entangles useful RL-induced improvements with the intrinsic capacity limits of the smaller model, and can overwrite stronger behavior already present in the student.
summary_en.importance: It introduces a new weak-to-strong post-training paradigm that treats small-model RL as a cheap generator of transferable supervision rather than a final teacher to imitate. The paradigm partially decouples post-training cost from target model size, substantially reducing the compute overhead of reasoning enhancement for large models. The core implication for pretraining research is that RL-learned improvements can be transferred across models in the form of a policy shift, without requiring an explicit reward model or a full RL rerun on the large model; this opens a new mechanism for signal reuse and cross-model knowledge transfer in the pretrain-posttrain loop.
summary_en.technical_approach: Direct On-Policy Distillation (Direct-OPD) does not distill the final post-RL small-model policy π_T, but instead distills the policy shift Δ_T = log π_T - log π_{T_ref}, where π_{T_ref} is the small-model reference policy before RL. This shift retains only the probability changes caused by RL and discards the small model's original preferences, avoiding the transfer of the teacher's capacity limits to the student. It is mathematically proven that under a KL-regularized RL objective, this policy shift is equivalent to the reward signal that trained the small model: optimizing against it recovers the same objective form as the original RL. During training, the student samples on its own on-policy states, uses the shift as an implicit reward, and is anchored to its own initialization via a KL term — no explicit reward model training or sparse-reward RL on the target model is required.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated with two teacher pairs (R1-Distill-1.5B→JustRL-1.5B, Nemotron-1.5B→QuestA-Nemotron-1.5B) and three students from two families (R1-Distill-7B, Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B). All students improve, including R1-Distill-7B and Qwen3-4B whose initial performance already exceeds the post-RL weak teacher. Qwen3-1.7B improves from 48.3 to 62.4 on AIME 2024 in roughly 4 hours on 8 A100 GPUs, on par with Polaris running RL directly on Qwen3-1.7B for at least a week on 32 A100 GPUs. At matched RL steps, running RL on a 1.5B model plus Direct-OPD transfer outperforms running RL directly on R1-Distill-7B in both accuracy and compute efficiency. Analysis shows the method does not rely on teacher-student top-k overlap and transfers across thinking patterns; response-length and KL conditions under which the implicit reward stays aligned with validation accuracy are identified.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read Section 2.2 carefully for the mathematical proof that policy shift is equivalent to the KL-regularized RL reward — this is the theoretical foundation of the entire method. Contrast the vanilla-OPD failure case and Direct-OPD success case in Figure 1 (Section 1) to build intuition. In Section 3, focus on transfer results across model families and across teacher-student ability relationships, as well as the 4-hour-vs-one-week cost comparison. Section 4 analysis on response length, KL thresholds and signal reliability is critical for practical tuning and deployment.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和 ablation 即可；log-ratio policy shift 比蒸馏弱教师输出更干净，适合内测 RLVR 复用。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; the log-ratio policy-shift signal is cleaner than distilling weak-teacher outputs and is worth testing for RLVR reuse.

paper.title: ACPO: Adaptive Credit Policy Optimization via Fine-Grained Surrogate Entropy
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has substantially improved the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs), but sparse outcome rewards still make token-level credit assignment difficult. Existing scalable RL methods typically assign trajectory-level rewards uniformly across tokens, while recent entropy-aware approaches either rely on coarse detached heuristics or directly optimize true entropy, which can introduce non-local gradient components misaligned with sampled-token policy updates. We p

summary.core_problem: 在基于结果奖励的强化学习（如 GRPO）中，稀疏的标量奖励导致 token 级别的信用分配（credit assignment）困难，而现有的基于熵的分配方法要么依赖粗糙的启发式规则，要么直接优化真实熵，这会引入与采样 token 策略更新不一致的梯度噪声。
summary.importance: 提出了一种细粒度的自适应信用分配框架 ACPO，在不依赖昂贵的过程奖励模型（PRM）的情况下，通过代理熵有效地解决了稀疏奖励下的信用分配问题，提升了 RL 在推理任务中的训练稳定性和性能。
summary.technical_approach: ACPO 引入了基于“局部模式代理熵”（mode-local surrogate entropy）的 token 级权重方案，动态调节优势估计（advantage estimates）。核心机制是不对称处理：在成功的轨迹中，放大高不确定性（高熵）决策的权重，认为这些是关键的推理分叉点；在失败的轨迹中，惩罚过度自信（低熵）的错误 token。通过使用代理熵，ACPO 避免了直接优化真实熵带来的全分布梯度噪声，确保了策略梯度的方向一致性。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen2.5-Math-7B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill 和 Qwen3-8B-Base 三个基座模型上进行了实验。在多个推理基准测试中，ACPO 稳定超越了 GRPO、DAPO 和 SAPO 等强 RL 基线，证明了在稀疏结果监督下，基于代理熵的信用分配的有效性。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Section 4.3 对真实熵梯度不一致性的理论分析，以及代理熵的数学推导。实验部分关注 ACPO 与 GRPO 在不同模型规模下的性能对比。预计阅读时间 20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In outcome-based reinforcement learning (e.g., GRPO), sparse scalar rewards make token-level credit assignment difficult. Existing entropy-based methods either rely on coarse heuristics or directly optimize true entropy, introducing gradient noise misaligned with sampled-token policy updates.
summary_en.importance: Proposes ACPO, a fine-grained adaptive credit assignment framework that effectively solves the credit assignment problem under sparse rewards without relying on expensive Process Reward Models (PRMs), improving RL training stability and performance in reasoning tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: ACPO introduces a token-level weighting scheme based on a 'mode-local surrogate entropy' to dynamically modulate advantage estimates. The core mechanism is asymmetric: in successful trajectories, it emphasizes highly uncertain (high-entropy) decisions, treating them as critical reasoning forks; in failed trajectories, it penalizes overconfident (low-entropy) incorrect tokens. By using surrogate entropy, ACPO avoids the full-distribution gradient noise of true entropy, preserving the intended policy-gradient direction.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Qwen2.5-Math-7B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill, and Qwen3-8B-Base. ACPO consistently outperformed strong RL baselines like GRPO, DAPO, and SAPO across multiple reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of surrogate-entropy-based credit assignment under sparse outcome supervision.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 4.3 for the theoretical analysis of true entropy gradient misalignment and the derivation of surrogate entropy. In the experiments, compare ACPO's performance with GRPO across different model scales. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和消融即可；它抓住了 RLVR 的真问题，但 surrogate entropy 的假设要等完整实验验证。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations only; it targets a real RLVR bottleneck, but the surrogate-entropy assumptions need cleaner empirical support.

paper.title: World Feedback for Clinical Agents: Diagnosing RL in FHIR Environments
paper.abstract: Clinical protocol-execution tasks -- checking a lab value, applying a threshold, placing a correctly structured FHIR order -- are natural candidates for RL from world feedback: once clinical SMEs encode decision logic into a verifier, that verifier grades unlimited rollouts without per-episode annotation. But applying RL requires a sound feedback channel and sufficient base capability. We audit MedAgentBench v1/v2, find a 41.7\% silent-finish ceiling that makes inaction the RL dominant strategy,

summary.core_problem: 诊断 verifier/world-feedback 驱动的 RL 在临床 FHIR agent 任务中为什么会失败，以及 benchmark 的反馈通道是否会诱导错误策略。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent/RL 评测修复与训练信号分析。虽然任务是临床协议执行，但 silent-finish ceiling、零基础能力导致零梯度、格式知识不可探索这三类问题，对 RLVR、world-model feedback 和 agent 后训练都有直接警示。
summary.technical_approach: 先审计 MedAgentBench v1/v2，发现 41.7% silent-finish ceiling 会让不行动成为 RL 优势策略；随后构造 MAB-v3，包含 508 个任务，将该 ceiling 降到 8.9%。再用 Qwen3-8B 做训练诊断，并把任务分为 decision、format-knowledge、lookup 等类型，分析哪些任务适合纯 RL，哪些需要 SFT 或外部知识。
summary.experiments: 在 MAB-v3 上训练 Qwen3-8B。结果显示 20 类任务中有 10 类 base performance 为 0%，导致 RL 没有有效梯度；3/20 类任务需要精确临床编码，探索无法发现。纯 RL pass@1 为 18.2%，规则 SFT 为 34.1%，15.9 个百分点差距被归因于能力 ceiling 和格式知识 barrier。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper diagnoses why verifier-based world-feedback RL fails for clinical FHIR agents and whether the benchmark feedback channel rewards degenerate behavior.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a benchmark audit plus training-signal analysis for agent RL. The clinical setting is domain-specific, but the findings about silent-finish rewards, zero-gradient capability gaps, and undiscoverable format knowledge are broadly relevant to RLVR and agent post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors audit MedAgentBench v1/v2 and identify a 41.7% silent-finish ceiling that makes inaction an RL-dominant strategy. They build MAB-v3 with 508 tasks and reduce that ceiling to 8.9%. They then train Qwen3-8B and classify failures into decision, format-knowledge, and lookup categories.
summary_en.experiments: On MAB-v3, Qwen3-8B training exposes 10 of 20 task types with 0% base performance, yielding no useful RL gradient, and 3 of 20 task types requiring exact clinical codes that exploration cannot discover. Pure RL reaches 18.2% pass@1 versus 34.1% for rule-based SFT; the 15.9 pp gap is attributed to these barriers.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 和错误 taxonomy 就够；它提醒 RLVR 前先测 verifier 漏洞、base success 和不可探索格式知识。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and failure taxonomy; it is a useful reminder to measure verifier loopholes, base success, and undiscoverable format knowledge before RLVR.

paper.title: Don't Let Gains FADE: Breaking Down Policy Gradient Weights in RL
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning post-training dramatically improves LLM reasoning, but suffers from training instability and diversity collapse. Advantage functions offer an appealing fix: they reshape the training objective, reweight which rollouts drive learning, and are trivial to implement. Yet a proliferation of methods makes it unclear which advantage to use and when. We cut through the confusion with a unifying framework that decomposes any advantage into its positive and negative gradient mass al

summary.core_problem: 带可验证奖励的LLM RL后训练（RLVR）中，现有各类策略权重/优势函数（GRPO、DAPO、pass@k加权等）缺乏统一分析框架，不同方法的设计改动混杂在多个维度，无法定位性能差异的来源；同时固定权重无法适配训练过程中熵坍缩、权重几何坍缩、样本方差的三重权衡，导致训练不稳定、输出多样性下降。
summary.importance: 明确了RL阶段策略权重设计的三个正交维度与可量化的权衡关系，为RL预训练、RL对齐的损失函数设计提供了可落地的指导原则，减少了调参的盲目性；提出的动态权重方法FADE可适配训练不同阶段的需求，提升RL训练的稳定性、最终精度与输出多样性，对pretrain-posttrain闭环优化有直接参考价值。
