summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses nine deterministic-generator reasoning tasks: Roman numerals, linear unit conversion, free fall, monoalphabetic substitution cipher, an 8-bit boolean program, two equation-induction families, and two cryptarithm families. Public and hidden splits are produced by the same generators, so a held-out slice of training data is a reliable proxy for test accuracy. The author reverse-engineers the generators into Python solvers, renders solver-grounded procedures as synthetic CoT with no value overlap with evaluation instances, and fine-tunes rank-32-or-smaller LoRA adapters on Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B, a 30B-parameter hybrid Mamba-2/MoE model with about 3.5B active parameters. Decoding is greedy with a 7680-token budget. When SFT saturates, the study escalates to RLVR/GRPO and STaR. The central analysis introduces faithful forward CoT: every emitted step should be derivable from the current prefix. Cryptarithm-style backtracking violates this property because the hidden mapping carries almost no local information before search resolution.
summary_en.experiments: Five tasks have Python solvers with at least 98% accuracy, but solver coverage does not predict distillation success. For four forward-computable tasks, the learned CoT model closely tracks solver performance. For cryptarithm, the learnability gap exceeds 0.65. The backtracking solver answers roughly 71% of instances, with the remaining cases being information-theoretically ambiguous, yet cryptarithm-deduce stays below 0.07 after eleven rounds of CoT engineering and three RL/self-training escalations. The diagnostics are sharp. A generate-and-verify reframing reaches hit@8=0.71, suggesting candidate generation and ranking are not the main bottleneck, while forward-derivation coverage is only 1/659. The hidden map has MI(digit; glyph)=0.021 nats, nearly zero. Line-level fidelity shows arithmetic lines are correct 97–100% of the time, but elimination verdicts have only 16–57% fidelity. The model learns verdict tokens as templates rather than computing their conditions. A controlled intervention that improves forward derivability lifts accuracy from 0.03 to 0.57, supporting the proposed mechanism. The practical workaround is to precompute the finite combinatorial core into a catalog and train the model to recall and verify, not to imitate search.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim with attention to the mechanism sections; budget about 35–45 minutes. Start with the research questions and Figure 1 to understand the solvability-learnability gap. Then read the task and training setup to check why the train-test comparison is unusually clean. Focus on the verdict-as-token analysis, Table 3 with the independent diagnostic measurements, Figure 4 showing failed escalation through SFT/RL/self-training, and Table 7 with the forward-derivability intervention. The final section on memorizing the finite structure is also worth reading because it clarifies that the task is not impossible; the failed object is search-trace distillation.

recommendation.zh: 对“可验证即可学会”的 RLVR 直觉是有用的反例，setup 干净；只看 cryptarithm 相关表格与失败模式分析即可。
recommendation.en: A useful counterexample to the intuition that verifiability implies learnability in RLVR, with a clean setup; read only the tables around Cryptarithm and the failure-mode analysis.

paper.title: Process-Verified Reinforcement Learning for Theorem Proving via Lean
paper.abstract: While reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically has relied on a single binary verification signal, symbolic proof assistants in formal reasoning offer rich, fine-grained structured feedback. This gap between structured processes and unstructured rewards highlights the importance of feedback that is both dense and sound. In this work, we demonstrate that the Lean proof assistant itself can serve as a symbolic process oracle, supplying both outcome-level and fine-grained tact

summary.core_problem: 现有基于可验证奖励的推理RL训练大多只使用最终证明是否通过的二值结果信号，浪费了Lean这类形式化证明助手提供的细粒度、步骤级可靠反馈；同时人工训练的过程奖励模型（PRM）存在标注成本高、信号噪声大、与真实证明语义对齐不足的问题。
summary.importance: 为RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）的信用分配提供了一条不需要额外PRM、直接利用符号系统原生过程反馈的路径，这套细粒度信号设计的思路可迁移到其他有可验证执行环境的推理、代码任务训练中，对缓解RL训练的稀疏奖励问题、提升过程监督可靠性有实际参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 将Lean证明助手直接作为符号过程预言机，不依赖自然语言CoT或者外部PRM。首先解析模型生成的tactic序列，通过Lean的elaboration机制标记每一步局部是否合法、以及最早出错的位置；然后基于tactic级MDP、首错传播规则（第一个出错的tactic及之后的步骤不分配正向奖励，之前的正确步骤分配对应奖励）、首token信用分配策略，把符号反馈转换成tactic级分数再映射到token级优势；最后将过程级优势与传统的结果级二值奖励结合，用GRPO目标做在线RL训练。
summary.experiments: 在MiniF2F、ProofNet两个形式化证明基准上，该方法相较纯结果奖励RL、无RL基线带来稳定性能提升，训练过程更鲁棒，没有出现纯结果奖励训练常见的震荡问题，全程不需要额外自然语言标注或单独训练PRM。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注第3节中符号反馈到token级优势的转换规则设计，对比其与现有PRM方案的设计差异，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for reasoning mostly relies on a single binary outcome signal indicating final proof correctness, underutilizing fine-grained, step-level reliable feedback from formal proof assistants like Lean. Separately trained process reward models (PRMs) suffer from high annotation cost, noisy signals, and poor alignment with formal proof semantics.
summary_en.importance: This work demonstrates a practical dense credit assignment path for RLVR that eliminates the need for auxiliary PRMs by directly leveraging native process feedback from symbolic execution environments. The signal design framework can generalize to other reasoning and code tasks with verifiable execution environments, offering reference for reducing sparse reward issues and improving process supervision reliability in RL training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Lean proof assistant is used directly as a symbolic process oracle, with no dependence on natural language chain-of-thought or external PRMs. Generated tactic sequences are parsed, and Lean's elaboration mechanism marks locally valid steps and the earliest failing step for each proof attempt. A structured credit assignment pipeline converts symbolic feedback into training signals: a tactic-level MDP formulation, a first-error propagation rule that assigns positive reward only to steps before the first failure, and a first-token credit assignment strategy map tactic-level scores to token-level advantages. These process-level advantages are combined with traditional binary outcome rewards in a GRPO-style objective for online RL training.
summary_en.experiments: On the MiniF2F and ProofNet formal theorem proving benchmarks, the method delivers consistent performance gains over outcome-only RL and non-RL baselines. Training is more stable, with less oscillation than commonly observed in outcome-only RL setups, and requires no external natural language annotation or separate PRM training.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper, focus on Section 3 covering the conversion pipeline from symbolic verifier feedback to token-level advantages, and note design differences from standard PRM-based approaches. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 reward 设计而非结果数字；§方法里的 first-error credit 应在内部 RLVR 任务复现。
recommendation.en: Read it for the reward design, not the headline numbers; the first-error credit scheme is worth reproducing in internal RLVR tasks.

paper.title: ADaPT: Token-Level Decoupling for Efficient Large Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Large reasoning models rely on long chain-of-thought to achieve strong performance, but applying such reasoning uniformly incurs high computational cost. Existing efficiency-oriented methods attempt to shorten or mix reasoning strategies, yet often degrade reasoning capability. We identify the root cause as sequence-level coupling between efficiency incentives and correctness optimization, which implicitly penalizes long but correct reasoning trajectories. To address this issue, we propose Adapt

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 reasoning model 的效率训练冲突：如果把“答对”和“少生成 token”都作为 sequence-level 奖励，训练会系统性压低长但正确的推理轨迹，导致深推理能力受损。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是核心贡献，但对 RLVR 和 reasoning post-train 的奖励设计有启发。关键点是把效率信号从完整答案上移开，避免让长度惩罚污染 correctness optimization。这个思路也提醒基座训练研究：当训练信号同时包含能力目标和成本目标时，标量化奖励很容易改变模型的解题分布，而不只是改变平均长度。
summary.technical_approach: ADaPT 引入一个显式的 mode-selection token，用来选择 fast reasoning 或 slow reasoning。训练分两阶段。第一阶段 SFT，让模型见到两类行为：短路径快速回答，以及带长 CoT 的慢速推理。第二阶段用 token-level 版本的 GRPO 做强化学习。核心设计是：正确性奖励仍作用于答案质量，效率相关奖励只作用于 mode-selection token，而不是惩罚整条序列。这样，模型可以学习什么时候触发慢思考，但不会因为某条长 CoT 是长的就降低其正确性学习信号。推理时可以调节触发 <think> token 的概率，让同一个模型在效率和性能之间连续移动。
summary.experiments: 论文声称在多个 reasoning benchmark 上验证 ADaPT 能显著减少推理 token 成本，同时保持较强的推理性能。可确认的实验设置包括基于 GRPO 的 RL 阶段、fast/slow 双模式训练，以及通过 <think> 触发概率控制效率—性能折中。当前给出的正文片段没有包含具体 benchmark 名称、模型规模、token reduction 比例或准确率数字，因此不宜补造定量结论。实验部分最应关注的是：ADaPT 与 sequence-level length reward、hybrid reasoning baseline 的对比；长题与短题分桶结果；以及调节 mode token 概率后是否形成稳定 Pareto 曲线。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。优先看方法部分对 sequence-level coupling 的分析，以及 token-level GRPO 如何只把效率奖励施加到 mode-selection token。实验表格只需要抓三类数字：平均生成长度、主 benchmark 准确率、不同难度题目的性能变化。若只关心 pretrain，可重点读奖励解耦的思想，不必深挖具体应用 benchmark。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets an efficiency–capability conflict in large reasoning models. When correctness and brevity are optimized at the sequence level, long but correct chains of thought are implicitly penalized, which can weaken deep reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a post-training and RLVR paper, not a pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model training is the reward-design lesson: cost objectives should not be naively scalarized with capability objectives when the two act on different parts of the generation process. A length penalty applied to the whole sequence changes the learned reasoning distribution, not just the average token count.
summary_en.technical_approach: ADaPT introduces an explicit mode-selection token that chooses between fast and slow reasoning. Training has two stages. The SFT stage exposes the model to both short fast responses and longer slow CoT-style reasoning. The RL stage uses a token-level variant of GRPO. The key design is to apply efficiency-related rewards only to the mode-selection token, while preserving correctness optimization for the answer. This decouples the decision to think slowly from the learning signal for whether the reasoning is correct. At inference time, the probability of triggering the <think> token can be adjusted, allowing one model to trade off compute and accuracy without retraining.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments across multiple reasoning benchmarks, with the main claim that ADaPT reduces inference cost while maintaining strong reasoning performance. The visible technical setup includes a GRPO-based RL stage, fast/slow dual-mode supervision, and inference-time control through the <think> trigger probability. The provided text does not expose the concrete benchmark list, model sizes, token-reduction ratios, or accuracy numbers, so the quantitative claims should be checked in the experiment tables. The important comparisons are against sequence-level length rewards and hybrid reasoning baselines, with separate attention to easy versus hard problems and to whether the mode-token probability produces a smooth Pareto curve.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the analysis of sequence-level coupling and the token-level GRPO objective, especially where the efficiency reward is attached only to the mode-selection token. In the experiments, look for three numbers: average generated tokens, reasoning accuracy, and performance by problem difficulty. For pretraining-oriented readers, the main transferable idea is reward decoupling; the benchmark-specific details are secondary.

recommendation.zh: 值得看奖励拆分的 setup；若实验干净，应把“效率惩罚只打到控制 token”放进内部 RLVR ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the reward-decoupling setup; if the experiments are clean, the control-token-only efficiency penalty deserves an internal RLVR ablation.

paper.title: VIMPO: Value-Implicit Policy Optimization for LLMs
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become a central tool for improving the reasoning ability of large language models, but current methods face a trade-off between simplicity and credit assignment. Group-relative methods such as GRPO avoid training a critic, but typically assign a trajectory-level advantage to every token. Actor-critic methods provide denser learning signals, but require a learned value function with its own training instability. We introduce VIMPO, a critic-free

summary.core_problem: VIMPO 处理的是 RLVR 里一个很现实的矛盾：GRPO 这类 critic-free 方法训练简单、稳定，但通常把同一个 trajectory-level advantage 广播给整条输出的所有 token，信用分配太粗；PPO / actor-critic 方法能给 token-level 信号，但需要单独训练 value function，容易出现 critic 失准、策略与价值网络共适应、训练不稳。作者试图证明，这个二选一并不是必须的：在 KL 正则化的自回归生成框架下，可以从策略本身和参考模型的 log-ratio 推出一个隐式 value recurrence，从而在不训练独立 critic 的情况下恢复更细粒度的 token-level credit assignment。
summary.importance: 这篇工作属于 post-train，但和基座研究的接口很直接。它的价值不在于提出一个更复杂的 RL 管线，而在于重新整理了 KL-regularized RLHF/RLVR 里 policy、reference、reward、value 之间的关系。对做预训练和后训练接口的人来说，重要启发有两点。第一，reference model 不只是一个 KL 约束对象，它还可以成为构造内部学习信号的坐标系。第二，很多所谓 critic-free 方法之所以信用分配差，不是因为没有 value network 就必然做不到，而是因为没有把策略最优性条件用到位。VIMPO 给出了一种中间路线：保留 group rollout 的简单性，同时通过 policy-implied value 恢复 Bellman-consistent 的 token 级监督。这对长链推理、代码生成这类长序列 RL 很有现实意义。
summary.technical_approach:
方法建立在一个标准但写得比较清楚的建模上：把自回归生成看成 deterministic-transition MDP，状态是 prompt 加上当前前缀，动作是下一个 token，终止时得到 outcome reward，并带有相对 frozen reference policy 的 KL 正则。

核心推导来自 KL-regularized 最优性条件。作者不是去学一个独立的 V(s)，而是利用策略与参考模型的 log-likelihood ratio，推导出一个隐式 value recurrence。直观上，若策略相对 reference 在某一步更愿意选择某个 token，这个偏离就携带了未来回报与 KL 代价平衡后的信息。再结合终止状态 V(s_T)=0 的边界条件，整条序列上的 value 可以被“闭合”起来。由于初始 value 仍需要和外部 outcome reward 对齐，作者用和 GRPO 类似的同 prompt 多 rollout Monte Carlo 估计来给出 trajectory-level target。

在此基础上，VIMPO 有两个训练部件。第一是 critic-free 的 value optimization objective：不是训练一个独立 critic 网络，而是让由 policy-reference log-ratio 诱导出的隐式 value 满足 Bellman consistency，并用平方误差去贴合 Monte Carlo 回报。第二是 actor update：由同样的推导可以得到 one-step temporal-difference advantage 的闭式表达，它完全由 policy 内部的 log-ratio 量构成，不需要额外 value head。作者还把它扩展成类似 GAE 的多步聚合版本，用于更平滑的 token-level advantage。

和 GRPO 的关键区别，是 advantage 不再整段共享，而是随 token 位置变化；和 PPO / VAPO 的关键区别，是没有单独训练 critic。和一些后处理式 token credit 方法相比，VIMPO 不是在 trajectory advantage 上再乘一个启发式权重，而是从 KL-regularized objective 的最优性条件直接推出来的，因此理论上更自洽。

从方法取舍看，VIMPO 仍然依赖 reference model 和 KL 框架，也仍然需要 group rollouts 来估计初始 value 或回报目标，所以它不是完全摆脱 RLVR 现有范式，而是在现有范式内把 credit assignment 做细。
summary.experiments:
从全文给出的信息看，实验重点是和 GRPO 做对比，任务集中在需要可验证奖励的推理场景。作者的主结论有两条：一是 VIMPO 在调好超参后训练上升更快，验证准确率更高；二是在 reward noise 存在时，两者都会退化，但 VIMPO 更稳，说明 token-level、Bellman-consistent 的优势估计比整段广播更不容易被噪声放大。

摘要和正文片段没有给出完整数表，但实验设计逻辑比较明确：会比较训练曲线、最终验证性能，以及 noisy reward 条件下的鲁棒性。若正文中包含 GAE-style 聚合、KL 系数、group size、reference 冻结方式等消融，这些会比单一最终分数更重要，因为 VIMPO 的收益高度依赖 value recurrence 是否稳定、以及 token-level advantage 的方差是否可控。

从研究判断看，这篇的实验说服力主要取决于三点：第一，是否在长输出任务上明显优于 GRPO，而不是只在短答案任务上有小幅提升；第二，是否展示了无需 critic 仍能得到更合理的 token 级 credit，而不是仅靠更强超参；第三，噪声奖励实验是否覆盖不同噪声强度，而不是单点比较。若这些部分做得完整，方法就不只是一个理论改写。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议按推导链条来读。

先看把 autoregressive generation 写成 deterministic MDP 的部分，以及 KL-regularized objective 的定义。这里决定了后面 value recurrence 的成立条件。若这一步没看清，后面的“implicit value”会显得像技巧而不是结构性结果。

然后重点看 value recurrence 和 terminal boundary condition V(s_T)=0 的推导。这是整篇最值得读的地方。要确认作者到底推导出了什么量、它和 soft value / standard value 的关系是什么、为什么不需要单独 critic 也能形成 Bellman-consistent 目标。

第三，看 actor update 那一节，尤其是 one-step TD advantage 和 GAE-style 扩展。这里决定它到底是不是一个可用的 RL 算法，而不只是一个 value identity。

最后再看实验。建议优先看训练曲线、reward noise 实验、以及和 GRPO 在长序列任务上的差异。如果时间有限，30 分钟可以抓住主要思想；若要判断是否值得复现，最好再花 20 分钟检查附录里的推导假设和实现细节，比如 KL 形式、group Monte Carlo 估计、以及 advantage 截断或归一化方式。

summary_en.core_problem: VIMPO targets a practical tension in RL with verifiable rewards for LLMs. Critic-free methods such as GRPO are simple and often stable, but they usually broadcast the same trajectory-level advantage to every token in a completion, which gives very coarse credit assignment. Actor-critic methods provide token-level learning signals, but they require a separately trained value function and inherit all the usual critic calibration and co-adaptation issues. The paper argues that this trade-off is not necessary: under KL-regularized autoregressive generation, one can derive a policy-implied value recurrence from policy/reference log-ratios and recover token-level credit assignment without learning an explicit critic.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training paper, but it matters for foundation-model researchers because it reorganizes the relationship between policy, reference model, reward, and value in KL-regularized RLHF/RLVR. Two ideas stand out. First, the reference model is not only a KL anchor; it can also serve as the coordinate system from which internal training signals are derived. Second, poor credit assignment in critic-free RL is not an unavoidable consequence of removing the value network. It is partly a consequence of not fully exploiting the optimality structure of the KL-regularized objective. VIMPO offers a middle path: keep the simplicity of grouped rollouts, but recover Bellman-consistent token-level supervision through an implicit value construction. That is especially relevant for long-form reasoning and code generation, where sequence-level broadcasting is a poor fit.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper models autoregressive generation as a deterministic-transition MDP. The state is the prompt plus the generated prefix, the action is the next token, and the episode ends with an outcome reward, together with a KL penalty relative to a frozen reference policy.

The key derivation comes from the optimality conditions of KL-regularized policy optimization. Instead of learning a separate value function V(s), the method expresses a value recurrence in terms of the policy/reference log-likelihood ratio. Intuitively, the extent to which the current policy departs from the reference at a given token already encodes information about future reward versus KL cost. With the terminal boundary condition V(s_T)=0, the recurrence can be closed along the generated trajectory. Since the initial value still needs to be tied to external outcome rewards, the paper uses Monte Carlo estimates from grouped rollouts, similar in spirit to RLVR practice, to provide trajectory-level targets.

This leads to two training components. The first is a critic-free value optimization objective: not a separate critic network, but a Bellman-consistency loss that forces the policy-implied value to match Monte Carlo returns. The second is the actor update: the same derivation yields a closed-form one-step temporal-difference advantage expressed entirely through policy-internal log-ratio quantities. The paper further extends this with a GAE-style multi-step aggregation to reduce variance and provide smoother token-level advantages.

Relative to GRPO, the main difference is that the advantage is no longer constant across the whole trajectory. Relative to PPO or VAPO, the main difference is that there is no separately trained critic. Relative to heuristic token-credit methods layered on top of group-relative RL, VIMPO is derived directly from the KL-regularized objective rather than from a post hoc reweighting rule.

In terms of design trade-offs, VIMPO still lives inside the standard RLVR setup: it depends on a frozen reference model, a KL term, and grouped rollouts for Monte Carlo estimation. The novelty is not abandoning that framework, but making credit assignment much finer within it.
summary_en.experiments:
From the available full-text content, the empirical focus is a comparison against GRPO on reasoning tasks with verifiable rewards. The headline claims are straightforward: with tuned hyperparameters, VIMPO improves faster during training and reaches higher validation accuracy; under noisy rewards, both methods degrade, but VIMPO degrades less, suggesting that Bellman-consistent token-level advantages are more robust than trajectory-wide broadcasting.

The excerpt does not include the full result tables, so the exact gains, model sizes, and benchmark details are not visible here. Still, the experimental logic is clear. The important evidence should include training curves, final validation performance, and robustness under reward corruption. If the full paper contains ablations on GAE-style aggregation, KL coefficient, group size, reference freezing, or advantage normalization, those are likely more informative than a single end metric because VIMPO’s practical value depends on whether the implicit recurrence remains numerically stable and whether token-level advantages have manageable variance.

The paper’s empirical strength therefore hinges on three questions. Does it show a clear advantage over GRPO on genuinely long outputs rather than only short-answer tasks? Does it demonstrate that the gain comes from better credit assignment rather than from heavier tuning? And does the noisy-reward study sweep multiple noise levels rather than report a single stress point? If those pieces are present, the method is more than a theoretical reformulation.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in the order of the derivation.

Start with the deterministic MDP formulation of autoregressive generation and the exact KL-regularized objective. Those assumptions determine what kind of value identity can be derived later. Without that setup, the implicit-value construction can look like a trick rather than a structural consequence.

Then focus on the value recurrence and the terminal boundary condition V(s_T)=0. This is the core of the paper. The main thing to verify is what value quantity is being represented, how it differs from soft-value formulations, and why Bellman consistency can be enforced without a separate critic network.

Next, read the actor-update section carefully, especially the one-step TD advantage and the GAE-style extension. That section determines whether the method is a usable RL algorithm or merely an interesting value identity.

Only after that should you inspect the experiments. Prioritize training curves, noisy-reward results, and comparisons with GRPO on long-sequence tasks. A 30-minute skim is enough to capture the main idea. If the goal is to decide on reproduction, spend another 20 minutes on the appendix to check the derivation assumptions and implementation details such as the KL form, grouped Monte Carlo estimation, and any clipping or normalization used for the token-level advantage.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看推导和 ablation，不一定改写 RLVR 范式，但如果你在嫌 critic 不稳、又嫌 GRPO 太糙，至少应复现它的 value recurrence 看信号是否真更干净。
recommendation.en: Read the derivation and ablations: it may not redefine RLVR, but if you dislike unstable critics and find GRPO too coarse, this implicit value recurrence is worth reproducing to test whether the signal is actually cleaner.

paper.title: Beyond Entropy: Learning from Token-Level Distributional Deviations for LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has significantly advanced Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning; however, it faces a fundamental optimization instability: uniform token updates precipitate entropy collapse, leading to premature convergence to suboptimal strategies, whereas excessive Shannon Entropy maximization can cause entropy explosion, driving blind exploration toward incoherent reasoning chains. To resolve this dichotomy, we introduce the Independent Combinatorial Toke

summary.core_problem: RLVR（带可验证奖励的 RL）训练 LLM 推理时，对所有 token 均匀施加策略梯度容易造成熵塌缩到次优策略；而单纯用 Shannon entropy 做强探索又会导致熵爆炸和无方向的胡乱探索。问题在于只用一个标量熵值无法刻画哪些 token 才是真正决定推理分支的关键位置。
summary.importance: 这篇工作属于 post-train / RL 训练信号设计方向，但对理解“预训练后阶段里哪些 token 承载主要学习信号”有启发。核心观察是：token 层面的重要性不应该只用熵这个不确定性标量衡量，而要看 token 分布相对序列平均分布的偏离程度。这个视角与 reward hacking、credit assignment、稀疏有效更新等问题直接相关。更实际的意义是，他们报告只更新约 10% 的 token 就能匹配或超过全量更新，这对降低 RLVR 计算成本和稳定训练都有价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ICT（Independent Combinatorial Tokens）框架。核心做法是：对每个 token 位置的 logit 分布，计算它与该序列上 token 分布的平均之间的 Jensen-Shannon divergence；JS 散度大的 token，代表其分布形态偏离整体，被视为关键分支点/unique token。训练时只对这些 top-k（如 top 10%）unique token 保留梯度，其余 token 的 policy gradient 被 mask 掉。这样梯度更新集中在真正决定推理路径分岔的位置，而不是对所有 token 一视同仁地推高或压低熵。论文从信息论直觉出发，证明这类分布独特的 token 对应关键 branching points，选择性更新能同时避免 entropy collapse 和 entropy explosion，实现隐式熵控。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen2.5 系列 0.5B、1.5B、7B 上做数学/代码类 RLVR 实验，覆盖七个推理 benchmark。结果显示只更新 top 10% distributionally unique tokens，性能可以匹配或超过全参数/全 token 更新；相比 GRPO、20-Entropy、STAPO 等强基线，平均 pass@4 提升约 4.37%、4.98%、4.38%，最大增益达 14.9%。论文还做了消融说明 JS 散度选 token 优于直接用 Shannon entropy 选高熵 token：高熵 token 只代表不确定，不代表有明确的有效探索方向。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，重点看 logit 分布偏离的定义、为什么 JS 比 Shannon entropy 更适合选关键 token，以及稀疏梯度只更新 10% token 的实验设置和结果。图 1 关于“相同熵但分布形态不同”的示意值得看，方法部分和实验表格是核心。理论证明部分可粗读，重点抓直觉。预计阅读时间 25–40 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In RL with verifiable rewards for LLM reasoning, applying policy gradients uniformly across all tokens often causes entropy collapse to suboptimal strategies, while indiscriminate Shannon-entropy-based exploration leads to entropy explosion and undirected search. A scalar entropy value is insufficient to identify which tokens actually determine critical reasoning branches.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training/RL credit-assignment paper, but it bears on a broader pretrain-relevant question: which tokens carry the effective learning signal in late-stage policy optimization. The useful observation is that token importance should not be measured by entropy alone; distributional shape relative to surrounding tokens matters. The practical claim is also strong: updating only around 10% of tokens can match or exceed full updates, with implications for RLVR stability and compute efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes ICT (Independent Combinatorial Tokens). For each token position, ICT computes the Jensen-Shannon divergence between that token’s logit distribution and the sequence-level average token distribution. Tokens with large JS divergence are treated as unique tokens, i.e., critical branching points. During policy optimization, gradients are retained only for these top-k tokens (e.g., top 10%), while other tokens are masked. This concentrates policy-gradient updates on decision points that steer reasoning trajectories, rather than uniformly pushing entropy up or down across all positions. The paper argues theoretically that these distributionally unique tokens encode directional exploration information, enabling implicit entropy control without directly regularizing Shannon entropy.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use Qwen2.5 models from 0.5B to 7B across seven reasoning benchmarks. Updating only the top 10% distributionally unique tokens matches or outperforms full-gradient training. Against strong baselines including GRPO, 20-Entropy, and STAPO, ICT reports average pass@4 gains of 4.37%, 4.98%, and 4.38%, with maximum gains up to 14.9%. Ablations support the claim that JS-based token selection is more effective than selecting high-Shannon-entropy tokens, since high entropy indicates uncertainty but not necessarily useful exploration direction.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for the token-selection idea and the sparse-update results. The most important sections are the motivation on why entropy is insufficient, the definition of distributional uniqueness via JS divergence, and the experiments showing strong performance with only 10% of token gradients. Figure 1 on equal-entropy but distributionally different logits is a useful intuition pump. Theoretical proofs can be read lightly. Estimated reading time: 25–40 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和熵分析部分；若实验 setup 干净，ICT 值得作为 RLVR token-level update 的内部 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the method and entropy analysis; if the setup is clean, ICT is worth an internal ablation for token-level RLVR updates.

paper.title: CARE: Competence-Aware Reward Shaping for Adaptive Reasoning Length in Video-MLLMs
paper.abstract: In multimodal video reasoning, reinforcement learning-based methods typically rely on simplistic and inflexible reasoning-length control strategies that fail to adapt to the model's evolving competence. This mismatch may suppress necessary exploration at early stages, while encouraging redundant reasoning and inefficient decoding once the model becomes more competent. In this paper, we propose CARE, a competence-aware reward shaping framework for adaptive reasoning length optimization in multimo

summary.core_problem: 在视频多模态推理的 RL 训练中，根据模型能力变化自适应控制推理长度，避免早期探索不足和后期冗长输出。
summary.importance: 贡献是后训练 reward shaping 方法，针对 reasoning length 的训练信号设计。它对 RLVR、推理预算控制和多模态 post-train 有一定参考，但属于较局部的 reward 工程。
summary.technical_approach: CARE 用 pass rate 的指数滑动平均估计模型 competence，并据此把训练路由到不同阶段：早期偏好较长推理以鼓励探索，后期偏好简洁推理以提升解码效率。它还用 batch-level 统计归一化 reasoning effort，避免把任务难度和啰嗦程度混在一起，并加入 posterior amplifier 强化奖励信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供模型规模、视频数据规模、基线和具体提升幅度；实验应比较固定长度惩罚、简单 brevity reward、无 competence routing 的 RL 训练，以及视频问答/视频推理准确率与输出长度的权衡。
summary.authors_note: Tat-Seng Chua 是多媒体与信息检索领域的知名研究者，长期参与多模态理解与视频相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies adaptive reasoning-length control during RL training for video MLLM reasoning, avoiding under-exploration early and verbose decoding later.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a reward-shaping method for post-training, focused on the training signal for reasoning length. It is relevant to RLVR, reasoning-budget control, and multimodal post-training, but remains a local reward-engineering proposal.
summary_en.technical_approach: CARE estimates model competence using an exponential moving average of pass rates, then routes training through stages that shift the reward preference from longer exploratory reasoning to concise efficient reasoning. It normalizes reasoning effort with batch-level statistics and adds a posterior amplifier to strengthen reward signals.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model size, video data scale, baselines, or numerical gains. The expected comparisons include fixed length penalties, simple brevity rewards, RL without competence routing, and trade-offs between video reasoning accuracy and output length.
summary_en.authors_note: Tat-Seng Chua is a well-known researcher in multimedia and information retrieval, with extensive work on multimodal and video understanding.

recommendation.zh: 只看 reward 公式和 competence 分段；长度控制思想可迁移到 RLVR，但结论别外推到纯文本推理。
recommendation.en: Read only the reward formula and competence staging; the length-control idea may transfer to RLVR, but do not overgeneralize it to text-only reasoning.

paper.title: Reasoning as Intersection: Consensus-Frame Alignment for Visual Focus in Video-MLLMs
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning has improved the reasoning ability of large language models, but applying outcome-only rewards to video multimodal large language models (Video-MLLMs) provides limited guidance on which visual evidence should support the answer. Inspired by multisensory integration, where consistent cues can enhance the salience and reliability of perceptual estimates, we introduce Consensus Frame GRPO (CF-GRPO), a temporal-annotation-free process-level reward framework for evidence-aware

summary.core_problem: 视频多模态大模型采用纯结果奖励的RL训练时，无法指导模型选择支撑答案的视觉证据，而现有过程级奖励依赖昂贵的人工时序标注。
summary.importance: 提出无需人工时序标注的视频MLLM过程级RL奖励框架，属于多模态对齐方法的增量改进。
summary.technical_approach: 提出CF-GRPO框架，从视频内在信号（时序覆盖、场景切换、查询条件视觉相关性）构造共识帧先验，从模型视觉与响应表示计算帧使用分数，通过二者对齐构造共识帧奖励，结合显著性稀疏聚合与分布锐化提供高对比度奖励信号。
summary.experiments: 在多个视频推理基准上验证，相比纯结果奖励的GRPO基线提升视频推理性能，全程无需人工时序标注。

summary_en.core_problem: Outcome-only RL rewards for video-MLLMs provide no guidance on selecting answer-supporting visual evidence, while existing process-level rewards rely on expensive human temporal annotations.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a temporal-annotation-free process-level reward framework for video-MLLM RL training, representing an incremental improvement in multimodal alignment methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: CF-GRPO constructs a consensus frame prior from intrinsic video signals (temporal coverage, scene transitions, query-conditioned visual relevance), computes model-side frame-use scores from visual and response representations, and aligns the two to form the Consensus Frame Reward, augmented with salience-aware sparse aggregation and distribution sharpening for high-contrast training signals.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on multiple video reasoning benchmarks, showing consistent improvements over outcome-only GRPO baselines without requiring any human temporal annotations.

recommendation.zh: 视频MLLM特化的GRPO奖励设计，无通用LLM场景验证，了解核心思路即可，无需细读正文
recommendation.en: A video-MLLM-specific GRPO reward design without validation on general LLM setups; note the core idea but no deep read needed.

paper.title: SFT Overtraining Predicts Rank Inversion via Entropy Collapse Under RLVR
paper.abstract: The standard heuristic of selecting the SFT checkpoint with the highest pass@1 for GRPO can fail when SFT compresses the rollout distribution. For binary rewards, the expected within group advantage variance is $p(1{-}p)(g{-}1)/g$; when early GRPO drives $p$ below $p^*(g)$, most groups have identical rewards and provide no group relative signal. We study SFT depth ladders for Qwen2.5-Coder-3B and DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B. We test Qwen2.5-Coder-3B across five depths and three seeds, and DeepSeek-Coder

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 SFT checkpoint 选择如何影响后续 RLVR，核心问题是：用 SFT 后 pass@1 最高的 checkpoint 做 GRPO，可能因为输出分布熵塌缩而得到更差的 RL 结果。它关注的不是 RL 算法本身是否有效，而是 SFT 训练深度如何改变 rollout 分布，从而改变 GRPO 可用的组内相对优势信号。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对 pretrain/posttrain 接口有直接启发。常见做法把 SFT 看成提高初始能力的阶段，默认 SFT 指标越高越适合接 RL。论文给出一个反例：更深的 SFT 提高 greedy pass@1，却压缩采样分布，导致 RLVR 需要的 reward variance 消失。对基座训练研究来说，这提示评估 checkpoint 时不能只看单点正确率，还要看采样温度下的熵、pass@k 形态和 reward 方差。它也解释了为什么某些模型在 SFT 后看似更强，但 RL 训练阶段难以继续提升：训练信号已经被上游 SFT 压窄。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先给出一个简单但有用的二元 reward 分析。对于 group size 为 g 的 GRPO，如果单个 rollout 成功概率为 p，组内 advantage variance 的期望为 p(1-p)(g-1)/g。当 p 接近 0 或 1 时，组内样本大多得到相同 reward，relative advantage 变小；当早期 GRPO 把 p 推到低于某个 p*(g) 区间时，多数组会变成全错组，几乎没有可学习信号。实验部分用 SFT depth ladder 隔离训练深度变量：同一 base model、同一数据、同一超参，只改变 SFT epoch，再把各 checkpoint 接到相同 GRPO recipe。论文重点比较 Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Base 和 DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B-Base。Qwen 出现 rank inversion：SFT 越深，pre-RL pass@1 越高，但 GRPO 后 peak pass@10 越低。DeepSeek 则处在更安全的区间，pass@1 保持在 p*(8) 之上，GRPO 排名只是压缩而非反转。论文还测试 KL penalty 和 label smoothing，发现不能救回已经熵塌缩的 checkpoint，说明问题主要发生在 RL 之前。
summary.experiments: 实验设置较干净。Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Base 使用 5 个 SFT 深度、3 个随机种子；DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B-Base 使用 4 个匹配深度、3 个随机种子。SFT 数据为 5,000 个中等难度 KodCode-V1 问题，和 HumanEval、MBPP 做 embedding 去污染，阈值 0.70，丢弃 20.8% 候选池。CoT 由 Gemini 2.5 Flash 重新生成，目标是较短推理，median 518 tokens，以适配 2,048 context。SFT 使用 BF16 LoRA，r=128、alpha=128，作用于所有 linear layers 和 embeddings；AdamW 8-bit，learning rate 1e-5，batch size 16，constant schedule，weight decay 0.001，并有 100 step 的格式 warmup。GRPO 训练集来自未用于 SFT 的 KodCode-V1，经过三轮去污染；用中间 checkpoint 做 16 次采样校准，T=1.0、top_p=0.95，只保留 pass_count 在 1 到 14 的题，Qwen 得到 1,096 条，DeepSeek 得到 1,104 条。每个 checkpoint 做 400 step GRPO/DAPO，group size 8，beta=0，无 KL penalty，learning rate 1e-6，gradient clip 0.1。关键结果是 Qwen 上 pre-RL pass@1 随 SFT 深度上升，但 peak GRPO pass@10 从 0.806 降到 0.481，且最高 pass@1 checkpoint 在每个 seed 中都输给更浅 checkpoint。pre-RL entropy 与 GRPO 结果正相关。DeepSeek 上没有出现同样的排序反转，而是排名差距被压缩。KL penalty 和 label smoothing 对 Qwen 的塌缩 checkpoint 没有救回效果。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读理论推导、SFT depth ladder 结果图、entropy/reward-variance 诊断三部分。理论推导给出 p(1-p)(g-1)/g，值得检查它如何连接到 GRPO 的组内 advantage 信号。实验结果要重点看 Qwen 的 rank inversion：pre-RL pass@1 上升，但 post-RL pass@10 下降，这比单个指标相关性更有信息。诊断部分建议看 entropy、reward variance、degenerate group 比例和不同 SFT 深度的 rollout 分布。DeepSeek 对照也很重要，它说明结论不是“深 SFT 一定有害”，而是当 SFT 把采样分布压到低熵区域时，RLVR 风险上升。预计精读需要 45 到 60 分钟；如果只服务于 checkpoint 选择，可以先看 Methods、§4 和 Appendix A.3。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a failure mode in the SFT-to-RLVR handoff: choosing the SFT checkpoint with the best pass@1 can lead to worse GRPO outcomes when SFT has compressed the rollout distribution. The issue is not whether RLVR works in general, but whether the selected checkpoint still provides enough stochastic reward variation for group-relative optimization.
summary_en.importance: The result is directly relevant to the interface between pretraining, SFT, and RL. A stronger greedy checkpoint is not necessarily a better RL initialization. If SFT overtraining collapses entropy at the sampling temperature used by GRPO, most rollouts in a group may receive identical binary rewards, removing the relative advantage signal. This suggests that checkpoint selection should include rollout entropy, pass@k shape, and reward-variance diagnostics, not only pass@1. It also gives a concrete mechanism for a common observation: a model can look better after longer SFT yet become harder to improve with RL.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper starts from a binary-reward analysis. For GRPO with group size g and per-rollout success probability p, the expected within-group advantage variance is p(1-p)(g-1)/g. When p is close to 0 or 1, groups are likely to have identical rewards and contribute little group-relative signal. The empirical design isolates SFT depth as the main variable. The authors train ladders of SFT checkpoints with the same architecture, data, hyperparameters, and evaluation protocol, then run the same GRPO recipe from each checkpoint. The main ladder uses Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Base; a contrastive ladder uses DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B-Base. On Qwen, deeper SFT increases pre-RL pass@1 but reduces the best post-GRPO pass@10, producing a rank inversion. On DeepSeek, the checkpoints remain in a safer regime and the GRPO rankings compress rather than invert. KL regularization and label smoothing are tested as interventions, but they do not rescue the collapsed Qwen checkpoints, indicating that the failure is upstream of these GRPO variants.
summary_en.experiments: The Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Base study uses five SFT depths and three seeds. The DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B-Base study uses four matched depths and three seeds. SFT uses 5,000 medium-difficulty KodCode-V1 problems, decontaminated against HumanEval and MBPP with an embedding cosine threshold of 0.70, dropping 20.8% of the pool. Chain-of-thought traces are regenerated with Gemini 2.5 Flash, with a median length of 518 tokens, to fit a 2,048-token context. Training uses BF16 LoRA with rank 128 and alpha 128 on all linear layers and embeddings, AdamW 8-bit, learning rate 1e-5, batch size 16, a constant schedule, weight decay 0.001, and a 100-step format warmup. The GRPO data is drawn from held-out KodCode-V1 problems and decontaminated in three passes. A middle checkpoint performs 16 stochastic rollouts per problem at T=1.0 and top_p=0.95; only problems with pass_count from 1 to 14 are kept, giving 1,096 Qwen records and 1,104 DeepSeek records. Each checkpoint is trained for 400 GRPO/DAPO steps with group size 8, beta 0, learning rate 1e-6, and gradient clipping at 0.1. On Qwen, peak GRPO pass@10 falls from 0.806 to 0.481 as SFT depth increases, even though pre-RL pass@1 rises. The highest-pass@1 SFT checkpoint loses to shallower checkpoints in every seed. Pre-RL entropy is positively associated with the GRPO outcome. DeepSeek does not show the same inversion, supporting the paper’s claim that entropy collapse, not SFT depth alone, is the risk signal.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the variance derivation first, especially the p(1-p)(g-1)/g result and how it maps to group-relative learning signal. Then inspect the SFT-depth ladder plots for Qwen: the key evidence is the divergence between rising pre-RL pass@1 and falling post-RL pass@10. The entropy and reward-variance diagnostics are the most useful parts for practice, because they translate the failure into measurable checkpoint-selection signals. The DeepSeek comparison should not be skipped; it clarifies that deeper SFT is not automatically harmful, but becomes risky when it compresses the sampled rollout distribution. A focused reading of the methods, main results, and Appendix A.3 should take about 45 to 60 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 直接推翻“选SFT最高pass@1做RL”的默认启发式，熵信号可立即加入内部SFT/RL checkpoint筛选流水线，建议优先复现两阶段诊断逻辑。
recommendation.en: Directly overturns the default heuristic of selecting the highest-pass@1 SFT checkpoint for RL; entropy signals can be immediately added to internal SFT/RL checkpoint selection pipelines, and the two-stage diagnostic logic is worth prioritizing for reproduction.

paper.title: STARE: Surprisal-Guided Token-Level Advantage Reweighting for Policy Entropy Stability
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards algorithms like GRPO have emerged as the dominant post-training paradigm for complex reasoning in LLMs, yet commonly suffer from policy entropy collapse during training. We conduct a first-order gradient analysis of token-level entropy dynamics under GRPO and identify a token-level credit assignment mismatch: the per-token entropy variation decomposes into the product of the trajectory-level advantage and an entropy sensitivity function over the nex

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 GRPO/RLVR 训练中的策略熵塌缩问题。关键点不是简单给 loss 加 entropy bonus，而是解释为什么同一个 trajectory-level advantage 作用到整条回复时，会在 token 级别产生错误的熵信用分配。正 advantage 的样本里，高频、低 surprisal token 往往主导梯度，并推动分布变尖；真正可能维持探索的高 surprisal token 因采样频率低而被稀释。负 advantage 样本中也存在对应的反向失衡。这会让 rollout 很快同质化，组内相对优势估计变差，限制长步数 RL 训练。
summary.importance: 这篇论文的价值在于把 RLVR 的熵稳定问题从 trajectory 粒度推进到 token 粒度。对预训练研究员也有参考意义，因为当前推理能力提升越来越依赖 pretrain、mid-train、post-train 之间的闭环，而 RL 阶段的训练信号质量和探索稳定性会反过来影响数据生成、长 CoT 分布和后续继续预训练的目标。STARE 的贡献量级不在于提出一个复杂的新 RL 框架，而在于给出一个可解释、低侵入的 credit reweighting 机制：只改 GRPO clipped surrogate 内的 token 权重，并用目标熵闭环控制是否启用。它提供了一个实用信号：RLVR 的熵塌缩可以通过少量 token 子集上的 advantage 重配来调节，不一定需要大幅改变 clip、KL 或全局 entropy regularization。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先对 GRPO 下 token-level entropy dynamics 做一阶梯度分析。每个 token 的熵变化可以分解为 trajectory-level advantage 与一个由 next-token distribution 决定的局部 entropy sensitivity function 的乘积。这个分解导出 advantage-surprisal 四象限结构：正 advantage/低 surprisal token 倾向于降低熵，正 advantage/高 surprisal token 倾向于提高熵；负 advantage 下方向相反。由于低 surprisal token 出现频率高，它们在实际梯度中占主导，造成熵下降偏置。论文进一步提出 near-criticality：只要对特定 token 的权重做温和扰动，就能翻转 batch-level entropy evolution 的方向；超过临界点后，权重主要影响熵变化幅度，而不是方向。STARE 据此做三件事。第一，用 batch 内 surprisal 分位数识别 entropy-critical token，而不是依赖绝对阈值，这使方法对模型尺度和任务分布更稳。第二，对正 advantage 的高 surprisal token 放大 effective advantage，对负 advantage 的高 surprisal token 降低 effective advantage，从而补偿稀有探索 token 在梯度中的弱势。第三，引入 target-entropy closed-loop gate：当 batch 平均熵低于目标熵时启用重加权，熵恢复后退回普通 GRPO。与 DAPO 的 clip-higher 相比，STARE 不依赖 importance ratio 明显偏离 1；在近 on-policy 训练中也能直接作用于 token credit。与 entropy bonus 相比，它不统一推高所有高熵位置，而是只干预由 surprisal 和 advantage 共同定义的关键 token。
summary.experiments: 论文覆盖 1.5B 到 32B 模型，以及 Short CoT、Long CoT、多轮 tool-use agent 三类任务。报告中最重要的训练稳定性结果是：7B 模型上 STARE 可以稳定训练超过 5k RL steps；14B 和 32B 模型上可以稳定超过 1.5k steps；训练期间 policy entropy 被维持在目标区间内。效果上，STARE 在 AIME24 和 AIME25 上相对 DAPO 有稳定提升，平均准确率提升约 4% 到 8%。论文还报告了 reflection-related tokens 和 response length 随训练增长，说明方法没有单纯压制生成长度或把策略固定到短答案，而是在保持探索的同时继续强化长推理行为。消融层面，最值得关注的是 surprisal token 子集选择、不同重加权强度、目标熵门控、以及与 DAPO clip-higher/entropy-aware advantage reshaping 的对比。near-criticality 的实验如果成立，说明权重超参不需要精细调到某个窄区间，这对大规模 RL 工程很重要。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Section 3 的 entropy dynamics 推导，这是论文的核心。重点看 per-token entropy variation 如何写成 advantage 与 sensitivity function 的乘积，以及四象限图如何解释正负样本中的熵变化方向。随后看 STARE 算法部分，尤其是 batch-internal surprisal quantile 的定义、positive/negative advantage 下的重加权规则、target entropy gate 的触发条件。实验部分优先看训练曲线，而不是只看最终准确率：policy entropy、reward、response length、reflection token 频率、组内 rollout 多样性这些曲线能判断方法是否真的延长了可训练区间。附录中的消融和超参敏感性也值得看，尤其是 near-criticality 的证据、不同模型尺度下目标熵设定是否需要重调、以及对 tool-use 场景的失败样例分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses policy entropy collapse in GRPO-style RLVR training. The central issue is not merely the lack of an entropy bonus. It is a token-level credit assignment mismatch: a single trajectory-level advantage is applied to every token in a rollout, while each token has a different local effect on entropy. In positive-advantage rollouts, frequent low-surprisal tokens dominate the gradient and tend to sharpen the policy. Rare high-surprisal tokens, which could preserve exploration, are underrepresented. A mirrored imbalance appears in negative-advantage rollouts. This homogenizes rollouts, weakens group-relative advantage estimation, and limits long-horizon RL training.
summary_en.importance: The paper is useful because it turns entropy stability in RLVR from a trajectory-level heuristic problem into a token-level training-dynamics problem. This matters for foundation-model training because RLVR is now part of the feedback loop between pretraining, reasoning data generation, and continued training. If the RL stage collapses exploration too early, it also biases the distribution of long-CoT traces and synthetic reasoning data. STARE is not a large new RL framework. Its contribution is a low-intrusion reweighting mechanism inside the GRPO clipped surrogate, governed by a target-entropy feedback gate. The practical message is that entropy collapse can be controlled by rebalancing the advantage of a small set of entropy-critical tokens, rather than by globally changing clipping, KL penalties, or entropy regularization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper derives a first-order analysis of token-level entropy dynamics under GRPO. The entropy change of a token decomposes into the product of the trajectory-level advantage and a local entropy sensitivity function determined by the next-token distribution. This yields an advantage-surprisal quadrant view: positive-advantage low-surprisal tokens tend to decrease entropy, positive-advantage high-surprisal tokens tend to increase it, and the signs are reversed under negative advantage. Since low-surprisal tokens occur much more often, the realized update is biased toward entropy reduction. The authors also identify a near-criticality property: a mild perturbation to the weights of specific tokens can flip the direction of entropy evolution; beyond the critical threshold, the weight mostly controls magnitude rather than sign. STARE uses this observation in three steps. It selects entropy-critical tokens using batch-internal surprisal quantiles, amplifies the effective advantage of positive-advantage high-surprisal tokens, attenuates that of negative-advantage high-surprisal tokens, and activates the intervention only when batch-averaged entropy falls below a target. Compared with DAPO-style clip-higher, it remains active even when importance ratios stay close to one in near on-policy training. Compared with entropy bonuses, it does not indiscriminately push up entropy at all high-entropy positions.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover model scales from 1.5B to 32B and three regimes: Short CoT, Long CoT, and multi-turn tool-use agents. The main stability result is that STARE sustains more than 5k RL steps on 7B models and more than 1.5k steps on 14B and 32B models, while keeping policy entropy within the target band. On AIME24 and AIME25, it improves average accuracy over DAPO by about 4% to 8%. The paper also reports that reflection-related tokens and response length grow during training, suggesting that the method does not simply suppress generation length or force early convergence to short answers. The most informative ablations are the surprisal-based token subset, the reweighting strength, the target-entropy gate, and comparisons against clip-higher and entropy-aware advantage reshaping. The near-criticality experiments are especially important because they indicate whether the method avoids narrow hyperparameter tuning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read Section 3 carefully. The key contribution is the entropy-dynamics derivation, especially the decomposition into advantage and entropy sensitivity, and the quadrant interpretation of advantage versus surprisal. Then read the STARE algorithm section, focusing on how batch-internal surprisal quantiles define the token subset, how positive and negative advantages are reweighted, and how the target-entropy gate is triggered. In the experiments, prioritize training curves over final accuracy alone: policy entropy, reward, response length, reflection-token frequency, and within-group rollout diversity are the signals that show whether the trainable horizon is actually extended. The appendix ablations are worth checking for evidence of near-criticality, scale-dependent entropy targets, and failure cases in tool-use settings.

recommendation.zh: 从token级梯度分解定位GRPO熵崩根因，提出的重加权方法可直接在RLVR训练中复现，解决实际痛点。
recommendation.en: Identifies the root cause of GRPO entropy collapse via token-level gradient analysis; the proposed reweighting is readily reproducible in RLVR training pipelines.

paper.title: GraphPO: Graph-based Policy Optimization for Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become a standard paradigm for enhancing the capability of large reasoning models. RLVR typically samples responses independently and optimizes the policy using from final answers. This paradigm has two limitations. First, independently responses often contain similar intermediate reasoning steps, causing redundant exploration and wasted computation. Second, sparse final-answer rewards make it hard to identify useful steps. Tree-based met

summary.core_problem: 解决 RLVR 中独立采样导致推理轨迹重复探索、最终答案奖励过稀疏、树搜索又无法跨分支共享相似状态的问题。
summary.importance: 这是后训练阶段针对 reasoning model 的 RL 方法改进。它不直接改 pretrain，但对“如何给长链推理提供更低方差、更细粒度训练信号”有现实启发，属于 pretrain↔post-train 接口上值得关注的工作。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GraphPO，把推理过程从独立样本或树结构扩展为图结构优化。核心动机是：不同分支可能到达相似 reasoning state，图比树更适合共享信息。方法上利用图结构聚合相近中间状态，并在图上做更细粒度的比较与 advantage 估计，以降低方差、减少重复探索。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集和提升幅度，但明确对比对象包括标准 RLVR 和 tree-based 方法。主要实验主张是：GraphPO 能更有效利用相似中间状态，缓解稀疏奖励和重复探索问题。若正文有 clean ablation，重点应看图构建准则、状态相似度定义以及 advantage 估计稳定性。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表中包含 Jingdong Chen、Jun Zhou，通常与工业研究团队相关；但仅凭摘要无法稳妥确认具体机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets two RLVR bottlenecks for reasoning models: redundant exploration from independently sampled trajectories and sparse final-answer rewards, while tree-based methods still fail to share information across similar states reached from different branches.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training RL paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it matters at the pretrain–posttrain interface because it studies how to provide lower-variance, more fine-grained learning signals for long-chain reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: GraphPO extends reasoning optimization from independent samples or trees to graph-structured policy optimization. The key idea is that different branches can converge to similar reasoning states, and a graph can share information across them. The method aggregates similar intermediate states and performs finer-grained comparison and advantage estimation on the graph to reduce variance and avoid repeated exploration.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, or exact gains, but the comparison targets clearly include standard RLVR and tree-based methods. The main empirical claim is that GraphPO uses similar intermediate states more efficiently, mitigating sparse rewards and redundant exploration. In the full paper, the most important parts to inspect would be graph construction, state similarity, and the stability of advantage estimation.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Jingdong Chen and Jun Zhou, which suggests an industry research team, but the exact institution cannot be confirmed from the abstract alone.

recommendation.zh: 这类工作对 pretrain 的价值在训练信号设计，不在 RL 包装；先看它如何定义“相似 reasoning state”，若这一步不干净，后面收益大概率站不住。
recommendation.en: Its value for pretraining researchers is in training-signal design, not the RL wrapper; inspect how it defines similar reasoning states first, because the rest depends on that being clean.

paper.title: Learning from Own Solutions: Self-Conditioned Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has driven substantial progress in training LLMs for reasoning tasks, but representative methods such as GRPO assign uniform credit across all tokens, wasting gradient on routine tokens while under-crediting pivotal reasoning steps. Existing token-level credit assignment methods require resources beyond the model's own rollouts. GRPO variants rely on process reward models or ground-truth answers. Knowledge distillation assigns credit through

summary.core_problem: 主流可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）方法如GRPO对整条 rollout 的所有token分配统一信用，梯度被无决策信息的常规token稀释，对关键推理步骤的信用分配不足；现有token级信用分配方法要么依赖外部过程奖励模型、外部教师模型，要么需要特权信息，无法在仅提供二值验证器的纯RLVR设置下使用。
summary.importance: 该工作提出了不需要任何外部额外资源的token级信用分配方案，对提升RLVR的样本效率、训练稳定性有直接实用价值，其自条件构造信用权重的思路也为RL预训练、推理能力强化阶段的梯度优化提供了新的设计方向。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SC-GRPO（自条件GRPO）方法：1）对每个查询采样一组轨迹，筛选出其中通过验证的正确轨迹；2）将一条正确轨迹作为上下文演示输入模型，计算每个token位置上，原始无演示分布与自条件分布的KL散度；3）论文从理论和实验两方面证明，传统做法将该KL作为辅助蒸馏损失会在存在多条正确轨迹时让模型收敛到多轨迹加权平均的不可行解，因此SC-GRPO将KL散度作为GRPO梯度的乘性权重：奖励决定梯度更新方向，KL值决定每个token位置的更新强度；4）对于没有任何正确轨迹的查询组，使用随机采样的轨迹作为参考，KL信号作为探索奖励鼓励轨迹多样性。
summary.experiments: 在覆盖数学、代码、多轮Agent任务的5个基准上，SC-GRPO相比原版GRPO的Average@8指标提升8.1%，相比DAPO提升5.9%，性能优于使用外部教师的在线蒸馏方法，且训练过程更稳定；消融实验验证了加性KL蒸馏确实无法带来性能提升，乘性权重设计是方法生效的核心。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注引言中对现有信用分配方法缺陷的分析、4.2节关于加性蒸馏失效的理论证明、乘性权重与加性损失的消融对比结果，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Mainstream RL with verifiable rewards (RLVR) methods such as GRPO assign uniform credit to all tokens in a rollout, diluting gradients across non-critical routine tokens and underweighting pivotal reasoning steps. Existing token-level credit assignment approaches require external process reward models, external teacher models, or privileged information, making them incompatible with pure RLVR settings where only a binary outcome verifier is available.
summary_en.importance: This work delivers a token-level credit assignment mechanism that requires no external resources beyond the model's own rollouts, providing immediate practical gains for RLVR sample efficiency and training stability. The self-conditioned credit weighting design also offers a new direction for gradient optimization in RL pretraining and reasoning-focused post-training pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: SC-GRPO (Self-Conditioned GRPO) is built on three core design choices: 1) For each query, sample a group of rollouts and identify trajectories that pass verifier checks. 2) Inject one verified correct trajectory as an in-context demonstration, compute per-token KL divergence between the original next-token distribution and the self-conditioned distribution. 3) The paper proves theoretically and verifies empirically that using this KL as an auxiliary distillation loss leads to convergence to an infeasible weighted average of multiple correct trajectories. Instead, SC-GRPO applies the KL value as a multiplicative weight on standard GRPO gradients: rewards determine update direction, while KL magnitude determines update intensity per token position. For query groups with no correct rollouts, a random trajectory is used as reference, and the KL signal acts as an exploration bonus to encourage trajectory diversity.
summary_en.experiments: Across five benchmarks covering math, code, and multi-turn agentic tasks, SC-GRPO improves Average@8 by 8.1% over vanilla GRPO and 5.9% over DAPO, outperforming on-policy distillation with external teachers while delivering more stable training. Ablation studies confirm that additive distillation formulations fail to improve over GRPO, validating the multiplicative weighting design as the core effective component.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim recommended. Focus on the problem analysis of existing credit assignment flaws in the introduction, the theoretical proof of additive distillation failure in Section 4.2, and the ablation comparison between multiplicative weighting and additive loss designs. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: RLVR 里“哪些 token 该吃梯度”是硬问题；先读 KL credit 的定义和理论反例，实验数字不足时别急着改 recipe。
recommendation.en: Token credit in RLVR is a real bottleneck; read the KL-credit definition and the theoretical failure case before trusting the empirical gains.

paper.title: Sparsity Curse: Understanding RLVR Model Parameter Space from Model Merging
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR) has emerged as a powerful post-training paradigm that surpasses Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) in eliciting reasoning intelligence and resisting catastrophic forgetting. Recent studies further reveal that RLVR induces highly sparse and off-principal parameter updates compared to SFT. This naturally raises the question: does such sparsity make RLVR models more amenable to model merging? If so, model merging would offer a scalable, training-free p

summary.core_problem: RL with Verifiable Reward（RLVR）诱导出的参数更新比 SFT 更稀疏、更少落在主奇异方向上，一个自然猜想是这种稀疏性会让模型合并（model merging）更容易。论文研究 RLVR 模型在参数空间中的可合并性，并解释为什么答案恰好相反。
summary.importance: 对理解 pretrain→RL 的参数几何、post-training 对基座表示的改动方式、以及靠模型合并聚合能力的工程路线都有实际意义。论文给出的核心观察是：稀疏不等于正交可加；RLVR 的更新虽然只改少量参数，但在不同独立训练 run 中落在近乎正交的子空间，形成彼此干扰很强的“shortcut”，这解释了为什么直接平均或传统 task vector 合并对 R1 式推理模型容易失效。对基座研究者来说，这一现象也提示 RLVR 可能不是在共享的稠密主方向上微调，而是在高维空间里沿不同低维路径扩展能力，因而对初始化、随机种子和 reward 噪声更敏感。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从模型合并视角系统比较 SFT 与 RLVR 的更新结构。作者先分析 task vector 的稀疏度、逐层更新方向的正交性、以及激活密度几何，指出 RLVR 的独立更新彼此距离更远、重叠区域存在冲突；随后提出针对 RLVR 的 SAR-Merging：第一步用 Fisher 信息度量参数敏感性，在更新重叠区域解决冲突，优先保留对任务更敏感的参数；第二步对合并后的 task vector 做 magnitude-aware sparsification 与 rescaling，避免把稀疏更新混成稠密噪声，从而保留 RLVR 的稀疏推理通路。方法整体仍是训练-free 的合并 recipe，不是新的 RL 算法。
summary.experiments: 实验主要在数学和代码基准上比较多种标准合并方法（如平均、task arithmetic、现有 RL 合并方法）与 SAR-Merging。论文报告现有方法在 RLVR 模型上会出现严重性能退化，而 SAR-Merging 在单任务增强和多能力融合上明显更稳。需要注意的是，论文属于经验机制分析加针对性 recipe 设计，量级上是 post-training/merging 层面的改进，不是基座训练方法突破；实验重点在于揭示“sparse but orthogonal”的几何现象，而不是给出新的 sota 预训练结论。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。重点看 Figure 1 关于 RLVR 合并失效的现象、参数更新稀疏性和正交性分析、以及 SAR-Merging 里“保稀疏、解冲突”的设计动机。若关心 R1 类 RL 训练对权重空间的影响，可重点读引言和机制分析部分；若只关心工程合并方法，直接看方法和实验表，预计 25–35 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: RL with Verifiable Reward produces parameter updates that are much sparser and more off-principal than those from SFT. The paper asks whether this sparsity makes RLVR models easier to merge, and shows that the opposite holds.
summary_en.importance: The finding is relevant to understanding the parameter-space geometry of post-training, especially R1-style reasoning RL. Sparsity does not imply compatibility: independently trained RLVR models modify small but near-orthogonal sets of directions, so naive merging destroys those pathways. This matters for pretraining–post-training interactions because it suggests RLVR does not simply refine a shared dense subspace, but can carve out fragile, run-specific shortcuts in low-curvature regions. It also explains a practical failure mode when trying to aggregate capabilities from multiple RL checkpoints without retraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first compares SFT and RLVR updates through the lens of model merging, measuring update sparsity, layer-wise orthogonality, and activation-density geometry. The main diagnosis is that RLVR updates are sparse but dispersed, creating strong interference when independently trained task vectors are combined. Building on this, the authors propose SAR-Merging (Sensitivity-aware Resolving Merging): Fisher information is used to resolve conflicts in overlapping update regions by preserving more task-sensitive parameters, followed by magnitude-aware sparsification and rescaling of the merged task vector so that the result remains sparse rather than collapsing into dense noise. The method remains training-free.
summary_en.experiments: On mathematical and coding benchmarks, standard merging methods that work reasonably well for SFT models cause severe degradation on RLVR models, while SAR-Merging gives substantially better results for both single-task improvement and multi-capability fusion. The main empirical contribution is the identification of the sparsity curse itself—sparse, off-principal, near-orthogonal RLVR updates rather than a dense shared update direction—while the proposed merging recipe is a targeted fix for that geometry.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read this for the mechanistic picture of RLVR in weight space, not for a new pretraining algorithm. Prioritize the introduction, the motivating failure figure, the orthogonality/sparsity analyses, and the two design moves in SAR-Merging. Estimated reading time: 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看参数空间分析和 merging 实验；它会修正“RLVR 更新稀疏所以好合并”的直觉，但需确认模型规模。
recommendation.en: Read the parameter-space and merging experiments; it corrects the intuition that sparse RLVR updates should merge well, but check the model scale.

paper.title: Dynamic Rollout Editing for Reducing Overthinking in RL-Trained Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Long-form chain-of-thought reasoning can improve LLM performance on complex tasks, but models often continue generating unnecessary reasoning after a correct answer has emerged. We refer to this behavior as overthinking. We study this phenomenon from the perspective of GRPO-style reinforcement learning (RL) post-training, framing it as a training-time credit-assignment problem rather than merely a decoding-time stopping problem. In rollouts sampled at the onset of GRPO training, we observe that

summary.core_problem: 在 GRPO 这类序列级奖励的 RL post-train 中，模型一旦在 chain-of-thought 里“已经出现可验证正确答案”，后续继续生成冗余推理（overthinking）会被和“到达正确答案的前缀”一起获得正向 credit，从而被训练过程系统性强化。论文要解决的不是解码时怎么停，而是训练时的 credit assignment：如何在不伤害到达正确答案的推理前缀的前提下，削弱成功轨迹中答案出现之后那段冗余 token 的偏好信号。
summary.importance: 把“过度思考”从 decoding/长度控制问题，改写成 GRPO/序列级优势函数带来的结构性训练偏差，并给出一个可落地的训练期干预。对推理模型的 post-train recipe 有直接影响：如果你的 verifier 能定位答案出现点，DRE 这类编辑式偏好学习可以在基本不掉准确率的情况下显著降长度与算力成本，并减少训练后期形成的“反复检查/重复验证/答案回看”模式。更重要的是，它提供了一个通用视角：当 reward 只在序列末端给出且更新对整段轨迹同权时，任何“成功后仍继续生成”的行为都可能被错误归因并固化。
summary.technical_approach:
核心做法是 Dynamic Rollout Editing (DRE)：
1) 让“答案出现”可观测：对每条 rollout，用 parser 抽取中间答案候选，并用外部 verifier 判定正确性，定义最早可验证正确答案出现的位置作为 answer emergence point。这样能把轨迹分成“到达答案的前缀”和“答案后冗余段”。
2) 训练期编辑成功轨迹：当一条成功轨迹在 answer emergence 之后仍有明显 overthinking，构造一个 edited counterpart：保留从开头到一个保守边界（围绕 emergence 点，避免误删必要 token）的 verified prefix，把后续 overthinking 替换/截断为更短的版本（目标是保留正确答案并去掉冗余）。
3) 在同一个 GRPO group 内做相对偏好：把原成功轨迹与 edited 轨迹放在同组比较，让 edited 轨迹获得更高 preference/优势，从而把“成功”的正向信号更多分配给短轨迹，弱化‘成功=长且反复检查’的耦合。
4) 两个训练细节用于避免误伤前缀并稳定学习信号：
- Prefix masking：对原轨迹与 edited 轨迹共享的 verified prefix 不施加负向更新，避免因为偏好 edited 而把到达答案所需的前缀也压下去。
- GClip：在编辑点附近给更可控的学习信号（论文将其作为对 edited tokens/边界处梯度的稳定化手段），避免“硬截断”导致的局部不连续训练效应。
与常见替代方案的差异：
- 不是 length penalty：长度惩罚会同时压制有用推理与无用推理，且对不同题型的最优长度不一致。
- 不是 stopping controller/early-exit：那些方法在策略学成后再控长度；DRE 直接改训练信号，阻断反馈回路。
- 不是对整条成功轨迹降权：那会削弱到达答案的关键前缀；DRE 通过“保前缀、改后缀”的编辑把 credit 分离。
summary.experiments:
全文宣称覆盖数学推理、科学 QA、代码生成等任务，结论集中在两点：
- 长度主要在 answer emergence 之后被削减：DRE 的长度收益不是靠缩短必要推理，而是减少答案出现后的冗余段（反复检查、重复验证、答案回看）。
- 性能基本保持：在保持任务成功率/准确率接近 vanilla GRPO 的同时，显著降低平均生成长度与推理成本，并在不同任务上复现。
给出的机制性证据是：GRPO 训练早期，同一 prompt 下成功轨迹在答案出现后往往比失败轨迹更“长一点”，这个微小偏差在序列级优势更新下会被放大，形成 overthinking 的自增强回路；DRE 通过组内偏好把这个回路切断。
（注：你提供的全文片段未包含具体表格数字、模型规模、数据量与提升幅度；若需要精确数值，需要对照论文的实验表与附录。）
summary.reading_guide:
精读优先级：
- 先看“Overthinking After Answer Emergence”的定义与 parser-verifier 标注流程：它决定了 DRE 是否可迁移到你的任务（能否稳定抽取并验证中间答案）。
- 重点看 GRPO credit assignment 的分析图/统计：成功轨迹在 emergence 后更长的早期偏差，以及训练过程中如何被放大。
- 再看 DRE 的编辑边界策略与两项训练技巧（prefix masking、GClip）：这里是工程可复现的关键，尤其是如何避免误删必要 token、如何处理编辑点附近的梯度不稳定。
- 实验部分建议按“长度分解（emergence 前/后）→ 任务成功率保持 → 不同任务泛化”顺序读，确认收益是否来自正确的段落（答案后）而不是牺牲推理质量。
预计阅读时间：60–90 分钟（含把方法映射到自己 verifier/数据管线的思考）。

summary_en.core_problem: In GRPO-style RL post-training with sequence-level rewards, a rollout can contain both (i) the reasoning prefix that reaches a verifiably correct answer and (ii) redundant tokens generated after the answer has already emerged. Because GRPO assigns the same positive advantage to the whole successful trajectory, it cannot separate credit between these two parts, and it may systematically reinforce “overthinking after answer emergence”. The paper targets this as a training-time credit-assignment issue rather than a decoding-time stopping problem.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a concrete diagnosis of why overthinking can get amplified during GRPO training, plus a training-time intervention that reduces post-answer verbosity without sacrificing task success. Practically, if you can reliably detect the earliest verifiable answer point (via parsing + external verification), the proposed editing-based preference signal can lower inference cost and curb common failure patterns like repeated checking and answer revisiting. Conceptually, it highlights a broader RLHF/RL-posttrain pitfall: whenever reward is terminal and updates are trajectory-level, any behavior that co-occurs with success after the goal is achieved can be inadvertently reinforced.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Dynamic Rollout Editing (DRE) has three pillars:
1) Make “answer emergence” observable: for each sampled trajectory, parse intermediate outputs to extract an answer candidate and use an external verifier to find the earliest position where a correct answer can be verified. This splits tokens into a necessary prefix vs. post-answer continuation.
2) Edit successful overthinking rollouts: when a successful rollout contains substantial continuation after emergence, construct an edited counterpart that preserves a conservative verified prefix up to a safe boundary around the emergence point, and replaces/truncates the remaining overthinking segment while keeping the correct answer.
3) Rewire the GRPO preference within the same group: place the original and edited trajectories in the same GRPO group and prefer the shorter edited one, so the positive learning signal is less coupled with post-answer verbosity.
Two training stabilizers are introduced:
- Prefix masking: avoid directly penalizing the shared verified prefix, preventing degradation of the reasoning needed to reach the answer.
- GClip: provide a controlled learning signal around the edit boundary to mitigate instability caused by hard edits near the cut point.
Key difference from alternatives: it is not a global length penalty (which can suppress useful reasoning), and not a post-hoc stopping controller (which does not change what RL reinforces). It explicitly changes the training signal to decouple success from post-answer continuation.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper reports consistent gains across math reasoning, science QA, and code generation: generation length is reduced primarily after the answer emergence point, while task performance remains close to vanilla GRPO. The mechanistic evidence is that early in GRPO training, successful rollouts for the same prompts already exhibit slightly more post-emergence continuation than unsuccessful ones; sequence-level advantages then amplify this bias over training. DRE breaks this feedback loop by shifting preference toward edited shorter counterparts.
(Note: the provided full-text excerpt does not include the numeric tables/model sizes; exact deltas require checking the main experiment tables and appendix.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read in this order:
- The formal definition and measurement pipeline for answer emergence (parser + verifier). This determines whether DRE is applicable to your domain.
- The analysis section that quantifies the early success/length imbalance and explains how GRPO’s trajectory-level advantage mixes credit.
- The DRE algorithm details: how the conservative boundary is chosen, what exactly is replaced after the edit point, and how prefix masking + GClip are implemented.
- Experiments: focus on length decomposition (pre- vs post-emergence), performance retention, and cross-task robustness.
Time budget: ~60–90 minutes if you also map it to your own verifier/data pipeline.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻复现它的 rollout 诊断；若成立，长 CoT RL 的长度偏置不是解码小毛病。
recommendation.en: Replicate the rollout diagnostics quickly; if it holds, length bias in long-CoT RL is not just a decoding nuisance.

paper.title: Nemotron 3 Ultra: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Model for Agentic Reasoning
paper.abstract: We introduce Nemotron 3 Ultra, a 550 billion total and 55 billion active parameter Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Attention language model. We pre-trained Nemotron 3 Ultra on 20 trillion text tokens, then extended the context length to 1M tokens, and post-trained using Supervised Fine Tuning (SFT), Reinforcement Learning (RL), and Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD). Nemotron 3 Ultra is our most capable model yet, employing multiple key technologies - LatentMoE, Multi Token Prediction (

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是大模型在 agentic reasoning 场景下的精度、长上下文能力和推理吞吐之间的取舍。Nemotron 3 Ultra 试图用 550B total / 55B active 的 MoE hybrid Mamba-Attention 架构，在保持公开模型可比精度的同时，显著降低 attention 成本和 KV cache 压力，并把预训练、长上下文扩展、低精度训练、RL 后训练和推理加速串成一条完整 recipe。
summary.importance: 这是一份对预训练研究有直接参考价值的系统报告。贡献不只在模型分数，而在若干可复用的训练和系统选择：第一，550B 规模上使用 NVFP4 预训练并保持稳定，给低精度预训练提供了大规模证据；第二，hybrid Mamba-Attention 与 MoE 结合，展示了用状态空间层降低长输出场景推理成本的路线；第三，LatentMoE、MTP、WSD 学习率、两阶段数据配比、1M context extension、SFT/RLVR/MOPD 被放在同一模型中验证，提供了一个较完整的 open recipe；第四，报告释放 base、post-trained、NVFP4 checkpoint，以及部分预训练和后训练数据，对复现实验和消融研究有实际意义。
summary.technical_approach:
模型是 550B 总参数、每 token 激活 55B 参数的 Mixture-of-Experts hybrid Mamba-Attention LM。架构延续 Nemotron 3 Super 的设计，使用 LatentMoE 作为 MoE 层，以提升每个激活参数的有效容量；同时混合 Mamba 与 attention，目标是降低长序列推理中的 attention 计算和 KV cache 占用。模型还原生加入 Multi-Token Prediction。MTP 使用两个 head，且两个 head 共享参数，用于训练出更稳的自回归 draft token，服务于 speculative decoding。每个 MTP head 由一个 attention layer 和一个 MoE layer 组成。

预训练使用 20T text tokens，采用 Warmup-Stable-Decay 学习率计划。数据分两阶段：前 15T tokens 强调多样性和领域覆盖，后 5T tokens 强调高质量数据，用于提升模型精度。这种安排接近大规模训练中的“先覆盖、后打磨”：前段用广覆盖保证能力底座，后段用更干净、更高价值的数据降低噪声并改善 benchmark 表现。

低精度训练是报告的重点之一。Nemotron 3 Ultra 使用 NVFP4 预训练，NVFP4 层采用 E2M1 数据类型，对权重做二维 block quantization；wgrad 输入使用 Random Hadamard Transform；梯度使用 stochastic rounding。为了稳定性，最后 15% 网络，也就是 16 层，以及 Mamba output projection、latent projection、QKV 和 attention projection、MTP layers、embedding layers 保持更高精度。这个选择反映了一个工程判断：不是所有矩阵都适合压到 FP4，靠近输出端、注意力投影和嵌入相关层对数值误差更敏感。

后训练路径包括 curated SFT、统一 RLVR、多教师 on-policy distillation。RLVR 覆盖 reasoning、agentic、code、safety、usability、chat 等多类环境。团队还训练了十多个领域教师模型，包括沿专门 agentic SFT 路径训练的教师。MOPD 在学生自己生成的 rollout 上提供 dense token-level guidance，把多个教师的能力合并到 Ultra。模型还支持 reasoning effort control，用于在推理时调节准确率和计算量之间的取舍。
summary.experiments:
关键规模和结果包括：模型为 550B total / 55B active；预训练数据量为 20T text tokens；上下文扩展到 1M tokens；开放 BF16 base、BF16 post-trained、NVFP4 post-trained checkpoint。推理吞吐方面，在 8K input / 64K output 设置下，相比 GLM-5.1-754B-A40B、Kimi-K2.6-1T-A32B、Qwen-3.5-397B-17B，分别达到 5.9×、4.8×、1.6× 的更高吞吐，并声称精度大体可比。

NVFP4 稳定性通过 BF16 分支实验监控：团队从 5T、10T、16T token 的 checkpoint 分支出来，把所有 tensor 切到 BF16，并继续训练 74B tokens。NVFP4 主训练相对这些 BF16 segment 的训练损失差距平均低于 0.4%。这说明在该 recipe 下，FP4 量化误差没有明显破坏优化轨迹。

base model 被报告为强于若干公开 base model，包括 DeepSeek v3.2、Mistral Large 3、Kimi-K2、GLM-4.5。给定内容没有提供完整分项表格，无法逐项列出 benchmark 数值。数据消融方面，报告提到在 Nemotron 3 Nano 上加入 Nemotron-Pretraining-Legal-v1 synthetic legal datasets 后，proxy LegalBench 平均准确率从 64.6 提升到 74.7。释放的数据还包括 173B tokens 的 fresh GitHub code 数据，以及 specialized synthetic pretraining data 和 post-training data。
summary.reading_guide:
建议精读 Pretraining 部分，尤其是 architecture、NVFP4 recipe、data mixture、training instability monitoring。Figure 2 和 Table 1 应该用于理解 layer pattern、Mamba/attention/MoE 的具体排布；Figure 3 值得看，因为 BF16 branch loss gap 是判断 NVFP4 是否可靠的关键证据。

第二优先级是 Post-training 部分。重点看 RLVR 环境如何统一、MOPD 如何在 on-policy rollout 上做 token-level distillation、reasoning budget control 如何实现。这里的价值在于 pretrain 和 posttrain 的接口：base model 的结构选择、MTP、长上下文、低精度训练，最后都要服务于 agentic inference 的吞吐和稳定性。

Inference 部分建议快速读，但要关注 8K/64K 设置下的吞吐定义、batching 策略、硬件配置、KV cache 口径，以及 hybrid Mamba-Attention 对长输出的实际收益。如果想复现或迁移，最值得深挖的是 NVFP4 哪些层保持高精度、MTP head 共享参数的消融、15T+5T 数据阶段划分、以及 1M context extension 的训练长度和数据构造。
summary.authors_note: NVIDIA Nemotron 团队。给定内容未列出完整作者名单；背景是 Nemotron 3 系列的开放模型、训练 recipe、数据和推理栈报告。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the accuracy-throughput-context trade-off for large models used in long-horizon agentic reasoning. Nemotron 3 Ultra combines a 550B-total, 55B-active MoE model with a hybrid Mamba-Attention architecture, aiming to match the accuracy of strong public models while reducing attention cost and KV-cache pressure during long-output inference.
summary_en.importance: The report is important for pretraining research because it exposes a full large-scale recipe rather than only final benchmark numbers. The notable pieces are NVFP4 pretraining at 550B scale, a hybrid Mamba-Attention MoE architecture, LatentMoE for active-parameter efficiency, native Multi-Token Prediction for speculative decoding, a 20T-token WSD pretraining run, 1M-context extension, and an agent-focused SFT/RLVR/MOPD post-training pipeline. The release of base, post-trained, and NVFP4 checkpoints, plus training recipes and datasets, makes the work useful for studying low-precision training and architecture-system co-design.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Nemotron 3 Ultra is a 550B total-parameter MoE language model with 55B active parameters per token. It follows the Nemotron 3 Super hybrid Mamba-Attention design, scaled up and combined with LatentMoE. The motivation is direct: MoE improves accuracy per active parameter, while replacing part of full attention with Mamba-style sequence modeling reduces inference cost and KV-cache footprint for long contexts and long outputs.

The model includes native Multi-Token Prediction with two shared-parameter heads. The heads are trained to produce autoregressive draft tokens and are used for speculative decoding. Each MTP head consists of one attention layer followed by one MoE layer.

Pretraining uses 20 trillion text tokens with a Warmup-Stable-Decay learning-rate schedule. The first 15T tokens emphasize diversity and broad domain coverage. The last 5T tokens emphasize higher-quality data to refine accuracy. This is a practical data schedule: broad coverage first, lower-noise refinement later.

A central technical point is NVFP4 pretraining. NVFP4 layers use the E2M1 datatype with two-dimensional block quantization on weights. Random Hadamard Transforms are applied to inputs for weight-gradient computation, and gradients use stochastic rounding. The recipe keeps numerically sensitive parts in higher precision: the final 15% of the network, corresponding to 16 layers, plus Mamba output projections, latent projections, QKV and attention projections, MTP layers, and embeddings. This selective precision policy is likely as important as the FP4 datatype itself.

Post-training starts with curated SFT, then applies unified RLVR over reasoning, agentic, code, safety, usability, and chat environments. More than ten specialized teacher models are trained, including agentic teachers from a dedicated agentic SFT path. Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation then gives dense token-level supervision on rollouts generated by the student model. The final model also supports reasoning effort control, allowing inference-time adjustment of the compute-accuracy trade-off.
summary_en.experiments:
The main scale numbers are 550B total parameters, 55B active parameters, 20T pretraining tokens, and 1M-token context extension. The paper reports 5.9×, 4.8×, and 1.6× higher inference throughput than GLM-5.1-754B-A40B, Kimi-K2.6-1T-A32B, and Qwen-3.5-397B-17B respectively under an 8K input / 64K output setting, while maintaining broadly comparable accuracy.

For NVFP4 training health, the team branches from checkpoints at 5T, 10T, and 16T tokens, switches tensors to BF16, and continues training for 74B tokens. The relative training-loss gap between the NVFP4 run and the BF16 continuation averages below 0.4%. This is the key evidence that the FP4 recipe tracks a high-precision training trajectory closely enough at this scale.

The base model is reported to outperform several public base models, including DeepSeek v3.2, Mistral Large 3, Kimi-K2, and GLM-4.5, though the provided text does not include the full benchmark tables. One concrete data ablation is given: adding the Nemotron-Pretraining-Legal-v1 synthetic legal datasets to Nemotron 3 Nano improves a proxy LegalBench average from 64.6 to 74.7. The release also includes 173B tokens of fresh GitHub code data, specialized synthetic pretraining datasets, and post-training datasets.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read the pretraining section carefully, especially the architecture, NVFP4 recipe, data schedule, and instability-monitoring subsections. Figure 2 and Table 1 should clarify the Mamba/attention/MoE layer pattern. Figure 3 is important because the BF16-branch loss gap is the main evidence for stable NVFP4 training.

Then read the post-training section for the interface between pretraining choices and agentic behavior. The key details are the unified RLVR environment mix, the construction of specialized teachers, token-level MOPD on student rollouts, and reasoning effort control.

The inference section can be read more selectively, but check the exact throughput setup: hardware, batching, sequence lengths, KV-cache accounting, and the 8K-input/64K-output measurement. For researchers trying to reuse the recipe, the most useful details are the selective high-precision layer policy, the shared-parameter MTP heads, the 15T plus 5T data schedule, and the 1M-context extension procedure.
summary_en.authors_note: NVIDIA Nemotron team. The provided content does not list the full author names. The work is part of the Nemotron 3 open model, recipe, data, and inference stack.

recommendation.zh: 这类 paper 要读 recipe，不要只看榜单；若 ablation 干净，它会直接改变你对“混合状态空间 + MoE + 低精度预训练”能否在大规模上稳定落地的 prior。
recommendation.en: Read it for the recipe, not the leaderboard; if the ablations are clean, it materially updates the prior on whether hybrid SSM+MoE+low-precision pretraining is stable at frontier scale.

paper.title: A Gradient Perspective on RLVR Stability and Winner Advantage Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves language-model reasoning, but GRPO-style optimization remains prone to collapse. We analyse this instability through token-level gradient dynamics, deriving a taxonomy that predicts how updates affect next-token probabilities and entropy. The taxonomy shows that stability depends jointly on the advantage sign and token distribution under the current policy. Motivated by this finding, we propose Winner Advantage Policy Optimization (W

summary.core_problem: 如何解决带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中 GRPO 风格优化容易崩溃的不稳定性问题？
summary.importance: 深入分析了 RLVR 训练不稳定的 token 级梯度动态机制，并提出了一种极其简单但有效的在线策略梯度目标（WAPO），显著提升了数学推理等任务的训练稳定性，对当前火热的 R1-Zero 范式（RL-pretrain）有直接的指导意义。
summary.technical_approach: 通过 token 级梯度动态分析，推导出一个分类法，预测更新如何影响 next-token 概率和熵。发现稳定性共同取决于优势（advantage）的符号和当前策略下的 token 分布。基于此，提出 Winner Advantage Policy Optimization (WAPO)：一种简单的在线截断策略梯度目标，仅对具有正优势（positive-advantage）的补全（completions）进行更新。
summary.experiments: 在数学推理和多跳 QA 基准测试中，WAPO 提高了跨多个模型系列的训练稳定性，并匹配或超越了基线方法（如 GRPO）。
summary.authors_note: 来自 Layer6 AI，该团队在强化学习和语言模型优化方面有持续产出。

summary_en.core_problem: How to resolve the instability and collapse issues in GRPO-style optimization for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR)?
