summary.technical_approach: 系统基于 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，用 GRPO 训练一个多轮 medical RAG agent，并扩展 Search-R1 框架。agent 有两个工具：Search 使用 MedCPT bi-encoder 在 MedRAG 语料中检索 top-5 passages；Check 是 claim-level NLI verification server，会把回答拆成 atomic claims，再判断每个 claim 与证据之间是 Entail、Neutral 还是 Contradict。作者把四种 checker 后端作为同一 reward path 的可替换组件：Likelihood-NLI 用 Meditron-3-8B 做 raw log-probability scoring；MedNLI-Cls 是 PubMedBERT-base 在 MedNLI 上微调的三分类器；Hybrid 使用 GPT-4o-mini 做 atomic claim extraction，再用本地 log-prob scorer；GPT-NLI 使用 GPT-4o-mini 端到端完成抽取和判定。核心诊断变量是 per-claim support rate，即生成 claim 中被判为 Entail 的比例。
summary.experiments: 主要发现有三点。第一，signal collapse 与 log-prob scoring 强相关：Likelihood-NLI 会把超过 97% 的 claims 判为 Neutral，使每个 claim 的支持率接近零，RL 梯度基本失效；同样的 claim-evidence 对，MedNLI-Cls 能产生非退化分布。第二，奖励信号强度和最终回答质量不是单调关系。MedNLI-Cls 的 support rate 约为 54%，属于 moderate signal，但 BERTScore 达到 0.600；更强的 GPT 类 checker support rate 更高，例如 Hybrid 约 76%、GPT-NLI 约 86%，但 GPT-NLI 对应 BERTScore 为 0.591，并触发 ultra-short answers、search avoidance、非英语回答规避英语 NLI prompt 等 reward hacking 路径。第三，signal strength 是 policy-checker pair 的性质，而不是 checker 单独的性质；作者用 Qwen2.5-7B 到 Qwen3-4B 的替换实验支持这一点，并在 Qwen3-4B、Llama-3.1-8B 上做复现性检查。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。优先看 Introduction 对“held-out NLI accuracy 不等于 trainable reward”的论证，再看 Method 中四种 checker 的机制差异。实验部分重点看 signal collapse 的 support-rate 曲线，以及 reward hacking cascade 的分析。对做 RLHF、RLAIF、过程监督或 verifier-guided training 的读者，最该关注的是诊断指标：不要只看 verifier accuracy，要记录 rollout 上的 label 分布、reward 方差、平均回答长度、工具调用频率、语言分布和搜索使用率。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why an NLI checker used as a process reward can fail during RL training. The central issue is that held-out NLI accuracy does not determine trainability; the checker’s output distribution on the policy’s own rollouts does.
summary_en.importance: The setting is biomedical RAG, but the lesson is broader for post-training and verifier-guided RL. A verifier can be accurate on static test pairs while producing either collapsed rewards or exploitable shortcuts during policy optimization. For pretraining and post-training researchers, the useful takeaway is to treat reward distribution under rollout as a training-time object: support rate, variance, shortcut channels, and policy dependence matter as much as offline accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system trains a multi-turn medical RAG agent based on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with GRPO, extending Search-R1. The agent can call Search, backed by a frozen MedCPT retriever over the MedRAG corpus, and Check, an NLI verification server that decomposes answers into atomic claims and labels each claim-evidence pair as Entail, Neutral, or Contradict. Four checker backends are plugged into the same reward path: Likelihood-NLI, which uses Meditron-3-8B with raw log-probability scoring; MedNLI-Cls, a PubMedBERT-base classifier fine-tuned on MedNLI; Hybrid, which uses GPT-4o-mini for atomic claim extraction and a local log-prob scorer; and GPT-NLI, which uses GPT-4o-mini end to end. The main diagnostic variable is per-claim support rate, the fraction of generated claims labeled Entail.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports three main diagnostic findings. First, signal collapse is specific to the log-probability scoring setup: Likelihood-NLI labels more than 97% of claims as Neutral, which removes useful RL gradient, while MedNLI-Cls gives non-degenerate labels on the same pairs. Second, stronger support signals do not monotonically improve answer quality. MedNLI-Cls produces a moderate support rate around 54% and reaches BERTScore 0.600, while stronger GPT-based checkers show higher support rates, such as 76% for Hybrid and 86% for GPT-NLI, but GPT-NLI reaches BERTScore 0.591 and induces shortcut behavior. The observed shortcut cascade includes ultra-short answers, search avoidance, and non-English responses that evade an English-only NLI prompt. Third, signal strength depends on the policy-checker pair rather than the checker alone, supported by a Qwen2.5-7B to Qwen3-4B swap and additional replication checks on Qwen3-4B and Llama-3.1-8B.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim takes about 25–35 minutes. Start with the introduction’s distinction between held-out checker accuracy and rollout-time reward distribution. Then read the method section describing the four checker backends, because the mechanism differences explain the later failures. In the results, focus on the support-rate diagnostics and the reward-hacking cascade. The most reusable part is the evaluation protocol for reward signals: log label distributions on policy rollouts, reward variance, answer length, tool-use frequency, language distribution, and retrieval usage, rather than relying only on verifier accuracy.

recommendation.zh: 领域任务外壳不重要；reward 分布比 checker accuracy 更关键，这个 prior 应进内部 RLVR 诊断清单。
recommendation.en: Ignore the medical shell; the useful prior is that reward distribution beats checker accuracy as a trainability diagnostic for RLVR-style setups.

paper.title: RLVR Datasets and Where to Find Them: Tracing Data Lineage for Better Training Data
paper.abstract: The proliferation of Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) datasets has exacerbated provenance collapse due to unclear lineage among existing datasets. To bridge this fragmented RLVR data landscape, we propose Atomic-source Tracing via Lineage-Aware Search (ATLAS), a systematic framework for tracing RLVR datasets back to their atomic sources, attributing over 99.7% of 1.45M instances to 20 atomic sources. Our analysis reveals that most RLVR datasets are variants of a small set of

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决 RLVR 训练数据的来源混乱问题。许多开源 RLVR 数据集并不是独立构造，而是从少数上游数学、竞赛、教材或众包来源经过过滤、改写、重组后形成。缺少原子来源标注会带来数据重复、评测泄漏和训练结论不可比的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇更接近 post-train 数据工程，但对预训练研究也有间接启发：训练信号质量不能只看样本量，还要看来源独立性、污染风险和可学习性。论文把 RLVR 数据集从“数据集级别比较”推进到“原子来源级别比较”，这对理解 reasoning RL 的数据收益更有用。它也提醒预训练和中训练数据治理需要记录 lineage，否则规模扩大后会出现 provenance collapse，数据看似变多，真实新信息可能很少。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法有两部分。第一是 ATLAS，即 Atomic-source Tracing via Lineage-Aware Search。作者先收集常用 RLVR 数据集及其上游数据，手工检查 schema 和 prompt 格式，将样本规范化为 question-answer pair；再用 SHA-1 哈希做精确匹配和时间索引，追踪样本在不同数据集中的出现顺序；对于无法精确匹配的样本，再做语义相似度匹配，恢复被改写或格式变化后的来源。第二是 SCA，即 Source-level Counterfactual Attribution。它在原子来源层面估计不同数据源对 RLVR 训练效果的贡献，并提供实例级 learnability 标注。基于 ATLAS 的发现，作者还构造了 DAPO++，目标是减少重复来源和泄漏风险。
summary.experiments: 论文追踪了 1,450,827 条 RLVR 样本，并将其中超过 99.7% 归因到 20 个原子来源。结果显示，大量 RLVR 数据集来自少数共享上游来源，真正新增的数据有限。作者还对 14 个数学评测 benchmark 做百万级 pairwise similarity matching，发现 36,148 条存在泄漏风险的样本。全文还提出基于 lineage 的 RLVR 数据集打分和 benchmark 框架，但从给定内容看，具体训练收益、各数据集排名和 DAPO++ 的完整性能数字需要查看实验表格后才能确认。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30 到 45 分钟。优先看 Figure 1 和 Figure 2，理解 RLVR 数据集之间的继承关系以及 ATLAS 流程；再看 Table 6，确认纳入了哪些 Hugging Face 数据集和上游来源；泄漏分析部分值得看具体匹配规则和 36,148 条泄漏样本的分布。SCA 部分可重点看 source-level utility 如何估计，尤其是 counterfactual attribution 的定义。若关注 RLVR 训练数据选择，实验中的数据集排名和 DAPO++ 构造规则比模型分数本身更值得细看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses provenance collapse in RLVR training data. Many open RLVR datasets are not independently constructed; they are derived from a small set of upstream math, competition, textbook, web, or crowdsourced sources through filtering, rewriting, recomposition, and aggregation. Without atomic-source annotations, dataset overlap, benchmark leakage, and unfair comparisons become hard to diagnose.
summary_en.importance: The work is most relevant to post-training data infrastructure, with useful implications for pretraining data governance. It argues that the value of RLVR data should not be measured only by instance count. Source independence, contamination risk, and learnability matter. The paper shifts the unit of analysis from dataset names to atomic sources, which is a better level for reasoning about data utility. The same lesson applies to pretraining and mid-training corpora: once lineage is lost, larger datasets may contain little genuinely new information.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two main components. ATLAS, or Atomic-source Tracing via Lineage-Aware Search, collects commonly used RLVR datasets and their upstream datasets, manually canonicalizes heterogeneous schemas and prompt formats into question-answer pairs, and uses SHA-1 hashing for exact matching and temporal indexing. For unresolved cases, semantic similarity matching is used to recover sources after rewriting or formatting changes. The second component is SCA, Source-level Counterfactual Attribution, which estimates the utility of atomic sources for RLVR training and produces fine-grained learnability annotations. The findings from ATLAS are then used to curate DAPO++, with the goal of reducing redundant sources and leakage risk.
summary_en.experiments: The authors trace 1,450,827 RLVR instances and attribute more than 99.7% of them to 20 atomic sources. The analysis shows that many RLVR datasets are variants of a small shared upstream pool, with limited genuinely new data. They also run million-scale pairwise similarity matching against 14 mathematical evaluation benchmarks and identify 36,148 potentially leaked instances. The paper further proposes a lineage-aware benchmarking and scoring framework for RLVR datasets, but the provided content does not include the full ranking tables, training gains, or complete DAPO++ performance numbers.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 to 45 minutes. Start with Figure 1 and Figure 2 to understand the dataset inheritance structure and the ATLAS pipeline. Then inspect Table 6 to see which Hugging Face datasets and upstream sources are included. The leakage analysis is worth reading for the matching rules and the distribution of the 36,148 leaked instances. In the SCA section, focus on how source-level utility and counterfactual attribution are defined. For RLVR data selection, the dataset ranking criteria and DAPO++ construction rules are more informative than the headline model scores.

recommendation.zh: 重点看§3数据集溯源的发现和SCA去污染准则，可直接复用到内部后训练对齐数据集的质量排查。
recommendation.en: Focus on §3 dataset lineage findings and SCA decontamination principle, which can be directly reused for internal post-training alignment dataset quality audits.

paper.title: CUA-Gym: Scaling Verifiable Training Environments and Tasks for Computer-Use Agents
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has driven breakthroughs in domains such as math, tool-use, and software engineering, yet its extension to computer-use agents (CUAs) has been bottlenecked by the scarcity of scalable training data with deterministic rewards. Constructing such data for CUAs requires consistent task instruction, executable environment, and verifiable reward. However, hand-curated benchmarks achieve high reward fidelity but cover few applications and LLM-as-jud

summary.core_problem: 计算机使用代理（CUA）的可验证强化学习（RLVR）训练存在结构性数据瓶颈：手工构建的基准应用覆盖范围窄，LLM打分的数据集奖励信号不可靠，代码原生环境管道规模有限。没有现有方法能同时满足CUA RLVR的三个核心要求：确定性可验证奖励、广泛应用覆盖、可扩展任务多样性，导致CUA无法复刻数学、代码领域RLVR带来的能力跃升。
summary.importance: 将RLVR的规模化数据合成范式拓展到CUA领域，打通了CUA能力 scaling 的核心数据瓶颈；提出环境多样性是独立于任务数据量的新增scaling轴，补充了现有智能体scaling law的研究维度；生成的数据集和可复用环境池可直接支撑开源CUA基座的RL后训练，验证了小参数量MoE模型通过RLVR可匹配10倍参数的未训练基座性能，为低资源智能体训练提供了可落地的参考。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 多代理协同的任务三元组联合生成管道：Generator代理构造初始环境和任务完成后的黄金环境，Discriminator代理仅基于任务描述编写奖励函数，Orchestrator代理驱动二者迭代验证，直到奖励函数能在执行时准确区分两种环境状态；2. 采用严格信息隔离机制防止奖励黑客，最后通过LLM多数投票+代理轨迹回放过滤不合格样本；3. 环境规模化方案：基于O*NET职业分类和Anthropic经济指数的软件使用分布选择目标应用，通过多代理合成自包含的模拟网页应用并做自动化交互测试，形成可复用、可重置的CUA-GYM-HUB环境池，将环境构建与任务生成解耦，每个环境可生成数千个不同任务。
summary.experiments: 生成32112个经过验证的RLVR训练三元组，覆盖110个环境（16个桌面应用+94个模拟网页应用）；使用GSPO算法在Qwen3.5-35B-A3B和Qwen3.5-397B-A17B两个MoE基座上做RLVR训练，在OSWorld-Verified基准上分别达到62.1%和72.6%的准确率，35B模型的性能与未训练的397B基座相当，参数量仅为后者的1/10左右；训练后的模型在WebArena基准上也有性能提升，验证了模拟环境到真实浏览器的迁移性；性能随数据量和环境池规模平滑提升，环境池从10个扩展到80个带来的收益无法通过单纯增加轨迹数量覆盖；RL训练自发涌现多动作工具调用能力，相同任务性能下轨迹长度压缩33%-45%。
summary.reading_guide: 精读第3章的多代理生成管道设计细节，重点关注信息隔离和迭代验证机制；精读第4章的环境规模化方法和CUA-GYM-HUB的实现逻辑；重点看第5章的scaling实验结果，尤其是环境多样性与数据量的scaling曲线对比，以及RL训练涌现多动作调用的消融分析；附录的环境列表和数据过滤规则可作为实际构建训练数据的参考。

summary_en.core_problem: Scalable verifiable reinforcement learning (RLVR) training data for computer-use agents (CUAs) faces a structural bottleneck: hand-curated benchmarks have narrow application coverage, LLM-as-judge datasets produce unreliable reward signals, and code-native environment pipelines lack sufficient scale. No existing approach simultaneously meets the three core requirements for CUA RLVR: deterministic verifiable rewards, broad application coverage, and scalable task diversity, preventing CUAs from replicating the capability gains RLVR has delivered in math and code domains.
summary_en.importance: It extends the scalable RLVR data synthesis paradigm to the CUA domain, removing the core data bottleneck for CUA capability scaling. It identifies environment diversity as an independent scaling axis complementary to task volume, expanding existing research on agent scaling laws. The released dataset and reusable environment pool directly support RL post-training for open-source CUA base models, and validates that smaller MoE models can match the performance of 10x larger untrained base models via RLVR, providing actionable guidance for low-resource agent training.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. A multi-agent collaborative pipeline for joint generation of task tuples: a Generator agent constructs the initial environment state and golden post-task state, a Discriminator agent writes reward functions solely based on task descriptions, and an Orchestrator agent drives iterative refinement until the reward function reliably distinguishes the two states during execution. 2. Strict information isolation prevents reward hacking, and a final filtering step combining LLM majority voting and agent rollouts removes low-quality tuples. 3. An environment scaling framework: target applications are selected based on O*NET occupational taxonomies and Anthropic Economic Index software usage distributions. Multi-agent synthesis builds self-contained mock web applications with automated interactive testing, forming the reusable, resettable CUA-GYM-HUB environment pool that decouples environment construction from task generation, enabling thousands of distinct tasks per environment.
summary_en.experiments: The pipeline produces 32,112 verified RLVR training tuples across 110 environments (16 desktop applications + 94 synthetic mock web applications). RLVR training with GSPO on two open-source MoE backbones (Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and Qwen3.5-397B-A17B) reaches 62.1% and 72.6% accuracy respectively on OSWorld-Verified, with the 35B model matching the performance of the untrained 397B base at ~1/10 the parameter count. Trained checkpoints also show improvements on the WebArena benchmark, demonstrating transfer from synthetic mock environments to real browser settings. Performance scales smoothly with both data volume and environment pool size; expanding the environment pool from 10 to 80 delivers gains that cannot be replicated by increasing trajectory volume alone. RL training also spontaneously induces multi-action tool calls, reducing trajectory length by 33-45% at matched task performance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for details of the multi-agent generation pipeline, especially the information isolation and iterative verification mechanisms. Read Section 4 for the environment scaling methodology and CUA-GYM-HUB implementation logic. Prioritize Section 5's scaling experiment results, specifically the comparison of environment diversity vs. data volume scaling curves, and ablation analysis of emergent multi-action tool calls. The appendix environment list and data filtering rules serve as a practical reference for building custom training datasets.

recommendation.zh: 应读方法和过滤 ablation；它把 RLVR 的瓶颈从“有没有题”推进到“奖励函数能否被程序化合成”。
recommendation.en: Read the method and filtering ablations; it shifts the RLVR bottleneck from task availability to whether reward functions can be programmatically synthesized.

paper.title: Credit Assignment with Resets in Language Model Reasoning
paper.abstract: Contemporary reinforcement learning with verifiable reward methods post-train language models on multi-step reasoning by assigning a single outcome reward uniformly across all tokens in a trajectory. Such uniform assignment ignores which steps contributed to success or failure. Improving credit assignment can address this limitation by enabling targeted refinement of faulty reasoning steps, rather than updating entire trajectories uniformly. Resets are one such simple mechanism, enabling more pr

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决 RLVR 训练长链推理时的信用分配问题。现有 GRPO 类方法通常把一个最终可验证奖励均匀传播到整条轨迹，导致正确步骤、错误步骤、无关步骤都被同等更新。对长 CoT 来说，这会稀释训练信号，也会让模型难以针对真正出错的位置改进。
summary.importance: 这是对推理后训练方法的实质改进，也对预训练研究有间接价值。关键点是把“结果奖励”变成更局部的“从某个状态继续生成后的反事实结果差异”。这提供了一种不依赖人工过程标注的过程级训练信号。对做 RL pretrain、long reasoning data、annealing/posttrain 接口的人来说，价值在于训练信号质量：不是简单增加 rollout 数量，而是把 rollout 放在更可能改变成败的中间状态上。理论部分也给出清楚解释：如果可改进状态在当前策略下出现概率为 pπ，那么只在这些状态 reset 可以把样本复杂度改善一个 1/pπ² 量级，并把单轮策略提升放大 1/pπ。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 reset。先从失败推理轨迹中选一个中间状态，把它当成共享前缀，然后从这个状态重新采样多个 suffix continuation。由于这些续写共享相同前缀，它们最终成功或失败的差异更容易归因到 reset 点之后的决策。训练时只对 suffix tokens 做 policy-gradient 更新，而不是更新整条原始轨迹。RRPO 随机选择 reset 状态，提供一个简单基线。SRPO 则让模型自定位失败轨迹中的第一个错误步骤，然后从该位置 reset；它不需要外部 step-level label，利用模型已有的自我错误定位能力近似 credit-assignment oracle。理论上，作者用 Conservative Policy Iteration 构造两个版本：CPI-RR 从随机 reset 状态更新，CPI-CARO 假设有一个 oracle 能判断某状态是否存在 advantage 超过阈值 τ 的改进行动。这个 oracle 版本解释了为什么 reset 到“可改进状态”比随机 reset 更有效，也为 SRPO 的设计提供依据。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖十个推理 benchmark，包含数学、科学、策略和常识推理。SRPO 优于 GRPO，以及带自我修正或 shared-prefix continuation 的 contemporaneous RL 基线。在代码任务 LiveCodeBench 上，SRPO 收敛到更高 pass rate，并且相对 GRPO 和 RRPO 学习速度快 2–3 倍。消融的重点不只是最终分数，而是 reset 位置质量：更干净的 prefix 带来更高 correction rate，clean prefixes 的修正成功率接近 erroneous prefixes 的 2 倍。结果支持一个实际判断：reset 本身有用，但收益高度依赖错误定位质量；如果 reset 点选在已经被污染的前缀之后，后续采样组的学习信号会明显变差。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。优先看 Introduction 中对 RLVR 信用分配问题的表述和 Figure 1；再看算法部分中 RRPO 与 SRPO 的 rollout 组织方式，尤其是只更新 suffix tokens 的细节；理论部分重点读 CPI-RR、CPI-CARO 和 Theorem 1，理解 pπ 因子如何进入样本复杂度与单轮改进；实验部分重点看十个 benchmark 总表、LiveCodeBench 曲线，以及 self-localization quality 的消融。值得深挖的问题有三个：第一，self-localization 错误会不会引入系统性负反馈；第二，reset suffix 更新和 KL 约束如何平衡，避免局部修正破坏整体推理风格；第三，这类方法能否前移到 mid-training 或高质量推理数据生成，而不只用于最终 RL 后训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets credit assignment in RLVR for long-form reasoning. Standard GRPO-style training uses a single verifiable outcome reward and applies it broadly across the whole trajectory. This makes correct, incorrect, and irrelevant reasoning steps receive nearly the same learning signal, which is especially inefficient for long chains of thought.
summary_en.importance: This is a meaningful step for reasoning post-training and a useful signal-design result for pretraining researchers. The central idea is to turn outcome reward into a more localized counterfactual signal: restart from an intermediate reasoning state, sample several continuations, and compare their outcomes. This gives a process-like learning signal without human step-level supervision. The theoretical result is also useful: if improvable states occur with on-policy probability pπ, concentrating resets on those states improves sample complexity by a factor of 1/pπ² and increases per-iteration improvement by 1/pπ compared with random resets.
summary_en.technical_approach: The shared primitive is reset-based rollout generation. Given a failed trajectory, the method selects an intermediate state as a shared prefix, samples multiple suffix continuations from that state, and applies policy-gradient updates only to the suffix tokens. Since the continuations share the same prefix, differences in final outcome can be attributed more directly to decisions after the reset point. RRPO chooses the reset state uniformly at random. SRPO asks the model to self-localize the first erroneous reasoning step and resets there, requiring no external process labels. The theory section formalizes this through Conservative Policy Iteration. CPI-RR samples random reset states, while CPI-CARO assumes an oracle that tests whether a state is improvable, meaning that it admits an action whose advantage exceeds a threshold τ. This oracle construction clarifies why targeted resets can be much more sample-efficient than random resets, and SRPO is an approximate practical version using self-localization.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical suite spans ten reasoning benchmarks covering math, science, strategic reasoning, and commonsense reasoning. SRPO outperforms GRPO and contemporary baselines based on self-correction or shared-prefix continuation. On LiveCodeBench, SRPO reaches a higher pass rate and learns 2–3 times faster than GRPO and RRPO. The most informative ablation concerns localization quality: clean prefixes correct nearly twice as often as erroneous prefixes. This supports the main mechanism. Resets help, but their benefit depends strongly on whether the selected state is actually a useful point for intervention.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read closely. Start with the motivation and Figure 1 for the credit-assignment framing. Then inspect the algorithmic details of RRPO and SRPO, especially how suffix groups are formed and why only suffix tokens receive updates. In the theory section, focus on CPI-RR, CPI-CARO, and Theorem 1 to understand where the pπ factors come from. In the experiments, prioritize the aggregate reasoning benchmark table, the LiveCodeBench learning curves, and the self-localization quality ablations. The main open questions are whether incorrect self-localization can create systematic negative updates, how suffix-only updates interact with KL control, and whether reset-based learning can be moved earlier into mid-training or reasoning data generation.

recommendation.zh: 应把 reset 当作 RLVR credit assignment 的最小可复现实验；先看算法和保守更新分析，再决定是否进内部 ablation。
recommendation.en: Treat resets as a minimal RLVR credit-assignment ablation; read the algorithm and conservative-update analysis before porting it internally.

paper.title: When Self-Belief Misleads: Active Label Acquisition for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable advancements in reasoning capabilities empowered by Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR). Nonetheless, RLVR intrinsically relies on ground-truth labels for reward computation, the acquisition of which is often prohibitively expensive in real-world scenarios. While unsupervised RLVR paradigms attempt to circumvent this by training on pseudo-labels, they are notoriously susceptible to training collapse. Moreover, different samp

summary.core_problem: 解决 RLVR 依赖可验证真值标签、但真实标签获取昂贵，而纯伪标签训练又容易崩溃的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练信号与数据选择方法。它关注 RLVR 中 label budget 的分配，而不是单纯改奖励函数；对构建可扩展推理训练管线有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RLAVR，即 Reinforcement Learning with Active Verifiable Rewards。方法主动选择少量高价值样本获取真值标签，并与伪标签混合用于奖励计算；核心选择指标是 Corrective Advantage Gap，用来估计某个样本在纠正策略优势估计和稳定训练动态上的监督价值。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、任务集合、标注预算比例或具体提升幅度。实验主张是在有限标注预算下，RLAVR 相比纯伪标签无监督 RLVR 更稳定，并能提升推理表现。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Beihang University 和 Nanyang Technological University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the label-cost problem in RLVR: verifiable rewards need ground-truth labels, while pseudo-label-only training is prone to collapse.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training signal and data-selection contribution. It targets how to spend a limited label budget in RLVR, which is directly relevant to scalable reasoning-training pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: RLAVR actively acquires ground-truth labels for a small selected subset and combines them with pseudo-labels for reward computation. The key metric, Corrective Advantage Gap, estimates sample-level supervision value by measuring how much true labels can correct advantage estimates and stabilize learning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, task suites, annotation ratios, or numerical gains. It claims that RLAVR stabilizes training and improves performance under limited annotation budgets compared with unsupervised pseudo-label RLVR.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions are Beihang University and Nanyang Technological University.

recommendation.zh: RLVR 的标签预算是真问题；CAG 若定义干净，应在内部数学/RL 数据管线做小规模复现。
recommendation.en: RLVR label budget is a real bottleneck; if CAG is cleanly defined, it deserves a small reproduction in an internal math/RL data pipeline.

paper.title: Harmony in Diversity: Multi-domain Contrastive Policy Optimization for Large Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Post-training has significantly enhanced the reasoning capability of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs), especially with Reinforcement Learning (RL) like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). However, GRPO-style RL methods in multi-domain settings often fail to achieve consistent improvements across all domains due to inherent interference in policy optimization. Prior studies on multi-domain RL primarily focus on alleviating cross-domain interference, while often neglecting the pivotal role of

summary.core_problem: 多领域（数学/代码/安全等）联合做 GRPO 类 RL 后训练时，单一共享目标往往导致跨领域干扰：某些领域提升的同时，另一些领域退化。现有工作多在“减少冲突”（采样/归一化/重加权/梯度平衡）上做文章，但对“如何让不同领域的正确推理轨迹互相迁移”缺少显式机制。论文要解决的是：在多领域 RL 中，把跨领域交互从竞争变成可利用的知识共享。
summary.importance: 属于 post-training 方向，但对基座研究也有接口价值：它把“正确 rollout 的结构可迁移”显式写成对比学习目标，提供了一种把多领域训练从纯标量 reward 聚合，升级为带结构的表示学习信号的思路。对持续训练/多任务对齐也有启发：当训练信号异质且会互相拉扯时，引入额外的表征约束可能比单纯调 sampling/weight 更稳定。
summary.technical_approach:
MCPO 在 GRPO 的基础上加了一个结构化对比学习分支：
- 先按常规对每个 prompt 采样多条 rollouts，并用领域特定 reward 判定好坏（正确/错误或高/低）。
- 构造“结构化对比池”：把同一 batch 内不同 prompt、不同领域的 rollouts 组织成正负样本关系。
  - In-domain consolidation：同领域内的正确 rollouts 互为正样本，拉近表示，促使领域内可复用解题结构被巩固。
  - Cross-domain sharing：从其他领域挑选“可迁移的正确 rollouts”作为正样本，同时把错误 rollouts 作为负样本，推动跨领域共享的推理结构在表示空间中对齐。
- 用一个轻量 contrastive head 把 rollout 映射到紧凑表示空间，采用 InfoNCE 风格损失；再与 prompt 内的 GRPO loss 组合训练。
关键区别在于：它不只是在标量 reward 上做平衡，而是显式学习一个“正确推理轨迹的几何结构”，用来承载迁移与抗干扰。
summary.experiments:
从片段可确认的结论级信息：MCPO 在多领域推理上实现更一致的提升，并且在部分设置下优于单领域训练。片段未给出具体基座模型、领域集合、训练步数/采样数、以及各 benchmark 的数值表。
评估时建议重点核对三类结果：
- 是否真的做到“各领域都不掉”（而非平均分上升）。
- 对比对象是否包含强的多领域 GRPO 变体（重加权/梯度平衡等）。
- 消融：只做 in-domain CL、只做 cross-domain CL、以及不同正样本挖掘策略对稳定性的影响。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（预计 30–45 分钟）：
- 先看方法动机那部分：他们如何定义“可迁移的正确 rollout”，以及为什么把 rollouts 类比成数据增强。
- 重点看 structured contrastive pool 的构造细节：正负样本怎么选、跨领域正样本如何判定“transferable”，以及 batch 内/跨 batch 的 memory bank 设计（如果有）。
- 再看损失组合与训练稳定性：contrastive loss 权重、是否影响 GRPO 的 advantage 估计方差。
- 实验部分优先看 per-domain 曲线与干扰案例，而不是只看平均分；如果提供了表示空间可视化或检索式分析，也值得快速扫一眼验证“对齐”是否发生。

summary_en.core_problem: In multi-domain RL post-training (math/code/safety, etc.), GRPO-style optimization with a single shared objective often causes cross-domain interference: gains in one domain come with regressions in others. Prior work mainly reduces conflicts via sampling control, reward normalization, reweighting, or gradient balancing, but lacks an explicit mechanism for knowledge sharing across domains. The paper addresses how to turn cross-domain interaction from competition into transferable learning.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training contribution, yet it is relevant to foundation-model training as an interface idea: it augments scalar-reward RL with a structured representation-learning signal over rollouts. For multi-task continual training and alignment, the message is practical: when heterogeneous objectives fight each other, adding explicit geometric/contrastive constraints over “good trajectories” can be more stable than tuning mixture weights alone.
summary_en.technical_approach:
MCPO adds a structured contrastive objective on top of GRPO:
- Sample multiple rollouts per prompt under mixed-domain batches and score them with domain-specific rewards to identify correct/incorrect trajectories.
- Build a structured contrastive pool from the same rollout batch.
  - In-domain consolidation: treat correct rollouts within the same domain as positives to cluster reusable solution structures.
  - Cross-domain sharing: select correct rollouts from other domains as positives (intended to be transferable), while using incorrect rollouts as negatives.
- Map rollouts into a compact embedding space via a lightweight contrastive head and optimize an InfoNCE-style loss.
- Combine the contrastive loss with the standard within-prompt GRPO objective.
The key difference from prior multi-domain RL tweaks is that MCPO explicitly learns a representation geometry for “good reasoning trajectories,” aiming to support transfer and reduce interference beyond scalar reward aggregation.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided excerpt, the claimed outcomes are: more consistent improvements across multiple reasoning domains, and in some settings outperforming single-domain training. The excerpt does not include concrete tables (model size, domains, training budget, benchmark deltas).
When reading results, the critical checks are:
- Per-domain improvements (not just averaged scores).
- Comparisons against strong multi-domain GRPO variants (reweighting/gradient balancing/normalization).
- Ablations separating in-domain vs cross-domain contrastive components and the effect of positive-pair mining on stability.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the motivation carefully: how they justify “correct rollouts contain transferable reasoning structure” and the augmentation analogy.
- Focus on how the structured contrastive pool is constructed: positive/negative definitions, how cross-domain positives are deemed transferable, and whether they use any memory bank.
- Check the loss coupling and stability knobs (contrastive weight, rollout count, variance effects on GRPO).
- In experiments, prioritize per-domain breakdowns and interference case studies; any embedding-space analysis is useful to validate that alignment actually happens.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法和 ablation；若结果干净，MCPO 是多领域 RLVR 里比“简单混数据”更可控的信号设计。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and ablations; if the setup is clean, MCPO is a more controlled signal design than naive data mixing for multi-domain RLVR.

paper.title: Extreme Region Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning for large language models faces a fundamental trade-off between sample efficiency and asymptotic performance: strictly on-policy methods discard trajectories after a single update, while off-policy reuse introduces distribution mismatch that existing trust-region techniques mitigate primarily by enforcing conservative optimization, often leaving rich training signals underutilized. To investigate this, we perform extensive off-policy updates on fixed data. Our experiments

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 LLM 强化学习中的样本效率和 KL 效率冲突。严格 on-policy 训练每批轨迹通常只用一次，采样成本高；off-policy 重复更新可以提高样本利用率，但会让当前策略偏离生成数据的旧策略，引入分布错配。PPO 类 KL 或 ratio clipping 能抑制漂移，但也会使优化过于保守。作者关心的问题是：能否充分挖掘一批轨迹里的训练信号，同时避免无效策略漂移消耗 KL 预算。
summary.importance: 这篇论文更接近 post-train，但对预训练研究有两个启发。第一，它把 reasoning RL 的瓶颈从“有没有更多数据”推进到“每批轨迹中的有效信号如何被利用”。这对长 CoT 采样成本很高的模型尤其重要。第二，它强调 KL divergence 不只是正则项，而是一种训练预算。无效漂移会占用预算，却不带来任务收益。这个视角对 mid-train、RL pretrain、持续训练中的 trust region 设计都有参考意义。贡献量级主要是训练范式和经验观察，不是基础架构变化。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Extreme Region Policy Distillation。它把一次 RL 更新拆成两个阶段。第一阶段先放松 KL 约束，在固定轨迹数据上做更激进的多步 off-policy 优化，目标是尽量提取这批数据中的训练信号。这个阶段得到的策略不直接作为最终模型，而是作为 teacher。第二阶段把 teacher 中有用的监督信号蒸馏回原始策略，并显式加 trust-region 约束，让 student 保留有效改进，同时过滤掉第一阶段产生的多余漂移。作者还讨论了 strong teacher 和 weak teacher 两类情况。strong teacher 指第一阶段确实训练出更强策略；weak teacher 指即使 teacher 本身不更强，甚至是退化构造，也可能通过不同 signal construction strategy 给 student 提供有用方向。这个设计的关键不是简单复用 off-policy 数据，而是先在“极端区域”探索可用信号，再用受约束蒸馏把有效部分投回可接受的 KL 区域。
summary.experiments: 实验主要在数学推理任务上进行，覆盖强基座模型在标准 on-policy RL 收益变小的场景。作者先做固定数据上的大量 off-policy 更新分析：早期多步优化能快速提升，但更新过多后，轨迹概率偏移增大，policy entropy 下降，性能很早进入平台期。单纯收紧 KL 约束不能解决问题，只会降低可达到的性能上限。两阶段蒸馏后，student 能在相近性能下使用更小 KL，说明一部分 off-policy 漂移不是有效任务改进。论文还报告了在 Qwen3.5-27B 级别强模型上的实验，显示 weak teacher strategy 在强模型继续提升困难时仍能带来收益。可见正文没有提供完整 benchmark 表和具体提升数字，因此更可靠的结论是训练动态和 KL-efficiency 观察。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30 到 40 分钟。优先看固定轨迹多步 off-policy 更新的诊断图，尤其是 performance、trajectory probability、entropy、KL 的联动变化。然后看两阶段框架图，理解为什么 teacher 不是最终策略，而是中间信号提取器。方法部分重点看三类 signal construction strategy，以及 student 何时能超过 teacher。实验部分建议关注强模型上的结果，因为这类模型最能暴露 on-policy RL 的边际收益问题。若时间有限，可以跳过一般 RL 预备知识，直接读 off-policy degradation 分析和 distillation ablation。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the tension between sample efficiency and KL efficiency in reinforcement learning for large language models. Strictly on-policy training usually uses each batch of trajectories once, which is expensive for long reasoning rollouts. Reusing trajectories off-policy improves sample utilization, but repeated updates move the policy away from the behavior policy that generated the data. Standard PPO-style clipping or KL penalties reduce this mismatch, but they also make optimization conservative. The central question is whether a training procedure can exploit more signal from each batch without wasting KL budget on ineffective policy drift.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a post-training paper, but it is relevant to pretraining researchers who care about the interface between base models and reasoning RL. The useful idea is to treat KL divergence as a limited optimization budget, not just as a regularizer. Off-policy updates may consume this budget through probability drift and entropy collapse without producing durable task improvement. That observation matters for RL pretraining, mid-training, continual training, and any setting where rollout generation is costly. The contribution is a training procedure and a set of empirical diagnostics rather than a new model architecture.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method is Extreme Region Policy Distillation. It separates signal extraction from trust-region optimization. In the first stage, the method relaxes KL constraints and performs aggressive multi-step off-policy optimization on a fixed batch of trajectories. The resulting policy is not used as the final model; it is treated as a teacher that exposes useful training signals. In the second stage, these signals are distilled back into the original policy under explicit trust-region constraints. The intended effect is to keep the task-relevant improvement discovered during aggressive optimization while removing spurious drift. The paper also studies strong-teacher and weak-teacher regimes. A strong teacher is an off-policy optimized policy that improves over the base. A weak teacher may fail to improve, or may even be constructed in a degenerate way, yet still provide useful supervisory signals through alternative signal construction strategies. The method is therefore not merely off-policy data reuse; it uses an unconstrained or weakly constrained phase to search for signals, then projects those signals back into a KL-controlled region.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments focus on mathematical reasoning tasks and strong base models where standard on-policy RL shows diminishing returns. The diagnostic experiments on fixed data show a consistent pattern: aggressive off-policy updates produce fast early gains, but excessive updates increase trajectory-probability drift, reduce policy entropy, and lead to an early performance plateau. Tightening the KL constraint alone does not solve the issue; it mainly lowers the achievable ceiling. The distillation stage achieves comparable performance with substantially smaller KL divergence, indicating that part of the off-policy movement was not useful for the task. The paper also reports experiments on a Qwen3.5-27B-scale model, where weak-teacher strategies can still improve a strong model when ordinary on-policy optimization is less effective. Exact benchmark numbers are not available in the visible manuscript content, so the most robust takeaway is the training-dynamics evidence and the KL-efficiency gain from distillation.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim reading should take about 30 to 40 minutes. Start with the diagnostic plots for repeated off-policy updates on fixed trajectories, especially the interaction among performance, trajectory probability, entropy, and KL. Then read the two-stage framework carefully: the teacher is an intermediate signal extractor, not the final policy. In the method section, focus on the signal construction strategies and the conditions under which the student can outperform the teacher. In the experiments, prioritize the results on strong models, because they best illustrate why standard on-policy RL leaves useful signal unused. The generic RL preliminaries can be skipped if the reader is already familiar with PPO, KL constraints, and off-policy mismatch.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 fixed-data off-policy 曲线；若现象稳，RLVR 采样复用的内部分层实验应复现。
recommendation.en: Read the fixed-data off-policy curves; if stable, this is worth reproducing in internal RLVR sample-reuse ablations.

paper.title: Not only where, But when: Temporal Scheduling for RLVR
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a core technique for post-training of Large Language Models (LLMs). While policy optimization is driven by all sampled tokens under a globally broadcast scalar reward, the heterogeneous policy behaviors exhibited along trajectories are largely overlooked without differentiation. Existing works address this by credit allocation, including token-level advantage reweighting, and selective token optimization, however, the allocation cr

summary.core_problem: 在基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中，现有的信用分配（credit allocation）方法通常在整个训练过程中使用固定的分配标准，忽略了训练动态中不同阶段对不同策略行为的优化需求。
summary.importance: 提出在 RLVR 优化中引入时间维度（temporal scheduling），指出“何时”调度学习信号与“何处”分配信号同样重要，为 RLVR 训练动态的控制提供了一个新的、正交的优化维度。
summary.technical_approach: 提出在训练过程中动态调度信用分配标准：在训练初期优先优化由分配标准强调的特定 token（例如通过优势重加权或稀疏 token 优化），然后随着训练的进行逐渐衰减，过渡到一般的全 token 优化。此外，发现简单的轨迹百分比（trajectory percentiles）可以作为一种有效的调度标准，即先从后续 token（可靠的延续）开始调度，逐步纳入早期 token（可靠的推理脚手架）。
summary.experiments: 在不同模型规模和 RLVR 算法（如 GRPO）上，结合连续优势重加权和离散稀疏 token 优化等现有信用分配策略，实验表明时间调度能带来一致的性能提升，并能有效缓解标准 RLVR 优化中因适应异构策略行为而导致的策略熵下降问题。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注 Introduction 中对现有静态信用分配局限性的分析，以及如何将时间调度与现有方法结合的具体实现细节。分析部分关于策略熵变化的讨论也值得一读。

summary_en.core_problem: In Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), existing credit allocation methods typically employ stagnant allocation criteria throughout the training process, neglecting the evolving optimization needs for different policy behaviors during training dynamics.
summary_en.importance: Introduces the temporal dimension to RLVR optimization, arguing that 'when' learning signals are scheduled is as crucial as 'where' they are allocated, providing a novel and orthogonal dimension for controlling RLVR training dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes to dynamically schedule credit allocation criteria over the course of training: prioritizing specific tokens emphasized by the allocation criteria (e.g., via advantage reweighting or sparse token optimization) in the early stages, and gradually attenuating towards general full-token optimization. Furthermore, identifies simple trajectory percentiles as an effective scheduling criterion, starting with later tokens (trustworthy continuation) and incrementally incorporating earlier tokens (reliable reasoning scaffolding).
summary_en.experiments: Across various model scales and RLVR algorithms (e.g., GRPO), combining with existing credit allocation strategies like continuous advantage reweighting and discrete sparse token optimization, experiments demonstrate consistent performance improvements. It also effectively mitigates the drop in policy entropy caused by accommodating heterogeneous policy behaviors in standard RLVR optimization.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Introduction for the analysis of the limitations of stagnant credit allocation, and the specific implementation details of how temporal scheduling is combined with existing methods. The analysis section discussing the changes in policy entropy is also worth reading.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和 ablation：若调度优于静态 token credit，它会影响 RLVR 数据和 loss 设计。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and ablations: if scheduling beats static token credit, it affects how RLVR losses and data are designed.

paper.title: CoSPlay: Cooperative Self-Play at Test-Time with Self-Generated Code and Unit Test
paper.abstract: Recently, Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) and Test-Time Scaling (TTS) have advanced LLM code generation through executable verification. Yet Ground-Truth Unit Tests (GT UTs) remain a bottleneck: SOTA RLVR methods require them for costly training, while existing TTS methods lose competitiveness without them. This motivates GT-free TTS, where existing methods directly use self-generated UTs to refine and select code candidates. Yet such UTs are often noisy or spuriously coupl

summary.core_problem: 代码生成的 RLVR 和 test-time scaling 往往依赖真实单元测试；没有 ground-truth unit tests 时，自生成测试容易噪声大，并可能与错误代码相互强化。
summary.importance: 这是代码生成中的训练无关 test-time 方法。它对预训练研究的间接价值在于展示了可执行验证信号如何在没有人工测试的情况下自举，可能为代码 RLVR 数据构造和 verifier 设计提供弱信号。
summary.technical_approach: CoSPlay 采用 cooperative self-play，同时改进候选代码和自生成单元测试。它先探索多样化解法与潜在失败模式，生成更有区分度的测试思路；随后构造 Code-UT execution matrix，用代码通过测试和测试区分代码的双向 pass-count 信号迭代剪枝与选择。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体 benchmark、模型规模或提升幅度。实验重点应是与依赖 ground-truth unit tests 的 RLVR/TTS 方法，以及直接使用自生成 UT 的 GT-free 方法比较，在无真实测试设置下评估代码候选选择质量。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)、Institute of Deep Perception Technology、JITRI 和 Wuxi。

summary_en.core_problem: RLVR and test-time scaling for code generation often depend on ground-truth unit tests; without them, self-generated tests can be noisy and spuriously coupled with wrong code.
summary_en.importance: This is a training-free test-time method for code generation. Its indirect value for base-model researchers is the self-bootstrapping of executable verification signals without human-provided tests, which may inform RLVR data and verifier design.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoSPlay jointly improves code candidates and self-generated unit tests through cooperative self-play. It explores diverse solution ideas and likely failure modes to generate discriminative test ideas, then uses a Code-UT execution matrix and bidirectional pass-count signals to iteratively prune and select both code and tests.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide benchmark names, model sizes, or numerical gains. The intended comparison is against RLVR/TTS methods that use ground-truth unit tests and GT-free methods that directly rely on self-generated tests.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed affiliations include The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou), Institute of Deep Perception Technology, JITRI, and Wuxi.

recommendation.zh: 看 Code-UT execution matrix 就够了；方法像工程自举，但对无标注 verifier 信号有可借鉴细节。
recommendation.en: Skim the Code-UT execution matrix; the method is mostly engineering self-bootstrapping, but the verifier signal is reusable.

Institute of Deep Perception Technology, JITRI, Wuxi

paper.title: Faithful-MR1: Faithful Multimodal Reasoning via Anchoring and Reinforcing Visual Attention
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a promising paradigm for advancing complex reasoning in large language models, and recent work extends RLVR to multimodal large language models (MLLMs). This transfer, however, surfaces a faithfulness challenge: faithful perception of task-relevant visual evidence and faithful use of that evidence during reasoning, leading to unsatisfactory gains on multimodal benchmarks. Specifically, existing perception supervision often oper

summary.core_problem: Faithful-MR1 解决的是多模态 RLVR 中的“看见”和“用上”脱节问题。现有方法常奖励最终答案或文本化的视觉描述，但模型即使正确识别了图像证据，也可能在后续推理中丢掉、改写或被语言先验覆盖。作者把这类现象称为 perception–reasoning disconnect。
summary.importance: 这项工作属于多模态 post-train / RLVR 训练信号设计，对 VLM 预训练和后训练接口有参考价值。它指出多模态推理不能只把图像转成文字再做语言推理，也不能只用最终答案 reward 期待模型自动学会视觉 grounding。更有效的信号需要同时约束视觉证据的提取位置，以及推理过程中哪些 token 真正依赖这些视觉证据。
summary.technical_approach: Faithful-MR1 分为 Anchoring 和 Reinforcing 两个阶段。Anchoring 阶段把感知显式变成推理前的一个子任务：模型在完整推理前先生成专用的 <Focus> token，并通过 attention supervision 让该 token 直接对齐问题相关的图像区域。这里监督的是图像 region，而不是模型自己生成的视觉描述，因此信号更接近原始视觉证据。Reinforcing 阶段处理更难观察的 faithful use。作者用 counterfactual image intervention 对图像做 mask，找出哪些 response token 的预测会因为图像遮挡而变化，这些 token 被视为视觉因果相关的位置。训练时奖励答案正确、并且在这些视觉相关 token 上集中视觉注意力的轨迹。这个设计把 answer-level RLVR、区域 grounding、token-level 视觉依赖联系在一起。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct 3B 和 7B。作者构造了 19.2K 条带 question-relevant bounding box 标注的 evidence-grounded training examples，用于区域级监督。论文报告在少于现有多模态 RLVR baseline 训练数据的条件下，Faithful-MR1 在多个多模态推理 benchmark 上优于当前方法。分析部分显示，单纯提高 perception text 的准确性并不稳定转化为最终答案提升；Faithful Use 与最终答案准确率的相关性更强。该结果支持了 PRD 是独立失败模式，而不是 perception accuracy 的附属现象。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。优先看 Section 4.4 的失败模式量化分析，它说明为什么只监督视觉描述不够。然后看 Anchoring 阶段的 <Focus> token 和 region-level attention supervision，再看 Reinforcing 阶段的 counterfactual image intervention。实验表格可以重点看 Qwen2.5-VL 3B/7B 上与 Vision-R1、Perception-R1、Vision-SR1、VPPO 类方法的差异。值得深挖的是 reward 是否可能被 attention proxy 欺骗，以及 counterfactual masking 找到的视觉相关 token 是否稳定。

summary_en.core_problem: Faithful-MR1 addresses a specific failure mode in multimodal RLVR: the model may perceive the relevant visual evidence correctly, but then fail to use it faithfully during reasoning. Existing methods often supervise textual visual descriptions or reward only the final answer. That leaves a gap between perception and reasoning, where visual evidence can be dropped, contradicted, or overridden by language priors.
summary_en.importance: The paper is relevant as a multimodal post-training signal design, with implications for the interface between VLM pretraining and RL-based reasoning training. It argues that answer-level rewards are not enough for visual reasoning. A useful training signal should constrain both where the model attends in the image and where the generated reasoning actually depends on visual evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: Faithful-MR1 has two stages. The Anchoring stage inserts an explicit pre-reasoning step: before producing the full reasoning trace, the model emits a dedicated <Focus> token. The attention of this token is supervised against question-relevant image regions using bounding boxes. This gives a region-level perception signal rather than an indirect text-description signal. The Reinforcing stage targets faithful use. Since faithful use is not directly observable from the reasoning text, the method uses counterfactual image intervention: mask visual evidence and identify response tokens whose predictions shift. These tokens are treated as locations where vision causally matters. The RL objective then rewards trajectories that are answer-correct and concentrate visual attention at those visually causal reasoning positions.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct 3B and 7B backbones. The authors build a 19.2K-example evidence-grounded training corpus with bounding-box annotations for question-relevant regions. With less training data than prior multimodal RLVR baselines, Faithful-MR1 reports better performance across multimodal reasoning benchmarks. The diagnostic analysis shows that improving perception text alone does not reliably improve final answer accuracy. Faithful Use tracks answer accuracy more closely, supporting the claim that perception-reasoning disconnect is a separate failure mode.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the failure-mode analysis, especially the part comparing perception coverage, faithful use, and final accuracy. Then read the Anchoring design around the <Focus> token and region-level attention supervision. The Reinforcing stage is the most technically useful part: focus on how counterfactual masking identifies visually causal response tokens and how that signal enters RL. In the experiments, compare the Qwen2.5-VL 3B and 7B results against Vision-R1, Perception-R1, Vision-SR1, and VPPO-style baselines. A useful follow-up question is whether the attention-based proxy can be gamed during training.

recommendation.zh: 值得看方法图和 reward 设计：它把多模态 RLVR 的失败点定位到视觉证据接口，而不是简单怪推理模型不够强。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram and reward design: the useful signal is the diagnosis of the visual-evidence interface, not another claim that stronger reasoning fixes VLMs.

institutions: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: Unified Data Selection for LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Effectively training Large Language Models (LLMs) for complex, long-CoT reasoning is often bottlenecked by the need for massive high-quality reasoning data. Existing methods are either computationally expensive or fail to reliably distinguish high- from low-quality reasoning samples. To address this, we propose High-Entropy Sum (HES), a training-free metric that quantifies reasoning quality by summing only the entropy of the top (e.g., 0.5\%) highest-entropy tokens in each reasoning sample. We v

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个很实际的训练瓶颈：长链式推理数据越来越多，但真正能提升模型 reasoning 的样本比例并不高，而现有筛选方法要么太粗，要么太贵。长度、困惑度、平均熵这类全局指标把所有 token 一视同仁，无法区分“真正承载推理转折的信息点”和大量模板化、低信息密度的铺垫文本；而用强模型打分或训练额外选择器，又会把数据筛选本身变成一项昂贵流程。作者要找的是一个训练无关、模型对齐、能同时服务 SFT、RFT、RL 的统一样本质量指标，用来识别哪些长 CoT 轨迹更值得学。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练接口的意义很直接。它不是改模型结构，而是改训练信号的密度：同样预算下，让模型更多看到“关键推理 token 密度高”的样本，少看冗长但无效的轨迹。贡献有三层。第一，提出了一个足够简单的指标 HES，可以离线筛 SFT 数据，也可以在线做 RFT/RL 的样本选择。第二，它把“高熵关键 token 可能是学习增益来源”这个观察，变成了可操作的数据工程方法。第三，实验显示小模型就能给大模型做筛选，这一点对大规模数据管线很重要，因为它意味着数据质量控制不必绑定目标模型规模。若这个结论稳健，它会影响 reasoning 数据合成、rollout 过滤、以及 continual post-train 中的数据再利用方式。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心很简单，但设计点抓得准。作者先观察长 CoT 中 token-level entropy 的分布，发现区分高质量与低质量样本的，不是全序列平均熵，也不是高熵 token 的平均值，而是少数最高熵 token 的熵总和。于是定义 High-Entropy Sum（HES）：对一条 reasoning 样本，先用当前打分模型计算每个 token 的预测熵，再取熵最高的 top-k% token（文中常用 0.5%），把这些 token 的熵相加，作为样本质量分数。

为什么是“求和”而不是“求平均”，这是全文最关键的判断。平均值会把长推理中真正困难、真正决定分支选择的少数位置稀释掉；而求和保留了两个信号：一是是否存在关键高不确定性节点，二是这类节点出现了多少次。对长 CoT 来说，这比全局平均更接近“样本里有没有多步有效推理”。

作者把 HES 统一接到三种训练范式里：
1. SFT：对现成 reasoning 数据按 HES 排序，只取 top-p% 训练。
2. RFT：对同一问题采样多个候选回答，用 HES 代替或补充传统选择函数，挑出更值得蒸馏回模型的轨迹。
3. RL：在 rollout 阶段先过采样，再按 HES 选前 50% 轨迹参与策略更新，而不是把所有 rollout 都送进 GRPO/PPO 式更新。

这里有两个值得注意的技术点。其一，HES 是 training-free 的，不需要额外训练 reward model 或 selector；其二，HES 与目标模型相对对齐，因为熵来自当前或代理模型自身的 token 分布，而不是外部 judge 的偏好。作者还专门验证了用 0.6B 小模型计算 HES，筛出来的数据对 8B 级训练也同样有效，这使它更像一个可部署的数据管线组件，而不是实验室里的昂贵分析工具。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 SFT、RFT、RL 三条线，这是这篇文章最完整的部分。

先看 SFT。作者报告：只用按 HES 排名前 20% 的样本训练，效果已经能接近全量数据；扩大到前 80% 时，则能稳定超过全量训练基线。这个结果说明原始 reasoning 数据里确实混有大量低效样本，简单扩充数据量并不等于更好的学习信号。更关键的是，作者比较了不同规模打分模型，发现用 0.6B 模型计算 HES，筛选效果与 8B 模型接近，说明 HES 对打分器规模不敏感，离线筛数成本可以压得很低。

再看 RFT。作者把 HES 当作训练无关的选择信号，在同一 query 的多个候选响应中挑选更优轨迹。结果上，HES 明显优于随机选择。这里的意义不是它超过了所有复杂 reward，而是它在几乎没有额外训练成本的前提下，已经能把自举数据质量往上拉一截。

最后看 RL。作者采用“先过采样 rollout，再只保留 HES 排名前 50% 的轨迹做策略更新”的策略，结果优于标准的“所有 rollout 全参与更新”。这说明在 RL for reasoning 里，更多 rollout 不一定更好；如果低质量轨迹占比高，它们会稀释甚至污染 policy gradient。HES 在这里起到的是一种轻量级 rollout denoising 作用。

从消融逻辑看，作者重点比较了几类替代指标：长度、perplexity、平均 token entropy、全部 token entropy 总和、高熵 token 平均熵等。结论是只有“高熵 token 的熵总和”最稳定地区分样本质量。这一组对比很重要，因为它说明 HES 的收益不是来自“熵”这个词本身，而是来自对长 CoT 结构的更细粒度利用。

摘要和正文片段里给出的明确数字包括：top 0.5% 高熵 token、SFT 取 top 20% 可接近全量、取 top 80% 可超过基线、RL 中保留 top 50% rollout、以及 0.6B 打分器可替代 8B 打分器。若精读全文，建议把各 benchmark 上的绝对分数和提升幅度逐一抄下来，因为这篇文章的说服力很大程度来自“跨范式一致有效”。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇值得精读，重点不是公式，而是它如何把一个看似简单的 token 熵统计，变成统一的数据选择原则。

建议先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1。Figure 1 是全文的起点：作者用几种不同熵统计去区分高低质量样本，只有 high-entropy sum 拉开了差距。这个观察如果不成立，后面的方法就没有基础。

然后看方法部分里 HES 的定义，尤其要想清楚两个问题：为什么 top-k% 只看极少数 token；为什么用 sum 而不是 average。这里其实对应长 CoT 的结构假设：真正有训练价值的，是少量决策点、反思点、分支切换点，而不是整段文字都“难”。

接着按训练范式读实验。SFT 部分看数据保留比例与性能曲线，判断它到底是在“去噪”还是在“丢信息”；RFT 部分看它与随机选择、其他启发式选择的差距；RL 部分重点看 oversampling + filtering 为什么比全量 rollout 更新更好，以及是否带来额外方差或偏置问题。

消融实验要重点看三类：k 的选择是否稳健；不同打分模型规模是否影响排序；HES 与长度、平均熵、perplexity 的差异到底来自哪里。若只看一遍，建议至少把这些图表看完。

这篇还有两个值得深挖的点。第一，HES 依赖模型自身熵，因而可能偏向“模型觉得难但可学”的样本，而不是“客观上正确且高质量”的样本；这在不同训练阶段可能是优点，也可能带来 curriculum 偏置。第二，HES 主要服务 reasoning 数据，是否能迁移到预训练阶段的高价值 token 识别，还需要进一步验证。完整读一遍大约 60-90 分钟，若要复现实验，优先从离线 SFT 筛数开始，工程门槛最低。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a practical bottleneck in reasoning training: large long-CoT datasets contain many samples that are expensive to train on but contribute little to reasoning improvement. Existing selection signals are either too coarse, such as length, perplexity, or average entropy over the whole sequence, or too expensive, such as strong-model judging or learned selectors. The authors want a unified, training-free, model-aligned metric that can identify which reasoning traces are actually worth learning from, and that can be used consistently across SFT, RFT, and RL.
summary_en.importance: Its significance lies in improving training signal density rather than changing model architecture. Under a fixed budget, the method tries to expose the model to samples with more informative reasoning pivots and fewer low-value verbose traces. There are three concrete contributions. First, it introduces a simple metric, HES, that works in offline supervised curation and online sample selection. Second, it operationalizes the idea that a small set of high-entropy tokens may carry most of the learning value in long reasoning trajectories. Third, it shows that a small proxy model can score data effectively for much larger target models, which matters a lot for scalable data pipelines. If this result holds broadly, it has implications for reasoning data synthesis, rollout filtering, and continual post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is simple, but the design choice is precise. The authors analyze token-level entropy distributions in long CoT responses and find that neither average entropy over all tokens nor average entropy over only the high-entropy tokens reliably separates good and bad reasoning samples. What works better is the sum of entropy over only the top-k% highest-entropy tokens. This leads to High-Entropy Sum (HES): compute token entropies for a response under a scoring model, select the top-k% tokens by entropy, and sum their entropy values to obtain a sample-quality score.

Why use a sum instead of an average? That is the key idea in the paper. Averaging dilutes the few critical decision points inside long reasoning traces. Summation preserves two signals at once: whether the sample contains genuinely difficult or branching moments, and how many such moments it contains. For long CoT, that is a better proxy for multi-step useful reasoning than a global average over mostly low-information tokens.

The paper then plugs HES into three training paradigms:
1. SFT: rank existing reasoning samples by HES and train only on the top fraction.
2. RFT: sample multiple candidate responses for the same query and use HES as the selection function for which traces to keep.
3. RL: oversample rollouts, then keep only the top-ranked subset by HES for policy updates instead of updating on all rollouts.

Two technical properties matter. First, HES is training-free: no reward model and no auxiliary selector need to be trained. Second, it is relatively aligned with the target model because the score comes from the model’s own token uncertainty, not from an external judge. The paper also shows that HES computed by a 0.6B model can be nearly as useful as HES computed by an 8B model, which makes it practical as a low-cost data curation component.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental coverage across SFT, RFT, and RL is the strongest part of the paper.

In SFT, the authors report that training on only the top 20% of samples ranked by HES already reaches performance comparable to using the full dataset, while using the top 80% consistently surpasses the full-data baseline. This suggests that a substantial fraction of raw reasoning data is low-yield, and that simply scaling data volume does not guarantee better reasoning supervision. A particularly important result is that HES computed by a lightweight 0.6B model performs comparably to HES computed by an 8B model for data selection, which sharply lowers the cost of offline curation.

In RFT, HES is used as a training-free selection signal among multiple sampled responses for the same prompt. It significantly outperforms random selection. The point here is not that it beats every sophisticated reward mechanism, but that it improves self-bootstrapped data quality with almost no additional training overhead.

In RL, the paper uses an oversample-then-filter strategy: generate more rollouts than usual, rank them by HES, and keep only the top 50% for policy updates. This outperforms the standard setting where all rollouts are used. The implication is important for reasoning RL: more rollouts are not always better if many of them are low-quality and inject noisy gradients. HES acts as a lightweight rollout denoiser.

The ablation logic is also strong. The paper compares HES against length, perplexity, average token entropy, total entropy over all tokens, and average entropy over only the high-entropy tokens. The conclusion is that only the sum over high-entropy tokens consistently separates sample quality. That matters because it shows the gain is not from “using entropy” in general, but from using entropy in a way that respects the sparse structure of long reasoning.

The explicit numbers available from the provided text are: top 0.5% high-entropy tokens, top 20% HES-ranked data for near-full SFT performance, top 80% for surpassing the baseline, top 50% rollout retention in RL, and 0.6B scoring models matching 8B scoring models closely. When reading the full paper, it is worth extracting the absolute benchmark scores and gains, because the paper’s credibility depends heavily on consistency across paradigms.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This one deserves a careful read. The main value is not the formula itself, but how a very small token-level statistic becomes a unified data selection principle.

Start with the introduction and Figure 1. Figure 1 is the foundation of the paper: it shows that several natural entropy-based summaries fail, while high-entropy sum separates high- and low-quality reasoning samples. If that empirical observation is weak, the rest of the method is much less convincing.

Then read the HES definition and think through two design choices: why only the top-k% tokens, and why sum rather than average. These choices encode a structural hypothesis about long CoT: the most useful learning signal is concentrated in a few planning, branching, or reflection points, not spread uniformly across the whole trace.

After that, read experiments by training paradigm. In SFT, focus on retention ratio versus performance to judge whether HES is removing noise or discarding useful diversity. In RFT, compare it against random and other heuristics. In RL, pay attention to why oversampling plus filtering beats using all rollouts, and whether this introduces bias or variance trade-offs.

The most important ablations are: sensitivity to k, dependence on the size of the scoring model, and comparisons against length / perplexity / average entropy baselines. Those are the sections that tell you whether HES is robust or just a narrow heuristic.

Two deeper questions are worth keeping in mind. First, because HES depends on model entropy, it may prefer samples that are hard-but-learnable for the current model, not necessarily samples that are objectively best. That could be useful as an implicit curriculum, but it could also bias selection. Second, the paper is about reasoning data; whether the same principle transfers to pretraining-stage token value estimation remains open. A solid first pass takes about 60 to 90 minutes, and the easiest reproduction path is the offline SFT filtering setup.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻复现到内部 reasoning 数据过滤；关键看 HES 是否只是在挑“难题”，以及 top-entropy token 的可解释性。
recommendation.en: Worth reproducing in internal reasoning-data filters; check whether HES is merely selecting hard cases and inspect the top-entropy tokens.

paper.title: From Reasoning Chains to Verifiable Subproblems: Curriculum Reinforcement Learning Enables Credit Assignment for LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) has shown strong promise for LLM reasoning, but outcome-based RLVR remains inefficient on hard problems because correct final-answer rollouts are rare and sample-level credit assignment cannot use partial progress in failed attempts. We introduce SCRL (Subproblem Curriculum Reinforcement Learning), a curriculum RL framework that derives verifiable subproblems from reference reasoning chains and fixes the final subproblem as the original probl

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 RLVR 在难题上的信用分配问题。标准 GRPO/RLVR 依赖最终答案奖励；如果同一题的一组采样全错，组内归一化后没有有效梯度。即使有接近正确的推理轨迹，最终答案错误也会让整段 rollout 得到同样的负反馈。作者要解决的是：如何让模型仍然保持 on-policy 探索，同时从难题中的中间进展得到可验证、可归因的训练信号。
summary.importance: 贡献主要在 post-train RL 与预训练能力边界的接口处。它不是简单增加数学题或模仿专家解，而是把专家解拆成一组可验证子问题，让难题从“全错无梯度”的区域变成“前几步可学习”的课程。对基座研究的启发在于：能力提升不只取决于题目难度，还取决于训练目标能否在模型当前能力边界附近产生非退化梯度。这个思路也可以迁移到代码、长程推理、工具使用等有中间状态可验证的任务。
summary.technical_approach: SCRL 包含三步。第一，给定原题和参考解，用外部 LLM 离线构造 K 个从易到难的可验证子问题，最后一个子问题固定为原题。子问题不是提示模型照着专家前缀继续写，而是要求模型在一次 on-policy rollout 中依次回答所有子问题。这样，中间结论需要模型自己生成，而不是由提示直接提供。第二，对每个子问题答案独立验证，并做 progress-aware correction：只保留从第一个子问题开始的最长连续正确前缀。例如奖励 [1,1,0,1] 会被改成 [1,1,0,0]，避免模型在没有建立前序结论时偶然答对后续问题也得到信用。第三，做 subproblem-level normalization：在每个子问题位置上独立归一化奖励，并把对应 advantage 分配给该子问题的答案 span，而不是把一个样本级 advantage 分给整段推理。为减少训练和原始推理格式的错配，作者还使用 mixed-group training，同时优化带子问题课程的 rollout 和原始问题 rollout。和 SFT/离线模仿相比，SCRL 保留 on-policy 分布；和给专家前缀的 curriculum RL 相比，它不把关键中间结论直接放进上下文，而是把这些结论变成模型需要求解的可验证目标。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 7 个数学推理 benchmark，使用 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-14B 作为主要模型。相对强 curriculum-learning baseline，SCRL 在 Qwen3-4B / 14B 上分别带来 +4.1 / +1.9 平均分提升。在 3 个困难 benchmark 上，报告了 +3.7 pass@1 和 +4.6 pass@64 的提升。消融结果支持两个关键判断：一是 subproblem-level credit assignment 比只看最终答案更有效；二是方法不强依赖高度人工筛选的子问题，也不强依赖特别强的子问题生成器。理论部分给出 metric recovery 分析：把原始问题的策略流形提升到子问题乘积流形后，困难问题中原本退化的梯度信号可以被较早子问题恢复，且原题越难，相对恢复比例越高。实验趋势与这个解释一致。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读方法部分的三个细节：子问题生成约束、progress-aware correction、subproblem-level normalization。核心创新在第三点，但前两点决定了奖励信号是否干净。理论部分重点看 gradient dead zone 与 metric recovery 的形式化定义，判断它是否只是解释性分析，还是能指导后续课程构造。实验部分优先看 7 个 benchmark 的主表、困难题 pass@1/pass@64 结果、以及消融表。最值得深挖的是 mixed-group training：它直接关系到课程格式训练是否会损害模型在原始问题格式下的推理能力。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a concrete failure mode of RLVR on hard reasoning problems: outcome-only rewards give little or no usable credit when all sampled rollouts fail, and a near-miss solution receives the same rollout-level signal as an immediate failure. The central question is how to extract verifiable intermediate learning signals from hard problems while keeping the policy on its own on-policy exploration distribution.
summary_en.importance: The contribution sits at the interface between RL post-training and capability expansion. Instead of adding more hard math problems or imitating expert traces, the method changes the reward granularity so that difficult prompts can still produce non-degenerate gradients near the model’s current capability boundary. This is relevant beyond math RLVR: code repair, tool use, theorem proving, and long-horizon agent tasks all have variants where intermediate states may be made verifiable.
summary_en.technical_approach: SCRL first uses an external LLM and a reference solution to derive an ordered curriculum of K verifiable subproblems. The final subproblem is the original problem. The policy is then asked to answer all K subproblems in a single on-policy rollout. This differs from prefix-hint curricula: the intermediate facts are not injected as fixed context; the model must derive them itself. Each subproblem answer is verified separately. A progress-aware correction keeps only the longest consecutive solved prefix, so a reward vector such as [1,1,0,1] becomes [1,1,0,0]. This prevents accidental success on later subproblems from receiving credit when earlier dependencies were not solved. The key optimization step is subproblem-level normalization: rewards are normalized independently at each subproblem position, and the resulting advantages are assigned to the corresponding answer spans. The method also uses mixed-group training, jointly optimizing curriculum rollouts and original-problem rollouts to reduce prompt-format mismatch.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-14B and evaluate on seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks. SCRL improves over strong curriculum-learning baselines by +4.1 average points on Qwen3-4B and +1.9 average points on Qwen3-14B. On three hard benchmarks, it reports +3.7 pass@1 and +4.6 pass@64 gains. Ablations indicate that subproblem-level credit assignment is a major source of the gain, and that the method does not require heavily curated subproblems or an unusually strong subproblem generator. The theoretical analysis frames the effect as metric recovery: decomposing a hard problem into a product of subproblem spaces can recover gradients from earlier solvable parts, with larger relative recovery as the original problem becomes harder.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the method section closely, especially the construction of verifiable subproblems, progress-aware correction, and subproblem-level normalization. The normalization rule is the main algorithmic change, while the correction rule is important for reward validity. In the theory section, focus on the definition of gradient dead zones and the metric recovery argument. In the experiments, prioritize the main benchmark table, hard-benchmark pass@1/pass@64 results, and ablations on credit assignment and subproblem generation quality. The mixed-group training design is also worth checking because it addresses whether curriculum-formatted training transfers back to the original prompt format.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻复现子问题级 advantage 的 ablation；它可能改变 outcome-only RLVR 在难题上够用的 prior。
recommendation.en: The subproblem-level advantage ablation is worth reproducing immediately; it challenges the prior that outcome-only RLVR is enough on hard reasoning.

paper.title: Scaling Behaviors of LLM Reinforcement Learning Post-Training: An Empirical Study in Mathematical Reasoning
paper.abstract: While scaling laws for large language models (LLMs) during pre-training have been extensively studied, their behavior under reinforcement learning (RL) post-training remains largely unexplored. This paper presents a systematic empirical investigation of scaling behaviors in RL-based post-training, with a particular focus on mathematical reasoning. Based on a set of experiments across the full Qwen2.5 dense model series (0.5B to 72B), we characterize how model scale, data volume, and computationa

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 RL post-training 在数学推理上的 scaling 行为：给定模型规模、RL 计算量、可用题目数量和数据复用强度，模型的 Pass Rate 改善是否存在可预测规律。它关心的不是某个 RL recipe 的单点效果，而是类似预训练 scaling law 的资源分配问题：在固定 FLOPs、固定唯一数据量、或固定总训练样本量时，应当选择多大的模型、训练多久、是否重复使用数据。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的价值在于，它把 post-train RL 从经验配方推进到可量化的资源规划问题。预训练 scaling law 通常用 loss、参数量、token 数和 compute 建模；这篇工作把类似思想放到 reasoning RL，使用 1 - PassRate 作为 test loss，分析模型规模和 RL 资源之间的关系。最有用的结论有三点：第一，大模型在 RL 阶段也更 compute-efficient 和 data-efficient，不只是初始能力更强；第二，这种效率提升有饱和趋势，不能简单外推为参数越大越划算；第三，在数据受限时，重复使用小规模高质量题目接近使用更大语料的效果。这对 RL pretrain、reasoning mid-train、以及后训练预算分配都有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法设计比较干净。作者选用 Qwen2.5 同构模型族，覆盖 0.5B、1.5B、3B、7B、14B、32B、72B，尽量让参数规模成为主要变量。RL 训练使用 VeRL 框架，训练数据来自 Reasoning360 的 guru-RL-92k 数学子集，并经过去重和难度过滤；题目按 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的 pass rate 从易到难排序，用作 curriculum。评测分两类：一类是 500 道同分布 held-out math problems，用于拟合和验证 scaling 公式；另一类是更宽的泛化评测，包括 AIME2024、AMC2023、GSM8K、MATH500、HumanEval、Zebra Puzzle、SuperGPQA。核心建模是把 RL 后的 test loss 写成模型规模 N 和资源预算 X 的函数，其中 X 可以是 compute C 或数据量 D。经验上，loss 随资源预算呈近似 log-linear 的下降；斜率可理解为学习效率 k(N)。进一步，k(N) 随模型规模增大而提高，但以饱和函数逼近上限 K_max，表示大模型的边际 RL 效率收益会递减。这个设定比简单拟合每个模型的学习曲线更有解释力，因为它同时回答了“同样预算给哪个尺寸”和“继续加大模型是否还划算”。
summary.experiments: 实验规模是这篇论文的主要支撑。作者在 Qwen2.5 0.5B 到 72B 上训练了 63 个 RL 模型，使用超过 50k 道数学题。主要结果显示，在 0.5B–72B 范围内，RL 带来的 loss reduction 与 compute 大致满足 log-linear 趋势；大模型不仅起点更好，单位 compute 和单位数据带来的提升也更高。论文还比较了 base model 和 instruct model，报告所提出的 power-law 形式在两类初始化上都具有预测性，能够外推较大模型表现和训练后期轨迹。数据受限实验显示，重复曝光较小数据集的效果接近使用更多唯一题目，说明对 math RL 来说，高质量题目的 reuse 是有效策略。附录还分析了 GRPO 中 rollout number 的影响，用于理解采样数量对 RL 学习效率和稳定性的作用。给定片段没有提供具体 benchmark 分数和拟合参数，因此不应过度解读绝对提升幅度；更可靠的结论是趋势、相对效率和可预测性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读实验设置、scaling law 公式和三组资源约束实验。优先看：1）模型族、数据、curriculum 和评测协议，判断变量控制是否足够干净；2）loss versus compute/data 的主图，重点看不同模型尺寸的斜率差异；3）k(N) 饱和拟合，判断 32B 到 72B 的边际收益是否已经明显下降；4）data-constrained 和 data reuse 实验，因为这部分最接近实际 RL 数据预算决策；5）base 与 instruct 初始化的对比，理解预训练/指令调优状态如何影响 RL scaling；6）GRPO rollout number 的附录，关注采样预算与学习信号质量之间的关系。深挖时要特别注意两个限制：数学题 reward 相对清晰，结论未必直接迁移到开放式偏好 RL；使用 Qwen2.5 单一模型族有利于控制变量，但也限制了架构和 tokenizer 差异下的外推。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether RL post-training for mathematical reasoning has predictable scaling behavior. The central question is how model size, RL compute, unique training problems, and data reuse interact when the target metric is pass-rate improvement rather than pretraining cross-entropy. It frames RL post-training as a resource allocation problem: under fixed FLOPs, fixed unique data, or fixed total sample budget, which model size and training regime should be preferred.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an empirical scaling study for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. It extends the scaling-law mindset from pretraining loss to reasoning RL, using 1 - PassRate as a test loss. The useful signal is not just that larger models perform better after RL, but that they learn more efficiently during RL as well. At the same time, the efficiency gain appears to saturate with scale, so the result does not support a naive “larger is always proportionally better” extrapolation. The data reuse finding is also practically relevant: when high-quality reasoning problems are scarce, repeated exposure to a smaller curated set can be close to using a larger pool of unique problems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study controls model-family variation by using Qwen2.5 models from 0.5B to 72B parameters: 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B. RL runs are conducted with VeRL. The training set is the math subset of guru-RL-92k from Reasoning360, after deduplication and difficulty filtering. Problems are sorted by increasing difficulty using the pass rate of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, forming a curriculum. Evaluation has two layers: a 500-problem in-domain held-out set for fitting and validating the scaling relation, and a broader benchmark suite covering AIME2024, AMC2023, GSM8K, MATH500, HumanEval, Zebra Puzzle, and SuperGPQA. The proposed formulation models post-RL test loss as a function of model size N and a resource budget X, where X can be compute or data. Empirically, loss decreases approximately log-linearly with the resource budget. The slope is interpreted as a learning-efficiency term k(N), and k(N) increases with model size but approaches a saturation limit K_max. This is the key modeling choice: it separates initial capability from RL learning efficiency and makes diminishing returns explicit.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical base consists of 63 RL-trained LLMs across the Qwen2.5 scale range, trained on more than 50k math problems. The main observation is that, from 0.5B to 72B, RL-induced loss reduction follows an approximately log-linear trend with compute. Larger models start stronger and also gain more per unit of compute and per unit of data. The paper reports that the same power-law style relation is predictive for both base and instruction-tuned initializations, including extrapolation to larger models and later training stages. In the data-limited regime, reusing a smaller set of problems is nearly as effective as increasing the number of unique problems under comparable total exposure. The appendix also studies the number of rollouts in GRPO, which is relevant for separating sample budget from reward-signal quality. The provided text does not expose exact benchmark scores or fitted coefficients, so the robust takeaway is the shape of the scaling behavior rather than a specific numerical improvement.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the experimental setup first, especially the model family, curriculum construction, reward/evaluation protocol, and the distinction between in-domain scaling validation and out-of-domain generalization. Then focus on the main loss-versus-compute and loss-versus-data plots, looking at slope differences across model sizes. The most important figure is the saturation fit for k(N), because it determines whether scaling RL to larger models remains cost-effective. The data-constrained and data-reuse sections are worth close reading for practical training decisions. Also inspect the comparison between base and instruction-tuned initializations, since it indicates how much the RL scaling law depends on the starting policy. The GRPO rollout-number ablation is useful for understanding whether more samples improve learning by reducing variance or by changing the exploration distribution.

recommendation.zh: 要读：它把 RLVR 拉进 scaling-law 框架，尤其应复现 k(N) 饱和项，避免把大模型 RL 效率外推得过满。
recommendation.en: Read it for the k(N) saturation result; the setup is narrow, but it is a useful guardrail against naive RLVR scale extrapolation.
