paper.title: You Only Need Minimal RLVR Training: Extrapolating LLMs via Rank-1 Trajectories
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a dominant paradigm for improving reasoning in large language models (LLMs), yet the underlying geometry of the resulting parameter trajectories remains underexplored. In this work, we demonstrate that RLVR weight trajectories are extremely low-rank and highly predictable. Specifically, we find that the majority of downstream performance gains are captured by a rank-1 approximation of the parameter deltas, where the magnitude of th

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究 RLVR 训练轨迹是否可以由早期 checkpoint 预测，从而用很少的强化学习训练步数外推出接近完整 RLVR 的模型权重。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的启发在训练动态分析和 post-train 成本压缩。结论不是提出新的 RL 目标，而是指出数学 RLVR 的参数更新可能高度低维：主要收益集中在每个权重张量的一个主方向上，训练时间主要改变这个方向上的系数。这对理解 RLVR 很有用，因为它支持一种观点：RLVR 更像是在放大预训练模型中已有的成功推理模式，而不是从零学习复杂新能力。限制也清楚：实验集中在数学 RLVR 和若干 Qwen 系列模型上，能否扩展到代码、agent、多模态或长链路 RL，还需要验证。
summary.technical_approach: 方法从 checkpoint 轨迹出发。设基础模型为 θ0，RLVR 第 t 步 checkpoint 为 θt，对每个参数张量计算 Δθt=θt-θ0。然后把同一张量在多个训练步的 delta 展平成向量并堆叠成矩阵 M∈R^{T×mn}，对 M 做 SVD。作者发现 rank-1 方向已经捕获主要的下游有效更新；把 checkpoint 投影到这个主方向后得到的标量系数 ct 随训练步近似线性，很多张量的线性拟合 R² 超过 0.98。RELEX 基于这个现象：只运行前 15% 到 20% 的 RLVR，利用早期 checkpoint 估计 rank-1 子空间，对投影系数做线性回归，再外推未来步数的权重。它不训练额外预测器，也不改变 GRPO 目标。一个关键观察是更高 rank 和非线性时间模型没有带来稳定收益，rank-1 投影反而像谱域去噪，保留稳定任务信号，丢掉一部分随机优化噪声。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 GRPO 风格的 RLVR，并在 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B、Qwen3-4B-Base、Qwen3-8B-Base 上验证。使用约 15% 到 20% 的训练成本时，RELEX 在 in-domain MATH 上达到或接近完整 RLVR：Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B 为 71.6% 对 71.5%，Qwen3-4B-Base 为 85.6% 对 85.5%，Qwen3-8B-Base 为 87.4% 对 88.5%。作者还报告 RELEX 在 5 个 OOD 数学 benchmark 的平均表现超过完整 RLVR。分析部分显示 rank-1 重构 checkpoint 能在多个训练步接近 oracle RLVR checkpoint；rank-1 系数随 step 近似线性；增加 rank 或使用非线性外推不能进一步改善结果。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读到半精读，预计 35 分钟。先看第 3.1 节的轨迹 SVD 分析，这是核心证据；重点确认 rank-1 是按张量做还是全模型做，以及 downstream-relevant change 如何评估。再看第 3.2 节 RELEX 算法，关注 T_cut、SVD、线性外推和 checkpoint 重构的具体实现。最后看第 4.3 节消融，尤其是 rank 数、非线性拟合和谱去噪解释。读的时候要留意三个风险点：早期轨迹是否受学习率 warmup 影响，外推步数超过平台期后是否会失效，以及该低秩结构是否只是数学 RLVR 的特例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether the future weight trajectory of RLVR can be predicted from a short prefix of training, so that one can obtain a near-final RLVR checkpoint with only a small fraction of the RL compute.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a training-dynamics observation with practical implications for post-training cost. The paper does not propose a new RL objective. Instead, it shows that, for math RLVR, parameter updates appear highly low-dimensional: most useful change in each tensor lies along one dominant direction, and training mostly changes the scalar magnitude along that direction. This supports the view that RLVR often amplifies reasoning behaviors already present in the base model rather than learning them from scratch. The evidence is still scoped: the experiments focus on math RLVR and Qwen-family backbones, so transfer to code, agentic tasks, multimodal RL, or long-horizon RL remains open.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis starts from checkpoint trajectories. Given a base model θ0 and RLVR checkpoints θt, the authors compute deltas Δθt=θt−θ0 for each parameter tensor. For a tensor, the deltas across training steps are flattened and stacked into a trajectory matrix M∈R^{T×mn}, followed by SVD. The key empirical finding is that a rank-1 component captures most of the downstream-relevant update, and the projected coefficient ct along this dominant direction evolves almost linearly with training step, with R² above 0.98 for many tensors. RELEX uses the first 15–20% of RLVR training to estimate this rank-1 subspace, fits a line to the projected coefficients, and extrapolates future checkpoints. It requires no learned predictor and does not alter GRPO. The paper also argues that higher-rank components mostly capture less stable dynamics, while rank-1 projection acts as a spectral denoising step.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use GRPO-style RLVR on Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, Qwen3-4B-Base, and Qwen3-8B-Base. With roughly 15–20% of the original training cost, RELEX matches or nearly matches full RLVR on in-domain MATH: 71.6% vs. 71.5% for Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, 85.6% vs. 85.5% for Qwen3-4B-Base, and 87.4% vs. 88.5% for Qwen3-8B-Base. The paper also reports stronger average performance than full RLVR on five out-of-domain math benchmarks. The ablations indicate that rank-1 checkpoint reconstruction tracks oracle RLVR checkpoints well, the coefficient dynamics are close to linear, and increasing the rank or using nonlinear temporal models does not yield consistent gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim with selective deep reading in about 35 minutes. Start with Section 3.1, which contains the central SVD evidence. Check whether the rank-1 structure is computed per tensor or globally, and how the paper measures downstream-relevant change. Then read Section 3.2 for the RELEX procedure, especially the choice of T_cut, SVD estimation, coefficient regression, and weight reconstruction. The most useful ablations are in Section 4.3: rank choice, nonlinear extrapolation, and the spectral-denoising interpretation. While reading, keep three caveats in mind: early trajectories may be shaped by learning-rate schedules, extrapolation may fail past the useful RL plateau, and the observed low-rank behavior may be specific to math RLVR.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是“RLVR 是否本质低秩”这个判断；若谱图和跨模型外推都站得住，会直接影响你怎么看 R1-Zero 类训练的有效自由度，先看奇异值分解和外推失效案例。
recommendation.en: Read it for the claim that RLVR is effectively low-rank; if the spectra and cross-model extrapolation are clean, it changes how you think about the effective degrees of freedom in reasoning RL.

paper.title: The Unlearnability Phenomenon in RLVR for Language Models
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR) has proven effective in improving Large Language Model's (LLM) reasoning ability. However, the learning dynamics of RLVR remain underexplored. In this paper, we reveal a counterintuitive phenomenon: among hard examples that the model initially struggles with, a substantial subset remains unlearnable even when correct rollouts are present. To understand the phenomenon, we first demonstrate that existing optimization and sampling techniques fail

summary.core_problem: 解释 RLVR 训练中的一个反常现象：即使某些难例已经出现正确 rollout，模型仍长期学不会，为什么会这样。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对 pretrain/post-train 接口很有价值。它不是提出更强 RLVR 算法，而是指出 RLVR 的失败有一部分不是 credit assignment 或采样不够，而是表征层面的“不可学性”。贡献类型是训练动态与机制分析，直接影响如何理解 RL 对推理能力的边界。
summary.technical_approach: 作者系统研究 RLVR 中的 unlearnability。先验证常见优化和采样技巧无法消除这类难例；再做 cross-example gradient analysis，发现不可学样本与其他样本的梯度相似度低，说明它们依赖的表征方向与主流训练分布脱节，推理模式也更难泛化。进一步分析表明，在 RL 阶段做数据增强也难以改善这种梯度相容性，因此问题更像是底层表示缺口，而不是 rollout 不够或 reward 稀疏。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模和任务集，但实验结构很清楚：比较可学/不可学 hard examples，测试现有 optimization 与 sampling 技术是否能救回；再用跨样本梯度相似度和泛化行为刻画 representation flaw。核心结果是：存在一批 hard examples，即便有正确轨迹也持续学不会；且 RL 过程难以修复其表示缺陷。没有看到完整数值前，最值得关注的是分析方法和 failure mode 定义。
summary.authors_note: He He 是较知名的 NLP/LLM 研究者，长期关注语言建模、推理与学习动态。其余作者背景在给定信息中无法进一步确认。

summary_en.core_problem: It explains a counterintuitive failure mode in RLVR: why some hard examples remain unlearnable even when correct rollouts are already present in training.
summary_en.importance: This is highly relevant to the pretrain/post-train interface. Rather than proposing yet another stronger RLVR recipe, it argues that part of RLVR failure is not about credit assignment or insufficient sampling, but about representation-level unlearnability. The contribution is a training-dynamics and mechanism analysis that sharpens the boundary of what RL can realistically fix.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper systematically studies unlearnability in RLVR. It first shows that existing optimization and sampling tricks do not resolve the issue. It then uses cross-example gradient analysis and finds that unlearnable examples have low gradient similarity with the rest of the data, suggesting that they rely on representation directions poorly aligned with the dominant training distribution and on reasoning patterns that do not generalize. It further shows that data augmentation in RL does not improve this gradient compatibility, pointing to a representation deficit rather than a mere rollout or reward problem.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes or exact task suites, but the experimental logic is clear: compare learnable vs. unlearnable hard examples, test whether standard optimization/sampling methods can recover them, and characterize them via gradient similarity and generalization behavior. The main result is that a substantial subset of hard examples remains unlearnable despite correct rollouts, and RL struggles to repair the underlying representation flaw. The analysis setup matters more than the headline numbers here.
summary_en.authors_note: He He is a well-known NLP/LLM researcher with sustained work on language modeling, reasoning, and learning dynamics. The provided metadata does not allow a more precise note for the other authors.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接影响你怎么看 RL 能否补 pretrain 的洞；建议优先看梯度相似度分析和“正确 rollout 仍学不会”的定义，值得在内部 RLVR 日志上复现。
recommendation.en: This changes how you think about RL as a patch for pretraining gaps; start with the gradient-similarity analysis and the definition of 'correct rollout yet still unlearnable,' then try to reproduce it on your own RLVR logs.

paper.title: Anti-Self-Distillation for Reasoning RL via Pointwise Mutual Information
paper.abstract: On-policy self-distillation, where a student is pulled toward a copy of itself conditioned on privileged context (e.g., a verified solution or feedback), offers a promising direction for advancing reasoning capability without a stronger external teacher. Yet in math reasoning the gains are inconsistent, even when the same approach succeeds elsewhere. A pointwise mutual information analysis traces the failure to the privileged context itself: it inflates the teacher's confidence on tokens already

summary.core_problem: 研究数学推理 RL 中 on-policy self-distillation 增益不稳定的问题，尤其是带 privileged context 的教师分布为何会压制有效的多步探索 token。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练方法与训练信号分析。它把 self-distillation 的失败解释落到逐 token 的 PMI 结构上：教师在答案结构和可验证声明上变得更自信，却在“Wait / Let / Maybe”这类探索性 deliberation token 上降低概率。这对推理 RL 的 token-level reward shaping 有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Anti-Self-Distillation。常规 self-distillation 是让 student 下降到 privileged-context teacher 的分布；AntiSD 反过来上升 student 与 teacher 的 divergence，把逐 token 符号翻转，形成一步内有界的 advantage。方法还加入 entropy-triggered gate：当 teacher entropy 已经塌缩时关闭该项，避免继续放大退化信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整实验配置、模型规模、数据集和提升幅度。可确认的是目标场景为数学推理 RL，并声称 AntiSD 是默认 self-distillation 项的 drop-in replacement，用于改善原方法在数学任务上的不稳定收益。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why on-policy self-distillation with privileged context gives inconsistent gains in mathematical reasoning RL, especially when the teacher distribution suppresses tokens needed for multi-step search.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training method plus a token-level signal analysis. The PMI view argues that privileged context makes the teacher overconfident on structurally implied or verifiable tokens while reducing probability on deliberative tokens such as “Wait,” “Let,” and “Maybe.” This is directly relevant to reward shaping and distillation signals for reasoning models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, Anti-Self-Distillation, reverses the usual distillation direction: instead of descending the divergence between student and privileged teacher, it ascends it. This flips the per-token sign and yields a bounded one-step advantage. An entropy-triggered gate disables the term once teacher entropy collapses, preventing the method from amplifying a degenerate teacher signal.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full experimental details, model sizes, datasets, or exact gains. The reported setting is mathematical reasoning RL, and AntiSD is positioned as a drop-in replacement for the standard self-distillation term.

recommendation.zh: 只看 PMI 分解和 entropy gate；若 token-level 图干净，值得在内部 RLVR 蒸馏项里复现。
recommendation.en: Read the PMI decomposition and entropy gate; if the token-level plots are clean, this is worth reproducing inside RLVR distillation losses.

paper.title: GoLongRL: Capability-Oriented Long Context Reinforcement Learning with Multitask Alignment
paper.abstract: We present GoLongRL, a fully open-source, capability-oriented post-training recipe for long-context reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Existing long-context RL methods often treat data construction as a matter of designing increasingly complex retrieval paths, leading to homogeneous task coverage and reward formulations that inadequately reflect practical long-context requirements. Our work offers two contributions. (1) Capability-oriented data construction with full open rel

summary.core_problem: 解决长上下文 RLVR 训练中过度依赖检索路径设计、任务覆盖单一、奖励定义与真实长上下文能力脱节的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个后训练数据与训练 recipe 工作，价值不在新 RL 算法，而在把长上下文能力拆成可操作的能力 taxonomy，并公开 23K 样本、构造流程和训练代码。对预训练研究员的意义在于：它提供了一个更干净的长上下文能力分解视角，可反过来检验预训练阶段到底缺了哪些能力。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 capability-oriented 的 RLVR 数据构造，而不是继续堆复杂 retrieval path。作者按长上下文能力分类组织 9 类任务，并为每类任务配自然评测指标；数据由两部分组成：从开源语料筛选的真实样本，以及基于书籍、论文、多轮对话等真实长文档生成的合成 QA。训练上使用 vanilla GRPO，强调在相同 RL 设置下，仅替换数据即可带来收益，并通过 multitask alignment 让不同长上下文能力共同训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要可确认的数据规模为 23K RLVR 样本，覆盖 9 类长上下文任务；实验主张是在相同 vanilla GRPO 设置下，仅靠该数据集就能优于现有长上下文 RL 方法。摘要未给出模型参数量、训练 token 或具体提升幅度，因此当前更应把它看作数据配方与任务设计信号，而不是已被充分定量验证的范式结论。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets a mismatch in long-context RLVR: existing methods over-index on retrieval-path engineering, cover a narrow task set, and use rewards that poorly reflect real long-context capabilities.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a post-training data/recipe paper rather than a new RL algorithm. Its value lies in turning long-context ability into an explicit capability taxonomy, with a fully open 23K-sample dataset, construction pipeline, and code. For pretraining researchers, the useful part is the cleaner decomposition of what long-context competence actually consists of.
summary_en.technical_approach: The key idea is capability-oriented RLVR data construction instead of increasingly complex retrieval-path design. The dataset spans 9 task types aligned with a taxonomy of long-context capabilities, each paired with a natural evaluation metric. Data comes from curated open-source samples plus synthetic QA built from real long documents such as books, papers, and multi-turn dialogues. Training uses vanilla GRPO, with multitask alignment across capability types.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the dataset contains 23K RLVR samples over 9 long-context task types. The main empirical claim is that under the same vanilla GRPO setup, swapping in this dataset alone outperforms prior long-context RL approaches. The abstract does not expose model size, training budget, or exact gains, so the current signal is stronger on data design than on fully quantified scaling conclusions.

recommendation.zh: 可读，但重点只在数据 taxonomy 和任务配比；如果你关心 long-context 能力到底该怎么拆，这篇比又一个花哨 RL 算法更有用，先看数据构造部分。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for the capability taxonomy and task mix, not for the RL algorithm; if you care how long-context ability should be decomposed, read the data construction sections first.

paper.title: Not Every Rubric Teaches Equally: Policy-Aware Rubric Rewards for RLVR
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has made post-training highly effective when correctness can be checked automatically. However, many important model behaviors require satisfying several qualitative criteria at once. Rubric-based rewards address this setting by grading prompt-specific criteria and aggregating them into a scalar reward. Yet standard static aggregations conflate a criterion's human-assigned importance with its current usefulness as an optimization signal. We show tha

summary.core_problem: 解决 rubric-based RLVR 中固定 rubric 权重不能反映当前 policy 可学习信号的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练 reward 设计方法。它区分“人类认为重要的目标权重”和“当前训练阶段有效的优化信号权重”，对减少 rubric reward 的无效梯度、饱和项和不可达项有直接意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 POW3R，一个 policy-aware rubric reward 框架。它保留 human weights 和 category balance 作为最终 rubric objective，但在训练中根据 rollout-level contrast 动态调整 criterion-level reward weights，优先强调当前能区分 policy rollout 的标准，同时避免把 rubric 目标本身改掉。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、任务集和数值提升。实验应围绕多标准 qualitative behavior 的 RLVR/RL 训练展开，比较静态 rubric aggregation 与 POW3R 的训练效果、criteria saturation、unreachable criteria 和 rollout 区分度。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包含 Bing Liu；其长期研究情感分析、观点挖掘和 NLP。其他作者机构与背景无法从给定信息确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a failure mode in rubric-based RLVR where fixed rubric weights do not match the current usefulness of each criterion as a learning signal.
summary_en.importance: This is a reward-design contribution for post-training. It separates human importance weights from optimization-time signal weights, which matters when criteria are saturated, unreachable, or weakly discriminative for the current policy.
summary_en.technical_approach: POW3R is a policy-aware rubric reward framework. It preserves human weights and category balance as the target rubric objective, while dynamically adapting criterion-level reward weights using rollout-level contrast to emphasize criteria that currently separate policy outputs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, or numerical gains. The experiments likely compare static rubric aggregation against POW3R in RLVR-style training for qualitative multi-criterion behavior, analyzing saturation, unreachable criteria, and rollout discrimination.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Bing Liu, known for work in sentiment analysis, opinion mining, and NLP. Other affiliations cannot be confirmed from the provided information.

recommendation.zh: 读 reward 分解和 ablation；它提醒 RLVR 里“重要标准”和“有梯度标准”不能混用。
recommendation.en: Read the reward decomposition and ablations; it makes a clean point that important criteria and gradient-bearing criteria are not the same in RLVR.

paper.title: Video Models Can Reason with Verifiable Rewards
paper.abstract: Video diffusion models have made rapid progress in perceptual realism and temporal coherence, but they remain primarily optimized for plausible generation rather than verifiable reasoning. This limitation is especially pronounced in tasks where generated videos must satisfy explicit spatial, temporal, or logical constraints. Inspired by the role of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) in reasoning-oriented language models, we introduce VideoRLVR, a practical recipe for optimizin

summary.core_problem: 当前视频扩散模型主要优化感知真实度与时序一致性，训练目标仅追求生成合理性，而非可验证的逻辑/时空约束正确性。即使经过监督微调（Supervised Fine-Tuning，SFT），模型也可能模仿解法的视觉模式，却不满足任务底层的规则约束，导致视频推理能力难以稳定引出和验证。
summary.importance: 这是将大语言模型侧的可验证奖励强化学习（Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards，RLVR）三阶段范式（预训练-监督微调-RLVR）迁移到生成式视频模型的系统性落地，证明生成式视觉模型也可以通过可验证奖励优化推理正确性，打破了此前视觉生成研究仅优先感知质量的路径依赖。提出的早期步聚焦、稠密分解奖励两个设计，解决了视频强化学习训练成本高、奖励稀疏的核心痛点，为多模态模型的对齐与推理优化提供了可复用的方法。该框架还将视频生成的范畴从内容合成拓展到视觉推理轨迹生成，定义了视频推理的新任务范式，对统一多模态推理的预训练-后训练闭环构建有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: VideoRLVR是面向流匹配视频扩散模型优化的三组件框架。第一，采用SDE-GRPO优化主干，将扩散模型的逆去噪过程建模为马尔可夫决策过程（Markov Decision Process，MDP）的状态转移，把强化学习优化适配到扩散模型的连续去噪轨迹上，而非传统的离散token强化学习。第二，早期步聚焦（Early-Step Focus）策略将探索与反向传播仅集中在决定粗粒度结构和长程规划的早期去噪阶段，后期去噪步固定使用参考模型的输出，不做强化学习更新，大幅降低计算开销。第三，稠密分解奖励将稀疏的任务最终成功信号，拆解为每帧对应的可验证规则组件（如迷宫任务中每一步的移动合法性、向终点的推进程度、无回溯等）。基于规则的规划器生成真值轨迹来对齐帧序列与逻辑约束，即使任务全程失败也能提供有效反馈。完整训练管线对齐大语言模型的三阶段流程：预训练获得通用生成能力，在规则生成的解法轨迹上做监督微调，再通过VideoRLVR做强化学习优化。与此前依赖稀疏人工评分奖励、全去噪步优化的视频强化学习工作不同，该设计明确面向可验证的推理正确性，同时降低了训练开销。
summary.experiments: 评测覆盖三个可验证推理任务：迷宫、FlowFree、推箱子。与用于初始化的监督微调检查点相比，VideoRLVR的任务成功率分别提升6.1%（迷宫）、5.5%（FlowFree）、3.2%（推箱子）。与持续监督微调相比，VideoRLVR在难度更高的任务上带来的提升幅度更大，说明可验证奖励能提供模仿学习无法覆盖的优化信号。在VBVR基准的分布外拆分上，VideoRLVR也表现出更优的跨域泛化能力。消融实验证实，稠密分解奖励对低成功率的难任务至关重要；早期步聚焦策略在保持性能几乎不变的前提下，减少约40%的训练时间。VideoRLVR在该可验证推理基准上的表现优于多个闭源与开源商用视频生成模型。
summary.reading_guide: 精读优先关注第3章的问题形式化部分，理解如何将逆扩散去噪过程建模为MDP，这是强化学习适配视频扩散的核心基础。然后查看第4章三个核心组件的细节，特别是早期步聚焦策略中去噪阶段划分的依据，以及稠密奖励的具体拆解设计。实验部分重点关注表2的消融结果和VBVR跨域泛化结果，理解各组件的贡献和泛化性的来源。可深挖的方向包括：早期步优化的结论是否可迁移到文本扩散模型或自回归多模态模型的强化学习中，以及如何为无规则求解器的任务自动化设计可验证奖励。

summary_en.core_problem: Current video diffusion models are primarily optimized for perceptual realism and temporal coherence, with training objectives that only target generation plausibility rather than verifiable compliance with logical, spatial, or temporal constraints. Even after supervised fine-tuning (SFT), models may imitate the visual patterns of valid solutions without satisfying underlying task rules, making visual reasoning abilities difficult to reliably elicit and verify.
summary_en.importance: This systematic implementation of the LLM three-stage RLVR (Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards) paradigm (pretrain → SFT → RLVR) for generative video models proves that generative visual models can be optimized for reasoning correctness via verifiable rewards, breaking the prior path dependence of visual generation research that prioritizes only perceptual quality. The proposed Early-Step Focus and dense decomposed reward designs address the core pain points of high training cost and sparse rewards in video RL, providing reusable methods for alignment and reasoning optimization of multimodal models. This framework expands the scope of video generation from content synthesis to visual reasoning trajectory generation, defining a new task paradigm for video reasoning with direct reference value for building the pretrain-posttrain closed loop of unified multimodal reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: VideoRLVR is a three-component framework optimized for flow-matching video diffusion models. First, it adopts an SDE-GRPO optimization backbone, which models the reverse denoising process of diffusion as state transitions in a Markov Decision Process (MDP), adapting RL optimization to the continuous denoising trajectory of diffusion models instead of traditional discrete-token RL. Second, the Early-Step Focus strategy concentrates exploration and backpropagation only on the early denoising phase where coarse-grained structure and long-range planning are determined; later denoising steps use fixed reference model outputs without RL updates, drastically reducing computational overhead. Third, dense decomposed rewards break the sparse end-of-task success signal into verifiable rule-based components aligned with each frame (e.g., valid movement, progress toward the goal, no backtracking in maze tasks). Rule-based planners generate ground-truth trajectories to align frame sequences with logical constraints, providing informative feedback even when full task success is rare. The full pipeline aligns with the LLM three-stage workflow: pretraining for general generative competence, SFT on rule-generated solution trajectories, then RL optimization via VideoRLVR. Unlike prior video RL work that relies on sparse human-scored rewards or full denoising step optimization, this design explicitly targets verifiable reasoning correctness while reducing training overhead.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations cover three verifiable reasoning tasks: Maze, FlowFree, and Sokoban. Compared to the SFT checkpoint used for initialization, VideoRLVR improves task success rates by 6.1% (Maze), 5.5% (FlowFree), and 3.2% (Sokoban) respectively. Compared with continued SFT, VideoRLVR delivers larger gains on harder tasks, indicating verifiable rewards provide optimization signals not captured by imitation learning alone. It also shows improved out-of-domain transfer on the out-of-distribution split of the VBVR benchmark. Ablations confirm that dense decomposed rewards are critical for low-success-rate difficult tasks, and the Early-Step Focus strategy reduces training time by ~40% while retaining nearly identical performance. VideoRLVR outperforms multiple closed-source and open-source commercial video generation models on the verifiable reasoning benchmark.
summary_en.reading_guide: For close reading, start with Section 3 on problem formulation to understand how the reverse diffusion denoising process is modeled as an MDP, the core foundation for adapting RL to video diffusion. Then review Section 4 for details of the three core components, especially the empirical justification for the denoising phase cutoff in Early-Step Focus, and the specific decomposition design of dense rewards. In experiments, focus on the ablation results in Table 2 and the VBVR out-of-domain generalization results to understand component contributions and generalization drivers. Follow-up exploration directions include verifying whether the early-step optimization conclusion transfers to text diffusion models or autoregressive multimodal model RL, and how to automate verifiable reward design for tasks without rule-based solvers.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 SDE-GRPO 和早期去噪优化；它会改变“RLVR 只适合文本推理”的默认边界。
recommendation.en: Read the SDE-GRPO and early-denoising pieces; it weakens the prior that RLVR is mainly a text-reasoning recipe.

paper.title: Nudging Beyond the Comfort Zone: Efficient Strategy-Guided Exploration for RLVR
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a scalable paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models. However, its effectiveness is fundamentally limited by exploration: the policy can only improve on trajectories it has already sampled. While increasing the number of rollouts alleviates this issue, such brute-force scaling is computationally expensive, and existing approaches that modify the optimization objective provide limited control ove

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 RLVR 里的一个老问题，但切得更具体：不是“奖励稀疏”本身，而是正确推理轨迹虽然存在、模型也给了非零概率，却在有限 rollout 下长期采不到，导致策略更新始终围着已知的舒适区打转。作者把问题拆成两层。第一层是探索效率：单纯增加 rollout 数量当然能提高撞到正确轨迹的概率，但代价很高。第二层是探索结构：已有做法多半通过熵正则、clip 变体之类在分布层面鼓励更散的采样，却不能指定“去探索哪些语义上不同的推理方式”。论文的核心目标，就是在不依赖 oracle 解答或中间步骤监督的前提下，给 RLVR 一个可控、低成本、能覆盖多种 reasoning strategy 的探索机制，并且让这种受控探索学到的能力最终回流到原始 policy，而不是只在带提示的采样条件下有效。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，它不是直接改 pretrain objective，但对 pretrain-posttrain 接口有现实意义。原因有三点。第一，它把“探索”从 rollout 数量问题改写成“策略空间覆盖”问题，这和预训练里讨论数据多样性、mixture design、curriculum 的思路是相通的。第二，它说明后训练阶段可以用很轻量的文本上下文去显式诱导不同推理模式，而不必依赖昂贵的过程监督；这对后续把 reasoning style 作为一种可控训练信号很有启发。第三，它指出 context-conditioned exploration 会破坏标准 GRPO 的 advantage 估计前提，并给出相应修补，这一点对所有“带条件采样再回写 base policy”的 RL 方案都有参考价值。贡献量级上，它更像一个扎实的方法改造，而不是范式替换；但如果结果稳定，确实能改变 RLVR 里“多堆 rollout”这一默认工程路径。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由三部分组成。第一部分是 Strategy Nudging。做法很直接：在同一个问题输入前后，附加一些轻量的、启发式的策略级文本上下文，让模型分别沿不同 reasoning mode 采样。例如对数学题，可以提示代数法、几何法、分步验证、边界检查之类。关键点不在提示词本身多精细，而在于它把原本混在一起的推理空间显式分桶，让 rollout 不再只是从一个单峰分布里反复抽样，而是被迫访问多个潜在子空间。作者强调这和 oracle-guided 方法不同：它不提供正确解，也不提供中间步骤，只提供“往哪个方向想”的弱引导，因此保留了发现新解法的空间。

第二部分是 Inter-Intra group advantage。标准 GRPO 假设同一 prompt 下的一组 rollout 来自同一采样条件，因此组内 reward 的均值和方差可以拿来做相对 advantage 归一化。NudgeRL 里不同 rollout 来自不同 strategy context，reward 差异既包含轨迹质量，也包含 context 本身带来的系统偏置。如果仍按原始 group-wise normalization 做，credit assignment 会失真：某些策略组可能整体更难或更易，导致组内相对分数不能横向比较。作者因此把 advantage 估计拆成 intra-group 和 inter-group 两层，既保留同一策略组内部的相对排序，又引入跨策略组的校正，让更新信号能区分“这个 rollout 在本策略下好不好”和“这个策略整体值不值得学”。从问题设定看，这一步是方法成立的关键，不然 strategy nudging 只会把采样分布打散，却未必能稳定训练。

第三部分是 distillation-augmented objective。因为训练时 rollout 是在带 strategy context 的条件下采样，而测试时通常不会给这些 context，所以存在明显的 train-test mismatch。作者的处理是把在 context-forced exploration 中发现的有效行为蒸馏回 base policy，让基础模型在无额外提示时也能复现这些更优轨迹。这个设计很像“探索策略”和“部署策略”解耦：前者负责发现，后者负责吸收。相比直接把带 context 的 policy 当最终模型，这样更符合 RLVR 的实际使用方式，也减少了推理时额外 prompt 工程的依赖。
summary.experiments:
从引言给出的结果看，主结论很明确：NudgeRL 在性能上超过标准 GRPO，即使后者拿到 8× 更大的 rollout budget 也追不上；同时也优于依赖 oracle 信息的引导式 baseline。这个结果如果在正文里覆盖多个任务和模型规模，说明收益主要来自探索效率，而不是单纯多算力。论文前面还引用了 Hu et al. 对 RLVR 一步性能增益的分析，把未采样正确 token 的概率质量 U_pos,2 视为主要负项，这为实验设计提供了理论支点：如果 NudgeRL 有效，应该能在相同 rollout 下更频繁命中原本低概率但正确的 reasoning path。

从全文结构推测，关键实验应包括几类。其一，主表比较不同 rollout budget 下的 GRPO、带目标函数改造的探索方法、oracle-guided 方法和 NudgeRL。这里最值得看的是“同等算力下提升多少”和“达到同等性能所需 rollout 降低多少”。其二，消融实验：去掉 inter-intra advantage、去掉 distillation、只保留 strategy prompt、或改成随机无意义 context，验证收益是否真的来自结构化探索而非简单 prompt 扰动。其三，策略多样性分析：不同 nudge 是否诱导出可区分的 reasoning trace，正确样本覆盖是否更广。其四，迁移实验：训练时用 context，测试时不用 context，检验蒸馏是否真正把能力写回 base policy。摘要里没有给出更多具体数字；如果正文有按任务拆分的提升幅度、成功率曲线和 rollout-efficiency 曲线，这些会比单点平均分更有信息量。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，但建议把方法和实验各抓一个重点。先看 Introduction 和 Preliminaries，作者对 RLVR 探索瓶颈的表述比较清楚，尤其是把问题落到“未探索到的正确区域”而不是泛泛的 sparse reward。然后直接看方法部分里 Strategy Nudging、Inter-Intra group advantage、distillation objective 的定义，重点想清楚两件事：为什么标准 GRPO advantage 在多 context 采样下会失效；为什么必须显式做蒸馏，而不是指望 PPO 更新自然消除条件依赖。实验部分优先看主结果表、rollout budget 对比图、以及 ablation。若时间有限，30-40 分钟足够抓住主要贡献。若要深挖，建议重点检查作者使用的 strategy context 是多通用还是任务特定、人工设计成本多高、以及 inter-intra advantage 是否会引入新的方差或超参敏感性。这些决定了方法能否从一个漂亮想法变成稳定配方。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific bottleneck in RL with verifiable rewards: the policy often assigns non-trivial probability mass to correct reasoning trajectories, yet finite rollout sampling fails to discover them, so optimization keeps reinforcing already-visited modes. The authors frame this not merely as sparse reward, but as an exploration coverage problem. Scaling the number of rollouts helps, but is expensive. Existing objective-level fixes such as entropy-style encouragement broaden sampling only in a distributional sense; they do not let us steer exploration toward semantically distinct reasoning strategies. The paper therefore asks: can we induce structured, diverse exploration without oracle solutions or process supervision, and can the gains found under such guided exploration be transferred back to the base policy used at inference time?
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training paper, but it matters for foundation-model research because it turns exploration from a brute-force sampling issue into a controllable coverage issue. That connects naturally to pretraining concerns such as data mixture design, diversity, and curriculum. A second reason is methodological: it shows that lightweight textual contexts can be used as weak control signals for reasoning-style exploration, avoiding expensive step-level supervision. A third reason is more technical: once rollouts are generated under different conditioning contexts, the assumptions behind standard GRPO-style group-relative advantage estimation break, and the paper proposes a repair. That makes it relevant beyond this specific method, especially for any RL setup that separates an exploratory policy from a deployment policy. The contribution is not a paradigm shift, but it is a meaningful systems-level refinement of RLVR training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three main components. First, Strategy Nudging. For each prompt, the model is asked to generate rollouts under lightweight strategy-level textual contexts, such as hints that encourage different reasoning modes. The key idea is not that the prompts are highly informative, but that they partition the reasoning space into multiple semantically meaningful subspaces. Instead of repeatedly sampling from one dominant mode, the policy is nudged to visit alternative trajectories it would otherwise ignore. Unlike oracle-guided methods, these nudges do not reveal the answer or intermediate steps; they only bias the search direction, leaving room for novel successful trajectories to emerge.

Second, Inter-Intra group advantage. Standard GRPO assumes that rollouts for a prompt are sampled under the same condition, so within-group reward normalization is meaningful. Here, rollouts come from different strategy contexts, and reward variation mixes two factors: trajectory quality and context-specific bias. A naive group-relative normalization would therefore distort credit assignment. The proposed estimator separates intra-context comparison from inter-context calibration, so the update can capture both whether a rollout is strong within its own strategy group and whether that strategy is globally useful. This is likely the central technical piece: without it, strategy-conditioned exploration may diversify samples but produce unstable or misleading policy updates.

Third, a distillation-augmented objective. Training-time exploration is performed under explicit strategy contexts, but inference typically uses the base prompt only. That creates a train-test mismatch. The paper addresses this by distilling useful behaviors discovered under context-forced exploration back into the base policy. Conceptually, this decouples discovery from deployment: the conditioned policy explores, the unconditioned policy absorbs. This is a practical design choice, because it avoids relying on extra prompting at inference time and makes the learned gains usable in standard RLVR deployment settings.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline result stated in the paper is that NudgeRL outperforms standard GRPO even when GRPO is given an 8x larger rollout budget, and it also beats oracle-guided baselines. If this pattern holds across tasks and model scales in the full experiments, the main takeaway is that the gain comes from exploration efficiency rather than simply more compute. The paper also grounds its motivation in prior analysis of one-step RLVR improvement, where unsampled correct token mass acts as a dominant negative term; this gives a clear mechanistic expectation for the experiments: a successful method should discover low-probability but correct reasoning paths more often under the same rollout budget.

The most informative experimental sections are likely to be: main comparisons against GRPO under matched and scaled rollout budgets; ablations removing inter-intra advantage, removing distillation, or replacing meaningful strategy nudges with random contexts; diversity analyses showing whether different nudges actually induce distinct reasoning traces; and transfer tests checking whether gains persist when the strategy context is removed at inference. The abstract snippet does not provide more detailed numbers such as model sizes, task breakdowns, or exact improvement margins. If the full paper includes rollout-efficiency curves, per-task gains, and variance analyses, those will be more revealing than a single average score.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper, but it is worth reading the motivation and method carefully. Start with the introduction and preliminaries, especially the discussion of why unexplored correct regions are the real bottleneck in RLVR. Then jump to the three method components: Strategy Nudging, Inter-Intra group advantage, and the distillation objective. Two questions are worth keeping in mind while reading: why exactly does standard GRPO-style advantage estimation fail under multi-context sampling, and why is explicit distillation necessary instead of relying on policy optimization alone to absorb the gains? In the experiments, prioritize the main comparison table, rollout-budget scaling plots, and ablations. A 30-40 minute read should be enough to capture the core idea. If reading more deeply, inspect how task-specific the strategy contexts are, how much manual design they require, and whether the new advantage estimator introduces variance or hyperparameter sensitivity.

recommendation.zh: RLVR的探索优化方法，适合推理能力对齐的实验参考，仅需阅读第3.2节的损失设计部分
recommendation.en: This RLVR exploration optimization method is suitable for reasoning alignment experiments, only read §3.2 for loss design

paper.title: AIS: Adaptive Importance Sampling for Quantized RL
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models (LLMs) is dominated by the cost of rollout generation, which has motivated the use of low-precision rollouts (e.g., FP8) paired with a BF16 trainer to improve throughput and reduce memory pressure. This introduces a rollout-training mismatch that biases the policy gradient and can cause training to collapse outright on reasoning benchmarks. We show that the mismatch is non-stationary and acts as a double-edged sword: early in training it prov

summary.core_problem: 这项工作处理低精度 rollout 与高精度训练器之间的分布不一致问题。LLM 的 RL 训练常用 FP8/INT8 模型生成轨迹，再用 BF16 模型计算 log-prob 和更新参数。这样能显著加速 rollout，但采样策略不再等于被优化策略，policy gradient 会带偏。长 CoT 场景下，token 级误差会沿生成长度累积，严重时会让推理任务训练崩掉。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在预训练目标，而在 post-train 与基座能力接口。大规模 RL 训练的成本主要在 rollout，低精度 rollout 已经是工程上很自然的选择。问题是它改变了训练信号的分布。AIS 给出的启发是：数值噪声不一定只该被消除，早期可能提供探索，后期才更像有害偏差。这个视角对 RL pretrain、verifiable reward 训练、长推理模型的训练稳定性都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是在 GRPO 中加入 Adaptive Importance Sampling。标准做法会用量化 rollout 直接训练，或用普通 importance sampling 修正采样分布差异。前者偏差大，后者容易引入高方差。AIS 不做固定阈值截断，而是在每个梯度步从训练器已有统计量中计算三个标量诊断：weight reliability 衡量重要性权重是否可信，divergence severity 衡量 rollout 策略与训练策略差异是否严重，variance amplification 衡量修正后是否放大梯度方差。然后用一个混合系数在未修正梯度和完整 IS 修正梯度之间插值。差异还处在有益探索区间时，修正放松；差异开始破坏稳定性时，修正加强。额外开销较小，因为这些量来自 policy update 中已经计算的 log-prob、ratio 或相关统计。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 LLaDA-8B-Instruct、Qwen3-8B、Qwen3.5-9B，任务包括数学推理、规划和通用评测。文中给出的关键现象是：单纯 FP8 rollout 在 Qwen3-8B 的 AIME25 上相比 BF16 rollout 下降 6.63%，说明 mismatch 足以改变训练结果。AIS 在多个 reasoning benchmark 上恢复了大部分 BF16 差距，明显优于截断式 importance sampling，并在不少任务上接近或超过 BF16 参考结果。同时保留低精度 rollout 的系统收益：约 1.5 到 2.76 倍 rollout 加速，以及约 50% 显存降低。另一个有意思的点是，作者把低精度 rollout 扩展到 diffusion LLM 的 RL 设置，实验包含 LLaDA-8B-Instruct。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction 中关于 mismatch 双重作用的分析，以及方法部分对三个诊断量和混合系数的定义。实验部分优先看 FP8 直接训练、BF16 参考、普通 IS、截断 IS、AIS 的对比曲线，尤其是训练早期和后期的行为差异。预计 30 到 45 分钟。若关心大规模 RL 系统，重点看 rollout 精度、显存、吞吐与最终准确率之间的取舍；若关心训练动态，重点看 mismatch 从探索噪声转为偏差源的证据。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses the distribution mismatch introduced by low-precision rollout in LLM reinforcement learning. In a common production setup, trajectories are sampled from an FP8 or INT8 rollout model, while log-probabilities and parameter updates are computed by a BF16 trainer. This speeds up rollout, but the sampling policy is no longer the policy being optimized. The resulting bias accumulates over long chain-of-thought trajectories and can destabilize reasoning RL.
summary_en.importance: The main value is at the pretrain-posttrain interface rather than in a new pretraining objective. Rollout dominates the cost of RL for reasoning models, so low-precision rollout is operationally attractive. The paper makes a useful training-dynamics point: quantization noise is not always harmful. It can act as stochastic exploration early in training, then become a bias source as the policy sharpens. That framing is relevant for RL pretraining, verifier-based training, and stability work on long-reasoning models.
summary_en.technical_approach: AIS is integrated into GRPO as an adaptive correction between the raw gradient and a fully importance-weighted gradient. Direct FP8 rollout leaves the policy gradient biased. Standard importance sampling reduces bias but often pays with high variance. AIS computes three scalar diagnostics at each update from quantities already available in the trainer: weight reliability, divergence severity, and variance amplification. These diagnostics determine a mixing coefficient. When the mismatch is still benign and helps exploration, the method relaxes correction. When the mismatch becomes destabilizing, it moves closer to full importance correction. The design avoids a fixed clipping rule and adds little overhead because it reuses log-probability and ratio statistics from the policy update.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses LLaDA-8B-Instruct, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen3.5-9B on mathematical reasoning, planning, and general benchmarks. A key reported failure case is Qwen3-8B on AIME25, where naive FP8 rollout drops accuracy by 6.63% relative to BF16 rollout. AIS recovers most of the gap to BF16 on reasoning benchmarks, outperforms truncation-based importance sampling, and often matches or improves over the BF16 reference. It keeps the systems benefit of low-precision rollout: roughly 1.5 to 2.76 times rollout speedup and about 50% memory reduction. The inclusion of LLaDA also makes the study relevant to RL for diffusion language models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction for the double-edged interpretation of quantization mismatch, then read the method section for the exact definitions of the three diagnostics and the adaptive mixing rule. In the experiments, focus on curves comparing naive FP8, BF16, standard IS, truncated IS, and AIS, especially the early-versus-late training behavior. Estimated reading time: 30 to 45 minutes. For RL systems work, focus on the throughput-memory-accuracy tradeoff. For training dynamics, focus on the evidence that mismatch changes from exploration noise into harmful bias.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和诊断指标即可；低精度 rollout 不是免费午餐，早期探索收益会在策略收敛后变成偏差。
recommendation.en: Read the method and diagnostics: low-precision rollouts are not free—early exploration noise later turns into policy-gradient bias.

paper.title: Learning from Language Feedback via Variational Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) suffers from sparse outcome signals, creating severe exploration bottlenecks on complex reasoning tasks. Recent on-policy self-distillation methods attempt to address this by utilizing language feedback to generate dense, token-level supervision. However, these approaches rely on a fixed, passive teacher to interpret the feedback. As the student policy improves, the teacher's zero-shot assessment capabilities plateau, ultimately halting furth

summary.core_problem: 现有基于语言反馈的在策略自蒸馏方法使用固定的被动教师模型解读反馈，随着学生模型能力提升，教师的零样本评估能力进入瓶颈，无法提供更精细的梯度信号，导致学习停滞；同时标准RLVR依赖稀疏的二元结果奖励，存在严重的信用分配和探索瓶颈。
summary.importance: 对RL pretrain和后训练的反馈利用有方法参考价值，提出了教师和学生协同进化的自蒸馏框架，明确了语言反馈驱动自蒸馏的适用边界。
summary.technical_approach: 提出变分策略蒸馏（VPD）框架，将从语言反馈学习形式化为变分期望最大化（EM）问题：E步基于轨迹结果和语言反馈主动优化教师模型的反馈解读能力，M步将优化后的教师的token级知识蒸馏到学生策略中；两者共享权重，通过自适应信任区域保证训练稳定性。
summary.experiments: 在编程、科学推理等基准上，VPD效果优于标准RLVR和现有被动自蒸馏基线；实验同时发现，虽然VPD能有效缓解训练崩溃、延迟性能平台期，但在任务难度极高的冷启动场景下，纯稀疏奖励RL最终仍是更有效的范式。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读引言了解现有自蒸馏方法的核心缺陷，第3章看EM框架的形式化推导，第4章看核心实验和适用边界分析；预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing on-policy self-distillation methods using language feedback rely on a fixed, passive teacher to interpret feedback. As student policy improves, the teacher's zero-shot evaluation capability plateaus and can no longer provide fine-grained gradient signals, leading to training stagnation. Additionally, standard RLVR depends on sparse binary outcome rewards, with severe credit assignment and exploration bottlenecks.
summary_en.importance: Offers methodological reference for RL pretraining and post-training feedback utilization, proposes a co-evolution framework for teacher and student policies, and clarifies the applicable boundary of language feedback-driven self-distillation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Variational Policy Distillation (VPD) framework formalizes learning from language feedback as a variational Expectation-Maximization (EM) problem. In the E-step, the teacher model is actively optimized to interpret language feedback based on trajectory outcomes. In the M-step, token-level knowledge from the refined teacher is distilled into the student policy. The two models share weights, and an adaptive trust region ensures training stability.
summary_en.experiments: On programming and scientific reasoning benchmarks, VPD outperforms standard RLVR and existing passive self-distillation baselines. Experiments also show that while VPD effectively mitigates training collapse and delays performance plateaus, pure sparse-reward RL remains the more effective paradigm in extremely hard cold-start scenarios.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction to understand core limitations of existing self-distillation methods, read Section 3 for formal derivation of the EM framework, and review Section 4 for core experimental results and applicability boundary analysis; estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 将语言反馈转化为 token 级密集监督的 EM 框架，对解决 RLVR 稀疏奖励有启发，关注其 E 步教师模型动态更新的具体实现。
recommendation.en: An EM framework converting language feedback into dense token-level supervision; inspiring for RLVR sparse reward issues. Focus on the dynamic teacher update in the E-step.

paper.title: Learning from Failures: Correction-Oriented Policy Optimization with Verifiable Rewards
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as an effective paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models. However, RLVR training is often hindered by sparse binary rewards and weak credit assignment, resulting in ambiguous optimization signals and underutilization of the useful information embedded in failed trajectories. To address this challenge, we propose Correction-Oriented Policy Optimization (CIPO), a simple and effective extension to RL

summary.core_problem: 在 RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）里，二值稀疏奖励导致 credit assignment 弱，失败轨迹被“一刀切”惩罚，既浪费了失败中包含的部分正确推理结构，也让优化信号方向性不足。论文要解决的是：不引入额外标注/外部 critic 的前提下，把 on-policy 失败样本变成更密、更有方向的训练信号。
summary.importance: 属于 post-train（RL）对基座能力的改进，但对“训练信号质量/稀疏奖励如何变稠密”这一类问题有直接启发。它的贡献不是提出新的 reward model 或过程监督，而是给出一种自举式的数据构造：用模型自己的失败输出作为条件，采样“修正解”，把失败轨迹转化为监督学习式的纠错目标，并与 GRPO 类 RL 目标联合优化。对做 RLVR 的团队，这类方法往往比引入额外模型更便宜、更稳定；对 pretrain 研究的间接价值在于：展示了如何把负样本从“抑制项”变成“可学习的局部邻域结构”，改善梯度信号的可用性。
summary.technical_approach:
CIPO（Correction-Oriented Policy Optimization）是在 GRPO/RLVR 框架上的扩展，核心是“失败→纠错监督”的自生成闭环。

- 失败轨迹转纠错对：每轮 on-policy rollout 后，收集失败输出 y_fail。构造新的条件输入（prompt + y_fail），再从当前策略采样 refined solution y_corr。直觉是：不同失败离正确解的距离不同，“near-miss”更容易在局部邻域被修正；这种可修正概率差异会自然提供更细粒度的学习信号，而不是把所有失败等价为负奖励。
- 联合目标：把纠错样本的监督目标（让模型在给定失败尝试的条件下生成正确/更优解）与标准 RLVR/GRPO 目标一起优化。这样既保留 RLVR 的可验证奖励优势，又引入更稠密、更具方向性的梯度。
- 稳定性设计：作者提到三类机制来避免“把失败都学进去”导致策略退化：
  1）自适应平衡成功/失败样本比例；
  2）risk-aversion reward shaping（更保守地处理高风险更新，细节需看方法章节公式）；
  3）基于 on-policy 采样准确率的 rollout preference，保证训练信号持续信息量。

与相关工作的区别：不依赖额外的过程奖励模型/LLM critic；也不同于 SDPO 那类需要更强反馈或反思能力的 teacher 构造。它更像“把失败当作可条件化的上下文”，训练一个显式的自我修正能力。
summary.experiments:
论文在 11 个基准（数学推理+代码）上报告一致收益。给出的关键数字包括：
- 纠错/调试：Seed-Coder-8B 用 CIPO 在 DebugBench 上提升 7.63%，效果达到 Claude-4-sonnet 水平，并超过 GRPO。
- 数学推理：Qwen-3-4B 用 CIPO 在 6 个数学基准上平均准确率提升 17.56%，相对 GRPO 额外提升 4.55%。
- 还报告 pass@K 更高，作者用此论证提升不只是“把概率压到少数解上”，而是扩大了可行解空间/推理能力（需要结合具体 pass@K 曲线与温度设置判断）。

从预训练/训练动态角度，建议重点看：纠错样本占比的调度消融、risk shaping 的 ablation、以及不同失败类型（near-miss vs fundamentally wrong）下纠错成功率与最终收益的对应关系是否被量化。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 40–60 分钟）：
- 先看 Figure 1/2：失败类型异质性与“失败→纠错采样→联合优化”的训练闭环。
- 再读方法章节里联合目标的公式与三项稳定性机制（自适应比例、risk shaping、rollout preference），这是可复现的关键。
- 最后快速扫实验：重点看 DebugBench 与数学 6-benchmark 的主表，以及 pass@K 与消融表。若要落地到自家 RLVR pipeline，优先复现“纠错样本构造 + 比例调度”，再逐步加 shaping 与 preference。

summary_en.core_problem: In RL with verifiable rewards (RLVR), binary sparse rewards make credit assignment weak and treat all failed trajectories as equally negative, wasting partially-correct reasoning in failures and providing ambiguous gradients. The paper targets a task-agnostic way to turn on-policy failures into informative training signals without extra annotations or external critics.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training (RL) contribution, but it directly informs how to improve training signal quality under sparse verification. The key idea is a self-bootstrapped data construction: condition on the model’s own failed attempt and sample a refined solution, then optimize a correction objective jointly with GRPO-style RL. Compared to adding process reward models or LLM critics, it is cheaper and often more stable. For pretraining researchers, the transferable insight is how to convert “negative samples” from pure suppression into learnable local structure that densifies gradients.
summary_en.technical_approach:
CIPO (Correction-Oriented Policy Optimization) extends GRPO/RLVR with a failure-to-correction loop.

- Failure → correction pairs: after on-policy rollouts, collect failed outputs y_fail. Build a new conditioning context (prompt + y_fail) and sample refined solutions y_corr from the current policy. The mechanism leverages heterogeneity of failures: near-miss failures are more correctable in the local neighborhood, implicitly yielding more informative supervision than uniform penalization.
- Joint optimization: train with a correction-style supervised objective on the generated correction samples together with the standard RLVR/GRPO objective, aiming to keep the benefits of verifiable rewards while adding directional, denser gradients.
- Stabilization components: the paper describes (i) an adaptive balance between successful and failed trajectories, (ii) risk-averse reward shaping, and (iii) a rollout preference strategy based on on-policy sampling accuracy to maintain informative updates and avoid policy degradation.

Distinct from prior work: no external process reward model or LLM critic; unlike SDPO-like approaches, it does not rely on strong feedback/reflective teachers. It explicitly trains “self-correction conditioned on own mistakes.”
summary_en.experiments:
Reported results span 11 benchmarks in math reasoning and code generation. Key numbers provided:
- Correction/debugging: Seed-Coder-8B + CIPO gains +7.63% on DebugBench, reaching performance comparable to Claude-4-sonnet and surpassing GRPO.
- Reasoning: Qwen-3-4B + CIPO improves average accuracy by +17.56% across six math benchmarks, with an additional +4.55% over GRPO.
- Higher pass@K is reported, suggesting improvements beyond mere probability sharpening (this should be interpreted alongside sampling settings and pass@K curves).

For deeper understanding, focus on ablations for correction-sample ratio scheduling, risk shaping, rollout preference, and any analysis that correlates failure types with correction success probability and final gains.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~40–60 min):
- Start with Figures 1–2 to internalize the failure heterogeneity argument and the training loop.
- Read the method section carefully for the joint objective and the three stabilization mechanisms; these are the implementation-critical parts.
- Then scan the main tables on DebugBench and the six math benchmarks, plus pass@K and ablation tables. For practical adoption, first replicate “correction sample construction + ratio scheduling,” then add shaping/preference if needed.

recommendation.zh: 读方法构造和 ablation 即可；失败轨迹转监督是干净的小改动，值得拿来对照 RLVR 信号稀疏问题。
recommendation.en: Read the construction and ablations; turning failed rollouts into supervision is a clean tweak worth testing against sparse RLVR signals.

paper.title: Correct Answers from Sound Reasoning: Verifiable Process Supervision for Language Models
paper.abstract: Training language models to produce both correct answers and sound reasoning remains an open challenge. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards typically optimizes only final outcomes, which can lead to a failure mode where task accuracy improves while reasoning becomes less accurate, less complete, or even internally inconsistent. We propose verifiable process supervision (VPS), a post-training framework for verifiable domains that jointly optimizes prediction accuracy and reasoning qual

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 outcome-only RL 在推理训练中的一个具体问题：模型最终答案变准了，但显式推理过程可能变差，表现为中间判断错误、遗漏或前后不一致。作者希望在可验证领域里，同时优化最终答案和推理过程质量。
summary.importance: 这篇论文属于 post-train，但和预训练研究有接口价值。它说明可验证奖励只看最终答案时，训练信号会鼓励捷径，而不一定鼓励可复用的中间推理状态。对 RL pretrain、reasoning-oriented midtrain、以及可验证数据构造都有启发：如果任务天然可分解，过程级 verifier 可以提供比最终答案更密的监督信号；但前提是中间声明能被稳定抽取并确定性验证。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Verifiable Process Supervision，简称 VPS。流程分三步。第一步，用合成推理轨迹做 SFT，让模型输出固定结构的 reasoning trace。结构化格式不是为了可读性，而是为了后续能用简单规则抽取中间 claims，避免依赖 LLM judge 或复杂语义解析。第二步，构造 reasoning verifier，把抽取出的中间声明和领域中的 ground-truth 信号或规则约束比较，得到多个 subtask reward。第三步，在 RL 训练中把最终答案奖励和过程奖励合并。作者还加入 adaptive reward weighting：对当前错误更大的子任务赋予更高权重，相当于让训练动态地偏向模型薄弱的 reasoning subskill。和普通 RLVR 相比，VPS 不只奖励 answer correctness；和 LLM-as-judge 过程打分相比，它更便宜，也更可控，但适用范围依赖可验证环境。
summary.experiments: 实验选择国际象棋作为测试床，因为棋局有确定规则、引擎参考信号，并且 move analysis 可以拆成候选着法、局面评估等可解释子任务。论文报告在四个开源 reasoning models 上，accuracy-only GRPO 能提升最终预测准确率，但会降低推理质量，例如 win-rate error 增大、内部一致性下降。VPS 在保留 top-1 accuracy 收益的同时，提高 Elo rating 和 coverage，并显著降低 win-rate error，使 consistency 接近饱和。adaptive weighting 相比固定聚合更好，尤其改善语言模型本来较难的子任务。在相同准确率下，三个独立 LLM judges 更偏好过程监督模型的推理轨迹。给出的正文片段没有包含 Table 1 的具体数值，因此不应推断精确提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30 分钟。重点看 Adaptive verifiable process supervision 这一节，确认中间 claims 如何定义、如何抽取、每个 subtask reward 如何计算，以及 adaptive weighting 的公式。实验部分重点看 accuracy-only GRPO 与 VPS 的对照表、win-rate error / consistency / Elo 的关系，以及预算长度变化下是否出现 shortcut strategy。若关注可扩展性，需要特别看 chess verifier 的领域依赖程度，因为这是方法能否迁移到数学、代码或工具使用任务的关键限制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a failure mode of outcome-only RL for reasoning models. Optimizing final-answer correctness can improve task accuracy while degrading the exposed reasoning trace: intermediate claims become less accurate, less complete, or internally inconsistent. The goal is to train models that produce both correct answers and verifiable reasoning steps.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training paper, but it is relevant to pretraining-facing research on reasoning signals. It shows that final-answer verifiability alone can create shortcut incentives. When a task can be decomposed into checkable intermediate claims, process-level rewards provide denser and better aligned supervision. The limitation is also clear: the approach depends on domains where intermediate statements can be extracted reliably and checked deterministically.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed framework is Verifiable Process Supervision, or VPS. It first uses SFT on synthetic traces to impose a structured reasoning format. This structure is functional: it allows claims to be extracted with syntactic rules rather than LLM judging or open-ended semantic parsing. A deterministic verifier then checks these claims against domain rules and ground-truth signals, producing multiple subtask rewards. These rewards are aggregated into a reasoning reward and combined with the standard final-answer reward during RL. The paper also introduces adaptive reward weighting, which gives more weight to subtasks where the model still has larger errors. Compared with standard RLVR, VPS supervises both the conclusion and the reasoning path. Compared with LLM-judge process supervision, it is cheaper and less noisy, but less general.
summary_en.experiments: Chess is used as the controlled environment because it has exact rules, engine-derived reference signals, and naturally decomposable reasoning components such as candidate move selection and position evaluation. Across four open reasoning models, accuracy-only GRPO improves prediction accuracy but harms reasoning quality, increasing win-rate error and reducing internal consistency. VPS preserves the accuracy gains while improving Elo rating and coverage, lowering win-rate error, and pushing consistency close to saturation. Adaptive weighting improves over fixed reward aggregation, especially on subtasks that are harder for language models. At matched accuracy, three independent LLM judges prefer the traces produced by process-supervised models. The provided text does not include the numeric entries from Table 1, so exact effect sizes cannot be verified here.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 minutes. Focus on the VPS method section: the trace schema, claim extraction rules, verifier design, subtask rewards, and the adaptive weighting formula. In the experiments, compare accuracy-only GRPO against VPS on top-1 accuracy, win-rate error, consistency, Elo, and coverage. The most important scalability question is how much of the chess verifier is domain-specific, since that determines whether the same idea can transfer to math, code, or tool-use settings.

recommendation.zh: 读奖励构造和自适应加权；chess 外推要保留，但它清楚暴露了 final-only RLVR 的坏激励。
recommendation.en: Read the reward construction and adaptive weighting; chess may not transfer cleanly, but it exposes the bad incentives of final-only RLVR.

paper.title: GAGPO: Generalized Advantage Grouped Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning has become a powerful paradigm for post-training large language model agents, yet credit assignment in multi-turn environments remains a challenge. Agents often receive sparse, trajectory-level rewards only at the end of an episode, making it difficult to determine which intermediate actions contributed to success or failure. As a result, propagating delayed outcomes back to individual decision steps without relying on costly auxiliary value models remains an open problem.

summary.core_problem: 多轮 agent RL 里奖励通常是回合末端的稀疏信号，但优化却在 token/动作层面进行，导致信用分配（credit assignment）难：中间哪一步做对/做错很难被定位。现有办法要么引入 critic/PRM 等额外模型增加复杂度与误差，要么用 trajectory-level 的 grouped 更新但方差大、监督传播弱。论文要解决的是：在不训练 critic 的前提下，能否做“按环境 step 对齐、并能时间递推传播”的优势估计，让多轮 agent 学得更稳、更快。
summary.importance:
这是典型 post-training/agent RL 方法论文，但对“RL 作为 pretrain/posttrain 接口”的研究者有两点价值：
1）给出了一个不依赖 critic 的时间差分（TD/GAE 风格）信用分配实现，降低了多轮 RL 的工程门槛；
2）把 grouped policy optimization 从单轮推理扩展到多轮交互，强调以 environment step 为单位做优势估计与归一化，对后续把 RL 信号更细粒度地注入到持续学习/数据生成闭环有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach:
GAGPO 的核心是“非参数 grouped value proxy + TD/GAE 式递推”，用采样 rollout 组构造每个 step 的价值近似，从而计算 step-aligned advantage，而不训练一个参数化 critic。

做法要点：
- 交互单位从 token 提升到 environment step（一次 action 输出对应一步），优势与更新在 step 级对齐，减少 token 级噪声。
- 对同一状态/step 采样一组 rollouts（group），用组内统计构造 value proxy（可理解为用同组样本的回报分布做 bootstrap），再用 TD/GAE 风格把末端稀疏回报向前递推，得到每一步的 advantage。
- 仍保持 GRPO/RLOO 一类的组内归一化与相对更新形式，以稳定训练并控制方差。

相对 GRPO：GRPO 更像 sequence/trajectory 级相对回报广播；GAGPO 引入时间递推，使早期 step 也能获得更定位的学习信号。相对 PPO：避免训练 critic，减少 value 估计误差与额外训练开销。
summary.experiments:
在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上，用 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 做对比，GAGPO 稳定优于 prompting 基线与多种 RL 基线（PPO、RLOO、GRPO、GiGPO）。论文还报告了：更快的早期学习、更高的交互效率、更平滑的优化曲线、以及更低方差的 step-level advantage 信号。

当前给到的全文片段未包含具体成功率/提升百分点表格；需要对照实验章节的主表与学习曲线图读取精确数字。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
- 先看方法章节里 value proxy 的构造与 TD/GAE 递推公式，搞清楚它如何在“无 critic”条件下做 bootstrap。
- 再看实验的学习曲线（early-stage learning、variance 分析）与 advantage 方差对比图，这些最能体现方法差异。
- 如果关心可迁移到推理/工具使用训练，重点看：step 定义（action 粒度）、group 采样策略、归一化细节、以及对不同 episode 长度/奖励稀疏度的敏感性。
预计阅读时间：30–40 分钟理解方法与结论；想复现需要额外 1 小时对照实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Multi-turn agent RL for LLMs suffers from sparse, delayed episode-level rewards while optimization happens at token/action granularity, making temporal credit assignment hard. Existing solutions either add critics/process reward models (extra complexity and estimation error) or stay critic-free but rely on trajectory-level grouped updates with weak reward propagation and high variance. The paper targets a critic-free method that still performs step-aligned, temporally propagated credit assignment.
summary_en.importance: Primarily a post-training/agent RL contribution, but relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface because it shows how to obtain TD/GAE-like temporal advantages without training a critic. It lowers engineering overhead for multi-turn RL and provides a cleaner way to inject temporally localized learning signals, which can matter when RL is used in continual training loops or data-generation-driven training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
GAGPO (Generalized Advantage Grouped Policy Optimization) builds a non-parametric grouped value proxy from rollout groups and uses TD/GAE-style recursion to compute step-aligned advantages—without a learned critic.

Key design choices:
- Credit assignment is aligned to environment steps (each step corresponds to an agent action), not tokens, reducing noise.
- For each step, a group of sampled rollouts provides statistics to form a value proxy; then TD/GAE-style bootstrapping propagates terminal outcomes backward through time.
- Group-wise advantage normalization (in the spirit of GRPO/RLOO) stabilizes updates and reduces variance.

Compared to GRPO: instead of broadcasting a trajectory-level signal, GAGPO propagates supervision temporally to localize which steps mattered. Compared to PPO: it avoids training a critic and the associated value estimation instability.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluated on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. GAGPO consistently outperforms prompting baselines and RL baselines (PPO, RLOO, GRPO, GiGPO). The paper also highlights faster early learning, better interaction efficiency, smoother optimization, and lower-variance step-level advantage estimates.

The provided full-text excerpt does not include the exact success-rate numbers; they should be taken from the main result tables and learning-curve figures in the experiment section.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim path:
- Read the method section focusing on how the grouped value proxy is constructed and how TD/GAE recursion is implemented without a critic.
- Then inspect learning curves and variance/advantage diagnostics; these best justify the method.
- For transfer to other agent settings, pay attention to: step/action definition, group sampling strategy, normalization details, and sensitivity to episode length and reward sparsity.
Time: ~30–40 minutes to grasp the idea; add ~1 hour for implementation-level details.

recommendation.zh: 只看 advantage 构造和 ablation；若 value proxy 真的稳，值得在多轮 RLVR 内部实验复现。
recommendation.en: Read the advantage construction and ablations; if the value proxy is stable, it is worth reproducing in multi-turn RLVR setups.

paper.title: Achieving Gold-Medal-Level Olympiad Reasoning via Simple and Unified Scaling
paper.abstract: Recent progress in reasoning models has substantially advanced long-horizon mathematical and scientific problem solving, with several systems now reaching gold-medal-level performance on International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) and International Physics Olympiad (IPhO) problems. In this paper, we introduce a simple and unified recipe for converting a post-trained reasoning backbone into a rigorous olympiad-level solver. The recipe first uses a reverse-perplexity curriculum for SFT to instill ri

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的问题是：如何把一个已有的 post-trained reasoning backbone，用统一且相对简单的 SFT、RL 和 test-time scaling 流程，推到奥赛级长程证明与科学推理能力。
summary.importance: 这篇更接近 post-train 与 inference scaling 论文，不是基座预训练论文，但对预训练研究有两个直接启发。第一，它把“能力底座”和“推理行为塑形”分开处理：30B-A3B backbone 已经具备科学推理和指令跟随能力，SFT 主要改变长证明的搜索、检查、修复习惯，而不是从零训练能力。第二，它说明长程推理能力的瓶颈不只在数据规模，也在训练信号的结构：可验证奖励适合扩展答案正确性，证明级 reward model 和 self-refinement 更适合优化证明质量。对 pretrain ↔ posttrain 接口来说，这提供了一个清晰样例：预训练或 mid-train 应提供足够宽的科学与形式推理表示，post-train 再通过高质量轨迹、课程顺序和奖励层级把行为稳定地拉到专家任务上。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三段。第一段是 SFT 行为塑形。作者从数学、科学、代码和通用指令来源整理长解答、自验证、自修复轨迹，过滤后得到 338K 条、每条响应短于 8K tokens 的训练样本。关键不是简单混合数据，而是用 reverse perplexity curriculum：先训练初始策略最不熟悉、perplexity 最高的轨迹，再回到更熟悉的样本做巩固。这个设计的意图是先强行注入更严格的证明搜索模式，再降低对原有能力的破坏。第二段是两级 RL。coarse RL 使用可验证题目和二值 outcome reward，类似 RLVR，目标是扩展 SFT 学到的解题行为。refined RL 转向 proof-level 训练，引入生成式证明奖励模型，对完整证明质量打分；同时使用 self-refinement prompts 训练批判与修复能力，并用 experience replay 保留困难题上的稀有成功轨迹。第三段是 test-time scaling。模型在推理时反复生成草稿、检查错误、修复候选证明，长轨迹可超过 100K tokens。和只靠采样多数投票不同，这里的推理扩展更偏向 proof search + self-verification loop。
summary.experiments: 主模型 SU-01 基于 30B-A3B backbone。SFT 数据为 338K 条长轨迹。答案可验证任务上，SU-01 在 AnswerBench、AMO-Bench、AIME 2025/2026、FrontierScience-Olympiad 上接近同尺寸强基线 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B。证明型评测上，SU-01 在 IMO-ProofBench 直接生成达到 57.6%，加入 test-time scaling 后达到 70.2%，明显强于同尺寸模型，并接近 Gemini 3.1 Pro Thinking 这类商业系统。FrontierScience-Research 上，SU-01 获得同尺寸模型中较好的整体表现，说明训练没有只过拟合奥赛题。官方竞赛题上，直接生成已经超过 2024 和 2025 IPhO 金牌线，并达到 IMO 2025 和 USAMO 2026 铜牌线；加入 test-time scaling 后，在两个数学奥赛上都得到 35 分，达到 IMO 2025 金牌线，并比 USAMO 2026 金牌线高 10 分。USAMO 2026 上，这个分数与 340 名参赛者中的最高人类总分持平。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 中 pipeline 的定位，重点确认它不是从 base model 训练推理能力，而是专门改造 post-trained backbone。然后看 SFT 部分的 reverse perplexity curriculum，关注样本排序为什么从“最不匹配初始策略”开始，以及它如何兼顾行为注入和能力保持。RL 部分建议看 coarse RL 与 proof-level RL 的分界：二值可验证奖励负责扩展正确性，证明奖励模型负责细粒度证明质量。实验部分优先看 IMO-ProofBench、官方 IMO/USAMO/IPhO 评分、FrontierScience-Research，以及 test-time scaling 的轨迹分析。附录若有数据过滤、reward model 训练和 replay 细节，适合进一步核查结果是否依赖隐含数据泄漏或评测特化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how far an already post-trained reasoning backbone can be pushed toward olympiad-level mathematical and scientific proof solving with a unified SFT, RL, and test-time scaling recipe.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a post-training and inference-scaling work, but it is relevant to pretraining because it cleanly separates latent capability from reasoning behavior. The backbone already has broad scientific competence; SFT is used to reshape how it searches, checks, and repairs long proofs. The RL design also gives a useful signal hierarchy: verifiable binary rewards are effective for scaling answer correctness, while proof-level reward modeling is needed when the target is a rigorous argument rather than a final value. For pretraining researchers, the lesson is practical: broad scientific and symbolic representations should be built before specialization, and later training stages can then steer the policy with much more targeted trajectory and reward design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The recipe has three stages. The first stage uses SFT to impose a more disciplined proof-search style. The authors curate long-form solution, self-verification, and self-refinement trajectories from math, science, coding, and instruction-following sources, ending with 338K filtered trajectories under 8K response tokens. A reverse-perplexity curriculum orders examples from those most mismatched to the initial policy to those more familiar to it. This is meant to inject unfamiliar proof behavior first, then consolidate without overly erasing existing competence. The second stage uses two levels of RL. Coarse RL uses verifiable prompts and binary outcome rewards in the RLVR style. Refined RL moves to proof quality, using a generative proof-level reward model, self-refinement prompts, and experience replay to retain rare successes on hard problems. The final stage applies test-time scaling through repeated drafting, verification, and repair, allowing very long inference traces rather than relying only on independent sampling.
summary_en.experiments: The main model, SU-01, is built on a 30B-A3B backbone. The SFT mixture contains 338K long trajectories. On answer-verifiable benchmarks, SU-01 nearly matches the strongest similar-size baseline, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, across AnswerBench, AMO-Bench, AIME 2025/2026, and FrontierScience-Olympiad. On proof-oriented evaluation, it reaches 57.6% on IMO-ProofBench with direct generation and 70.2% with test-time scaling, outperforming similar-size models and approaching systems such as Gemini 3.1 Pro Thinking. On FrontierScience-Research, it reports the best similar-size overall score among the compared models, suggesting that the recipe does not only specialize to olympiad-style prompts. On official problems, direct SU-01 exceeds the gold lines for IPhO 2024 and 2025 and clears bronze lines on IMO 2025 and USAMO 2026. With test-time scaling, it scores 35 points on both math olympiads, meeting the IMO 2025 gold line and exceeding the USAMO 2026 gold line by 10 points; on USAMO 2026, this matches the highest reported human total among 340 competitors.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25–35 minutes. Start with the pipeline description in the introduction to understand that the work specializes a post-trained model rather than training reasoning from a base checkpoint. Then read the SFT section on reverse-perplexity curriculum, since that is the most reusable training-detail idea. In the RL section, focus on the division between verifiable outcome rewards and proof-level reward modeling. For results, prioritize IMO-ProofBench, official IMO/USAMO/IPhO scoring, FrontierScience-Research, and the test-time scaling traces. If the appendix contains data filtering, reward-model training, or replay details, those are worth checking for possible benchmark-specific effects.

recommendation.zh: 读 SFT curriculum 和 RL 交接部分即可；若 200-step RL setup 干净，它支持奖励设计比 RL 预算更关键。
recommendation.en: Read the SFT curriculum and RL handoff; if the 200-step setup is clean, it argues reward design matters more than RL budget.
