paper.title: Teacher-Guided Policy Optimization for LLM Distillation
paper.abstract: The convergence of reinforcement learning and imitation learning has positioned Reverse KL (RKL) as a promising paradigm for on-policy LLM distillation, aiming to unify exploration with teacher supervision. However, we identify a critical limitation: when the student and teacher distributions diverge significantly, standard RKL often fails to yield meaningful improvement due to uninformative negative feedback. To address this inefficiency, we propose Teacher-Guided Policy Optimization (TGPO), an

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 on-policy LLM 蒸馏里的一个具体失效点：用 Reverse KL 让学生在自己采样的轨迹上贴近教师，看起来能同时兼容 RL 探索和教师监督，但当学生和教师分布差距较大时，教师只是在事后给学生 token 打分，不能告诉学生应该往哪个 token 移动，梯度容易变成低信息量的惩罚信号。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在模型结构，而在训练信号设计。它提醒我们，KL 方向和采样分布的选择会改变教师信号的性质：RKL 保留了 on-policy 形式，但牺牲了前向指导；SFT 有强指导，但训练状态来自教师分布。TGPO 尝试把两者拆开：状态来自学生 rollout，目标 token 来自教师条件预测。这对小模型推理蒸馏、RLVR 早期训练、以及 pretrain 到 posttrain 的接口设计都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先把 RKL 蒸馏写成学生分布上的期望，并指出它等价于在 RL 目标中加入一个内在奖励：负的 student-teacher log-ratio。问题在于，这个奖励只评价学生已经采出来的动作。如果学生 token 落在教师低概率区域，教师概率接近零，训练信号主要是在压制当前动作，而不是指出替代动作。TGPO 的改法是：仍然让学生生成 on-policy rollout，但在每个学生生成的上下文上查询教师，让教师给出下一步 token 分布或预测 token，然后对学生施加类似 SFT 的 token-level 似然学习。这样，状态分布保持 on-policy，监督信号则从“判别当前 token 好不好”变成“在当前状态下教师会怎么走”。论文还讨论了教师信号放进 reward 还是作为 loss regularization 的设计差别，重点是避免把密集 token 指导退化成稀疏或高方差的奖励估计。
summary.experiments: 实验结论集中在三点。第一，标准 RKL 在学生和教师分布差距较大时训练不稳定，提升有限，和第 2 节的分析一致。第二，TGPO 能在这些远分布场景下继续提供有效更新，因为教师是在学生实际访问的上下文上给出方向性监督。第三，TGPO 与 mixed-policy 类方法相比有竞争力，同时不需要额外人工标注，能够嵌入现有 RLVR 流程。提供的正文片段没有给出完整模型规模、任务集合、表格数值和消融数字；精读时需要核对实验表格中 RKL、TGPO、SFT、mixed-policy 与 RLVR baseline 的具体差距。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25 分钟。先看第 2 节的 RKL 推导，尤其是把 RKL 写成 RL intrinsic reward 的部分，这是理解失效机制的核心。再看 Figure 1 和第 3 节目标函数，确认 TGPO 的教师查询发生在学生 rollout 的哪些位置，以及教师信号最终进入 loss 还是 reward。实验部分重点看三类对比：远分布教师-学生设置、RKL 训练曲线稳定性、TGPO 与 mixed-policy 方法的消融。若只关心预训练训练信号，可重点看 KL 方向分析和 token-level dense guidance 的实现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a failure mode in on-policy LLM distillation. Reverse KL allows the student to learn on its own rollouts and therefore fits naturally into RL-style training, but when the teacher and student distributions are far apart, the teacher mostly acts as a post-hoc scorer of bad student tokens. It does not provide a clear direction toward better tokens.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is training-signal design rather than architecture. It shows that the direction of KL and the source of sampled states can change what supervision actually means. RKL is on-policy but weakly directional. SFT is directional but off-policy. TGPO keeps student-generated states while using teacher predictions as dense token-level guidance. This is useful for reasoning distillation, early-stage RLVR for small models, and the interface between pretraining, distillation, and reinforcement learning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first formulates RKL distillation as an expectation over student samples and connects it to an RL objective with an intrinsic reward given by the negative student-teacher log-ratio. The weakness is that this reward only evaluates actions already sampled by the student. If a sampled token lies in a low-probability region under the teacher, the signal mainly says “do not do this,” without indicating the better action. TGPO changes the supervision path. The student still produces on-policy rollouts. For each student-generated context, the teacher is queried for its preferred next-token behavior, and the student is trained to increase the likelihood of the teacher’s token prediction on those visited states. This resembles SFT on student states rather than teacher states. The paper also discusses whether teacher information should be injected as a reward or as a regularizing loss; the central concern is preserving dense, low-variance token supervision.
summary_en.experiments: The reported evidence supports three claims. Standard RKL becomes unstable or unhelpful when the teacher-student gap is large. TGPO remains useful in such far-distribution settings because it supplies directional token supervision on the states the student actually visits. It is also reported to be competitive with mixed-policy approaches while requiring no additional annotation and remaining compatible with RLVR pipelines. The provided text does not expose the full experimental tables, model sizes, dataset details, or exact numerical deltas, so those numbers should be checked directly in the experiment section.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25-minute skim is enough for the main idea. Read Section 2 carefully, especially the derivation that rewrites RKL as an intrinsic-reward RL objective. Then inspect Figure 1 and the Section 3 objective to see where the teacher is queried and how the token-level loss is applied. In the experiments, focus on comparisons among RKL, TGPO, SFT, mixed-policy distillation, and RLVR baselines, with particular attention to stability curves and far teacher-student distribution gaps.

recommendation.zh: 读 RKL failure 分析和算法式即可；若实验规模干净，值得在内部 RLVR 蒸馏里复现。
recommendation.en: Read the RKL failure analysis and algorithm; if the scale setup is clean, it is worth reproducing inside an RLVR distillation pipeline.

paper.title: Revisiting Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards from a Contrastive Perspective
paper.abstract: RLVR has become a widely adopted paradigm for improving LLMs' reasoning capabilities, and GRPO is one of its most representative algorithms. In this paper, we first show that GRPO admits an equivalent discriminative reformulation as a weighted positive-negative score difference. Under this view, GRPO increases sequence-level scores of verified positive rollouts and decreases those of negative rollouts, where the scores are averages of clipped token-level importance sampling ratios. This reformul

summary.core_problem: GRPO作为可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的核心算法，存在两个结构性优化缺陷：一是优化的截断重要性采样替代分数与生成阶段使用的似然不匹配，二是信用分配仅依赖采样组的正负样本通过率，对组内不同样本间的分数差距不敏感。
summary.importance: 首次明确GRPO的判别式目标等价形式，为RLVR算法优化提供了对比学习的新视角；提出的ConSPO算法可直接落地到推理类任务的RL训练流程，提升训练效率和最终模型性能。
summary.technical_approach: 首先将GRPO重写为加权正负样本判别目标的等价形式，明确其两项核心缺陷。提出的ConSPO用长度归一化的序列对数概率替换截断重要性采样分数，对齐训练目标与推理阶段的序列排序依据；再引入组级InfoNCE对比目标，让梯度依赖组内样本的相对分数，同时加入课程调度的间隔项防止梯度过早衰减。
summary.experiments: 在多个不同参数量的骨干模型、不同训练数据集上测试，ConSPO在7个数学推理基准上均取得一致的性能提升。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看Proposition 1的GRPO等价推导、图1的梯度对比，以及ConSPO目标函数的定义部分，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: As the core algorithm of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), GRPO has two structural optimization flaws: first, the optimized clipped importance sampling surrogate score is misaligned with the likelihood used in the generation phase; second, credit assignment only relies on the positive/negative sample pass rate of the sampling group, and is insensitive to the score gap between different samples in the group.
summary_en.importance: It explicitly derives the equivalent discriminative objective form of GRPO for the first time, providing a new contrastive learning perspective for RLVR algorithm optimization. The proposed ConSPO algorithm can be directly applied to RL training pipelines for reasoning tasks, improving training efficiency and final model performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, GRPO is rewritten into the equivalent form of a weighted positive-negative sample discrimination objective to clarify its two core flaws. The proposed ConSPO replaces clipped importance sampling scores with length-normalized sequence log-probabilities, aligning the training objective with the sequence ranking basis in the inference phase; then a group-level InfoNCE contrastive objective is introduced to make gradients depend on the relative scores of samples within the group, and a curriculum-scheduled margin is added to prevent premature gradient attenuation.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on multiple backbone models with different parameter sizes and different training datasets, ConSPO achieves consistent performance improvements on 7 mathematical reasoning benchmarks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the equivalent derivation of GRPO in Proposition 1, the gradient comparison in Figure 1, and the definition of ConSPO's objective function. Estimated reading time is 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: GRPO的本质重构和缺陷分析，做RL后训练的研究员可直接参考ConSPO的损失设计，重点看§2的等价推导
recommendation.en: Essential reformulation and defect analysis of GRPO, RL post-training researchers can directly reference ConSPO loss design, focus on §2 equivalence derivation

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Entropy Polarity in Reinforcement Fine-Tuning: Direction, Asymmetry, and Control
paper.abstract: Policy entropy has emerged as a fundamental measure for understanding and controlling exploration in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for LLMs. However, existing entropy-aware methods mainly regulate entropy through global objectives, while the token-level mechanism by which sampled policy updates reshape policy entropy remains underexplored. In this work, we develop a theoretical framework of entropy mechanics in RLVR. Our analysis yields a first-order approximation of the

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究 RLVR/RFT 中熵如何被 policy-gradient 更新改变。它不只把 entropy 当作全局曲线，而是追问一个更细的问题：在某个解码状态下，强化一个 sampled token 会让下一 token 分布变尖还是变平，这个方向能否提前计算，并用于控制训练中的探索与利用。
summary.importance: 对 pretrain-posttrain 接口的价值在于，它给 RL 训练动态提供了 token-level 的可观测信号。许多 RLVR 失败模式表现为 entropy collapse，但常见做法是加全局 entropy bonus、clip 或调 KL。这些方法知道“熵太低”，但不区分哪些 token 更新在压缩分布，哪些更新在扩展分布。论文提出 entropy polarity，把 advantage、sampled token 概率和当前分布形状联系起来，使熵控制从全局正则变成局部更新重加权。这个思路对推理模型训练、verifiable reward 数据构造、以及 RL 是否在扩大可探索空间都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从 GRPO 出发。对于 prompt x，模型采样一组回答，每个回答得到 response-level reward，并用组内归一化 advantage 优化 clipped surrogate objective。作者把每个 token 的局部分布写成 softmax logits z，在状态 s_t 下采样 token y_t，分析由 A log π(y_t|s_t) 诱导的一阶 logit 扰动。softmax policy gradient 会提高 sampled token 的 logit，同时按当前概率降低其他 token 的相对位置。熵变化 ΔH_t 可以一阶分解为 sampled-token contribution 和 state-wise distributional correction。由此得到 entropy polarity：一个带符号的量，预测当前 token 更新倾向于增加还是减少局部 entropy，并估计幅度。核心观察是非对称性：强化高概率 token 更容易让分布变尖；想让熵上升，通常需要低概率 token 获得正 advantage，或者需要分布校正项足够强。基于这个信号，Papo 不再统一调节 entropy，而是区分 positive-polarity 和 negative-polarity 更新，根据训练中的 entropy trajectory 动态重分配 token-level advantage 权重。熵接近坍缩时提高扩展分布的更新权重；需要巩固 reward-aligned 行为时允许收缩分布的更新发挥作用。
summary.experiments: 论文声称在数学推理和 agentic tool-calling 场景上验证 Papo，并与 RLVR/RFT baseline 比较，在 in-distribution 和 out-of-distribution benchmarks 上都有稳定收益。经验分析包含两个关键点：第一，entropy polarity 能预测连续优化步之间测得的 token-level entropy change，说明它不是只停留在推导中的量；第二，只保留正 polarity 或只保留负 polarity 都不足以稳定训练，正 polarity 更偏向保留探索，负 polarity 更偏向强化已获奖励的行为，二者需要动态平衡。给出的内容没有包含具体数据集名称、模型规模、训练 token 数、准确率提升或消融表格，因此不应补写无法核验的数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读第 3 节的 entropy mechanics。重点看从 policy gradient 到 logit perturbation，再到 ΔH_t 一阶分解的推导；这里是整篇工作的核心。然后看第 3.3 节中 polarity 与实际 entropy change 的相关性实验，这是判断信号是否可用的关键。第 4.1 节关于正负 polarity 分支的动态差异也值得看，它解释了为什么简单 entropy bonus 不够。Papo 算法部分可重点关注 token-level advantage reweighting 的实现细节，以及它如何避免把所有 entropy 变化都朝同一方向推。预计精读需要 1 到 1.5 小时，若只关心方法可先看理论定义、算法框和主要 ablation。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how policy-gradient updates in RLVR and reinforcement fine-tuning change token-level entropy. Instead of treating entropy as a single training curve, it asks whether reinforcing a sampled token at a given decoding state will sharpen or flatten the next-token distribution, whether that direction can be predicted, and how it can be used to control exploration and exploitation.
summary_en.importance: The work is useful for understanding the pretrain-to-posttrain interface because it turns entropy into a local training signal. Many RLVR failures show up as entropy collapse, but common interventions such as entropy bonuses, clipping, or KL tuning operate globally and do not identify which token updates are entropy-expanding or entropy-contracting. Entropy polarity links the sampled token, its probability, the surrounding distribution, and the signed advantage. This makes entropy control more targeted: the optimizer can change the pressure on different token updates rather than pushing the whole policy with one scalar regularizer.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis starts from GRPO. For each prompt, the policy samples a group of responses, receives response-level rewards, normalizes advantages within the group, and optimizes a clipped policy objective. At a decoding state s_t, the next-token distribution is represented by softmax logits. For a sampled token y_t with advantage A, the update from A log π(y_t|s_t) increases the sampled token logit and redistributes probability mass according to the current distribution. The paper derives a first-order approximation of the local entropy change ΔH_t after this logit perturbation. The decomposition contains a sampled-token term and a state-wise distributional correction. Entropy polarity is the resulting signed quantity that predicts whether the update expands or contracts entropy and by how much. The asymmetry is important: reinforcing an already high-probability continuation tends to make the distribution sharper, while entropy expansion usually requires a lower-probability sample with positive advantage or a strong correction from the surrounding distribution. Papo then uses polarity as an online control signal. It reweights token-level advantages differently for positive- and negative-polarity updates, increasing entropy-expanding pressure when collapse is likely and allowing entropy-contracting updates when the policy needs to consolidate reward-aligned behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments on mathematical reasoning and agentic tool-calling, with comparisons against reinforcement fine-tuning baselines on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution benchmarks. The empirical claims are centered on two findings. First, entropy polarity predicts measured token-level entropy changes between consecutive optimization steps, which supports its use as a behavioral signal rather than only a theoretical diagnostic. Second, positive- and negative-polarity updates play complementary roles: positive polarity preserves exploration, while negative polarity strengthens exploitation. Keeping only one branch is insufficient for stable RL training. The provided content does not include dataset names, model sizes, token budgets, accuracy numbers, or ablation tables, so exact numerical gains should not be reconstructed.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the entropy mechanics section carefully, especially the path from policy gradient to logit perturbation and then to the first-order decomposition of ΔH_t. That derivation is the main technical contribution. The empirical validation that polarity predicts actual entropy changes is the next key part. The section separating positive- and negative-polarity dynamics is also important because it explains why a uniform entropy bonus is a blunt control mechanism. For implementation, focus on how Papo reweights token-level advantages and how the method decides when to favor entropy expansion versus reward-aligned contraction. A focused read should take about 60 to 90 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变你看 RFT 熵塌缩的方式：别再只盯全局 entropy bonus，先看 token-level polarity；建议直接复现理论预测和实测熵变化的对齐图。
recommendation.en: This changes how you should think about entropy collapse in RFT: stop staring only at global entropy bonuses and inspect token-level polarity; the first thing to reproduce is the theory-vs-measured entropy-change alignment.

institutions: University of Hong Kong, Shanghai Jiao Tong University and Tencent Hunyuan

paper.title: Boosting Omni-Modal Language Models: Staged Post-Training with Visually Debiased Evaluation
paper.abstract: Omni-modal language models are intended to jointly understand audio, visual inputs, and language, but benchmark gains can be inflated when visual evidence alone is enough to answer a query. We study whether current omni-modal benchmarks separate visual shortcuts from genuine audio-visual-language evidence integration, and how post-training behaves under a visually debiased evaluation setting. We audit nine omni-modal benchmarks with visual-only probing, remove visually solvable queries, and reta

summary.core_problem: 现有全模态语言模型的基准测试存在严重的视觉捷径问题——大量音视语言任务仅靠视觉输入和问题文本就能得到答案，导致模型性能提升无法反映真实的跨模态融合能力；同时全模态后训练的最优范式不明确，不清楚仅增强双模态能力是否足够支撑全模态理解。
summary.importance: 揭示了全模态基准的视觉泄漏问题，提供了可复用的去偏评测集，同时验证了全模态后训练中显式全模态数据的必要性，对多模态大模型的后训练流程设计、评测体系建设有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 首先构建去视觉偏置的评测集OmniClean：对9个现有全模态基准的16968条查询做视觉-only探测，移除仅靠视觉就能回答的查询，最终保留8551条有效查询，过滤评测中的视觉捷径。然后提出分阶段后训练方案OmniBoost：对比平衡双模态SFT、混合模态RLVR、自蒸馏合成数据SFT三种范式，其中自蒸馏方法不需要更强的外部全模态教师模型，通过多源双模态模型（LLaVA-Video、Step-Audio-R1、Qwen3-VL等）的输出提取实体、时空关系，合成全模态查询并过滤推理轨迹得到训练数据。
summary.experiments: 基于Qwen2.5-Omni-3B基座测试，仅做平衡双模态SFT的全模态迁移效果有限且不均衡；只有加入显式的全模态数据训练后才能获得明显的全模态性能提升；使用自蒸馏合成数据SFT后，3B模型在OmniClean评测上的性能与更大规模的开源模型相当，略超过Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读第3章的视觉泄漏审计方法和OmniClean构建规则、第4章的分阶段后训练对比实验，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing omni-modal language model benchmarks have severe visual shortcut problem: a large number of audio-visual-language tasks can be solved with only visual input and question text, making model performance improvements fail to reflect real cross-modal fusion capability. Besides, the optimal paradigm for omni-modal post-training remains unclear, as it is unknown whether enhancing bi-modal capabilities alone is sufficient to support omni-modal understanding.
summary_en.importance: Reveals the visual leakage problem in omni-modal benchmarks, provides a reusable debiased evaluation set, and verifies the necessity of explicit omni-modal data in omni-modal post-training, which has direct reference value for post-training pipeline design and evaluation system construction of multimodal large models.
summary_en.technical_approach: First constructs OmniClean, a visually debiased evaluation set: conducts visual-only probing on 16,968 queries from 9 existing omni-modal benchmarks, removes queries that can be answered with visual input only, and finally retains 8,551 valid queries to filter visual shortcuts in evaluation. Then proposes OmniBoost, a staged post-training recipe: compares three paradigms including balanced bi-modal SFT, mixed-modality RLVR, and SFT on self-distilled synthetic data. The self-distillation method does not require a stronger external omni-modal teacher model: it extracts entities and spatiotemporal relations from outputs of multiple bi-modal models (LLaVA-Video, Step-Audio-R1, Qwen3-VL, etc.), synthesizes omni-modal queries and filters reasoning traces to obtain training data.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on Qwen2.5-Omni-3B base model, balanced bi-modal SFT alone brings limited and uneven omni-modal transfer; significant omni-modal performance improvement can only be obtained after adding explicit omni-modal data for training. After SFT on self-distilled synthetic data, the 3B model achieves comparable performance to larger open-source references on OmniClean evaluation, and slightly outperforms Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the visual leakage audit method and OmniClean construction rules in Section 3, and the staged post-training comparison experiments in Section 4. Expected reading time is 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 建议读评测清洗和 RLVR 消融；它提醒多模态后训练先验不能建立在视觉捷径 benchmark 上。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark-cleaning and RLVR ablations; it warns against forming multimodal post-training priors from visually shortcut benchmarks.

paper.title: Breaking $\textit{Winner-Takes-All}$: Cooperative Policy Optimization Improves Diverse LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiers (RLVR) has become a central paradigm for improving LLM reasoning, yet popular group-based optimization algorithms like GRPO often suffer from exploration collapse, where the models prematurely converge on a narrow set of high-scoring patterns, lacking the ability to explore new solutions. Recent efforts attempt to alleviate this by adding entropy regularization or diversity bonus. However, these approaches do not change the \textit{winner-takes-all} nature,

summary.core_problem: 现有基于组的带验证器强化学习（RLVR）优化算法如GRPO存在探索坍塌问题，模型过早收敛到狭窄的高分推理模式，现有熵正则、多样性奖励等方案未改变赢者通吃的竞争本质，无法平衡推理质量与真实推理路径多样性的矛盾。
summary.importance: 为RLVR阶段的推理多样性优化提供了协作式训练的新方向，避免纯正则方案带来的奖励目标冲突，可直接适配现有推理增强训练流程。
summary.technical_approach: 提出组协作策略优化（GCPO），将单次采样的一组推理轨迹（rollout）视为协作团队，用行列式点过程（DPP）的L-ensemble定义团队价值，同时耦合推理正确性和路径多样性，再根据每条轨迹对团队价值的平均边际贡献重新分配奖励，将优化目标从个体竞争转向非冗余正确推理路径的覆盖。
summary.experiments: 在多领域推理基准上验证，可同时提升推理准确率和有效解的多样性，与GRPO相比无显著额外计算开销。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第3章的团队价值定义和奖励分配机制，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing group-based Reinforcement Learning with Verifiers (RLVR) algorithms such as GRPO suffer from exploration collapse, where models prematurely converge to a narrow set of high-scoring reasoning patterns. Current solutions including entropy regularization and diversity bonuses do not change the winner-takes-all competition nature, and fail to resolve the trade-off between reasoning quality and genuine reasoning path diversity.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a new cooperative training direction for reasoning diversity optimization in the RLVR stage, avoids reward objective conflicts caused by pure regularization schemes, and can be directly adapted to existing reasoning enhancement training pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Group Cooperative Policy Optimization (GCPO), which treats a group of sampled rollouts as a cooperative team. The team value is defined via the L-ensemble of Determinantal Point Process (DPP) to couple both reasoning correctness and path diversity. Rewards are redistributed according to each rollout's average marginal contribution to the team value, shifting the optimization objective from individual competition to coverage of non-redundant correct reasoning paths.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across multi-domain reasoning benchmarks, it simultaneously improves reasoning accuracy and valid solution diversity, with no significant additional computational overhead compared to GRPO.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for team value definition and reward allocation mechanism, estimated reading time 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看的是 reward design，不是结果数字；先看它如何定义 coverage credit，若干净可直接拿去做 RLVR ablation，对 reasoning mode collapse 很对症。
recommendation.en: What matters here is the reward design, not the headline numbers; inspect the coverage-based credit assignment first, because if the setup is clean it is a very plausible fix for RLVR reasoning mode collapse.

paper.title: CuSearch: Curriculum Rollout Sampling via Search Depth for Agentic RAG
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a promising paradigm for training agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems from outcome-only supervision. Most existing methods optimize policies from uniformly sampled rollouts, implicitly treating all trajectories as equally informative. However, trajectories differ substantially in search depth and are therefore not equally informative: deeper-search trajectories contain more retrieval decision points and provide

summary.core_problem: 现有基于可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的智能体RAG训练方法采用均匀采样轨迹优化策略，未考虑不同搜索深度的轨迹对检索子策略的监督信息量差异，且训练过程中批次内轨迹深度分布向高值偏移时，优化预算分配错配的问题会进一步加剧。
summary.importance: 首次利用无标注的轨迹固有结构信号（搜索深度）实现课程采样，为RL训练中轨迹级样本权重分配提供了不需要额外标注的实现路径，可直接复用到各类基于GRPO的对齐训练流程中。
summary.technical_approach: 基于GRPO框架提出CuSearch，核心是搜索深度贪心分配（SDGA）算子。每个训练步从N个prompt对应的N*G条轨迹池中筛选K条深度最高的轨迹参与奖励归一化、优势估计和梯度更新。SDGA有两个变体：SDGA-Auto直接选当前批次最深的轨迹，随训练深度分布上移自动形成隐式课程；SDGA-Phase设置显式阶段阈值，当更深轨迹在采样池中占比达标后不可逆提升阈值。
summary.experiments: 在ZeroSearch基准上比标准GRPO最高提升11.8个精确匹配点，性能优于DAPO、AR3PO等prompt级自适应方法。跨2个模型家族、2个检索框架、7个基准测试均获得一致性能提升，增益的核心驱动因素是训练过程中搜索深度的增长，检索环境随机性是次要放大因素。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看Introduction中关于轨迹深度分布偏移的训练动态分析、Method部分的SDGA算子实现逻辑，以及实验部分的增益影响因素消融，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing RLVR-based agentic RAG training methods adopt uniform rollout sampling for policy optimization, ignoring the gap in supervision informativeness for retrieval sub-policies across trajectories with different search depths. The optimization budget misallocation problem worsens as the within-batch trajectory depth distribution shifts to higher values during training.
summary_en.importance: It leverages annotation-free, trajectory-intrinsic structural signal (search depth) for curriculum sampling for the first time, providing an annotation-free implementation path for trajectory-level sample weight allocation in RL training, which can be directly integrated into all GRPO-based alignment training pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: CuSearch is built on the GRPO framework, with the core Search-Depth Greedy Allocation (SDGA) operator. For each training step, it selects K trajectories with the highest search depth from the pool of N*G rollouts generated for N prompts, and only these selected trajectories participate in reward normalization, advantage estimation and gradient update. Two SDGA variants are implemented: SDGA-Auto directly selects the deepest trajectories in the current batch, forming an implicit training-aligned curriculum automatically as the depth distribution shifts upward; SDGA-Phase sets explicit phase thresholds, which are irreversibly raised when deeper trajectories account for a sufficient proportion of the rollout pool.
summary_en.experiments: It achieves up to 11.8 exact match points improvement over standard GRPO on the ZeroSearch benchmark, outperforming prompt-level adaptive methods such as DAPO and AR3PO. Consistent performance gains are observed across 2 model families, 2 retrieval frameworks and 7 benchmarks. The primary driver of gain magnitude is search depth growth during training, and retrieval environment stochasticity acts as a secondary amplifier.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the training dynamic analysis of trajectory depth distribution shift in Introduction, the implementation logic of SDGA operator in Method section, and the ablation study of gain influencing factors in experiments. Expected reading time is 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 关注 RL 训练数据采样的动态调整，SDGA 算子设计对优化长轨迹 RL 训练效率有启发，可看 §3 了解其课程调度机制。
recommendation.en: Focuses on dynamic adjustment of RL training data sampling; the SDGA operator design is inspiring for optimizing long-trajectory RL training efficiency. Check §3 for its curriculum scheduling mechanism.

paper.title: Reward Hacking in Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has enabled strong post-training gains in domains such as math and coding, though many open-ended settings rely on rubric-based rewards. We study reward hacking in rubric-based RL, where a policy is optimized against a training verifier but evaluated against a cross-family panel of three frontier judges, reducing dependence on any single evaluator. Our framework separates two sources of divergence: verifier failure, where the training verifier credi

summary.core_problem: 解决基于评分规则（rubric）的强化学习中奖励黑客问题，即策略在训练验证器上的得分提升不对应真实任务效果的提升，需拆分该问题的两类独立来源。
summary.importance: 对后训练阶段的强化学习对齐流程设计有明确参考价值，尤其是在医疗、科学等无法做精确正确性校验的开放领域，可支持提前识别奖励漂移、选择合理早停时机。
summary.technical_approach: 搭建双维度诊断框架：第一，用3个前沿评估器组成的参考面板对比训练验证器的判断，拆分出「验证器失效」（训练验证器奖励了参考面板拒绝的响应）；第二，对比基于评分规则和无评分规则的评估结果，拆分出「评分规则设计局限」（即使强验证器也会偏好无规则评估打分更低的响应）。另外提出无需外部评估器的「自内化差距」指标，通过策略自身的对数概率计算跟踪奖励黑客情况，可作为早停信号。
summary.experiments: 在医疗、科学领域数据集上，弱训练验证器场景下训练奖励持续上升，但参考面板评估的奖励进入平台期，策略对验证器的利用程度持续上升；识别出三类常见的验证器失效模式：部分复合、隐含当显式、不精确校验。即使使用强验证器，基于评分规则的评估偏好强化学习 checkpoint，无规则评估仍偏好基础模型，收益集中在完整性等存在性类指标上，对应更长、声明密度更高但整体质量更差的响应。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看引言部分的问题拆解、诊断框架定义和核心实验结论，跳过冗余的实验实现细节，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: This work addresses reward hacking in rubric-based reinforcement learning, where policy performance gains on training verifiers do not translate to real task effectiveness, and aims to disentangle two distinct sources of this performance divergence.
summary_en.importance: It provides actionable insights for post-training RL alignment design, especially for open-ended domains like medicine and science where exact correctness verification is not feasible, enabling early detection of reward drift and reasonable early stopping decisions.
summary_en.technical_approach: A two-dimensional diagnostic framework is proposed: First, a reference panel of three frontier judges is used to compare with training verifier judgments, isolating verifier failure where the training verifier rewards responses rejected by the reference panel. Second, comparisons between rubric-based and rubric-free evaluation isolate rubric design limitation, where even strong rubric-based verifiers prefer responses with lower rubric-free quality scores. A verifier-free self-internalization gap metric computed from the policy's own log probabilities is also introduced to track reward hacking and serve as an early stopping signal.
summary_en.experiments: On medical and science domain datasets, under weak training verifier settings, training reward increases continuously while reference panel reward plateaus, and policy exploitation of the verifier rises consistently. Three recurring verifier failure modes are identified: partial-compound, implicit-as-explicit, and imprecise verification. Even with strong verifiers, rubric-based evaluation prefers RL checkpoints while rubric-free evaluation still prefers the base model, with gains concentrated on presence-based criteria like completeness, corresponding to longer, more claim-dense responses with lower overall quality.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the problem disentanglement in Introduction, diagnostic framework definition, and core experimental findings. Skip redundant experimental implementation details, expected reading time 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得读 failure taxonomy；它提示开放域 RLVR 的主要坑不是 reward 弱，而是 rubric 本身会诱导错目标。
recommendation.en: Read the failure taxonomy; the warning is that open-domain RLVR can fail because the rubric itself induces the wrong target.

paper.title: Drop the Act: Probe-Filtered RL for Faithful Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reasoning models post-hoc rationalize answers they have already committed to internally, producing chains of *reasoning theater*: deliberative-looking steps that contribute nothing to correctness. This wastes inference tokens, pollutes interpretability, and obscures what the model actually computed. We introduce **ProFIL** (**Pro**be-**Fil**tered Reinforcement Learning) to *reduce theater, increase chain-of-thought faithfulness, and shrink chain length* in a single, drop-in extension to Group Re

summary.core_problem: 现有基于RL的推理模型普遍存在「推理剧场」问题：模型内部提前确定答案后，仍生成无实际作用的后验推理步骤，浪费推理token、干扰可解释性、污染过程奖励训练信号；且标准GRPO无法优化推理忠实度这类无外部真值标签的行为。
summary.importance: 提出了一种无需人工标注的推理忠实度优化方法，对RL对齐（尤其是推理类任务的RLHF/RLAIF）的目标设计和效率提升有实用参考价值，同时可以降低推理阶段的token成本。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ProFIL框架，是GRPO的可插拔扩展：首先在冻结的基座模型上训练一个多头注意力探针，从内部残差激活检测后提交步骤；在GRPO训练过程中，若某条rollout的平均探针得分超过阈值，则将其优势值置零，不参与梯度更新；探针基于冻结基座训练，决策边界稳定，不会出现RL训练过程中模型欺骗探针的问题。
summary.experiments: 在GSM8K、LiveCodeBench、ToolUse、MMLU-Redux四个推理任务，Llama-8B、Qwen-7B两个架构上均取得一致效果：推理忠实度提升32%，推理链平均长度缩短27%，任务准确率保持不变甚至略有提升；探针在训练前、中、后阶段的AUROC均达到1.000（LiveCodeBench上），无被模型规避的情况。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看引言中关于推理剧场的危害分析，第3节探针的构造方法和第4节的GRPO过滤机制，实验部分的跨任务跨架构验证结果，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing RL-based reasoning models widely suffer from the "reasoning theater" problem: the model commits to an answer internally early, then generates non-contributory post-hoc reasoning steps, which wastes inference tokens, undermines interpretability, and pollutes process reward training signals. Standard GRPO cannot optimize behaviors like faithfulness that have no external ground-truth labels.
summary_en.importance: Proposes an annotation-free method for optimizing reasoning faithfulness, offers practical reference for objective design and efficiency improvement of RL alignment (especially for reasoning tasks like RLHF/RLAIF), and reduces token cost during inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the ProFIL framework, a drop-in extension of GRPO: First, a multi-head attention probe is trained on the frozen base model to detect post-commitment steps from internal residual activations. During GRPO training, if the average probe score of a rollout exceeds the threshold, its advantage value is set to zero and it does not contribute to gradient updates. The probe is trained on the frozen base, so its decision boundary stays stable and avoids the RL obfuscation failure mode where the model learns to hide performative steps from the probe.
summary_en.experiments: Consistent gains are observed across 4 reasoning tasks (GSM8K, LiveCodeBench, ToolUse, MMLU-Redux) and 2 model architectures (Llama-8B, Qwen-7B): reasoning faithfulness increases by 32%, average chain length reduces by 27%, while task accuracy remains unchanged or slightly improves. The probe achieves 1.000 AUROC on LiveCodeBench rollouts before, during and after training, with no sign of being evaded by the model.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the analysis of harms of reasoning theater in the introduction, the probe construction method in Section 3 and GRPO filtering mechanism in Section 4, as well as cross-task cross-architecture validation results in the experiment section. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看 probe 标签构造和 advantage-zeroing 细节；结论若成立，会改变“RL 必然学会骗 probe”的悲观先验。
recommendation.en: Read the probe-labeling and advantage-zeroing setup; if the result holds, it weakens the prior that RL will simply learn to game probes.

paper.title: Understanding and Preventing Entropy Collapse in RLVR with On-Policy Entropy Flow Optimization
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an effective paradigm for improving the reasoning ability of large language models. However, widely used RLVR algorithms, such as GRPO, often suffer from entropy collapse, leading to premature determinism and unstable optimization. Existing remedies, including entropy regularization and ratio-based clipping heuristics, either control entropy in a coarse-grained manner or rely on approximate on-policy training. In this paper, we rev

summary.core_problem: 现有可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）算法如GRPO存在熵坍缩问题，训练早期策略熵快速降至近零，导致过早收敛到确定性策略、探索不足。现有熵正则化和裁剪启发式方法要么粗粒度控熵易引入训练不稳定，要么依赖过期参考策略无法保证严格同策略性质。
summary.importance: 从token级熵流视角给出了熵坍缩的统一解释，提出的严格同策略熵流优化方法可用于RL后训练阶段稳定训练过程、提升推理任务性能，为RL预训练/后训练的熵控制提供了新的优化方向。
summary.technical_approach: 提出从token级熵流角度分析熵动态，发现训练早期降熵token更新幅度远超过增熵token，净熵变化为负是熵坍缩的核心原因。基于此提出同策略熵流优化（OPEFO），自适应对增熵、降熵的token级更新按其对熵变化的贡献重缩放，平衡熵流的同时不需要依赖参考策略，保持严格同策略性质。
summary.experiments: 在2个不同基座模型、6个数学推理基准上测试，OPEFO相比现有RLVR方法同时实现了更稳定的熵动态和更优的最终性能。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议看引言部分的熵坍缩问题分析和熵流动机解释，以及方法部分的OPEFO重缩放策略设计，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) algorithms such as GRPO suffer from entropy collapse, where policy entropy drops rapidly to near zero in early training stages, leading to premature deterministic policies and insufficient exploration. Current remedies including entropy regularization and clipping heuristics either control entropy in coarse granularity and introduce training instability, or rely on outdated reference policies and cannot guarantee strict on-policy property.
summary_en.importance: It provides a unified explanation for entropy collapse from the token-level entropy flow perspective, and the proposed strict on-policy entropy flow optimization method can stabilize training process and improve performance on reasoning tasks during RL post-training, offering a new optimization direction for entropy control in RL pretraining/post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: It analyzes entropy dynamics from the token-level entropy flow perspective, and finds that entropy-decreasing token updates significantly outweigh entropy-increasing ones in early training, leading to negative net entropy change which is the root cause of entropy collapse. On-Policy Entropy Flow Optimization (OPEFO) is proposed to adaptively rescale entropy-increasing and entropy-decreasing token-level updates based on their contribution to entropy change, which balances entropy flow without relying on reference policies and maintains strict on-policy property.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on 2 base models and 6 mathematical reasoning benchmarks, OPEFO achieves both more stable entropy dynamics and better final performance compared to existing RLVR methods.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the entropy collapse analysis and entropy flow mechanism explanation in the introduction section, as well as the OPEFO rescaling strategy design in the method section. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 entropy-flow 分解和消融即可；若 token 级失衡曲线干净，应加入内部 GRPO 稳定性 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the entropy-flow decomposition and ablations; if the token-level imbalance curves are clean, add this to internal GRPO stability ablations.

paper.title: From Generic Correlation to Input-Specific Credit in On-Policy Self Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy self-distillation has emerged as a promising paradigm for post-training language models, in which the model conditions on environment feedback to serve as its own teacher, providing dense token-level rewards without external teacher models or step-level annotations. Despite its empirical success, what this reward actually measures and what kind of credit it assigns remain unclear. Under a posterior-compatibility interpretation of feedback conditioning, standard in the implicit-reward l

summary.core_problem: 同策略自蒸馏（OPSD）作为RL后训练的稠密奖励构造方法不需要外部教师和步级标注，但现有自蒸馏奖励的实际含义、信用分配机制不明确，存在输入通用相关性偏差，会奖励跨输入通用的反馈相关模式而非当前输入特有的推理贡献，导致优化偏移。
summary.importance: 从理论上厘清了自蒸馏奖励的数学含义，提出的偏差校正方法可提升自蒸馏的信用分配准确性，为RL后训练的稠密奖励构造提供了理论支撑和实用改进方案。
summary.technical_approach: 在贝叶斯后验兼容假设下证明自蒸馏token奖励是贝叶斯滤波增量，其轨迹和等于给定输入下响应与反馈的点互信息，点互信息同时包含输入特有推理贡献和输入通用快捷模式两部分。基于此提出Credit（对比蒸馏奖励）方法，通过批内对比抑制输入通用偏差分量，保留输入特有信用信号，额外计算开销极低。
summary.experiments: 在代码生成、数学推理等可验证奖励任务上，Credit相比标准同策略自蒸馏提升了整体性能，无额外标注需求，计算开销可忽略。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议看引言部分的自蒸馏奖励解释和偏差分析，以及方法部分的Credit对比校正设计，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD), a dense reward construction method for RL post-training, does not require external teachers or step-level annotations, but the actual meaning and credit assignment mechanism of existing self-distillation rewards are unclear. It has input-generic correlation bias, which rewards cross-input generic feedback-related patterns instead of reasoning contributions specific to the current input, leading to optimization deviation.
summary_en.importance: It theoretically clarifies the mathematical meaning of self-distillation rewards, and the proposed bias correction method improves the credit assignment accuracy of self-distillation, providing theoretical support and practical improvement scheme for dense reward construction in RL post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Under the Bayesian posterior compatibility assumption, it proves that the self-distillation token reward is a Bayesian filtering increment, whose trajectory sum equals the pointwise mutual information between response and feedback given the input. The pointwise mutual information includes both input-specific reasoning contribution and input-generic shortcut patterns. The Credit (Contrastive Reward from Distillation) method is proposed to suppress the input-generic bias component via in-batch contrast, preserving input-specific credit signals with negligible extra computation overhead.
summary_en.experiments: On verifiable reward tasks such as code generation and mathematical reasoning, Credit outperforms standard on-policy self-distillation on overall performance, with no additional annotation requirement and negligible computation overhead.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the self-distillation reward interpretation and bias analysis in the introduction section, as well as the Credit contrastive correction design in the method section. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看推导和 CREDIT 消融即可；它把“自蒸馏 reward 等于好推理”这个 prior 拆得比较干净。
recommendation.en: Read the derivation and CREDIT ablations; it cleanly challenges the prior that self-distillation rewards are faithful reasoning credit.

institutions: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: Evolutionary Task Discovery: Advancing Reasoning Frontiers via Skill Composition and Complexity Scaling
paper.abstract: The reasoning frontier of Large Language Models (LLMs) has advanced significantly through modern post-training paradigms (e.g., Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR)). However, the efficacy of these methods remains fundamentally constrained by the diversity and complexity of the training data. One practical solution is data synthesis; yet, prevalent methods relying on unstructured mutation or exploration suffer from homogeneity collapse, failing to systematically expand the reaso

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 RLVR 训练中的推理数据扩展问题：现有合成方法常用“改得更难”“增加约束”这类非结构化提示，容易生成近重复样本，或者只覆盖技能标签而没有系统控制题目复杂度。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对基座预训练的直接贡献不大，但对 post-train 数据引擎有参考价值。它把推理数据合成从文本扰动推进到结构化搜索：同时控制“需要什么算法技能”和“实例复杂度如何变化”。这个视角适合用于 RLVR、SFT 数据构造，也能反哺预训练阶段对算法题、数学题、程序合成数据的组织方式。贡献量级属于方法框架和数据生成范式改进，不是模型架构或预训练目标的改动。
summary.technical_approach: EvoTD 将 reasoning task 表示为两个相对独立的维度：Algorithmic Skills 和 Complexity Attributes。前者描述逻辑骨架，例如二分、堆、图算法；后者描述结构约束，例如输入规模、图大小、约束数量。方法包含两个演化算子：Attribute Mutation 用来放大或改变复杂度属性，Skill Crossover 用来组合不同技能，生成新的复合任务。系统采用 proposer-solver 流程：proposer 生成任务，solver 在这些任务上训练。为了避免样本太简单或完全不可学，作者引入基于当前 solver policy 的 Zone of Proximal Development 过滤，只保留处在当前模型可学习区间内的样本。随着 solver 变强，过滤器会接受更难的任务，从而形成动态课程。另一个过滤环节使用 LLM 的自评能力检查合成任务是否真的匹配目标技能，避免技能标签和题目内容脱节。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖代码生成和数学推理等五类 benchmark。作者报告 EvoTD 在多种 backbone 上都优于启发式合成方法，包括 Qwen3、LLaMA，不同预训练状态的 Base/Instruct 模型，以及 3B 到 8B 参数规模。以 Qwen3-4B reasoning model 为例，AIME 24 提升 8.2 个百分点，AIME 25 提升 7.2 个百分点。增益还能迁移到 MMLU-Pro、SuperGPQA 等通用推理评测，主要集中在 STEM 相关科目。文中给出的实验信息说明，收益不只来自生成更多样本，而是来自技能组合、复杂度扩展和动态可学习性过滤的配合。不过从摘要和正文片段看，仍需要重点检查合成成本、验证器误判、以及生成题目和真实 benchmark 分布之间的距离。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 15–20 分钟。优先看方法部分对 Algorithmic Skills / Complexity Attributes 的形式化定义，再看 Attribute Mutation、Skill Crossover 和 ZPD 过滤流程。实验部分重点看三类内容：与普通 prompt mutation 的对比、去掉两个演化算子的消融、不同模型规模和 Base/Instruct 设置下的稳定性。如果时间有限，只看任务空间建模和过滤器设计即可；这是对 RLVR 数据合成最有信息量的部分。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a data-scaling bottleneck in RLVR: current synthetic reasoning data pipelines often rely on unstructured prompt mutations, which tend to produce near-duplicates or broaden skill coverage without systematically increasing instance complexity.
summary_en.importance: The work is more relevant to post-training data engines than to core pretraining objectives, but it carries useful lessons for pretraining data construction as well. Its main contribution is a structured view of reasoning-data synthesis: control the algorithmic skill being exercised and the complexity attributes of the instance separately. This is a practical abstraction for RLVR curricula, SFT data generation, and possibly large-scale algorithmic data mixtures in pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: EvoTD models a reasoning task along two axes: Algorithmic Skills, which specify the logical backbone such as binary search, heaps, or graph algorithms; and Complexity Attributes, which specify structural constraints such as input size, graph size, or the number of conditions. The framework introduces two evolutionary operators. Attribute Mutation scales or changes complexity attributes. Skill Crossover composes skills to discover new compound tasks. A proposer generates candidate tasks, and a solver learns from tasks that pass filtering. The key filter is based on the solver’s current policy and keeps tasks in the model’s zone of proximal development: not already trivial, but not impossible either. As the solver improves, the accepted task distribution shifts toward harder instances. The pipeline also uses an LLM-based metacognitive check to verify that the generated task aligns with the intended skills.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover five benchmarks across code generation and mathematical reasoning. The reported results show consistent gains over heuristic synthesis methods across Qwen3 and LLaMA backbones, Base and Instruct variants, and model sizes from 3B to 8B. On Qwen3-4B reasoning model, EvoTD improves AIME 24 by 8.2 percentage points and AIME 25 by 7.2 percentage points. Gains also transfer to MMLU-Pro and SuperGPQA, with stronger effects on STEM-adjacent categories. The reported evidence suggests that the benefit comes from the combination of skill composition, complexity scaling, and learnability filtering rather than from simply adding more generated examples. The remaining questions are generation cost, verifier reliability, and distributional distance between synthesized tasks and target benchmarks.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 15–20 minute skim is enough. Focus on the formalization of Algorithmic Skills and Complexity Attributes, then read the definitions of Attribute Mutation, Skill Crossover, and the solver-dependent filtering rule. In the experiments, check comparisons against plain prompt mutation, ablations of the two evolutionary operators, and robustness across model scale and Base/Instruct settings. If time is limited, the task-space abstraction and filtering mechanism are the most useful parts.

recommendation.zh: 看任务空间定义和去重实验；若复杂度轴干净，可直接借到 internal RLVR 数据管线。
recommendation.en: Read the task-space definition and dedup tests; if the complexity axis is clean, it is usable for internal RLVR data pipelines.

paper.title: fg-expo: Frontier-guided exploration-prioritized policy optimization via adaptive kl and gaussian curriculum
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become the standard paradigm for LLM mathematical reasoning, with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) serving as the dominant algorithm. We identify two overlooked inefficiencies inherent in GRPO. First, a fixed KL coefficient overly restricts policy exploration at moments when the model needs to diverge significantly from the reference policy. Second, uniform question sampling overlooks that moderately difficult problems produce th

summary.core_problem: 当前主流的RLVR算法GRPO存在两个效率缺陷：固定KL系数在模型需要探索时过度约束策略偏离参考策略，均匀问题采样浪费算力在过易或过难的无梯度信号样本上，导致探索预算分配不合理。
summary.importance: 提出的两个轻量化组件适配RL预训练/后训练的效率优化方向，无额外超参的自适应KL和课程采样方案可以直接集成到现有GRPO训练流程中，提升RL训练效率和推理性能，对数学推理类RL训练有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出FG-ExPO算法，包含两个轻量化组件：1）精度条件KL缩放（AKL）：将KL惩罚系数设为批次平均精度的平滑非线性函数，模型表现差时放松惩罚鼓励探索，表现好时收紧惩罚保证稳定性；2）高斯课程采样（GCS）：以问题的模型通过率p=0.5为中心的高斯密度重加权采样，优先采样中等难度的frontier问题，平滑降低过易和过难问题的权重。
summary.experiments: 在1.5B和8B两个尺度的基础模型、DAPO-17K数据集、6个数学推理基准上测试，FG-ExPO全面优于GRPO：8B模型在AIME2025 pass@32提升13.34个点，6个基准平均pass@32提升2.66个点；1.5B模型平均pass@32提升2.16个点，AIME2024 pass@32提升10个点。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看方法章节的AKL和GCS设计细节、实验部分的消融和结果对比，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The dominant RLVR algorithm GRPO has two efficiency flaws: fixed KL coefficient over-constrains policy deviation from reference policy when exploration is needed, and uniform question sampling wastes compute on too-easy or too-hard samples with no informative gradient signals, leading to suboptimal exploration budget allocation.
summary_en.importance: The two lightweight components fit the efficiency optimization direction of RL pretraining/post-training. The parameter-free adaptive KL and curriculum sampling scheme can be directly integrated into existing GRPO training pipelines to improve RL training efficiency and inference performance, providing direct reference for mathematical reasoning RL training.
summary_en.technical_approach: FG-ExPO algorithm is proposed with two lightweight components: 1) Accuracy-Conditioned KL Scaling (AKL): KL penalty coefficient is set as a smooth non-linear function of batch mean accuracy, relaxing penalty to encourage exploration when model performance is poor, tightening penalty to ensure stability when performance is good; 2) Gaussian Curriculum Sampling (GCS): Re-weight sampling with Gaussian density centered at problem pass rate p=0.5, prioritizing medium-difficulty frontier problems, and smoothly down-weighting too-easy and too-hard problems.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on two base model scales (1.5B and 8B), DAPO-17K dataset, and 6 mathematical reasoning benchmarks, FG-ExPO outperforms GRPO consistently: 8B model achieves 13.34 absolute improvement on AIME 2025 pass@32, 2.66 average pass@32 improvement across 6 benchmarks; 1.5B model achieves 2.16 average pass@32 improvement, 10 absolute improvement on AIME 2024 pass@32.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on AKL and GCS design details in the methodology section, ablation studies and result comparison in experiments. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看 KL schedule 和难度采样 ablation；想法合理但偏工程调参，别把它当 GRPO 新范式。
recommendation.en: Read the KL schedule and difficulty-sampling ablations; the idea is sensible engineering, not a new GRPO paradigm.

paper.title: Rethinking Importance Sampling in LLM Policy Optimization: A Cumulative Token Perspective
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning, including reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), has emerged as a powerful approach for LLM post-training. Central to these approaches is the design of the importance sampling (IS) ratio used in off-policy policy-gradient estimation. Existing methods face a fundamental bias-variance dilemma: token-level IS ratios, as adopted by PPO (Schulman et al., 2017) and GRPO (Shao et al., 2024), introduce bias by ignoring prefix state distribution mismatch; full sequ

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM离策略（off-policy）策略优化中的重要性采样（IS）存在根本性的偏方差权衡困境：GRPO采用的token级IS忽略前缀状态分布不匹配，引入系统偏差；全序列IS可提供精确的轨迹级修正，但token概率的连乘导致方差极高；GSPO通过长度归一化的序列级IS提升数值稳定性，但偏离了严格的IS修正定义，同样存在偏差。该缺陷是当前GRPO系后训练算法（含可验证奖励强化学习RLVR）的核心底层问题，直接影响梯度估计质量和训练效果。
summary.importance: 该工作从理论层面定位了现有主流RL后训练算法在IS设计上的根本缺陷，提出的累积token IS比率在理论上无偏，且方差严格低于全序列IS，解决了长期存在的偏方差权衡问题。提出的位置自适应截断方法解决了累积IS实际落地中的正则不一致问题。最终得到的CTPO算法可直接替换工业界广泛使用的GRPO，对推理类任务的RL后训练效果有可落地的提升。该工作属于后训练优化算法的底层范式改进，直接关联预训练-后训练闭环的核心优化。
summary.technical_approach: 该工作首先在token级策略梯度框架下，推导了累积token IS比率（第t个位置及之前所有token级IS的乘积）的两个核心性质：一是该比率对每个token的梯度项提供无偏的前缀分布修正，因为它完整覆盖了当前前缀在行为策略和目标策略下的似然差；二是其方差严格低于全序列IS，因为t位置之后的后缀token在行为策略下的期望为1，只会引入不必要的方差，无法降低偏差。针对累积IS的对数方差随token位置线性增长（Var(logρ_t^cum) = tσ²），固定截断阈值会导致早期token几乎不被截断、后期token被过度截断的正则不一致问题，该工作提出位置自适应截断策略：截断阈值随√t线性缩放，匹配累积对数IS的标准差增长规律，实现不同位置token的正则强度一致。基于以上两点，该工作提出CTPO（累积token策略优化）算法。
summary.experiments: 实验在工具集成推理（TIR）设置下开展，即模型迭代生成并执行沙箱环境中的Python代码解决复杂数学题。对比GRPO、GSPO等强基线，CTPO在多个模型尺度下均取得最高的平均性能。消融实验验证了位置自适应截断对最终性能的显著贡献。
summary.reading_guide: 重点精读累积token IS比率无偏性和方差性质的理论推导部分，这是核心创新的理论基础。其次关注位置自适应截断的动机和推导逻辑。实验部分优先查看不同IS策略的偏方差对比可视化，以及自适应截断的消融实验图表。附录中的完整理论证明可进一步深挖，训练过程中不同位置token的截断频率统计，也能直观体现固定截断的缺陷。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing importance sampling (IS) designs for off-policy LLM policy optimization suffer from a fundamental bias-variance tradeoff: token-level IS used in GRPO ignores prefix state distribution mismatch and introduces systematic bias; full-sequence IS provides exact trajectory-level correction but suffers from extremely high variance due to multiplicative accumulation of per-token probabilities; GSPO's length-normalized sequence-level IS improves numerical stability but deviates from strict IS correction definitions and remains biased. This is a core underlying flaw of mainstream GRPO-family post-training algorithms, including reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), that directly degrades gradient estimation quality and training performance.
summary_en.importance: This work identifies the fundamental theoretical flaw in IS design of state-of-the-art RL post-training algorithms, and proposes a cumulative token IS ratio that is theoretically unbiased and has strictly lower variance than full-sequence IS, resolving the long-standing bias-variance dilemma. The proposed position-adaptive clipping strategy solves the regularization inconsistency issue in practical cumulative IS deployment. The resulting CTPO algorithm can directly replace the widely used GRPO in industrial settings, delivering measurable improvements to RL post-training for reasoning tasks. It represents a low-level paradigm improvement for post-training optimization, directly relevant to the pretrain-posttrain closed loop.
summary_en.technical_approach: Under the token-level policy gradient framework, this work derives two core properties of the cumulative token IS ratio, defined as the product of all per-token IS ratios up to position t. First, this ratio provides unbiased prefix distribution correction for gradient terms at each token position, as it fully accounts for the likelihood difference of the current prefix under the behavior and target policies. Second, its variance is strictly lower than full-sequence IS, since suffix tokens beyond position t have unit expectation under the behavior policy and only introduce unnecessary variance without reducing bias. To address the issue that the log variance of cumulative IS grows linearly with token position (Var(logρ_t^cum) = tσ²), which causes inconsistent regularization where early tokens are rarely clipped and late tokens are over-clipped under a fixed clipping threshold, this work proposes a position-adaptive clipping strategy that scales clipping thresholds proportionally to √t, matching the standard deviation growth of cumulative log IS and achieving consistent regularization intensity across all token positions. These two insights form the CTPO (Cumulative Token Policy Optimization) algorithm.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted in the tool-integrated reasoning (TIR) setting, where models iteratively generate and execute Python code in a sandboxed environment to solve challenging mathematical problems. Compared to strong baselines including GRPO and GSPO, CTPO achieves the highest average performance across multiple model scales. Ablation studies confirm that position-adaptive clipping makes a statistically significant contribution to final performance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the theoretical derivations of the unbiasedness and variance properties of the cumulative token IS ratio, which forms the core theoretical foundation of the work. Then review the motivation and derivation logic of position-adaptive clipping. For experiments, prioritize visualizations comparing bias and variance across different IS strategies, as well as ablation results for adaptive clipping. Full theoretical proofs in the appendix are worth deep diving, and statistics of clipping frequency across token positions during training provide intuitive understanding of the limitation of fixed clipping.

recommendation.zh: 从理论上修正了PPO/GRPO等主流RL算法的梯度估计偏差问题，是后训练算法迭代的核心参考，应立刻复现并做内部ablation
recommendation.en: Theoretically corrects the gradient estimation bias in mainstream RL algorithms like PPO/GRPO, a core reference for post-training algorithm iteration; immediately replicate and run internal ablation.

paper.title: Beyond Reasoning: Reinforcement Learning Unlocks Parametric Knowledge in LLMs
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved remarkable success in LLM reasoning, but whether it can also improve direct recall of parametric knowledge remains an open question. We study this question in a controlled zero-shot, one-hop, closed-book QA setting with no chain-of-thought, training only on binary correctness rewards and applying fact-level train-test deduplication to ensure gains reflect improved recall rather than reasoning or memorization. Across three model families and multiple factu

summary.core_problem: 检验 RL 是否只能提升推理，还是也能在无 CoT、闭卷、一跳事实问答中提升 LLM 的参数知识召回。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是受控实证和机制分析。它把 RL 的作用从 reasoning-time search 扩展到 parametric knowledge recall，并用 fact-level train-test deduplication 和无 CoT 设置排除记忆泄漏与显式推理因素，对理解 RL 与预训练知识的接口很关键。
summary.technical_approach: 在 zero-shot、one-hop、closed-book QA 中训练模型，只使用二元正确性奖励，不引入 chain-of-thought。通过事实级去重保证测试事实未在训练中重复，并用采样分布和数据归因分析区分“学到新事实”与“重排已有知识概率质量”。
summary.experiments: 覆盖三个模型家族和多个事实 QA benchmark。RL 带来约 27% 平均相对提升，并超过训练时和推理时 baseline。机制上，RL 主要把正确答案从低概率尾部推到 greedy generation 可稳定输出的位置，而不是真正获取新事实。数据归因显示最难样本最有训练价值：pre-RL 采样 128 次也从未出现正确答案的样本只占约 18%，却驱动了主要收益。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中国科学院计算技术研究所、人工智能安全全国重点实验室和中国科学院大学；摘要中未能确认更具体的知名作者背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether RL can improve parametric knowledge recall, not only reasoning, in no-CoT closed-book one-hop QA.
summary_en.importance: This is a controlled empirical and mechanistic study. It extends the role of RL from reasoning-time behavior to recall of stored knowledge, using fact-level train-test deduplication and a no-chain-of-thought setup to reduce leakage and reasoning confounds.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup trains with binary correctness rewards in zero-shot, one-hop, closed-book QA and removes chain-of-thought. The analysis uses fact-level deduplication, sampling-distribution inspection, and data attribution to separate new fact acquisition from probability-mass redistribution over existing knowledge.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers three model families and multiple factual QA benchmarks. RL gives roughly 27% average relative gains and beats both training-time and inference-time baselines. Mechanistically, RL mostly moves correct answers from the low-probability tail into reliable greedy generations rather than acquiring new facts. The hardest examples are most informative: examples whose answers never appear in 128 pre-RL samples make up about 18% of training data but drive the main gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, the State Key Laboratory of AI Safety, and the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; no widely known author background can be confirmed from the provided information.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改 prior：RL 不只是推理搜索，还能重排预训练知识概率；应复现 hard-example attribution。
recommendation.en: This changes a prior: RL can reorder pretrained knowledge probabilities, not just improve reasoning; reproduce the hard-example attribution.

State Key Laboratory of AI Safety
University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
